tei:div.tei:p: gaskyo yosnar+shasgornagrar+shamathe sgrushāsna rnamatho spu'i smospo/ma sgom lo: zab gsang rdo rje snying po las:dbang chen bde klong rol ba'i bskyed rdzogs kyi sngon 'gro khog phub pad+ma'i 'phreng ba bzhugs so:

gtsasdo: na mo gu ru pad+ma kā ra ye: 4443) pad+ma bde klong rol ba'i kyil 'khor ni: spros pa'i mtha' dang bral la phyag 'tshal lo: dbang chen sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor skal ba can: bskyed rdzogs cha lag 'di nyid gces par zungs sa ma yā: dang po rol mo byin rlabs ni o ma hā badz+ra dzñā na sa ma ya hūṃ me trīḥ snang ba 'gags thabs kyi rdo rje dang: tshangs dbyangs 'gag med shes rab dril bu'i sgra thabs shes zung 'jug rol mos don kun grub: bde mchog yab yum thod rnga ṭā ma rtsa chos sgras stong khyab ye shes rnga bo che: bcu drug bde ba'i rol ston glu ma zung: ro mnyam 'khyug ma sdong po brgya pa'i sgra: pho nya 'bod pa'i mchog chen rkang gling dang kha grags tshogs bskul rgyang khyab skad po che: ma tshogs bskul ba'i g.yer 'phreng ting ting shag: gsang ba'i bshug glu nye ba'i phag sdob pa: thams cad kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin te: lha tshogs chos sku'i dbyings las gzugs skur bskul: grags stong rdo rje'i chos sgras khams gsum khyab 'khrul ba ru bzlog ye shes dbyings su bsre gsang chen sngags kyi spyod pa bla na med:

—8rdo: slo badz+ra shasta spra ra ṇa sa ma ya āX /: rol mo'i brdul spugs nyes skyon sbyangs: chos nyid gsung gi dbang chen bskul sa ma yā: gnyis pa tshogs bsags yan lag ni: ma āḥ/ bde stong spros dang bral ba'i pho brang nas dbang chen pad+ma gsung gi dkyil 'khor ni: zla gam e klong rdzogs pa'i sprin rab 'byams: sgrub mchog mosangor spyan 'dren shegs su gsol: oṃ āX hūṃ chags med pad+ma 'dab stong bzhad pa'i khar: thabs shes zu 'jug nyi zla kha spyor steng rnam rtog bdud bzhi sde brgyad bsnol ba'ikhrir: bde chen gsung gi dkyil 'khor bzhugs su gsol: 37 ādza /: dad mos dam chig dag pas rab bskul te: mkha' khyab lus dpag bsam yas rab sprul nas: yanalag lnga ldan phyag gis gar bsgyur te chos nyid lta ba mjal bas phyag bgyi'o: oṃ āhūṃ: gzung 'dzin mtshan ma'i skyon gyis ma gos pa'i: rang bzhin 'od gsal thig le bde ba'i sprin kun tu bzang po'i rol ston mtha' yas pas: dbang chen gsung gi dkyal 'khor rgya mtsho mchod rdza ā ṭ+wāṃ mi dge bcu dang mtshams med las lnga dang: 'dul

khrims nyams dang byang sems bslab bya ral gsang chen sngags kyi dam tshig nyams pa kun: mi 'chab mi sbed dbang chen dgongs klong bshags: tse( yisahūṃ so skyes rnams kyisazag bcas dge bsags dang nyan thos rnams kyis zhi ba phyogs gcig sgrub: byang chub sems dpas gzhan don khur du len: rig 'dzin sngags spyod kun la yi rang ngo: 37 usno byang sems rig 'dzin rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis zab zhi sprob bral chos kyi 'khor lo kun: gdul bya gang la gang 'dul dang mthun par: rgyun chad mi mnga' rtag par bskor du gsol: olo6hūṃ: mi mjed 'jig rten bye ba phrag brgya phu mdo dang sngags kyi bstan pa rin po che: yongs su skyongs ba'i 'gro 'dren ded dpon kun mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs: 61 gisahūṃ zag dang zag med kun rdzob don dam chos bsags dang bsags 'gyur bsags pa'i dge ba kun: 'khor gsum yongs dag chen por bsngo bar bya phyam gcig pad+ma he ru'i dpal thob shog de nas tshogs zhing rang la bstu gsum pa dkar gtor 'bul ba ni rang nyid 'jig rten dbang byug gi:

ga6/sdo bskyed rim ting 'dzin gnad ldan pas: gtor ma sbyangs spel bsgyur ba ni: sa su bha was sbyangs t+t+waṃ las rin chen yangs pa'i sgod nang du: gtor ma dkaragasum mngar gsum bdud rtsir gyur: a ka ro yis zad med spel: dzaḥhū phyag rgyas mgron rnams bkugs kyi: stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten dbang bsgyur ba'i rgyalaba'i spyan sngar khas blangs dam tshig can: dkar phyogs skyong mdzad pho mo ma ning rigs: ma lus 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol: gtsang sbyar gtor ma gser skyemasamachod pa bzhes: rnal 'byor sgrub pa po yi 'phrin las sgrubs dbang chen sa yi lha mo bstan ma dang sa bdag lto 'bye tsang kun mched bzhi dang: lo zla zhag dus rgyal blona'abangs 'khor tshul: dam tshig can rnams gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: gtsang sbyar gtor ma gser skyems mchod pa bzhes: rin chen sa 'di bdag la stsal du gsol khyad par yul gzhi skyong ba'i dam tshig can: mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon rdza brag na ba lam: gang la brten bcas gnyug gnas glo bur lhag ma lus 'khor bcas sngon gyi dam

tshig bzhin:sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol:gtsang sbyar gtor ma gser skyems mchod pa bzhes:sgrub pa'i rkyen bzlog mthun snang legs tshogs sbyor bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā bhu mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra e de bha ling ta kha kha khahi khahi:lan bdun gyis phul gtor skyems mchod 'brin las sgrub ces khas blangs bsam bzhi pa dmar gtor 'bul ba ni:pā bha was sbyangs: snye las rin chen yangs pa'i snod nang du tshe las gtor ma 'dod yon phung por gyur:nam mkha' mdzod sngags gsum gyis spel:dza:/ phyag rgyas pho nya bkugs:hū hrīḥsngon tshe 31 rgyan pad+ma thod 'phreng gis:bka' dam la bzhag dregs pa'i tshul 'dzin pa:sde brgyad gza' the'u rang rang g.yog 'khor bcas dam tshig gnas 'dir 'bod do da tshur byon:sha khrag dmar gyi mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:'dre srin gdug pa'i mgo 'phang dma' bar mdzod sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen nyer 'tshe tha dag bzlog:mthun snang legs tshogs dpal 'byor dngos po stsol:bcol ba'i phrin las ma g.yel sa ma yu:zhes brjod gtor skyems gtsang sar

—8rdo: gshegs:'phrin las sgrub ces khas blangs bsam:lnga pa bgegs gtor bsngo ba ni:su bha wa yis stong par sbyangs:1 la ren chen snod dutson be+eg las:glud kyi gtor ma zag med bdud rtsir gyur:yi āhūṃ:su bha ra yis zad med spel:a ka ro yis bdud rtsir bsgyur:gzhung bzhin bka' brgo btang ba' rjes:'dod yon gtor ma bsngo ba ni:glud gtor 'dod yon lnga ldan 'di:gsang sngags sgrub la 'tshe ba'i bdud:dug gsum rang mdangs 'byung po ni:sha khrag za zhing mtshanamor rgyu:sgrub pa'i drod la 'gab 'dre byed:rnal 'byor tshe srog mdangs la za:snyan 'gyur rol mo'i sgra la 'jab:bdud rtsi sman gyi bcud la rol dpal gyi gtor chen rtsi la 'jib rak+ta a mdangs la blta:zhun chen snang gsal 'od nyams byed:dri zhim bdug pa'i ngad pa 'phrog:chag sgo nyer 'tshe slong byed pa'i:bgegs rigs stong phragabargyad cu dang:byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga po:nad rims yams kyi bdag mo sogs:bar du gcod pa'i 'byung po rnamasaḥlan chags glud gtor 'di khyer la rang rang

so so'i gnas su dengs: gal te mi 'gro 'tshe gyur na: ye shes khro bos nam mkha' gang: dam tshig khro bos sa gzhi gang: 'bar ba'i khro bos bar snang khyab dbang chen rta yi brtul zhugs kyis khyed rnams lus srog dngos po 'thar: de bas da ltar phyir dengs shig: hūṃ hūṃsnga tsa ta ya phaṭa: hū bzhi'i sngags brjod thun gyi brab: lta stangs bsgrad cing brtul zhugs bskyed: sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen brlag par byed drug pa khro bo'i srung 'khor ni: nyu hrīX ngang nyid bde chen rdo rje khro bo'i rgyal: rā ga'i mdangs 'bar bcu drug rol rtsed bsgyur: gtum drag dus mtha'i me ltar rngam gshe 'bar: zil gnon khro chen rgyal bos bgegs bzlog cig pa hūṃ steng gi phyogs nas mtshams gcod khro bo'i rgyal: nyu chen ka ra zhal gsum phyag drug pa: lha yi gdon tshogs zhabs bzhi'i stabs kyis gnon: steng gi phyogs nas 'tshe ba'i gdon bzlog cig: 〈sna badz+ra kro ta hūṃ ka ra hūṃ: steng phyogs kyi lha gdon 'byung po thams cad gardza gardza4 phaṭa (:shar gyi phyogs nas mtshams gcod khro bo'i rgyal rnam par rgyal ba zhal gsum phyag drug pa: zhabs bzhi'i stabs kyis

bam/: dri za pho mo gnon: shar gyi phyogs kyi bar chad gdon bzlog cig: o badz+ra kro ta bhi dza ya hūṃ: shar phyogs kyi dri za pho mo ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa: hū: lto yi phyogs nas mtshams gcod khro bo'i rgyal gshin rje gshed po zhal gsum phyag drag pa: zhabs bzhi'i stabs kyis 'chi bdag pho mo gnon: lho yi phyogs kyi bar chad rkyen bzlog cig o badz+ra kro ta ya man+ta ka hūṃ: po phyogs kyi gshin rje pho mo pa ca pa tsa hūṃ droṭa: hū: nub kyi phyogs nas mtshams gcod khro bo'i rgyal: dbang chen he ru zhal gsum phyag drug pa:zhabs bzhi'i stabs kyis chu lha pho mo gnon: nub kyi phyogs kyi bar chad sru bzlog mdzod rlo badz+ra kro ta h+ya shrī wa hūṃ: nub phyogs kyi chu lha pho mo hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: hūṃ: byang gi phyogs nas mchams gcod khro bo'i rgyal bdud rtsi 'khyil ba zhal gsum phyag drug pa zhabs bzhi'i stabs kyis gnod sbyin pho mo gnon byang gi phyogs kyi dam sri 'byung po bzlog: oṃ badz+ra kro ta a dṛ ta kun li :: byang phyogs kyi gnod sbyin pho mo tshin+ta tshin+ta hūṃ phaṭa: hūṃ: shar lho'i phyogs nas mtshams gcod khro bo'i rgyal: dbyug pa sngon po zhal

gsum phyag drug pa: zhabs bzhi'i stabs kyis me lha pho mo gnon: shar lho'i phyogs nas 'tshe ba'i dam sri bzlog: sa badz+ra kro ta ni lam̐ tan+t+ra (: shar po'i phyogs kyi me lha pho mo da ha da ha hūm̐ phaṭa: sa: lto nub phyogs nas mtshams gcod khro bo'i rgyal: mi g.yo mgon po zhal gsum phyag drug pa zhabs bzhi'i stabs kyis laṅka pho mo gnon: lho nub mtshams kyi dam sri tshar chod cig: sa badz+ra kro ta ār+ya a tsa la 〉: lho nub mtshams kyi srin po pho mo bhan+ta bhan+ta hūṃ phaṭa: shā:nub byang mtshams nas mtshams gcod khro bo' rgyal 'dod pa'i rgyal po zhal gsum phyag drug pa zhabs bzhi'i stabs kyis rlung lha pho mo gnon: nub byang mtshams kyi dgra bgegs tshar chod cig: tsan badz+ra kro ta a pa ra tsit+ta rtse: nub byangamatshams kyi rlung lha pho mo tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ phaṭa: ྅: byang shar mtshams nas mtshams gcod khro bo'i rgyal: khams gsum rnam rgyal zhal gsum phyag drug pa: zhabs bzhi'i stabs kyis bgegs tshogs pho mo gnon: byang shar mtshams kyi dam sri 'byung po bzlog: badz+ra kro ta tre+e lo kya bi dza ya (: byang shar mtshams kyi bgegs tshogs pho mo snyin+ta bhin+ta hūṃ phaṭa:

—8/sde sa /: 'og gi phyogs nas mtshams gcod khro bo'i rgyal: 'jigs byed stobs chen zhal gsum phyag drug pa zhabs bzhi'i stabs kyis sa bdag klu gnyan gnon: 'og gi phyogs kyi dam sri 'byung po bzlog: slo badz+ra kro ta mahā ba la shā: 'og gi phyogs kyi sa bdag klu gnyan pho mo sgro ṭa sbo ṭa hūṃ phaṭa: hūṃ: khro rgyal stobs 'dus gar dgu'i nyams rdzogs pa'i: phyag mtshan phur pas gdon tshogs 'bigs par byed: thog zer me yis 'byung po 'bog brgyal byed: steng 'og phyogs mtshams las byed pho nyas gtams hū hūṃ ha ha e ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ phaṭa: srung dmigs 'gyur med rwa gur dkrigs: ye shes lnga yi sgrom du btsud: sa ma yu: bdun pa brda sgo dbye phyag ni: / nyi ye nas rnam dag thig le nyag gcig klong: pad+ma dbang gi dkyil 'khor rang byung rdzogs: ma rig dbang gi sgrib pa da dbye'o: rang rig bde ba'i klong chen mjal phyag 'tshal: e badz+ra man ṭa la pra we sha ya phaṭa: dṛ dzā na na mo na ma ho: brgyad pa bshags pa ni ho: dbang chen pad+ma gsung gi dkyil 'khor dgongs: bdag rmongs gnyis 'dzin 'khyal bas dam

bcing ste rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor rang la ye rdzogs kyang: rtog pa'i dbang gis yid ches gting ma 'byams bde ba'i rnam pa bcom ldan dbang gi dal: stong pa'i rang bzhin gar dbang phag mo yum ye shesarol rtsal dkyil 'khor lha tshogs shar: kun rtog dbang gis du ma so sor bzung: gnyis med dgongs pas ma lus bshags bgyi'o: sgribabral tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub stsol: sgo badz+ra sa ma ya āḥ dbang chen gsung gi yig rgyas bzod gsol phul: dgu pa tshogs la rol ba ni: ho bdobar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes zhal rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol gnyis med mnyam pas tshogs ston bzhes: a la la sa theg pa mchog gi dam rdzas 'di: rin thang med la legs 'ong chos: gzung 'dzin mtshan mas ma gos par: de bzhin nyid spyod bdag phyag 'tshal: sidhopha la oṃtsasahūṃ 'dinirnal 'byor mchog gi rdzas: rigs lnga yab yum dkyil 'khor te: reg myong ngan song skye sgo kheg: rig 'dzin sa la spror bar byed: a la la ho gtsang sme'i rtog pa dang bral bar: gnyis med mnyam

bas: pa nyid du spyod:sa ma ma:bcu pa rdo rje'i sa bzung ba:a ās mchog 'od gsal rdo rje'i rtse mo rtsabade ba'i mthar son dwangs ma'i thig le rtsaye shes gsang ba srog lnga'i dkyil 'khor klong:mtha' bral rta phag dgongs pa rtag par skyongs:zhes snod bcud lha snang bde ba'i dkyil 'khor la:de yang thugs srog nā da mtha' bral ngang:dpa' bo yab yum sku gsung thugs kyi mthil:'od gsal spros dang bral bar ci gnas bzhag:dang po rtsal sbyangs bar du ngang la gnas:tha ma nyag gcig dgongs par btsan sa zin:sa ma yā:e ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i:ma 'ongs 'gro la shin tu brtse sems kyis shin tu nye lam rdo rje snying po'i chos:grub pa'i dbang phyug khye'u chung lo tsā dab :dbang chen bka' bab rgyal ba mchog dbyangs la:pha nor dpal kha 'gyur med bka' yis gtad:da dung spel ba'i dus la ma bab pas rin chen brda la bstems shig sa ra dz+re:mdo khams bkra shis rdzong der dgongs pra sdoms:ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus:dpa' bo khyed zung sprul ba las ldan dang:'phrad nas

bshad sgrub bstan pa'i sgron me sbar 'gro don 'phrin las sma smra phyogs su rgyas 'brel tshad don ldan pad+ma 'od du 'god bka' gsang srungs shig gnod sbyin btsan sgod rgyal bka' log lag tu ma sgo ra thub par srungs:las can skal ba bzang po'i dpal du sgo ga sa ma yā:rgya rgya rgya:khog phub pad+ma'i 'phreng ba rdzogs so:gter rgya:gtad rgya sbasargya:zab rgya gsang rgya:gu rgya:o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka':bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o:brda thim:3/:ces pa 'di'ang lung zin dam papad+ma dgyes pa'i rdo rjes bkra shis dge ba'i skyes bzang po du ma dang bcas te bkas bskul ngor/kho bo dbang chen dgyes pa'i rdo rjes mkha' 'gro'i gsang ba'i 'phrul brda dag paraphab pa'i yi ge pa ni lung zin nyid kyis bgyis pa'o/sarba maṅga le/
྾7masmanimasgru zla ka྾ga྾70zu྾rnyalo: zab gsang rdo rje snyeng po las:dbang chen bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal gyi sgrub ba'i lhan thabs dngos grub char 'bebs bzhugs so:

—8rdo: na mo gu ru pad+ma kā ra ye: zab sgyu// bdestong sprosabral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas lhan skyes bla ma pad+ma he ru ka bdud dpung zal gnon ye shes gsang ba'i sku rtag par bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyan du rol lasacan skal bzang rnal 'byor pho mo yis bsnyen bsgrub lhur len bskyed rdzogasagazhung bgrangs tshe med du mi rung yan lag lta bu'i chos sgrub pa'i lhan thabs dngo grub char 'bebs bstan sa ma yu dang po rdor dril byin gyis brlabs pa ni nye sarba dharmā ga ga na a nya: mtshan ma rdzas kyi rdo rje stong par gyur: stong pa'i ngang las bde gshegs thugs kyi dal: yar gyi rwa lnga kun bzang yab lngadang: mar lnga yum lnga lte ba phyed po zung: yas sad mas sad sems dpa' sems ma'i dal gzung 'dzin mtshan rtog chos kyi dbyings su gcod bde gshegs thugs kyi rdo rjemangon du byed: slo ma hā badz+ra (: dngos 'jin dril bu'i rtog pa dbyings su sbyangs: chos dbyings dril bu byang chub sems kyi dal: rig kyi zhal ni rnam par snang mdzad dal rigs lnga'i srog zhu snyan cha thabs shes brgyan: nges pa lnga ldan rtse lnga mdzes pa'i mtshon ye shes sa brgyad mtshon pa'i pad 'dab brgyad: chos dbyings gsung snyan mdzes pa'i drwa

de'adi: phyed brgyan: badz+ra 'phreng ba kun rtog gcod pa'i rtags: ma rig 'khrul ba ru bzlog chos skur bzhengs dzñā na tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ: gnyis pa ṭā ru byin r+ṣas ni e k+ṣa thod rnga mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang nyid las: thabs shes kun bzang yab yum bzhugs pa'i dal: bcu drug rtags rdzogs khro hūṃ rang sgra sgrogs: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro nyi rdul 'jigs bzhin bskul: thugs mchog ye shes snying po mngon du byed: e āḥk+ṣa badz+ra sa man+ta bhā tra oṃ dzñā na tsit+ta shrī me sa ma ya 〉: gsum pa rnga chen byin rlabs ni skyid badz+ra kro ta shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa:rnga chen mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang nyid las che mchog yab yum zhu bde'i rol rtsed bsgyur: bde gshegs dbyings bskul 'khor ba dong sprugs byed: nyon mongs las kyi rgyun gcod 'khrul ba sbyongs: don dam gsang gsum 'gyur med mngon du byed: o badz+ra kro ta ma hā shrī he ru ka hūṃ phaṭa: sa ma yā: dzñā na tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: bzhi pa rol mo byin rlabs ni hā nya rol mo sil snan stong pa nyid du gyur: bde gshegs don tshob yab yum gnyis med dal: chos dbyings byang sems sngags kyi rang sma sgogs: 'khor ba dong sprags mdzad pa bsam

yas 'gyed: sangs rgyas byang sems 'gro ba'i don la bskul: mtshan ma'i chos rnams mtshan ma med par bzhengs ma rig ru bzlog 'khor ba dong sprugs byed hā pradzñā dhig rtabadz+ra ra ti s+t+waṃ: dharmā gar+bha shabha /: lnga pa bsang chu byin rlabs ni hrīḥ bsang chu mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang nyid las khro bo rdo rje bgegs tshogs 'thar byed dang: khro mo rlung 'byin shes rab gsang ba'i yul: rigs kyi zhal gsang bde ba chen por sbyor: rdo rje rdul gyi spro bsdu 'khrigs pa las: 'byung po dam sri mthar zhing brlag byed cing: ye shes bdud rtsi'i rol bar bsgyur byed kyi: nus mthu gzi byin phun sum tshogs par gyur: / bisnan ta kṛt+ta tshin+ta tshin+ta hūṃ phaṭa: nyer gcig badro da la gzi byin nus mthu bskyed lha nyad 'od zhu bdud rtsa' rol b.radamigs drug pa mchod rdzas byin rlabs ni hūṃ snyisnan ta kṛt+ta tshin+ta tshisto hūṃ phaṭa: 37 su bha wa sogs mchod rdzas mi dmigs stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las phyi mchod nyer spyod bdun nyon mongs rang grol nang mchod 'dod yon lnga dug gsum rang grol sman raka gtor gsum dang rdo rje rig ma mdzes pa'i rnam 'khyar ngom sbor sgol byang sems

—8/sde: mchod pa bsam mtha' yas: dngos 'dzin mtshan rtog spros pa rnam dag cing kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa phun tshogs gyur: 67badz+ra spa ra ṇa sa bdun pa sposabyung ni hū ni tsan+dan a shar sing ha la sogs pa'i: bzang po'i dri ldan bdug pa spos kyi dri: ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje'i byin rlabs pa'i: tshul khrims bzang po'i dri bsunga'athul ba yis: gnyis 'dzin rnam rtog dri ma bsang sbyangs byed: se sa le sang nge ye swā hā: brgyad pa skyabs yul bskyed pa ni 67 mahā shu bye ta dzñā na badz+ra swā wa ad+ma ko3nya: mi dmigs ka dag chos sku'i rol pa las: rang mdun nam mkhar seng khri pad zla'i steng bde gshegs kun 'dusagu ru pad+ma 'byung: snang srid zil gnon ye shes sgyu ma'i sku: lta stangs gzirabs sde brgyad zil gyis gnon: rgya bod lo paṇa rig 'dzin spro bsdu 'gyed: g.yas su rgyal ba shākya seng ge la: bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong gis bskor: rgyab tu yum chen shes rab phar phyin la: lung dang rtogs pa'i dam chos rnams kyis bskor: g.yon du 'phags pa byams pa mgon po la: sa gnas byang sems rig 'dzin tshogs kyis bskor

mdun du yi dam dbang chen yab yum la: yi dam rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i 'khor gyis bskor: bar mtshams dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can rnams: nyi rdul 'khrigs bzhin ma 'dresalam mer rdzogs kun gyi gnas gsum rdo rje'i sa bon las: 'od 'phros phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas: phyag rgya yig 'bru phyag mtshan rnam pa sa spyan drangs dbyer medabade ba chen por bsre: mkhyen brtse nus pas skal ldan sgrub pa por zhal gyis phyogs la spyan gyis rab gzigs te rtag par byin gyis brlabs par rab mos te: skyabs 'grosems bskyed tshogs bsags maṇ+ḍal phul 'byu bzhis skyab yul 'od zhu rang la bstim dgu pa mtshams lha bskyed pa ni bdag nyid skad cig gas ga ga ma'i lha mchog dbang chen he ru ga: dmar gsalapad+ma rā ga'i gzi 'od 'bar ba: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril khro gtum gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa: g.yas rdo rje'i dbyug pa nam mkha' la phyar zhing sde brgyad dbang du sdud pa g.yon sdigs mdzub gzir bas 'byung po 'bog brgyal byed pa: shadas gnyis gyad kyi 'dor thabs bsgrad cing: dur khrod dpal chas mjes par klubs pa: dmar ser ral pa

—8/da gyen du 'khyil zhing:rta mgo ljang zhur rta skad hi hi sgrogs pas khams gsum dbang du bsdud cing srid gsum dam la 'dogs pa:rab 'jigs dus me 'bar ba'i klong na:sku rngam brjid 'jigs su ru bar bskyed do:trīḥpad+ma ta kut+ta mahā shā he ru ka hūṃ phaṭa:bcu pa bden brjod bya ba na na mo rig 'dzin rtsa rgyud kyi bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa da :ston pa bla na med pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang lung rtogs dam pa'i chos rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang tshogs mchog 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyi bka' bden pa da :dab chen pad+ma gsung gi dkyil 'khor kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang:rnal 'byor ba bdag gi lha sngags phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin kyi bka' bden pa dang:don dam chos nyid ka nas dag cing chos can kun rdzob bslu ba med pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang:bden pa chen po'i mthu stobs nus pa'i byin rlabs la brten nas:bsnyen sgrub ting nge 'dzin zab mo la bar du gcod pa'i 'byung po bdud bgegs log par 'dren pa thams cad len chags

glud kyi gtor ma len pa'i slad du 'dir 'dus shig sarba bhu ta ā gar+sha ya dza dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho: ya— na bsnyen sgrub zab mo la bar du gcod pa'i 'byung po gdon bgegs log para'adren pa thams cad: lan chags glud kyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'dis dga' zhing mgu bar gyis la so so rang rang gi gnas su bde bar dengs shig: gal te mi 'gro zhing 'tshe b.ragyur na bdag nyid dbang chen he ru ga'i sku gsung thugs las sprul pa'i khro tshog kyis 'byung po bgegs tshogs khyed cag gi lus sgog gi dngos po thal ba rdul phran bzhin du brlagapar 'gyur ta re: / bzhi'i sngags brjod thun gyis brab bcu gcig sru 'bor sgom pa ni ye shes gyi rang snang las grub pa' mtshon cha sna tshogs kyis: gnod byed 'byung po thams cad ri rab kyi zom dang gling bar mun pa'i smag rum du bsgrad tshur 'dus de dag gis gtams pa'i srung ba'i gur khang chen po ye shes lnga yi 'od dang 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus su bdag dang bsrung bya thams cad yi dam pad+ma dbang chen gyi sku gsung thugs su dag smin rdzogs par bsam la: dzñā na dhartu rak+ta rak+ta bhe: bcu gnyis snyan gsan dbab pa na rang rang

—8rdo rnams kyisadad pa dang mos gus gdung shugs bskyed pa dang chab gcig:snying ka nas 'od dang 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros te:phyogs bcu dus bzhi'irgyal ba sras dang bcas pa:yi dam rgyud sde bzhi drug gi dkyil 'khor ma gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho thams cad:dbang chen pad+ma gsung gi dkyila'akhor tu bzhengs nas:kun kyang sku phyag rgya gsung yig 'bru thugs phyag mtshan:yon tan phrin las thams cad 'ja' 'od thig le'i rnam par bun ling ling byon nas:bdagamadun sgrub pa'i rdzas yo byad rnams la thim pas sgod bcud dag pa rab 'byams kyi rol pa chen por dag smin rdzogs par bsam la:byin dbab so bcu gsum dab bskur rgyas gdab ni rang gi snyeng ga nas 'od zer 'phros te:phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad bde gshegs rigs lnga'i rnam par byon nas:rin po che'i bum pa thogs te zag medaye shes kyi bdud rtsis dbang bskur:sdig sgrib nyes lhung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad dag par byas dbang bzhi ye shes kyi dgongs pa ra dag smin rdzogs:'khor 'das kyi spyi

dpal chen por dbugs dbyung: khams gsum gyi 'khor ba mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su sgrol ba'i mthu thob: rigs dang dkyil 'khor ye shes kyi gsang ba chen por dbang bskur bar bsam la: snyed brnya dha ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: / badz+ra dha ra sa ma ya tswa: / rat+na dha ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: trī pad+ma dha ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: ā garma dha ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: slar yang rgyal ba rigs lnga'i sa bon sa ā hūṃ swā hā rnams gnas lngar gsal ba la rgyal ba rigs lnga yab yum bstem te dag pa ye shes kya 'khor lo lnga ldan du rgyas gdab par gyur sgo brnya dha ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ā pad+ma dha ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra / badz+ra dha ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: swā rat+na dha ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: hā garma dha ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: slar yang gnas gsum rdo rje snying po las 'od 'phros pas: rab 'byams rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad dbang chen pad+ma gsung gi dkyil 'khor kyi rnam par spyan drangs te gnyis su med par bsdim mo: bcu bzhi ril bu bskyed pa ni skyed ma shu sgye ta sogs konya : mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang las rang byang lngan grab thod pa'i sma mkhar rngam brjid 'jigs su rung

—8/sa: ba dbang chen bde ba'i gzi 'od rab tu 'bar ba'i klong du: ril bu rnams pad+ma dbang chen sku mdog dmar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje thod dbyug dang: g.yon sdig pa 'dzin pa dur khrod dpal chas mdzes par klubs pa: rngam brjid 'jigs su rung ba: dbang chen bde ba'i gzi 'od 'bar ba: grangs med pa spros te kun kyang rdo rje'i gar bsgyur mdzad bzhin gdug pa gza' klu sde brgyad zil gyis gnon par byed pa: drag po'i gad rgyang ha ha dang nyi nyisgrogs pas dbang phyug ma sring mkha' 'gro bde ba chen po ra bskul bar bskyed do: de dag rnams kyi spyi bor sku mi 'gyur ba'i ngo bo oṃ kyi rnam pa: mgrin par gsung mi 'gag pa'i rdo rje āḥs mtshan pa snying gar thugs mi 'khrul ba'i brda rtags hūṃ sngon po gsal ba las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum spros te: dbang chen gsung gi dkyil 'khor bdud dpung zil gnon gyi rgyal po yab yum 'dzadar dang bcas pa thams cad kha ba bu yug 'tshubs bzhin spyan drangs te ril bu lhar gsal ba rnams la sib sib thim par gyur: 31 ā( 1 badz+ra gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki ni sarba sa pa

ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza a we sha ya a āḥ bco lnga 'phreng ba byin rlabasani dzad sarba dharma ga ga na āḥ stong pa'i ngang las bgrang phreng rnams bde gshegs zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya'idakyil 'khor du gsal: 'phreng lung ye shes lnga'i zer thag gi lu gu rgyud du 'brel bar bsam: kun kyang nyams bde ba chen po'i gzi byin 'bar te: gsung chos nyid kyi rang sgrasgrogs bzhin rdo rje'i rtse gar bsgyur nas 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i mdzad pa lhun gyis grub par dmigs: bla ru rtse ra maṇ+ḍi pra wadhe na ye swā hā: nyer gcig brjod la dbyangs gsal dang rtena'abrel snyang pos gzi byin bskyed sa ma yā bcu drug ral bu' bzlas dmigs ni bum pa dzha las gzhal yas khang yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su pad+ma gsung gi dkyil 'khor kyi lha tshogs rnamasagasal ba'i sku yi cha thams cad nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas: 'khor 'das 'byung ba'i dwangs bcud thams cad bsdus te sib sib thim par bsam la: bsnyen pa tanga'adzin ldan pas gtong sa ye shes lnga las sgrub pa'i gzhal yas khang yangs pa'i dbus su: ril bu bde gshegs gsung gi dkyil 'khor ma 'dres lam gyi gsal bar bskyed pa'i

—8/sde: gnas gsum las 'od zer zla ba dkar bo'i rang bzhin phyogs bcur spros te rab 'byams rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i gzi byin bskul te byin dbab ril bu'i mtshan 'dzin dag pa ye shes kyi 'khor lor sad par dmigs la:nye bar bsnyen pa tang 'dzin ldan pas bzla sa snang srid thams cad dag pa 'od kyi gzhal med khang du shar ba'i dbus su:ril bu rnams dbang chen gsung gi dkyil 'khor bdud dpung zil gnon gyi rgyal por gsal ba'i sku re re las kyang brgya stong khri 'bum bye ba sa ya dung phyur grangs med pa spros te:kun gyi 'dzab dbyangs di ri ri sgogs pa'i snang srid thams cad g.yo 'gul byed cing:bde gshegs thugs kyi gzi byin bstim par byas te/sgrub dang sgrub pachen po 'a bzlas pa bya'o hūṃ ril bu ye shes lha yi rang bzhin du gsal ba'i sku las 'od dang 'od zer pho nya mtshon thun gyi rnam par spros te:gzung 'dzin gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i las nyon bag chags gnod byed thams cad thul gyis bsregs par dmigs la:las sbyor 'phrin las grub pa' 'dzab dbya sa sgrogs 'dod gsol ni ho bdud dpung zil gaje na gyi rgyal po

dbang chen pad+ma gsung gi lha tshogs khyed rnams la: mkhyen pa'i ye shes: brtse ba'i thugs rje: mdzad pa'i 'phrin las: skyobs pa'i nus mthu: sgrol ba'i 'dren stobs: 'dulaba'i brtul zhugs: bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba lags pas bdag cag sgrub pa po rnams la mchog thun mong gnyis kyi dngos grub thams cad dang: bde stong mchog tu mi'agyur ba'i 'od gsal chen po mngon du gyur ba'i dngos grub dam pa dus da lta nyid du stsol bar mdzad du gsol: gu ru dzñal ḍāk+ki ni sarba sirnyi pha la a la la ho: r+sā bdun chos skyongagator ma byan rlabs ni stong palingang las āX las stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsa lnga gtso bor gyur pa'i bza' bca' btung ba ldagagazhib kyi rnam pa thams cad: rigs lnga yab yum gyi rnam par dbang bskur: me rlung 'phrod pa'i brda thabs kyis dngos po mtshan ma thams cad bsregs sbyang bkrus la rangabazhin zag pa med pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur: 'ad ā/ hanyo nyi lan gsum brjod dngosapo dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag la rnam pa 'dod yon lnga ldan gyi phung po

ba ma: zad mi shes par gyur: badz+ra spa ra ṇa khaṃ: rang nyid dbang chen rta mgrin du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer slog 'byug pa ltar 'phros te: rdo rje'i chos skyong ba'i srung ma bka' sdod pho nya'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad: sngon gyi bka' tha tshig dran nas rang bzhin gyi gnas so so nas rdzu 'phrul thogs pa med pas dam tshig gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir byon par bsam pañtsa ma hā kro ta dharma pā la tri shu ya ho: 'dod gsol mi ho pad+ma gsung gi bka' nyan: dgra gshed spyi yi gnya' non: sbas pa nabhe gi dkor srung: nyams rtogs yon tan gyi byed po: dbang drag btsan rgod 'bar ba: gnod sbyin ya le ber: bka' 'khor sprul pa bran g.yog dabhe bcas pa rnams kyis: dpa' skyems sha khrag 'dod yon lnga ldan gyi phung po 'di bzhes la: sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa sru sa: sems can la phan bde spel: rnal 'byor ba'i sku tshe bsri sa sbyin bdag la mnga' thang bskyed: dus kyi rgud pa mtha' dag ming gi lhag mar mdzod: rgyal bsen gdug pa can gyi sma phob: sgrub pa'i drod tshad skyongs: 'gal zla nyer 'tshe sol

mthun rkyen legs tshogs spel: gzhan yang ci re ba dang ci smon pa'i las thams cad thogs pa med par stsol ba'i 'brin las dam pa rgya chen po yongs su grub par mdzad dugasol: 'phrin las gang bcol thogs med 'grub sa ma wā bco bskyad tshogs kyi brda dang brda lan ni las kyi rdo rjes phyag dang zhe sa bcas ho dgongs su gadre la ma : ho dgongs su gsol 'o : ho dgongasasu gsol lo: spros med chos nyid gyi dbyings: rang bzhin rnam par dag pa na bzhugs pa'i dbang chen bde ba'i gzi brjid: za byed pad+ma gar dbang: sbyor sgrol thabs mkhasapho mo: zil gnon khro rgyal yab yum: pad+ma gsung gi dkyil 'khor ma lus pa thugs brtse ba chen pos dgongs su gsol: 'dir 'dus rnal 'byor sgrub pa po rnams kyi dam tshig nyams chags bskangs ba dang: tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho lhun gyis grub pa'i slad du: 31ngas spyod tshogs kyi 'khor lo 'bul lags na: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs snams kyis bzhes pa ci gnang: de nas rdo rje rgyal po'i brda lan ni ho 'dir 'tshogs rig 'dzin gyi gtso bo rdo rje rgyal thebs karma gdongs can karma mtshams pa rdo rje gdong 'khrugs las dag

—8/sde: pa'i bya ba mos sogs:'dir 'dus rig 'dzin rgya mtshos gsan du gsol:deng 'og min gsang ba'i dur khrod 'bar ba dbang gi da la bde chen gzibarjid 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor du:tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po gzhung bzhin du bshams shing:gnyis chos kyi rtog pa shes rab chen pos zil gyis mnan te dbyer medamanyam pa chen por 'bul lags na:thugs rje brtse ba chen pos bzhes pa gnang ngo:tshogs nas dga' spro thal sbyar bcas bye spre sa med rang bzhin dag pa'i dkyil 'khor du:dmatshig gcig bsdus tshogs rnams ngo mtshar che:rtogs pas bdag bsgral mtshan ma thad gar gcod:lhag mthong rdo rje rnon po'i tshogs ston spro:dbyer med bde ba chen por 'bulalags na:thim pa'i tshul gyis dang du bzhes su gsol a la la he che brngo da la sogs gzhung ltar gto bcu dgu bskang rjas byin rlabs ni sarba dharmā ga ga na āḥsnye nga pa'i ngang las mkha'adabyings rnam par dag pa'i klo du:ye shes sgyu 'phrul gyi rol rtsed bsgyur ba:rang byung bhan+ta ka pā la sto gsum dang mnyam pa'i nang du tshogs rdzas snod bcud 'dod yon gyi

dngos po thams cad zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rol pa chen por bsgyur te: steng lha'i dga' ston blo yis mi dpog pa: bar mi yi longs spyod tshad bzung dang bral ba:'og klu'i dpal 'byor zad mtha' las 'das pa: ngo mtshar ba'i rdo rje'i rig ma bcu drug: dgyes bskang kyi mchod sprin kun tu bzang po'i rol ba: dus 'khor ba ci srid ma stong gi bar du: yul dbang chen gsung gi dkyil 'khor rab 'byams: dgyes pa bskyed pa'i 'brin las zad pa med pa'i dpal ting 'dzin rdo rje'i rol ston mtha' yas pa 'byung bar gyur cig: rten snying lan bdun dang bcas te ting nge 'dzin gyis bskang dzos spel sa ma mā nyi shu tshogs 'gugs bya ba ni 31gas spyodad lcags khang shā1 gsum 'bar ba'i nang du: dzardogs rdzas dgra bgegs gnod byed thams cad dngos su gsal la: na mo mchog gsum rtsa gsum sku gsum bden gnyis basmu ba med pa'i bden pa'i mthus: spyir mchog gsum bstan pa'i spyi dgra: bshes gnyen dam pa'i sku dgra: khyad par du bskyed rdzogs ting nge 'dzin la bar du gcod pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad mtshan ma rdzas kyi rten 'di la khug cig: rjotre+e

—8sde: badz+ra e gu sha dza: dzaḥshā baṃ ho: lan gsum brjod la tshogs bsgral bya nyer gcig lhag ma byin rlabs ni t+t+waṃ bhaji ka pā la /: bhardzi lcang ma can yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du:me sa rak+ta tsit+ta kau ni ri ti ho: gti mug gi rang bzhin me sa sha yi ri bo: 'dod chags kyi mtshan ma bcom pa'i rak+ta khrag gi rgya mtsho zhe sdang gi rtog pa gcod pa'i tsit+ta snying gi dga' ston: mchan bcas kyi 'khrul ba dbyings su gcod pa'i kau ni ri ti rus pa'i gram khrod chen po gcig tu gyur: ma āḥ/ ha ho nyi lan gsum brjod ho: rdo rje gsang ba'ipho nya dbang phyug ma sring king dang laṅka thams cad: rdo rje'i bshud pas bskul lo: sngags tshig glu yis 'bod do: zhing chen g.yab mos mtshon no: dpal gyi gtor mas brngan no: rdo rje'i tha tshig bsgrag go: dam tshig gnyan gyis drangs so: gsang ba las kyi dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir: e a ra yi pho pho : bdag nyid pad+ma dbang chen gsal ba'i ya rkan zla ba'i dkyil 'khor lce nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dam tshig gi chu bde ba chen po'i ra bzhin can: ya so dpa' bo pho tshogs kyis bskul: ma so shes rab ma tshogs kyis dbab: rdzas

pham 'bab bka' yi gtor ma: dam tshig srog gcig tu bsre bar byed pa'i rang bzhin tu gyur: hrīX ha ho dzñā na pañtsa hrīX yang dbang chen gyi spyi gtsug nas rta skad thang gsum btonapas dregs pa las la bskul: sde brgyad dam la btags: zhing bcu sgrol ba'i las kyi gnyer gtad do yum rdo rje phag mo' dbu gtsug nas phag skad lnga ngur bas 'khor ba'i chos la gad mo bsgrags: ma rig ru tra'i dpa' bskong: log 'dren 'byung po'i sma phab: shes rab bde ba'i dbyings bskul: rak+ta tshal gsum gyi dgongs pa'i 'phrin las lhun gyis grub par bsam: pad+ma sa ma ya ha he ho: gzhung ltar lag gtor rgyas par 'bul nyer gnyas gtor ma byin rlabs na ā75sa bhan+ta yangs shing rgya chen po'i sgod du: gtor ma gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad dngos su gsal la na mo brgyud pa drug ldan bla ma dam pa dang: yi dam rgyud sde rgya mtsho lhag pa'i lha: gnas gsum ma dang mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dang pho nya bstan srung dam can nor lha'i tshogs bden gnyis baspu ba med pa'i bden mthu yis sangs rgyas bstan dgra dkon mchog spyi dgra dang: dge 'dun dgos dgra sngags 'chang

ba'adi: dam dgra dang: skye rgu yongs la 'tshe ba'i dgra dang bgegs: bsam ngan sbyor rtsub log pa'i blo ngan can: ngan song rgyu sgrub thar med las ngan rnams:khug cig badz+ra e gu sha ya dza: ske nas chings shig badz+ra pa sha (: yan lag sdoms shig badz+ra sbo ṭa baṃ:myos par gyis shig badz+ra gan+ḍi ho: phyes shig badz+ra pra we sha ya phaṭa: dbyer med bstim cig a we sha ya ā zhes brjod pas dgra bgegs kyi phung khams dum bur gtubs te rnam shes ā dkar po dri ma med pa'i rnam par mdun bskyed lha'i thugs gar bstim te sangs rgyas: tshe bsod rnams j-iḥyig ljang gu'i rnam par rang la bstim te bkrag mdangs gzi byin rgyas: gzugs phung khrol kyis zhig te sha yi ri bo khrag gi rgya mtsho rus pa'i gram khrod chen po:ngo bo zag pa rmed pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur:o āXhūṃ ha ho hrī lan gsum brjod la chad mdo gto nyer gsum bstan gtor byin rlabs ni bdag nyid pad+ma dbang chen gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu ltar 'phros pas:mi sdug khro zhal ma'i bu mo bdud mo mched bzha dang: dkar gsal bzhin bzang ma'i bu mo gnod sbyin ma

bzhi dang: sman btsun bde ba gzugs legs ma'i bu mo sman mo mched bzhi rnams rang rang g.yog 'khor sprul ba dpung dang bcas pa rnams skad cig gis byon te: da la'i rgyab tu dar gyi yol ba bkram pa'i phag tu dbu 'phang dma' la dpa' zhum pa'i tshul gyis 'dar yed yed du gnas par gyur rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du bshal chu'i gtor ma zag pa med pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur 3 āhūṃ ha ho nyi lan gsum brjod la bstan gtor 'bul nyer bzhi gro lasags bya ba ni gtor gzhed kha sbubs pa dang mnyam du mi mthun pa'i phyogs dam sri 'byung po thams cad nub par gyur: na mo mchog gsum rtsa gsum sku gsum bden gnyis basmu ba med pa'i bden pa'i mthus sgrub pa zab mo la bar du gcod pa'i gnod byed dam sri nyul le mi la spun dgu bse rag pho mo thams cad chos nyid e yi sgrom du khug cig badz+ra e gu sha ya dza: rat+na pa sha shā: pad+ma sbo ṭa baṃ karma garnye ho gnod byed dam sri pho mo sa rim pa dgu'i mar zhabs: 'chi bdag las gshin pho mo'i lto ba: gru gsum e yi btson khang 'bar ba'i nang du pho rnams kha

—8mirnya sbubs mo rnams gan skyal gyi tshul du gnas pa la rkang pa lcags gzer gyis rgyas gdab ste: 'phar sdang 'gul bskyod mi nus par bde ba'i ngang du brgyal bar bsam gzhung gi bro mnan bya'o gtor gzhung rat+na mdzes pa'i snod yar bteg tshe: bdag cag rnal 'byor dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshe dpal bsod nams snyan grags thams cad zla ba yar gyi ngos bzhin gong nas gong du 'phel zhi rgyas par gyur cig: bhe a yu pukhye dzñā na puṣ+ṭi ku ru ye swā hā nyer lnga tshe 'gugs bya ba ni bdag nyid dam tshig gi tshedapag med sku mdog pad+ma rā ga'i gzi byin 'bar ba: longs sku'i rgyan dang mtshan dadre'i rnam par 'khyud pa: phyag mnyam gzhag gi steng na 'chi med tshe yi bum pa 'dzin pa zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs shing: sku las 'od dang 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros te: 'khor 'das brtan g.yo 'byung ba'i dwa sa bcud thams cad bsdus te bdagadang bsrung bya rnams la sib sib thim pas 'chi med tshe yi dbang dang dngos grub thams cad thob par bsam la: bhe a yu dzña na tshe s+t+waṃ n+ni dza sirnyi pha la hūṃ u brgya rtsa brjod la tshe rjas

rnams dbang bskur byin rlabs gzi byin bskyed slar yang tshe bsod 'gugs pa ni bdag dang bsrung bya'i bla tshe nyams pa dang yal ba dang: 'khyams pa dang chad gas ral ba dang gdon chenagyis 'phrog pa dang: gdon phran gyis brkus pa byad ma lha srung gis bkugs pa thams cad 'od dang 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus te bdag dang bsrung bya rnams la sib sib bstem pas: 'chi ba med pa rdo rje tshe yi dbang dang dngos grub thams cad thob par bsam la: nyu nyi rang snang mi shig dag pa'i zhing: lnga ldan zangs mdog dpal gyi ri pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas 'gro ba'i mgon po thod 'phreng rtsal: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol mos ldan sgrub mchog pho mo la: dgongs rgyud byin rlabs 'pho ba dang: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsal: — nyi zla gam dbang chen e yi klong: bdud bzhi nyi zla pad+ma'i steng: chos 'byung zur drug mdzes pa'i dbus: bde mchog dbang chen he ru ga: gar dbang gzi ldan dbyings dang bsre: thabs kyi pho nya smog ltar 'khyag: shes rab rang bzhin char ltar 'bebs: gnyis

badz+ra: med bde ba chen po'i gzi dad ldan mos ngor sgyu mar byon: dgongs rgyud byen rlabs 'pho ba dang: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol: hūṃ hrī tshad med thugs rje'i klong yangs nas: 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub pa'i: 'jam dpal sku dang che mchog gsung: yang dag thugs dang 'phrin las dpal: bla med dregs pa stobs ldanasogs: rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i sprin rab 'byams: dad pas thugs dam dbyings nas bskul: ting 'dzin mos ngor gsal bar byon: dgongs rgyud byen rlabs 'pho ba dang: 'chi medatshe yi dngos grub stsol: hū nyi bde chen 'od gsal thig le'i klong: nyag gcig gsang ba chen po nas: rgyal ba kun yum rnal 'byor ma: 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dngabacas: gnas yul nyer bzhi'i 'du ba mchog: phyi nang gnyis med sgyu 'phrul sprin dad ldan sgrub mchog mos ngo dza ye shes gzigs pa'i zhal bzang ngom: dgongs rgyud byinarlabs 'pho ba dang: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsoli: hūṃ nyi lha dang rig 'dzin tshe yi bdag: 'byur ba med pa'i gzi byin can: pad+ma gsung gi dkyil 'khor gyis: 'dir tshogs

rnams la tshe dbang bskur 'chi med rig 'dzin mchog thob nas don gnyis lhun gyis grub par sgo ga: shes pad+ma kro ta sarba ā yu dzñā na sirnyi pha la hūṃ hrīX tshe bum dang tshe chang tshe ril tshe 'brangarnams rim bzhan gto de nasargyas gdab ni hūṃ hrīḥ mda' ni rgyal ba rigs lnga'i rten: dar tshon ye shes lnga yi gsang: gser ni rin thang bral ba'i nor: bal ni longs spyod g.yang gi rgyu shwa ni byis pa chung gi rten dung ni bkra shis dge ba'i rdzas: pho yi bla rten pho la gtad: tshe srog bkrag mdangs rgyas gyur cig: mo yi bla rten mo la gtad: zhi dul lang tsho'i dpal 'dzom shog: byis pa'i bla rten chung la gtad: bkra shis las mtha' phun tshogs shog: tshe srog 'gyur med ka chen 'dzug lo brgyar 'tsho zhing ston brgya mthong tshe ring nad med bde skyid ldan: dge legs chos ldan dpal 'byor shog hūṃ tra tra shag: mu tra ho: tiṣ+ṭha lhan: brgya rtsa brjod la tshe sba bstims de nas smon lam gdab pa ni ho gsang chen rdo rje sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor rnams snang mtha' yas pa'i tshe la mnga' brdes shog: mi basmod rdo rje'i lang tshor mnga' bsnes shog: rin chen 'byung gnas dpal yon 'byor bar shog: don

ba6/sdo 7 yod grub pa'i 'brin las mthar phyin shog: rnam par snang mdzad nges pa lnga 'byor shog: 'khor ba dong sprugs mdzad pa mthar phyin shog: de nas shis brjod ni ho: bde ba chen po'i rigs dang dkyil 'khor bdag: gsung mchog pad+ma dbang gi 'khor lo'i dpa la: bde legs kun gyi 'byung gnas rta phag zhal: ye shes 'bar ba mchog gi bkra shis stsol: gzhan yang shis brjod rgya cher bya nyer drug mchod bstod rgyas spro na bdag mdun gyi gnas rnams las spros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo grangs med pa'i: sku mdzes pas gar bsgyur zhing: phyag na kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin mtha' yas pa thogs te: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la: dgyes mchod phul bar bsam la: mchod pa rgyas pa ra 'bul slar yang rdo rje'i rig ma rnams kyi: sku dam tshig gi phyag rgyas bro gar khrigs khrigs: gsung chos kyi phyag rgyas bstod dbyangs 'ur 'ur: thugs chos nyid kyi phyag rgyas ye shes klong sbyoramanyam mnyam: yon tan 'phrin las kyi phyag rgya sna tshogs par dra sa te lha tshogs rnams la bstod pa glu'i mchod pa 'bul bar bsam la: bstod pa rgyas pa ra bya slar dga' ston

'byed pa mo thams cad: bdag mdun gyi gnas so sor thim pas dbang byin dngos grub 'phel zhing rgya / par bsam: nyer bdun bzod gsol 'bul ba ni ho dbang chen pad+ma gsungagi dkyil 'khor thams cad: thugs brtse ba chen pos dgongs su gsol: 'dir 'tshogs rnal 'byor pho mo rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin bying rmugs su gyur pa dang: rtog pa'i golasgrib ma chod par: bag med 'khrul ba'i spyod par 'phyan pa dang bde ba chen po'i ye shes dang du ma blang ba dang: mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i 'od gsal zab mo'i gdeng shor ba dang tan gaṇa spyor sgrol gyi dgongs pa dang du ma blang ba dang: dngos po bcu'i dam tshig yang dag par ma spyod pa dang: lta ba'i stangs dang sgom pa'i gdeng dang spyod pa bag med du shor ba la sogs: mdor na rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams chags ral ba thams cad mthol lo bshags so mi 'chab po: mi sbed do: phyin chad sgog gi slad du bsdoms par bgyi na: tshangs pa mchog gi dngos shākyab ma lus pa stsal du gadrenal: thasam ya snyi 8)bye ā dbya sa gsal yag brgya lan gsum brjod lag chad kha bskang dag par bya sa ma rwa nyer brgyad bden

brten: tshag bskul ba ni rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros te: phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad mdun gyi lha lam yongs su gang bar byon te zhal nas bkra shis dge mtshan gyi glu dbyangs brjod cing: phyag nas me tog man dha ra ba'i char chen po bsnyil bar gyur: bkra shis bden tshig rgya cher brjod me tog sil ma kun tu bkram bkrashis dga' ston mdzes par byaḥ sgo 'dis don gnyis lhun grub byed sa ma yā ye ma rgyal ba' dbang tho pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i ma 'ongs 'gro la thugs brtse chen po yis shin tu zab pa rdo rje snyi po' bskor grub pa 'i dab phyug khye'u chu 'o tsā dang dbang chen bka' bab rgyal ba mchog dbyangs la dam tshig dus gnad zab pa'i bka' rgya gtad ma 'ongs don phyir mdo khams gter rgya sdoms dus kyi snyigs mar zhabrugs rtsod gze sa lang tshe dpa 'a bo khyed zu sprulapa las ldan gyis sgo 'di sbyan drangs bstan 'gro'i rgud pa gso 'brel tshad don ldan rig 'dzan zhing du 'god bka' yi gnyer skyong gnod sbyin yang le ber bcud kya dpa la sru sa klu bdud spu gri 'bar zab pa 'i mdzod 'dzan spuganag 'od 'phro da shin tu dge ba'i grogs gcig ging dmar nag thub par sru sa shag chos kya gnyer bcol lo bka' log lag tu ma shor sa ma yu dam lan zugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog sa ma wā rgya rgya rgya sgrub pa'i lhan

thabs zab mo rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda thim snyi ces pa 'di' lung zin sprul ba'i sku rin po che pad+ma dga' ba'i rdo rjes bkra shas kyi lha regs go bzang yug chen bde gshegs sku gsung thugs kya brten ya mtshan dge ba'i skyesabazang po du ma dang bcas te 'bad stsol lhur len rgya chen pos bskul ba don dang ldan phyar kho bo rgyal mchog bshad pa rtsal gyas mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i 'phrul brda zab mo las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa 'i yi ge pa ni chosabadag nyad kyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga la/

zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: dbang chen pad+ma he ru ga'i phyi nang gsang ba'i zab sgrub rnams la nye bar mkho ba'i gsola'adebs bdud dpung 'thar byed bzhugs so:—8rdo ca na mo gu ru pa d+ma kro dha rā dza ye: za 6)77 pad+ma dab pho mdun gyi nam mkhar gsal sgo gsum gus pas gsol ba gdab pa ni e ma ho: bde chen dbang gi zhal bza bzhadapa'i gar dmar nag bzod dka'i rnam 'gyur khro gtum sgeg: gsol ba 'debs so bdud dpung zil gnon pa'i: mthu rtsal rmad du 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs: 'bar ba'i spyan rnams sdang mig glog ltar 'khyug: drag po hūṃ glus bdud dpung 'dar zhing sngangs: gsol ba 'debs so bdud dpung zil gnon pa'i: mthu rtsal med du 'byu bar byin gyis rlobs: rta skad bshad pas sde brgyad dam la btag: ye shes me yis nyon mongs mtshan 'dzin bsreg gsol ba 'debs so bdud dpung zil gnon pa'i: mthu rtsal rmad du 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs: zhabs gnyis bsgrad pas bdud bzhi zil gyis gnon: dur khrod dpa' chas dpa' ba'i rtags su bgo: gsol ba 'debs so bdud dpung zil

gnon pa'i: mthu rtsal rmad du 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs pho gdon 'thar byed thod dbyug ral gri gdeng: ma tshogs dam 'dog thod khrag sbrul zhags bsdams gsol ba'adebs so bdud dpung zil gnon pa'i mthu rtsal rmad du 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs dpa' bo dgyes byed phag mo sku la 'khril: bde ba'i rang bzhin rtsa khams lha sku'i sprin gsol ba 'debs so bdud dpung zil gnon pa'i: mthu rtsal rmad du 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs: phyogs bzhilibadud 'dul khro chen rigs bzhi dang: gsung gi dkyil 'khorarab 'byams rgya mtsho la gsol ba 'debs so bdud dpung zil gnon pa'i: mthu rtsal rmad du 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs rig sngags zhing skyes dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang dmus long rgyab 'brel pho nya dam can la gsol ba 'debs so bdud dpung zil gnon pa'i: mthu rtsal rmad du 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs deng sang snyigs ma'i smag ruma'athug po na chos byed skal bzang nyin skar las kyang dkon: nag pos gzengs bstod nyi rdul bas kyang 'thibs: dam sri 'byung po nag phyogs za kha dar: dmag 'khrug

ga'adirnya mtshon chas gzengs pa rtag tu g.yo dgra yi kha dar nad dang mu ge 'tshubs: dus kyi tha ma las nyon rmag rum 'dir: dbang chen pad+ma'i rjes 'jug skal bzang rnams: log lam bdud kyi g.yul las rgyal bar mdzod: ma rig 'khrul ba'i 'dam las brgal du gsol: bzod dka' ngan 'dza'i 'phrang las bskyab tu gsol: dus kyi 'khrug rtsod sna tshogs zhi bar mdzod: 'jig rten rgud pa ma lus rab zhi nas drag po pa d+ma dbang chen he ru ga'i gsang gsum sgyu 'phrul 'khor lor longs spyod nas: he ru ka dpal sras su byang chub regag: de ltar gsol btab dgongs rgyud byin rlabs 'jug bar chad g.yul rgyal don gnyis lhun gyis grub sa ma yā ye ma rgyal ba' dbang po pa d+ma saṃ bha was ma 'ongasa'agro la brtse ba chen po yis thugs kyi thig le zang gsang rdor snya skor grub pa'i dab phyug rgyal mchog khyod la gtad da dung ma spe ba rin chen brda la bstem mdo khams bkra shis rdzong der dgo sa bra sdoms ma 'o sa snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus nad mug mtshon chas gze sa pa lang pa'i tshe dpa 'a bo khod nyid 'dus pa rtsal du bzhengs skyes bu de da gdams pa 'ad 'phrad nas 'gro don 'phrin las byang gi phyogs su rgyas 'brel tshad don ldan pa d+ma 'od du 'god bka' 'ad

grungs shig gnod sbyan btsan rgod rgyal dam nyams lag tu ma shor spu gra gsum thugs sras rnams la sprod cig ging dmar nag sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gsol 'debs bdud dpung 'thar byed rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ nyi wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda thim snyi ces pa 'da'ang lung zan sku skyesapad+ma bsod nams grub pa'i rdo rjes bkra shas lha reg shig tu dge ba'i skyes ya mtshan can du mar bcas te nan dan chen pos bskul ngor kho bo rgyal mchog bzhad pa rtsal gyas mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i 'phrul brda las zhal bzhus te dag pa ra phab pa'i yi ge pa na lung zan chos kyi bdag po nyid kyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel sarba maṅga la/

zab gsang rdo rje snying po las dbang chen gsung gi gsol 'debs bde stong bum bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs so:—8rdo cha na mo gu ru pad+ma kā ra ye: zag)/ dbang pho gsung mchog bde ba' dkyil 'bor lo mi 'bral bde za 'khor lo' rgyan du bzhugs las ldan pho mo' sgo gsum smin grol phyir snyan pa 'idabyangs kyis gsol ba 'debs pa ni e maho: ma chags dri bral bde ba chen po'i sku: mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gter chen snang mtha' yas: gsol ba 'debs so rtag tu thugs rjes zungs pad+ma dbang chen 'grub par byin gyis rlobs brtse chen thugs rjes 'khor ba kha lo bsgyur: gzhan phan 'phrin las mtha' yas spyan ras gzigs gsol ba 'debs sortag tu thugs rjes zungs: pad+ma dbang chen 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: misnye'i dwangs mtshor pad+ma'i sbubs las 'khrungs: dregs pa zil gnon pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: gsol ba 'debs so rtag tu thugs rjes zungs: pad+ma dbang chen 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: dbang chen zla gam e klong mnga' dbang bsgyur: bde chen rdo rje nā gardzu na la: gsol ba

'debs so rtag tu thugs rjes zungs: pad+ma dbang chen 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: dbang chen bka' bab rta skad gtsug na spud: ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs bzhad pa rtsal: gsol ba 'debs so rtag tu thugs rjes zungs: pad+ma dbang chen 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: smon lam 'phro bzang gzhan phan 'brin las phyugs: grub pa'i dbang phyug khye'u chung lo tsā la: gsol ba 'debs so rtag tu thugs rjes zungs: pad+ma dbang chen 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gangs ldongs mun sel bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin:dbyangs can 'dzum zhal ye shes mtsho rgyal la: gsol ba 'debs so rtag tu thugs rjes zungs: pad+ma dbang chen 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: bde ba'i gar spyod 'dzum pa'i zhal bzang can: rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i gsang 'dzin shel dkar bzar gsol ba 'debs so rtag tu thugs rjes zungs: pad+ma dbang chen 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: bcu drug gar 'khyug mtsho byung dga' ster dpal: dgyes sde chen mo bkra shis khye 'dren la: gsol ba 'debs so rtag tu thugs rjes zungs: pad+ma dbang chen 'grub par byin gyis rlobs:

—8rdo: byin rlabs sprin 'jigs ye shes gzigs pa can: rtsa brgyud bla ma bka' drin can rnams la:gsol ba 'debs so rtag tu thugs rjes zungs: pad+ma dbang chena'agrub par byin gyis rlobs dngos grub char 'bebs dregs pa dbang du bsgyur: yi dam dbang chen rgyud sde rgya mtsho la:gache la ba 'debs che rtag tu thugs rjes zungs: pad+madabang chen 'grub par byin gyis rlobs bde stong rab sbar nyi zla'i gsang sgo 'byed: 'bum phrag yangs pa'i ḍāk+ki rgya mtsho la gsol ba 'debs so rtag tu thugs rjes zungs pad+ma dbang chen 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: rang byung lhan skyes bde ba mchog gi gsang: gnas yul nyer bzhi'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro la: gsol ba 'debs so rtag tu thugasarjes zungs: pad+ma dbang chen 'grub par byin gyis rlobs:bcu drug dga' ster ye shes gzi byin can: dur khrod brgyad dang he ru'i mkha' 'gro la: gsol ba 'debs so rtag tuthugs rjes zungs: pad+ma dbang chen 'grub par byin gyis rlobs:bshad pa'i bde rtsal khrag 'thung bka' nyan pa: dbang phyug ma sring pho nya rgya mtsho la: gsol ba 'debs so rtag

tu thugs rjes zungs: pad+ma dbang chen 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ye nas mnyam nyid bde chen ye shes zhal 'khor 'das dag pa rab 'byams dkyil 'khor la: gsol ba 'debs so rtag tu thugs rjes zungs pad+ma dbang chen 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyi nga bdag mtshan 'dzin spros pa ka nas dag:rlung sems dhu ti'i mdud pa dbyings su spyol: nyi zla spros byed dri ma bde klong sprin: don dam mtha' bral rta phag gsang bar rdzogs: dbang chen pad+ma brtsegs par byang chub shog mos gus gdu shugs drag po yis gsol ba btab pas gzi byan thob don gnyis lhun grub sa la sbyor bslu ba med do sa ma yu e ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse phyir thugs bcud chos dbang chen bka' bab rgyal mchog dbyangs la gtad rin chen brdar bstemasamado khams gsham du sbos ma 'o sa snyigs mar nad mtshon gzeng sa lang tshe dpa' bo khyod sprul lasaldan bu yas rten rten 'brel legs na 'gro don bsam mtha' yas 'brel tshad don ldan pad+ma 'od du 'god bka' 'di thub par srungs shig btsan rgod rgyal dam nyam lag tu ma shor rtag par sru sa sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya dbang chen gsol 'debs bde stong bum bzang rdzogs so gter

— mi: rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi mkhan po pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o bdo thim snyi ces pa 'di yang lung zin chos kya bdag po pad+ma dga' ba' rdo rjes shan tu dge ba' skyes dang bcas te yang yang bskul ngor kho bo rgyal mchog bshad pa'i rdo rje 'dzam gli dab rgyan rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i 'phrul brda las chos bdag a snya sa ra dzus bde sto tshogs ston mtha' yas pa 'bul skabs zhal bshus rte dag par phab pa 'i yi ge pa na chos kya bdag po nyid kyis bgyis pa 'o/sarba masko le/
po'i 0chatāmasgyucu sgomanumashām spyagamema'ismom khyarna sbyolo:zab gsang rdo rje snying po las rta mgrin khams gsum rol pa rtsal gyi gsol 'debs bdud dpung zil gnon zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

— mi: na mo gu ru pad+ma kwa ra ya: smo rnams bdeb kun gyi 'byung gnas ye shes gsang za byed phag gi gar la mnyam rol ba'i bdud dpung zil gnon rta phag zung 'jug la ye shesarig pasabatud de brda phyag 'tshal phyi rabasaskal pa bzang po'i skyesabu rnams shes rab klong bskyed dad pa'i stobs bskyed de lhag pa'i lha la gsol ba gdab pa 'di snyan ra rdo rje'i glu la drang te bskul snyen ā nyu:gu ru pad+ma kro ta hrī ya baṃ pho hūṃ nyibade stong zhal sbyor spros bral pho brang nas:rdul bral dngas ma'i sku mchog snang mtha' la:mos gus thang lhod bral bas gsol ba 'debs:dbang chen gsung mchog 'grub par byin gyis rlobs:ka dag stong chen lhun grub snying rje'i gtam:dri bral 'od 'bar nam mkha' rgyal po la:ltem rkyang med par gsol ba rtag tu 'debs:dbang chen gsung mchog 'grub par byin gyis rlobs dpal ldan mcho gling pad+ma'i sdong po las:ya mtshan mchog brnyes o rgyan chen po la:khyed shes dad pas gsol ba 'debs lags na:dbang chen gsung mchog 'grab par byin gyis rlobs:gang 'dul mdzad pa rgya mtsho'i 'phrin las can:dpal lngan dgyes sde grab pa'i rgyal po la:

gtsasdo: bka' drin dran pas gsol ba 'debs lags na:dbang chen gsung mchog 'grub par byin gyis rlobs:tshogs smon las 'phro bzang po'i sa bon btabs gdul bya'i skyabs mgon rgyal ba mchog dbyangs la:dus bab rtags kyis gsol ba 'debs lags na:dbang chen gsung mchog 'grub par byin gyis rlobs:snying dbus zangs mdog dpal ri'i pho brang na:'og min phun tshogs lnga yi bkod pa la:mngon gyur rig pas gsol ba 'debs lags na:dbang chen gsung mchog 'grub par byin gyis rlobs:rtse mo rnam bkod dbu ma'i gzhal yas na:bka' drin mtshungs med don dam bla ma la:thugs yid gcig 'dres dad pas gsol 'debs na:dbang chen gsung mchog 'grub par byin gyis rlobs:zla gam bde stong 'khyil ba'i gzhal yas nas:'bar ba'i gar mdzad dbang gi rgyal po la:gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub char ltar phob:sde brgyad bran du khol bar byin gyis rlobs dbang chen 'dul glus rū tra'i sde tshogs 'thar:che btsan zla med gar dgu'i nyams rdzogs la:gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub char

ltar phob:sde brgyad bran du khol bar byin gyis rlobs:za byed bde bar sbyor ba'i brtul zhugs can don dam mnyam nyid rdo rje phag mo la:gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub char ltar phob:sde brgyad bran du khol bar byin gyis rlobs:thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i tshul yab yum zhal sbyor bde ba'i dkyil 'khor la gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub char ltar phob:sde brgyad bran du khol bar byin gyis rlobs dpa' bo dgyes sprin khrag 'thung rigs bzhi dang:phag mo 'dzum zhal mkha' 'gro sde bzhi la:gsolab 'debs so dngos grub char ltar phob:sde brgyad bran du khol bar byin gyis rlobs:ye shes las grub dpa' bo yab yum dang:tshad med rang gdangs sgo skyong ma bzhi la gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub char ltar phob:sde brgyad bran du khol bar byin gyis rlobs:ma sring dbang phyug dmu long rgyab 'brel tshogs:dpal gyi khyi spyang drwa ba glog 'gyu la:gsol ba 'debs so 'phrin las rnam bzhi skrubs:byin gyis rlobs shig dngos grub char ltar phob:de ltar gsol ba btab pas byin rlabs kyis:phyi nang 'byung khams

gtsasdo: lha yi 'khor lor dag: bde stong ye shes sku gsum 'khor lor smin: snang grags rig gsum chos nyid chen por rdzogs: srid zhi mnyam nyid he ru ka dpal17nga: dbang chen gsung gi rdo rje mngon gyur 31ga: de ltar gsol btab dgongs rgyud byin rlabs 'jug don gnyis lhun grub srid gsum zil gyis gnon sde brgyad dam 'dogs phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub srid pa'irba klo 'tshub ma bzlog pa ra 'gyur sa ma yā ye ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma saṃ ba wa'i ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis snyi ga yang bcud rdo rje snying po' skor grub pa' dbang phyug 'brog ban lo tsā dang:ngan lam rgyal mchag lang gro lo tsa la yongs rdzogs bka' gtad man ngag snying nor son da dung spel ba'i dus la ma bab pasaḥ ran chen bdo la bsnyim cig sar bye mdo khams rtse shod gnam du dgongs rgya sdoms ma 'o sa snyigs ma sum cu kha raladus dpa 'a bo khyed gsum sprul ba gcig bsdus pas 'dren ston dam pas 'gro khams kha lo bsgyur de la dgongs te smon lam rgya cher thobs 'phran las bslu ba med do sa ma ya bka' 'di thub par srungs shag sbu gri gsum bka' log lag tu ma shor la shan rje zab bcud ma g.yel sdoms shig drang srong gza' dam ldan thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gsol 'debs bdud dpung zil gnon rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya

sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha was bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzasabakod pa'o brda tham snyi zhes 'di'ang dbang chen gsung gi chos bka' bab pa sa skyong mi ya rje bo dbang chen lha rgyal nas bkra shis lha regs dang bcas te bskul ba dang chos 'di'i gnyer 'dzin dam pa ra bsngags pa sog sprul rin po che pad+ma'i ming gi cod pan can gyis bkra shis lha gos gser mdog 'gyur med g.yung drung bkra ba'i skyes dang nor mchog shog dkar dra ma bral ba lha regs dkar po dang bcas te yang yang bskul ba dang ldan phyar kho bo rgyal mchog bshad pa'i rdo rje 'dzam glang dbang rgyal rtsal gyis zla gam dbang gi dus tshod la mkha' 'gro'i gas bdo dag pa ra phab pa'i yi ge pa ni samarnya bha tra' mang gis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba masgo le/ dge'o/ bkra shis/

thopho4zhedzezlarnarmasnyirmāspom yā mamag sloma'ezag snasgyubasalo zab gsang rdo rje snying po las:rta mgrin khams gsum rol pa'i rtsa sgrub bdung dpung zil gnon bde stong gar gyi rnal wor zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

—8rdo: na mo gu ru pad+ma kā ra ye: thasnyasgomasgo117 bde ba kun gyi gsang chen po ye shes kun gyi rtser gyur pa rig stong rta phag zhal sbyor klong lta ba don gyi phyag bgyi'o chogasasmon la 'phyo 'dzom pa yi bgo skal pha nor snyang thag skor rta mgrin khams gsum rol rtsal gyi rtsa sgrub bdud dbu zal gnon bstan sa ma pā dben gnasalug dang mthun par phyin sa bsla dkar skyems gtor mas brngan nag phyogs sha khrag dmar gyis bskang 'byung po glud gtor rgya mtshos brngan maṇ+ḍal mda' gang zla gam pa chos 'byung e yi mtshan par bya sgrub gtor bla rdo srog 'khor bkod dbang chen gsung gi sgrub phur ni dkyil 'khor la gra sa da mthunabya nyer spyod sman raka gtor ma sogs shan tu mdzes shi yad 'ong bya phya nang gsang ba'i dam rgya sdoms khrus dang mnol bsang gtsang sbra byed bde ba'i stan la bag pheb gnas rlu sems rig pa sor gzhug te chos nyid lta ba'i brtul zhugs skyongs sa ma yā 'di la spyi don rnam pa gsum dang po spyor ba la ni bcu thog mar skyabs su 'gro ba ni na 31: gzo da nas ma ba〈snas bde stong spyo sa bral gsang: lhan skyes bla ma pad+ma gsung gi dal: dbang chen rta phag zhal sbyor dkyil 'khor la: mngon gyur rig stong rjen pas skyabs su mchi: gnyis ba sems bskyed ni ho: tha rnyad sgo btags gzung dang 'dzin

(6/sdo: pa'i chos:ye nas mi dmigs dbu ma chen po'i don:ma rtog gnyis 'dzin 'ching bas dam bcing rnams:sku gsum dgongs klong 'god phyir sems bskyedado:gsum pa tshogs bsags ni na mo:gsung mchog pad+ma rol ba'i dkyil 'khor la:rang rig 'od gsal rjen pas phyag 'tshal lo gang shar rang grol ye shes rgyan mchod 'bul rtag chad mu bzhir gol ba mthol lo bshags:dus gsum mnyam nyid bzhugs la rjes yi rang:'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa'i chos bskor bskul:ka dag zang thal dgongasaklong bzhugs gsol 'debs:dge kun gcig bsdus 'khor gsum dag par bsngo 'gro kun rang rig mngon gyur byang chub shog:bzha pa maṇ+ḍal sna tso ātu ste nga gsum rgyan bkod rat+na'i maṇ+ḍal 'di:bla ma sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku la 'bul:rang lus rnam dag dbang lnga 'dod lnga'i sprin:bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la 'bul:sems nyid rnamadag ye shes gsang chen po:bla ma sangs rgyas chos kyi sku la 'bul:bdag sogs 'gro ba'i tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa dang:'khor ba dong sprugs sku gsum mngon gyur shog:/e

rda rat+na maṇ+ḍal pū dza me gha sa mu dra spra ra ṇa sa ma ya sa /: lnga pa bka' bsgo na hūṃ hrī ༷ ye nas rnam dag chos sku'i dkyil 'khor la: nga bdag mtshan 'dzin spros pa ka dag kyang: glo bur kun rtog 'phral byung dug gsum gdon: rang grol glud kyi gtor ma 'di longs la: byang chub sems dang ldan pas rang sar dengs: gal te log 'khrul nye bar 'tshe gyur na: ye shes mtshon cha 'bar ba'i gzhom ta re: hū hū u tsa ta ya phaṭa: ཿ bzhi'i sngags brjod thun gyis brab drug pa srung 'bar sgom pa ni hūṃ hrīḥ rang byung rang shar ye shes lnga yi 1nga 'pho 'gyur gzhom gzhig bral ba'i rwa gur ste: 'di la mtshan ma'i gdon gyis glags mi rnyed: gdod ma'i sangs rgyas dgongs pa mngon du bya: badz+ra sa ma ya rak+ṣa rak+ṣa t+t+waṃ bdun pa byin 'bebasani hūṃ hrīX ma bcos bde ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor ni: nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i 1ga yangs nas: khams gsum dbang bsgyur rta yi brtul zhugs can: rdo rje'i dam dgongs thugs dam mi g.yel bar: mos ldan sgrub mchog rnal 'byor pho mo la bde stong dbang bskur rtogs pa'i gzi byin phob: don gnyis lhun gyis grub par mdzad du

—'di: gsol: 3 pad+ma ta kṛt+ta h+ya snyi wa bibyu dha ra badz+ra sa ma ya: a be sha ya a ā brgyad pa mchod rdzas byin rlabs ni yin āhu: dbang yul chogs drug 'dod yon lhamo'i sprin dug gsum rnam dag sman gtor rak+ta'i gsos rdo rje rig ma yid 'ong mchod pa'i mchog: thams cad kun khyab rol pa'i ltad mor spel: sa badz+ra spra ra ṇa sa: dgu padam bca' ni ho: 'khor 'das thams cad ye shes chos skur mnyam: log 'khrul dbang gis du ma so sor bzung : da ni lha mchog khyod kyi ngo bor mthong: srog gi phyir yang mi gtong dam du 'dzin: badz+ra sa ma ya tsit+ta aḥhūṃ: bcu pa bshags ba ni ho: tha rnyad mtshan mar 'dzan pa sems kyis nongs: gnyis snang dri ma'i rab rib bag chags kun: dbang chen gsung gi rdo rjer bshags bgyi'o bzod gsol tshangs pa mchog gis dngos grub stsol: bla badz+ra sa ma ya bi shudhe ā de dag sngon du 'gro ba'i chos sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gnyis pa dngos gzhe skyo sab la rnam gra sa bco brgyad sgo nas bstan dang po ti 'dzan rnam gsum ni bla : chos sku mi 'gyur de bzhin nyid kyi klong: ā: longs sku 'gag med kun tu snang ba'i zer: hūṃ: sprul sku mtha'

yas rgyu yi sems dpa' che: trī: 'khor 'das byed po dbang chen gsang ba'i mdzod: o ā hūṃ nyibadz+ra sa ma dhī (: gnyis pa zhing khams bskyed pa ni e: chos dbyingasami'agyur nam mkha'i 1nga yangs su: dbang chen 'degs byed rlung gi dkyil 'khor steng: chags pa rab bsgral rak+ta'i rba 1nga 'khyil: zhing chen sa gzhi khod snyoms yangs par brdal: gnyis snang mun sregs ye shes me lnga 'phyo: tshogs yul gnas dag dur khrod bkod pa rdzogs: dbang phyug ma sring kib dang laṅka 'phro: dug gsum rtsad gcod lce spyang pho nya 'gyed: rngam brjid 'jigs rung khrag 'thung zhing bkod gsal: t+t+waṃ dzñā na maṇ+ḍal e spra ra ṇa phaṭa: se ha ra ṇa hūṃ: gsum pa gzhal yas khang bskyed mi trīḥ rang byung lhun grub ye shes gzhal yas khang:sgod pa'i sku mkhar klad zhag thabs kyis sbyar rak+ta'i chags gdab lha brgyad ka ba dang: klu brgyad gdung ma gza' chen ka zhu bkram: rgyu skar gral kheb nyi zla'i mig tshag mdzes bde ba'i 'dod snam lha mo'i spro bsdu 'gyed: mog 'bras drwa ba lag pa'i mdo 'dzin byas: mi rkang shar bu sgal tshig mda' yab mtshon: tshad med rnam bzhi'i rta babs 'phrin las

ga6/sdo: sgo ri dwags chos nyan chos 'khor gdugs tog mdzes: rnam rgyal rgyal mtshan 'chi med mda' dar dang: bdud dpung zil gnon ru mtshon rnga yab mdzes phyi ni chos nyid zhi ba'i rang bzhin la: nang khang khrag 'thung he ru'i bkod pa rdzogs: t+t+waṃ rat+na maṇ+ḍal e dzñā na tsakra sarba sa ma ya /: bzha pa gdan bskyed ni hrī: rngam brjed thod mkhar dbang gi 'od khyim klong tshogs brgyad gnas dag byol song gtso brgyad khrir: rin chen khri rkang pad zla nyi ma'i steng: gza' klu dregs pa phyi chings bsgol ba'i khar lnga pa la bskyedani rgyu yi yi ge spro bsdus zhu ba las: bdag snang mi shig dbang chen rta mgrin ni: dmar gsal pad+ma rā ga'i lhun po la: nyin phyed 'bum gyis 'khyud pa'i gzi brjid 'bar: garadagu'i nyams rdzogs bde stong 'od gsal sku: zhal gdang ljags 'dril rno dbal mche ba gtsigs: ha hi hū phaṭa nam mkha'i 'brug ltar sgrogs: rgyud brgyad sems kyi rū tra dbyings su bsre: theg pa'i sgo brgyad mtshan ma med par ston: ye shes sa brgyad mnyam pa nyid du sbyor: 'gros dgus gar gyis 'khor 'das mnyam nyid sgrol: g.yas zhal sgrug

nag longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku: lta stangs gzir bas sde brgyad dbang du bsdud drag po'i hūṃ sgras gdug tshogs dam la 'dogs: g.yon zhal dmar nag thabs mkhas sprul ba'i sku: gang 'dul gzigs pas mtshan ma'i gdon tshogs 'thar: bde stong 'dul glus ḍāk+ki las la 'gyed: ye shes thugs kyis gzhan snang mnga' dbang bsgyur: rgyab zhal ljang kus las rnams lhun gyis grub: bya ba mthar phyin bdud rtsi'akhrul bar byed: lta dman zil gnon theg rtse'i dgongs par sbyor: kun kyang thod skam dbu brgyan dar sna'i 'phan nyi zla'i snyan cha rat+na'i rtse phran mjes: dmar ser ral pa g.yas g.yon 'khyil zhing 'phyo: sgra gseb rta zhal rigs lnga'i bzhad glu sgrogs: dug lnga'i 'byung po 'bog brgyal dam la 'dogs: rngog ma le brgyan ye shes me ltar 'bar: chos phung brgyad khris chos can chos skur spyor: phyag brgyad gang 'dul mtshon cha bsnams pa ni nyon mongs rgyun gcod shes rab gri gug dang: bde stong 'ub chub thod khrag thugs gar 'dzin: gzung 'dzin rab gcod shes rab ral gri dang pho nya 'bod pa'i rnge'u chung mkha' la gdengs:

badz+ra: dug gsum gdon tshogs 'thar byed dbyug do dang: bgegs tshogs 'byin gcod spu gri 'bar ba phyar: bde ba'i sgo 'byed nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang: stong nyid mnyam sbyor zla ba bsnol thabs 'dzin: zhabs bzhi bsgrad pasabadud bzhi dbyings su gnon: rdo rje'i gshog pas mtshan ma'i rba rlabs gcod: dur khrod dpal chas dpa' ba'i rtags su bgo ye shes drug rdzogs rus pa'i rgyan cha spras: 'bar ba' 'od zer phyogs bcu kun tu 'phro: dgyes bskyed gar dbang rdo rje phag mo mthing: zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum khro 'dzum sgeg: in+d+ra'i rang bzhin ral ba sku rgyab 'phyangs skra gseb phag skad rur sgras 'khor ba stong: gzig sham rus rgyan me long dril g.yer dang: dar gyi dpyangs pa mi lpags g.yang gzhi klubs: dbu rgyan cod pan rin chen snyan cha mdzes: rtsa phyag gri thod 'dzin zhing yab mgul 'khyud: zhabs g.yon dpa' bo yab kyi sku la btud:g.yas pas 'khor ba'i sgo 'phar dbyings su gnon: zhal sbyor bde ba'i gad rgyang hibo sgrogs: tha ma'i phyag gnyis spu gri snying zhags bsdams: snang stong zung 'dug bde ba'i

dkyil 'khor rdzogs gzhan gyi ma brtsal rang byung lhun rdzogs lha: bde chen 'khor lor 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed: sku mchog lha tshogs ma 'dres lam mer rdzogs: longasaspyod 'khor lor che mchog he ru ga: dbyings phyug yum dang yon tan lha tshogs spro: chos kyi 'khor lor yang dag he ru ga: kro ti shwa ri thugs kyi dkyil 'khor shar: sprul pa'i 'khor lor rdo rje gachen nu dang: 'khor lo rgyas 'debs 'phrin las lha tshogs 'gyed: bde skyongs 'khor lor bla med he ru ga: nyid bzhi mu kha dbyings kyi ma tshogs spro 'bar ba'i 'khor lor dregs pa kun 'dul yab khams gsum spyi 'dul sde dpon sum cu shar: bskyod pa'i 'khor lorastobasaldan nag po dang: 'byung lnga'i bdag mo dregs pa bco brgyad 'khor: ma 'dres rang gsal chu zla 'ja' tshon bzhin: gnyis med zung 'jug bde ba chen por shar: gtsug tor 'khor lor rigs bdag thod phreng rtsal: dmar skrug zhi ma khro 'dzum he ru ga: thod skam dbu rgyan dar gyi cod pan 'phur: rus pa'i rgyan rdzogs gri thod bsnol thabs 'dzin rol ba'i stabs kyis gzhan snang zil gyis gnon rdo

'am rje rnala'abyer thod bum 'dzin dang sbyor: lo paṇa rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ging: nyi rdul 'khrigs ltar sku yi 'od rtser 'gyed: gzhan yang dbang chen gsung gi dkyil 'khor gyi: rtsa khams thig le phra rags bsam yas pa zil gnon khro chen yab yum phyogs skyong sde dmus long rgyab 'brel khyi spyang bcu drug dang: drwa ba gloga'agyu 'brug lnga gsang ba'i ging: dbang chen lha tshogs ma 'dres lam mer rdzogs: kun kyang bde spyor bde ba'i rol rtsed kyis: phyogs bcu'i brnya bo dhi sa twa mchod mkha'adabyings bde gshegs rgyal ba'i zhing khyab bskul: 'khor ba dong sprugs gzi byin nus mthu bkug: dbyer med gcig gyur 'khor 'das spyi dpal shar:don dam ngo sgo chosasku'idakyil 'khor la: rang bzhin ma 'dres longs spyod rdzogs pa'i gter: thugs rje so sor dbye ba sprul ba'i sku: gnyis med zung 'jug rdo rje'i dal du sgom: drug pa dbang bskur ba ni hūṃ hrīX thabs dang shes rab mdzad pas 'gro sgrol phyir bde gshegs ma lus rigs lnga'i skur bzhengs te: rigs mchog ye shes lnga yi dbang bskur nas: dbyer med sku gsung

thugs su rgyas gdab po: a oṃ swā hūṃ snya hūṃḥshāḥpheḥṭ+wāṃ hūṃ sarba a snyi ṣiñtsa cha: kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: dzaX hūm̐ baṃho: bdun pa spyan 'dren ni hūṃ nyi bde stong spros dang bral ba'i pho branganas: dregs pa zil gnon dbang chen he ru ga: rta mgrin rgyal po pad+ma gzi ldan yum: bka' nyan pho nya sras 'khor g.yog dang bcas: rang bzhin dbyings nas gzugs kyi phyag rgyar bzhengs: sgrub mchog byin gyis brlabs phyir gshegs su gsol: nyi ya dregs pa sde brgyad 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: gza' klu rgyal bsen 'joms phyir gshegs su gsol: mtha' dmag dus 'khrug bzlog phyir gshegs su gsol: nad mug mtshon rtse bsgyur phyir gshegs su gsol: rgud pa sna tshogs bsal phyir gshegs su gsol:badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: brgyad pa bzhugs gsol ni hūṃ hrī phungakhams dbang yul yan lag rnam pa bzhi gdan gsum tshang ba'i dam tshig chen po la dbyings nas drangs ba'i ye shes 'khor lo bsre: gnyis med zung 'jag bde ba chen por bathags: dzānasamaya nyija lngan: dgu pa phyag 'tshal na na mo gdod nas rnam dag phyag rba'i dkyil 'khor la: ma

—8/sde: 'gags bde chen gsung gi 'khor lo rdzogs:dri med ka dag ye shes thugs su bzhugs:dbyer med bde ba'i klong la phyag 'tshal lo:ma na mo na ma ho:bcu pa phyi na gas mchod ni hū hrīḥtshogs yul gnas dag rdo rje lha mo yis:mdzes pa'i me tog bdug pa dbang gi me:bde ba'i dri mchog ro bcud ldan pa'i zas dbyings nas bton te ye shes dbyings su 'bul:snang stong zung 'jug rtogs pa'i dngos grub stsol:hrī ༷gzung 'dzin mtshan mas ma gos pho nya yis snang stong me long grags stong taspyo rā tshor stong spos me stong stong ba lirnyi:reg stong pañtsa rig stong chos kyi dbyings:bde ba'i thabs tshul rnam 'phrul mtha' yas pas:dbang chen gsung gi dkyil 'khor dgyesapa bskangs:gsal stong gnyis med rtogs pa'i dngos grub stsol:trī:sgeg mos 'khor 'das bde ba chen por brgyan:glu mas chos nyid stong pa'i rang sgra sgrogs:'gyeng mas chags med pad+ma'i bde ba sbin:gar mas gzung 'dzin mtshan ma dbyings su basbyar:rig mas ye shes bde ba mthar thug sprin:gsang gsum rigs kyis bde dga' mnyam

par 'bul: bde stong zung 'jug rtogs pa'i dngos grub stsol: snye ma hā byu dza garma mu dra sarba sa ma ya ho: bas gcag sman raka gtor mchod na hūṃ hrī rtsa brgyad stong sbyar pañtsa a dṛ ta 'khor 'das mnyam nyid rtogs phyir lha la stobs: chags pa rab bsgral rten 'brel rak+ta'i bcud: khams gsum dbyings su dag phyir lha la stobs: brtan g.yos dpal rdzogs mahā ba lidha: 'dod yon zhen pa dag phyir lha la stobs: dug gsum 'khrul ba dbyings su dag pa dang gsang gsum ye shes rtogs pa'i dngos grub stsol: snye ma hā pañtsa rak+ta ba lirnya khāhi: bcu gnyis glu gar bro mchod ni hūṃ hrīḥ sku ni skye med chos kyi dbyings su sgogs gar ni gzung 'dzin mtshan ma bcom phyir bsgyur: pro ni bar chad bdud bzhi 'dul phyir brdung: rten 'brel brtul zhugs stobs kyi mchod pa rnams: dbang chen pad+ma gsung gi dal du 'bul: yinam hā rā ga ho haṃ ya mi ga sarba sa ma ya ho: bcu gsum sbyor sgrol gyi mchodapa ni hūṃ hri0 thabs dang shes rab bde ba chen por sbor: 'khor lo lnga ru bcu drug phyed phyed basbyar: byang chub sems kyi mchod pa bla na med: zag med ye shes rtogs phyir lha la

—8rdo 7 stobs: hi baṃ: thog mar bdag tu 'dzin pa'i rtog pa bsgral: de nas gnyis med blo yis sems can btul: blo ngan gnas stong bsgral mchod sha rus khrag khams gsum yongs sgrol dbang gi zhal du stobs: e ma tram̐ du tra pra bhan tsakra pra we sha ya phaṭa:mu dra a nu rā ga bho dhi tsit+ta spra ra ṇa phaṭa se ha ra ṇa 〉: sarba pū dza sa ma ya ho: phabazhi de bzhin nyid mchod ni hrī0 'khe ra 'das chos rnams gdod nas rnam par dag: ka dag zang thal spros bral sku gsum ngang nam mkha' la ni mkha' thim ci bzhin du: gnasalugs ye mnyam chen po mchod pa'i mchog: dbang chen gsung gi dkyil 'khor dgyes byir 'bul: chos zad blo bral rtogs pa'i dngos grub stsol: ma ma hā shu n+de ta dzñā na badz+ra sābha wa ad+ma ko3 nya: pū dza ho: bca lnga bstod pa glu mja ni hū nyi bde chen 'bar ba dbang gi dkyil 'khor ni: ma chags pad+ma rā ga'i lhun po la: nyin byed 'bum gyis 'byud pa'i gzimadangs can: dbang chen chags pa'i rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod zhal bzhi'i dkyil 'khor ye shes gzigs stangs can: dbang chen rta tsho lnga sgogs khams gsum 'dul

dregs pa'i spyi rje sde brgyad gdan du bting: 'jigs byed bzod dka'i dpal la phyag 'tshal bstod: rngam bzhad hu lu dgyes pas ma tshogs bskul bde stong hu ya sgrogs pa'i bdun ldan sbyor: gnyis med mnyam pa'i 'od zer zhing kun khyab: dbang chen spro bsdus rgyal la phyag 'tshal bstod:'gros brgyad gom pas theg brgyad zil gyis gnon: bde ba'i 'gros gcig a ti'i dgongs klong skyol sa lam thod rgal rta mchog myur bde'i lam: dbang gi rgyal po he ru ka la bstod phyag brgyad mtshan chas rgyud brgyad rtog pa'ajom: ye shes bzhi dang tshad med rnam pa bzhis: ma rig bdud dpung dbyings su 'thar mdzad pa'i: khro rgyal stobs 'dus lha la phyag 'tshal bstod:bdostong dpal ster rdo rjephag mo yum: gzung 'dzin rtsad gcod gri thod snying zhags stobs dga' bzhi'i dpal sbyin rus rgyan dar dpyangs spras: shes rab bde ba'i dbyings la phyag 'tshal bstod dpa 'a bo'i zhabs bsgrad thog bcas bdud bzhi gnon: sde brgyad dregs pa pho mo stobs su bcir: dug gsum ma rig 'byung po ar la gtad: zil gnon nus mthu'i bdag

—8 : por phyag 'tshal bstod:'bar ba'i 'od zer phyogs bcu kun tu 'phro:rtsa khams bde klong sgrub sde'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs:gnas yul nyer bzhi'i mkha' 'gros rtag tu mchod:rdo rje sku yi yon tan rdzogs la bstod:dbang chen rtsa lha ma 'dres til gong bzhin:rigs bdag bde ba'i sku can thod 'phreng rtsal dug gsum gdon 'dul sdig khyung phag nag 'phro:yongs rdzogs ye shes gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod:ye shes gzigs pa'i spyan ldan bla ma dang:khams gsum rol pa dbang chen ya dam lha:bde stong dga' bzhi'i dpal ster wa ra hi:tha tshig gtsug 'dzin pho nyar bcas la bstod:bcu drug 'dzab kyi 'brul 'bar na hū hrī bdag nyid dbang chen rtsa ba'i thugs ka na ye shes sems dpa' tshon gang he ru ga'i thugs klong nyi ste rā ga'i rdo rje ni:nas tsam lte bar nyi zla kha sbyor sbubs rig pa hrīX hū sgog mthar sngags kyis bskor:bzlas pas gzung 'dzin sgrib tshogs sbyangs ba dang:khams gsum dbang bsgyur rta yi brtul zhugs mthong:he ru ka dpal gsang gsum mngon gyur dmigs:sa pad+ma kro ta h+ya hṝ wa trī ba

sarba sirnyi hūṃ: bzlas sngags chu bo' gzhung ltar bzla 'phro 'du 'phrin las rno la drangs 'khor 'das yongs kyi dbang byin bstim grangs tshad 'bru 'bum gnad thang na dge ba'i ltas mtshan bzang por bcas grub pa' rtagasa'abyung sa ma yu brgya bdun sgrub pa'i 'dzab dmags ni hūṃ hrīḥ sngags kyi'aphradang ba bde ba'i gzi byin can yab yum zhal gsang bar brgyud dga' bzhi'i sprin rtsa khams rgyud sde rgya mtshoraspel khyab 'phrul: sku gsung thugs yon 'brin las rgya mtsho bskangs: dbang byin dngos grub zag med bde stong ngang: mngon gyur bskur thob bral bar gdeng rnyed nas: donaganyis lhun gyis grub pa'i mthu thob bsam: snye pad+ma pa ta h+ya hṝ wa hrī baṃ mahā su kha sto dhi cit+ta sarba sidhi pha la hūṃ yas sgrub bsnyen chu bo'i gzhung ltar bzla smra bcad ting 'dzan ldan pa skes 'bum phragabadun bzlas nyams rtog 'bar don gnya lhun grub the tshom med sa ma mā bas brgyad las spyor bzlas dmagasani hūṃ rdo dbang chen gsung ge dkyil 'aXrgor gsal ba yi: sku gsung thugs las sprulaba'i khro tshogs dang: drag sngags me 'phreng ye shes mtshon cha'i char: bya khyung lcags sdig phag nag mgo dgu pa: dpag yas 'phros te rgyal bsen bdud bgeg sri smon log

—8/sde: 'byung po 'tshe byed zhing bcu'i dgra: ma lus thal ba'i rdul bzhin brlag byas te sha khrag sgog dbugs hab hab grum grum rol: rjes lhag mes bsregs ye shes chu yis bkrus lhag ma spu gri rlung gis gtor byas te: mi gnas chos nyid stong ba'i 'khor lor sangs: snang grags rig gsum dbang chen he ru ga'i: gsang gsum ye shes rol bar dag smin rdzogs: gang snang ma bcos bde stong spros bral ngang: gla dzñā na pañtsa kro ta bṛ he ru ka hrīḥbaṃḥkhya shrī wa badz+ra wa ra hi ma hā kro ta shrī he ru ka ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ oṃ pra sod chu sod: dur ta sod: dur mi sod: lhog pa sod: sa srin sod: sarba tur ta sod: gnyan mgo la chod: kha la dza: sgog la ram̐: snying la ye: tsit+ta tsig tsig: slo zim tha ra ti pa dudhe dz+wa la ram̐ pa ye swā hā: las sngags bye ba gcig bsgrangs na nus mthu nam mkha'i mtha' da mnyam bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi' nad rnams thub sto phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs rnams gzhes dus min 'chi ba'i g.yul ngo bzlog gang la btab kyang dmigs don 'grub rno nus nam mkha'i thog las che bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsal sa ma yu dngos gzhi rnal 'byor lam gya ram sku gsung thugs su sgrub pa'o rgya rgya rgya de nas rjes kyi rim

pa la rnam grangs nyi shu'i sgo nas bstan dang po tshogs kyi che brjod ni sha lnga bdud rtsi gtsor gyur bas sga da sbod rags ma dwa na me sa bha la gal phye sogs dum gcig snod du bsags byas te sha chen gsur btang zhun me sbar rnal 'byor lta ba'i gdeng bskyed te hū nyi dur khrod gsang chen rol ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gzhung bzhin bkod byas te: sgrub rdzas gnyan po tshul ltarabakram pa ni: mahā me sa'i longs spyod ri ltar brjed: ma hā rak+ta'i rang bzhin mtsho ltar bskyil: ma hā tsit+ta sna tshogs rdza ltar snyil: ma hā ko ni ri ti khrol bur brdal mahā galaphye'i tshogs ni phye ltar spungs: rdo rje tshe zan pad+ma'i mdangs kyis 'khyud: dag byed las chus chab sbyar byang sems bskyil sha chen lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga yis brgyan rnam rtogamatshan mas ma gos ro mnyam dal: ye shes bde ba mchog gi dga' ston rdzas: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dgyes pa'i dbyid du spel: hū nyi stong chen yangs pa'i bhan+ta phu 'khora'adas dpal yon tshogs su shar: dbang chen rta phag dgyes phyir bshams rten 'brel 'byung 'dus dkyil 'khor tu: ye shes bde ba bcud kyi gtams: rta phag dkyil 'dor

(6sdo: dgyes phyir bkod:mchog tu mi 'gyur da la sadri med 'od gsal thig le'i bkang:dbang chen rta phag dgyes phyir bshams gnyis med bde ba chen por 'bul:/ trīḥrtsa brgyad stong sbyar sbreng ba yang ma dang mkha' 'gro brten phyir 'bul:dam rdzas gtor chen bshams pa yang:ma dang mkha' 'gro brten phyir 'bul:bhan+ta rak+tas bkang ba yang:ma dang mkha' 'gro brten phyir 'bul:rkang gli thod rnga rol mo'i tshogs:ma dang mkha' 'gro brten phyir 'bul:zhing g.yang rdo rje g.yab dar yang ma dang mkha' 'gro brten phyir 'bul:bshug glu bde stong pheg rdob pa:ma dang mkha' 'gro brten phyir 'bul:gzung 'dzin thad gcod brtul zhugs kyang:ma dang mkha' 'gro brten phyir 'bul:snang srid ro mnyam rtogs pa yang:ma dang mkha' 'gro brten phyir 'bul:bde stong dga' bzhi'i rol ston kyang:ma da mkha' 'gro brten phyir 'bul khams gsum mkha' ru sbyor ba yang:ma dang mkha' 'gro brten phyir 'bul chos nyid mnyam pa'i mchod pa yang :ma dang mkha' 'gro brten phyir 'bul 〉 hrīḥtshogs kyi bkod

pa sha sna snying sna stong:tshogs kyi che ba sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga:tshogs kyi ngo bo ye shes lnga yi gsang tshogs kyi rang bzhin byang chub sems su gnas:tshogs kyi dga' ston lha mi'i 'du ba rgyas:tshogs kyi dgongs pas kun bzang yab yum bskul:tshogs kyi mdzad pas 'khor ba dong sprugs byed:tshogs kyi gzigs mas bde mchog bde bar bskul:tshogs kyi thugs rjes theg dman rtogs pa bskyed:ngo mtshar tshogs kyi dga' ston brjod las 'das a la la ho:hūṃ hrīḥkun gzhi ka nas dag pa'i chos nyid la:yid dpyod sgro btags mtshan ma'i chos kun dben:ye nas gnyis med mnyam pa'i dkyil shāX ra gyis:dbang chen gsung gi lha tshogs thugs dam bskang:gnyis pa tshogs sa byan brlabs ni oṃ sarba pra phyam shā dha ni hūṃ phaṭa spyo hrīḥngang nyid bde ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor nas:'bar ba'i 'od zer bde ba'i gzi byin gyis:tshogs kyi daro sa 'dzin mtshan ma bsregs smrangs bkrus:bde stong zag med ye shes bdud rtsir spel: ram̐ ye khe:tshe uts+tsha:'khor 'das yongs khyab zag med bdud rtsi'i sprin:gang 'dod mos ngor snang ba ye shes
