—8rdo: 'phrul: yid dpyod blo yis mi dpog zad mtha' bral chos nyid mnyam pa'i brtul zhugs maho: gsum pa tshogs zhing spyan 'dren na hūṃ hrī mi gnas mi dmigs chos kyi dbyings nyid las: bde gshegs zhi khro'i bkod pa bsam mtha' yas: don dam bde ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor la: ris chad mtshan ma'i spros pa rnam dag kyang/khams gsum rol rtsed rta yi brtul zhugs can dbang chen bdemachog pad+ma gsung gi lha: 'du ba tshogs kyi 'khor lor spyan 'dren gshegs: rmad byung bde ba mchog gi thigaler bzhugs: dri med dgongs pa'i dam bskang bzod gsol bzhes:yin pad+ma kro ta hrībaṃbidu dha ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: bzhi pa tshogs phud 'bul ba ni yin āhu:snod ba da dpal 'phyor ye shes bdud rtsir shar: sha lnga bdud rtsi che ba'i mchog chen po: dbang chen gsung gi dkyil 'khor dgyes phyir 'bul: bde stong zag med ye shes dngos grub stsal:yo ma hā ga ṇa tsakra byu dza khāhi: lnga pa bshags pa ni ho: blo chung rtog pa dman pa'i las dbang gis: snang srid chos sku yin par ngo ma shes: lhan skyes dbang chen gsung gi zhal ma

mjal gnyis 'dzin sems kyis nongs pa mtha' dag bshags badz+ra sa ma ya bhi shud+dhi pha drug pa tshogs bsgral ni hūṃ bh+yo dbang chen zla gam e yi dkyil 'khor nas: bdud dpung zil gnon pad+ma gsung gi sku: che ba'i stobs rdzogs rta yi brtul zhugs can zhing bcu bsgral ba'i las la ma g.yel zhig: / hūṃ bstan dang 'gro la 'tshe ba'i dgra bdud bgegs: rno mtshon shes rab ral gris thal mar 'byin: sgrib med ye shes thugs rjes dbyings su spor: nga bdag mtshan 'dzin chos nyid 'khor lor gzhom: khye /: sarba rū tra mā ra ya phaṭa bdun pa bstab pa ni hūṃ hrī bdag 'dzin du dra bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus drod dbugs phung khams skye mched ma lus pa: mnyam nyid bde stong gsag ba'i klong du bstabs: 'khrul ba ka nas dag phyir 'ub chub rol sarba sha hūṃ mā ra ya phaṭa kha ram̐ khāhi brgyad pa lhag ma ni bh+yo: dang po phud kyis mi mchod rgyu dbang chen lha tshogs phud la dgyes bar du tshogs la mi rol rgya: rgyad sde'i dkyil 'khor tshogs la dgyes tha ma lhag mas mi brngan rgya: dbang phyag ma sring lhag la dgyes: de gnyis gcig tu mi bsre rgya: chos

—8rdo: nyid ye nas rgyu 'bras gcig lhag ma kha chus mi bran rgyu: khyod dang nga gnyis tha tshig gcig: dkyil 'khor mtha' la mi bzhag rgyu: bran g.yog pho mo'i tshul du gnas bh+yo: khrag 'thung pad+ma dbang chen he ru ga'i: spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas tha tshig can: dbang phyug ma sring ging lang 'bar ma rnams: pham 'bab bka' yi lhag gtor 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor sgrub pa po yi 'phrin las sgrubs: rlung sems las rung rtogs pa mngon gyur stsol: phyu ma ma hring ma ma hring uṣ+ṭi ṭa bha lirnya khahi: dgu pa bskul ba na hūṃ hrīḥ dbus mtha' med pa chos kyi dbyings nyid las: bde gshegs rigs 'dus pad+ma gsung gi lha: che ba'i stobs rdzogs rta yi brtul zhugs can: du tra sgrol ba'i dpa' rtags ngar skad 'don: brtse chen thugs rjes khams gsum chos la sbyor: pad+ma he ru'i thugs dam gnad nas bskul: brgyan pa'i mchod gtor dam pa 'di bzhes la: dam sri rū tra 'dul ba'i phrin las mdzod: bcu pa go mdo ni hā bh+yo sngon tshe 'das dus bskal ba'i dang po la: bcom ldan dbang chen pad+ma he ru gas: rta skad dgu bton dregs pa dbang du

bsdus:rang rang sgog gi snying po phul nas su gsang sngags bstan pa srung bar ma chad dam:gtsug lag 'dus sde skyongs bar ma chad dam:sgrub pa'i bar chad bzlog par mchad dam: sbyin bdag bde legs sbyor bar ma chad dam:sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam la ma 'da' bar:sha khrag brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:rnal 'byer bcol ba'i'aphrin las grub par mdzod hūṃ spyodo'og bar kyi dus tshig gnyis pa la:dur khrod ro gling bsil ba'i tshal chen du:slob dpon chen po klu sgrub snying po yis:dgongs pasagazir tshe bde byed brtsegs pa nas mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul zangs sgrom dmar po phul: dbang chen zhal phyes rta yi brtul zhugs kyis: phyi nang gsang ba'i dregs pa kunabasdus te bka' yi bstan pa srung ba'i gnyer byang gtad:ma 'ongs sangs rgyas thob par lung bstan gnang:de tshe rang rtags srog snying mngon phul nas:gsang sngags bstan pa srung bar ma chad dam:gtsug lag 'dus sde skyongs bar ma chad dam:sgrub pa'i bar chad bzlog par ma chad dam:sprin bdag bde legs spror bar ma chad dam:sngon tshe zhal

bam/: bzhes dam la ma 'da' bar:sha khrag brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod:/ 1de 'og bar gyidus tshig gsum pa la:gangs ljongs bod khams gdul byar bab pa'i tshe:mkhan slob chos rgyal sprul pa'i lo paṇa gyis gsang sngags bshad sgrub bstan pa'i gzhi btsug tshe dbang chen bka' bab rgyal ba mchog dbyang gis rta rkad gtsug bton dregs pa dbang sdud tshe:dbang phyug ma sring pho nya dam can rnams:dam btags srog phul bstan pa'iganyer gtad tshe:gsang sngags bstan pa bsrung bar ma chad dam sogs gong bab 'gre'o grub par mdzod:hū bh+yo de 'og bar kyi dus tshig bzhi pa la:rang byung ston pa pad+ma saṃbha was:gangs can bod khams gter kyis phan bde mdzad:gsang sngags sgrub sde mo yi bka' rtsis btab:mi 'gyur rang bsrel brda yi ris su bkod sku gsung thugs rten bstan 'gro'i btsas su bzhag:de tshe gnyer bya thob pa'i dregs tshogs kyis:zab gsang rdor snying bstan pa gtsug tu bkur:de 'dzin 'dus sde zhabs tog sbyin bdag bcas

gnyer bcol srung ba'i dam tshig mnos pa bzhin ma g.yel 'phrin las gnyer skyong dam tshig sgrubs khyad par phyi dang bye brag nang rgyud kyi:gsang sngags bstan pa srung bar ma chad dam:sogs 'gre'o grub par mdzod:hū spyodeng dus snyegs ma'i rtsub 'gyur gzengs skabs su rngam brjid rnga yab dpal gyi ri bo nas rgyal mchog zlos garanus ldan rdo rje yis:'od gsal snying po'i klong brda bkrol ba'i tshe dbyings kyi ma lnga skyes bu ging drug gis:srog snying mngon phul tha tshig dam blang skabs:zab gter bstan pa srung bar ma chad dam gtsug lag 'dus sde skyongs bar ma chad dam:sogs 'gre'o grub par mdzod:bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā bcu gcig gtor ma zor brgyur ni hūṃ bye dbang chen gsung ne+e lha tshogs dpang sor bzhugs:pho nya dam can rgya mtsho dmag la sbran:ma nyes drang mkhan rnams kyis shan 'byed mdzod:dpal gyi gtor chen mtshon cha 'bar ba 'di gang la gzas tshad thal ba rdul brlag byed:mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las zab mo 'di:bstan pa'i dgra dang gnod byed bgegs la bzor:myur mgyogs

/'di: rdzu 'phrul stobs rtsal ma g.yel bar: dgra la bab na bdun rgyud rtsad nas chod: bgegs la bab na thal ba rdul du rlog sri la bab na ming tsam med par mdzod: thugs dam dus la bab po sa ma yā: ka la rū pa thun ya thun ya: zor ya zor ya: dgra bgegs gnod byed mā ra ya rbad sod: gtor ma dgra bo'i phyogs su rdebs bcu gnyis bstanagator 'bul ba ni hū bh+yo: bod khams skyong ba'i gnyer thob dam tshig can: rdo rje kun drag gangs kyi g.yu bun dang dpal ldan ha ri 'brog chen 'khor 'dul ma: btsan la rol mdzad shugs ldan la ro sman: drag mo rgyal dang sman btsun ug chos dpal:rdo rje g.yar mo bde sbyin gzugs legs ma: drag mo rgyal dang dam ldan ting lo sman: kong btsun de mo la sogs dam tshig can: bstan ma bcu gnyis ya ma skyongs pa'i tshogs: dpon g.yog sna tshogs 'du ba rgya mtsho bcas sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir skad cig yud tsam byon tha tshig chad tho zab mo dran gyis la: dbu 'phang dma' bzhin bshos skyems brngan bzhes la: bod khams bde skyid ldan pa'i 'phrin las mdzod: mtha' yi dmag bzlog dus kyi

rgud pa sol: bshad sgrub bstan pa'i zhabs tog mthun rkyen sbyor: zab gter sgron me mi nub dar rgyas mdzod: bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā: ma ma sring 'gro ma e rda bha lirnya kha kha khahi khā hi: brgya gsum rta bro ni hūṃ trīḥ dbang chen e klong gdengs ba'i mkha' dbyings su ma rig dug lnga 'dus pa'i phung khams brub: stobs chen ye shes rta yi brdul zhugs kyis: gzung 'dzin mtshan ma skye med ar la gtad: rang byung ye shes byang chub sems thob par: g.yo med bde ba chen por rgyas gdab so: sa lo yisale hūṃ le: swā le: hā le: s+t+waṃ bha ya: mā ra ya nam nan brgya bzhi dngos grub zhu ba ni hū trī skye med chos sku spros pa med mod kyang: rang bzhin 'gag med bde ba chen por bzhugs thugs rje rtsol bral mos ldan mthun snang ngor: thun mong mchog gi dngos grub rgya mtsho stsol: sarba sirnyi pha la a la la ho: bco lnga bzod gsol ni ho: lta ba dman pas rgyu 'bras mtshan mar bzung sgom yun thung bas gsal snang ting 'dzin g.yel: spyod pa tho cos re dwogs rtsis gdab 'chol: 'bras bu yid smon gyur ba mthol lo bshags: badz+ra sa ma ya āḥ brgya drug bsngo ba ni

—8/sde: ho zag dang zag med dge ba ji bsags pa: mkha' khyab 'gro ba yid can yongs la bsngo: phyam gcig ma rig dgongs rgya rab grol te gzhon nu bum sku'idagongs klong byang chub shog: bcu bdun smon lam ni ho: snang srid rnam dag pad+ma he ru ga'i: gsang gsum ye shes rol bar dag smin rdzogs: 'jig rten srid pa'i gdos po yongasagrol nas: he ru ka dpal lhums su dbang bsgyur re ga bco brgyad rtag mtha' bsal ba ni ā: btag pa'i chos dang bskyed pa'i 'khor lo kun: rim bsdus khrag 'thung sku gsungathugs su 'khyil: de yang chos nyid 'od gsal thig le'i klong: mtha' bral de bzhin nyid du mnyam par bzhag: ayi bcu dgu chad mtha' bsal ba ni ho: slar yang mkha' las glog 'od 'khyug pa bzhin: gsal snang ye shes sgyu ma lta bu yi: 'gro ba 'dren pa'i spyod lam rnam dag gis: don gnyis yid bzhin 'byung ba'i thabs la 'badaḥ phaṭa phaṭa: nyishushisabarjod ni na mo: bde stong spros bral dbang chen gsung gi dal: lhan skyes ye shes dzñā na wa ra hi bcu drug rol rtsed rgyud sde'i 'khor lor sad: rang byung bde ba chen po'i shis

pa stsol: kun khyab nam mkha' dpe med bsam brjod bral ye shes rdo rje sems rtog dri mas dben: gnyis med thig le chos sku'i dgongs nyams ste gnas lugs spros dngabral ba'i bkra shis shog: tha snyad rten 'brel srid pa'i 'khor lo na sangs rgyas bstan pa'i nyi 'od phyogs mthar khyab: skye rgu'i bde skyid rdzogs ldan ltar 'phel rgyas: bshadasgrub 'khor los 'tsho ba'i bkra shis sgo ga nyin yang bkra shis dpal 'bar bde stong spyod: mtshan yang bkra shis dpal 'bar 'od gsal skyongs: rtag par bkra shis dpala'abar bskyed chenags sgob: bkra shis kun gyis rtag tu mdzes gyur cig: gzhan yang shis brjod rgya cher bya des ni don gnyis lhun gyas grub bar chad bdud kyi g.yul las rgyal tshe 'dir rig 'dzan sa la sbyor sa ma yā rjes kyi las rim tshangs pa'o rgya rgya rgya mim rgyal ba'idabang po pad+ma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la shin tu brtse sems kyis snying dang 'dra ba'i yang zab med byung ba grub palidabang phyug 'brog ban khyod la gtad da dung spel ba'i dus la ma bab pas rin chen bdo la bstems shigasar rdzu ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus rgyal mtshag sprul pa nus ldan rdo rje yis mdo khams bkra shis tsa ri ṭa nas rnyed bstan pa'i rgud pa 'khrug rtsod

— mi: cha shas bzlog dus kyi rgud pa nad yams mu ge sel 'gro don 'phrin las rma smad phyogs su rgyas don gnyis lhun gyisagrub pa'i rten 'brel yod bka' 'di thub par srungs shig: ma ra:dam med lagatu ma shor a tham rgya sa ma wā rgya rgya rgya rtsa sgrub bdud dpu zil gnon rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pa d+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa 'o brda thim ñtsā zhes pa 'di yang lu zin chos kyi bdag poshu ga sprul ran po che pad+ma bsod nams grub pa' rdo rjes bkra shis lha reg gser mdog gos bzang bde bar gshegs pa 'a sku gsung thugs kyi rten ya mtshan can gyi skyes bzangapo dang bcas bskul ba dang dbang chen a yi yul gru skyongs ba'i rgyal po zung gis bskul ba rtag rten 'grel bzang por mthong nas re bo rgyal mchog bshad pa rtsal gyis mdo khams tsa ri tra yi gnas mdun nas mkha' 'gro'igasang brda dag par phab pa 'i ye ge pa ni chos kyi bdag po nyid kyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel sarba ma le/

—'di: bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul ba ni oṃ ā〉: bde chen gsung gsang pad+ma 'bum sprin 'khyugs: dbang gi lcags kyus 'gro khams kha lo bsgyur: bde gshegs kunagyi gsung gi rdo rje che: dri med ye shes 'od snang mtha' yas la: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul mthu dbang tshe dang chos kyi dngos grub stsol: snying rje chen posa'agro khams kha lo bsgyur: byams dang brtse bas gang 'dul mdzad thabs mkhas ye shes gzigs pas bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel: dri bral pad dkar phyag na 'chang mdzad la rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul mthu dbang tshe dang chos kyi dngos grub stsol: dha na ko sha'i mtsho gling pad sdong rtser: ya mtshan mchog brnyes rgyal tshab sprul ba'i sku nang rgyud sde gsum bstan pa'i mdzod 'chang ba mi mjed skyabs mgon pad 'byung gangs can mtshor: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul: mthu dbang tshe dang chos kyi dngos grub stsol: bde gshegs 'dus pa'i bka' bab rig 'dzin brgyad: man ngag mdzod brnyes 'bangs su bu dgu dang: las 'phro dag pa'i zab gter mdzod 'dzin pa:

bdud 'dul rnam lnga dri med rnam gnyis la rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul: mthu dbang tshe dang chos kyi dngos grub stsol: dam tshig dbang dang man ngan lung gnang zhing nyams chags skong zhing shes rgyud grol mdzad pa'i brgyud pa'i bla ma byin rlabs char 'bebs dang: rtsa ba'i bla ma bka' drin gsum ldan la: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul: mthu dbang tshe dang chos kyi dngos grub stsol: zla gam dgu rdzogs pad+ma dbang gi dal rgyud sde'i mkha' 'gro rdo rje rnal 'byor ma: bde stong char 'beb sprul 'khor rgya mtsho dang: las mdzad pho nya 'phrin las mdzod 'dzin la: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul: mthu dbang tshe dang chos kyi dngos grub stsol: ma hā sarba pañtsa adṛ ta kha re khā hi: sa lce yi dam tshig rdo rje pad+mo las: rdo rje spyan gyi gsang bar hūṃ:sgom ste: thabs shes dwangs ma mtheb srin rtse sbyar nas: gnyis su med par blang te nyams myong bas: mchog thun dngos grub rgya mtsho dus 'dir (65: kā ya sirnyi tho: wāk+ka sirnyi a: tsit+ta sirnyi /: sarba sidhi hrīḥ de ltar dbang blang dngos grub thob nyams rtogs yon tan 'phel

—rte/na rgyas 'gyur sa ma pā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda them sna zhes chos bdag pad+ma' mtshan can zung ga bskul rnga ra nus ldan rngal pa' rdo rjes smras ta yo rga pa na mi pas bgyas pa dge'o/sarba ma la/

—'di gto lugs gi dus su daro sa grub zhu ba ni hū trī0 zla gam dgu rdzogs pad+ma 'bum 'khyil klong: bde stong mkha' 'gro bsam yas nye ba'i gnas: o rgyan rang byung mkha' mnyam dkyil bshesar nas: rū tra bsgral ba'i dpa' rtags gtsug rgyan 'chang: dbang gi zhal bzang pad+ma he ru ga: bsnyen sgrub mos pa'i bu la nye bar dgongs: 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub char ltar phob: lha dang skal ba mnyam par byin gyis rlobs: rtsa sngags mthar kā ya sirnyi sa: wāk+ka sirnyi āX tsit+ta sidhi shā: sarba sirnyi trīḥ zhes daro sa grub rol b.rabya'o 'di ya gter ston ra gis sbyar ba'o/
badz+ra: zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: dbang chen bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal gyi dgos chos:bshags pa ye shes sgon me ma rig mun sel bzhugs so:

—8rdo: na mo gu ru pad+ma kwa ra ya: ga〉〉 shin tu bde ba mchog gi gzi byin can 'bar ba'i khro rgyal rta skad bzhad la 'dud rnal 'byor gsang za sgor zhugs pho mo la dam tshag gas lngos skyon dang bral ba'i phyir zhi khro rab 'byams mdun gya nam mkhar gsal smre sngags bton la gnong 'grod sems kyis bshags sgrib bral dri med 'od kyi phung por 'gyur nyams rtogs mkha' ltar rgyas pa'i dgos pa che sa ma yu e ma nyo rang mdun nam mkhar 'ja' 'od thig le'i klong: bde gshegs zhi khro rab 'byams sras 'khor bcas: ma 'dres lam mer gsal ba de dag gi: mkhyen brtse nus pas bdag la dgyes dgongs dmigs: nyo ye nas dri med chos skur byang chub pa: kun bzang yab yum klong la phyag 'tshal lo: nyon mongs gti mug 'khrul ba rnam dag pa'i: bde gshegs rnam snang sku la phyag 'tshal lo gdos mtshan zhe sdang rtog pa rnam dag pa'i bcom ldan rdo rje sems la phyag 'tshal lo 'khrul rtog nga rgyal mtshan ma rnam dag pa'i:jen chen 'byung ldan sku la phyag 'tshal lo: 'du shes 'dod chags rtog pa rnam dag pa'i: gsung mchog snang mtha' yas la phyag 'tshal lo: 'du byed phrag dog g.yo ba rnam dag

(6/sdo: pa'i:rgyal ba don yod grub la phyag 'tshal lo:'byung ba nam mkha'i rang bzhin rnam par dag:dmigs med dbyings phyug ma la phyag 'tshal lo:gsher zhing bskyod pa chu khams rnam dag pa'i:yum mchog ma mā ki la phyag 'tshal lo:sra zhing 'thas pa'i sa khams rnam dag pa'i:mnyam nyid sangs rgyas spyan la phyag 'tshal lo:tsha zhing bsregs pa'i me khams rnam dag pa'i:yum mchog gso dkar mo la phyag 'tshal lo:yang zhing g.yo ba rlung khams rnam dag pa'i:shes rab dam tshig sgrol la phyag 'tshal lo rnam shes tshogs brgyad mtshan ma rnam dag pa'i:byang chub sems dpa' brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo:'byung khams yul brgyad rtog pa rnam dag pa'i:sems ma chen mo brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo:nyon mongs dug lnga ser sna rnam dag pa'i:bcom ldan thub pa drug la phyag 'tshal lo:rtag chad bdag mtshan rtog pa rnam dag pa'i:sgo ba chen po bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo:skye gnas bzhi yi mtshan ma rnam dag pa'i lcags zhags sgrog dril ma la phyag 'tshal lo:nyon mongs las kyi gnas rnams stong mdzad pa'i:sbor byed chen mo brgyad

la phyag 'tshal lo: bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis ye shes 'od kyi sku: gdos por bzung ba'i mtshan 'dzin dri ma dang tha rnyad chos su bcos pa'i nongs pa kun: ye shes thugs kyi dbyings su bzod par gsol gol sgrib rtog pa'i dri ma mthol lo bshags gnyis med chos kyi sku yis bzod par bzhes: sgrib bral mkha' ltar dag pa'i dngos grub stsol: a la la ho: rde ma rig rū tra dbyings su bsgral mdzad pa'i che mchog he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo lhan skyes bag nyal dri ma bsal mdzad pa'i: gnam zhal dbyings phyug ma la phyag 'tshal lo: nyon mongs 'khrul ba ka nas dag mdzad pa'i: khrag 'thung he ru bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo: ye shes bzhi yis chos kun mnyam nyid ston kro ti shwa ri bzhi yum la phyag 'tshal lo: gnas brgyad chos kyi dbyings su 'thar mdzad pa'i: ko'u ri khro mo brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo: yul brgyad bkod pa bde ba chen por bsre seng ha phra men brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo: kun rtog mtshan ma dbu ma'i dbyings su bcom: dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo: tshad med rnam bzhis 'khor ba dbyings su sgrol: ye shes sgo ma bzhi

—8/de la phyag 'tshal lo:rang snang rnam dag khrag 'thung drug cu'i dal:gud na mi dmigs 'od gsal rig pa'i mdangs:ma rtog mtshan 'dzin blo yis bcos pa'i nongs:chos nyid mnyam pa chen po'i klong du bshags:sgro btags kun rtog 'khrul ba rnam dag nas:kun khyab chos sku'i klong du byang chub shog:a la la ho:ho:'khor 'das bde klong pad+ma gsung gi dal:dbang chen he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo:chags pas ma gos ye shes mnyam nyid gsang:rdo rje phag mo yum la phyag 'tshal lo:thabs dang shes rab 'phrin las rgya mtsho 'gyed bka' nyan pho nya zung la phyag 'tshal lo:sde brgyad dregs pa ma lus 'dul mdzad pa'i zil gnon khro chen brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo:ma rig bdud bzhi'i mtshan ma ra sar sgrol las byed sgo ba bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo:mtshan 'dzin dam sri bdud bgegs 'thar mdzad pa'i gsung gi bka' sdod rnams la phyag 'tshal lo:gsang mchog ye shes dbang gi dkyil 'khor kun ye nas gnyis med bde chen ngang du rdzogs ma rig dbang gis mtshan ma so sor bzung:thams cad chos kyi dbyings su

mthol lo bshags: sgrib med tshang pa mchog gi dngos grub stsol: a la la ho: ho: dngos kun bdud rtsir 'byung ba'i gzhi gcig pu: che mchog he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo: rngam sems rlangs por spyod pa kun 'dul ba'i: 'jam dpal sku yi lha la phyag 'tshal lo: ma rig gtum sems g.yo ba'i gdug pa 'dul: yang dag thugs kyi lha la phyag 'tshal lo:snang srid dngos mtshan shes rab dgongs pa'i 'dul: thal 'byin 'phrin las lha la phyag 'tshal lo: rigs mchog bde ba ye shes dbyings su bsre: bla med he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo: dkyil 'khor kun gyi 'byung gnas dbang phyug dpal: rig 'dzin rdo rje chos la phyag 'tshal lo: stobs mchog dregs pa'i gzhan snang zil gyis gnon: mchod bstod dregs pa'i gtso la phyag 'tshal lo: 'phrin las mi nub thabs mang mdzad pa can: dmod pa drag sngags lha la phyag 'tshal lo: sangs rgyas bstan srung zhing bcu'i sgog dbugs sdud bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: sgrub sde'i dkyil 'khor rang byung rang la rdzogs: ye nas gnyis med thig ler byang chub kyang: rtog pa'i dbang gis du ma so

badz+ra: sor bzung: mnyam nyid chos kyi dbyings su bzod par gsol: sgrib bral mkha' ltar dag par mdzad du gsol: a la la ho: ho: sangs rgyas nyag gcig gsang ba chen po la: sku gsum lhun gyis grub pa'i rang bzhin las: log btags 'khor ba'i chos rnams ka dag kyang: 'on kyang ma rig gsum gyi rdul bslad te: snod bcud brtan g.yo mtshan ma so sor bzung phan gnod re dogs nyer len a 'thas gol rtag chad bdag mtshan dge sdig yul du bzungs de yi rang bzhin kun rdzob rten 'brel tsam: sgyu mas bslus te so thar 'dul khrims nyams: rtog pas kha brid byang sems bslab bya ral: nyon mongs log 'khrul dbang gis dam tshag nyams: ma lus chos nyid mnyam pa'i ngang du bshags: snang srid bla ma'i dkyil 'khor zhal ma 'jal: rtsa ba'i dam tshag nyer bdun srung ma nus mched lcam ye sangs rgyas pa ngo ma shes: tha snyad 'khrul ba'i dbang gis brtse gdung g.yel: 'gro kun pha ma yin par thag ma chod: chags sdang 'khrugs rtsod byas nas rang gal 'phyan: sngags gsum phyag rgya bzhi ru ye bzhugs kyang:

thams cad dngos po sems kyis mtshan mar bzung: spyad par bya ba'i dam tshig rnam pa lnga mi dge thabs kyi spyod pa ngo ma shes: bsgrub par bya ba'i dam tshig rnam pa lnga: rang la ye gnas rdzogs pa'i tshul ma mthong shes par bya ba'i dam tshig rnam pa lnga: ye nas gnyis med chen po'i don ma rtogs: dang du len bya'i dam tshig rnam pa lnga: ro mnyam bdud rtsi'i spyod pa bsre ma thub mi spang ba yi dam tshig rnam pa lnga: nyon mongs log par bzung te 'du shes 'byul: snang srid med pa'i chos nyid mtshan mar bzung: rig pa gcig klong sems kyi smag gis bslad: bar med byul ba a 'thas dri mas sgrib: lhun grub sku dang ye shes don ma rtogs: srung dang mi bsrung spyi dang khyad par lhag: gang yang sems kyi dbang gis rdul bslad pa gnong zhing 'gyod sems drag pos mthol lo bshags: lta ba mkha' ltar dag pa'i dbyings su bshags: sgom pa nyi ltar gsal ba'i ngang du bshags:spyod pa 'ja' ltar bkra ba'i 1nga du bshags: 'bras bu sangs rgyas nyag gcig dgongs par bshags bshags bya bshags byed gnyis med ka nas dag gnas lugs rig

ra mi: rdo/nga cherdogs pa chen lnga ra yis de ltar phyag 'tshal bshags pa yis dam tshag nyams chags nyes lhung kun sgrib bral tshangs pa mchog thob nas rig 'dzan sa la nges par 'byon sa ma yu ye ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha was ma 'o sa 'gro la shin tu brtse sems kyis thugs kyi yang bcud rdo rje snying mo 'i skor grub pa 'i dbang phyug 'brog ban lo tsā dang dbang chen bka' bab rgyal ba mchog dbyangs la dam tshag gnyer byang pha phog zab mo gtad da du spel ba'i dus la ma bab pa sa ran chen brda la bstems shig sar bye mdo khams bkra shis rjong du dgongs bra sdoms ma 'ongasasnyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus dpa' bo khyed zung sprul pa las ldan gyis rnyed nas bstan da 'gro ba'i rgud — sel 'gro don 'phrin las lo byang gnyis su rgyas 'brel tshad don ldan pa d+ma 'od du 'god bka' 'di thub par srungs shig btsan rgod rgyal dam nyams lag tu ma shor a tham rgya las can thugs kyi sras da 'phrad pa ra shog sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya bshags nga ye shes sgron me rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gas rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma sa bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda thim snyi zhes pa 'di' lu zin chos kyi bdag po pad+ma dga' ba'i rdo rjes bkra shis dge ba' skyes du ma dang bcas te bskul ngor kho bo rgyal mchog bshad pa rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro gas ba'i 'phrul brda las
zhal bzhus te dag par phab pa 'i ye ge pa ni chos bdag nyid kyi bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba mabe le/

bshā: zab gsang rdo rje snying po las:dbang chen bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal gyis dgyes bskang tshogs bsdus dngos grub char 'bebs bzhugs so:a:na mo gu ru kā ra ye:4 134spyos/ dbang chen 'bar ba las kyi brtul zhugs 'chang brag 'thung rgyal po spya bo' gtsug tu mchod rnal 'byor tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho rdzogs pa' phyar bsod nams gtar gyi dpa la 'ad zhal phye'oḥbaza' bca' bayi ba dum gcig snod du bsags pa sngags phyag rgya ting 'dzan ldan pa yis oṃ ā /:sgyu 'phrul tshogs brgyad srin yul bkod pa'i rtser mi shig dwangs ma bde chen dpal gyi ri:rig stong ngo bo bla ma rdo rje 'chang:yi dam dbang chen rta phag mnyam sbyor 1nga:gnas yul nyer bzhi'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang rig sngags zhing skyes bde chen rnal 'byor ma:dga' ston tshogs kyi 'du bar gshegs su gsol snang srid ro mnyam dga' bzhi'i tshogs la rol:gzung 'dzin las nyon mtshan ma dbyi sa su bshags:rlang sems rgya ba ye shes d+ngha tir sgol gnyis med bde sbor 'od gsal phra bar stobs:ska gsum mnyam nyid 'khor lor longs sgod rol:rtogs pa'i yon tan dbang phyug

mkha' 'gros bskyed:pham 'bab 'di bzhes 'khor ba dong sprugs mdzod:bdag cag tshogs rdzogs sgrib dag sangs rgyas shog:de ltar grangs ldan phul ba yis tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho rdzogs par 'gyur sgrib dag nyams rtogs yon tan 'phel don gnyis lhun grub ze tshom med sa ma yā ye ma rgyal dbang pad+ma'i thugs bcud skor ma 'ongs dus kyi tha ma la rgyal mchog sprul ba'i dpa' bo dang 'phrad nas bstan 'gro'i rgud pa gso de bar srungs shig btsan rgod rgyal bsdam dang spel la ma g.yel zhig sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya tshogs bsdus dngos grub char 'bebs rdzogasaso gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gya slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha was bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda thim snyi ces pa 'di'ang chosabadag ba na 'gru snying stobs chen po' mthu mnga' ba pad+ma' mtshan can gyis bskul ngor/kho bosasaldan rdo rjes mkha' 'gro'i 'phrul brda dag par phab pa'i yege pasna rolagada' nyid kyathabagyi pa sarba ma lo/
r+sā/yabalemimastom zu mi/ma mala'ikhyesgesgo10martsetshu zab gsang rdo rje snying po las:dbang chen gsung mchog rol ba'i rgyud bskang yid bzhin nor bu bzhugs so:

—8rdo: na mo gu ru pad+ma kā ra ye: phro/zu zo/ / bdeb kun gyi mthar son pa mi rtog ye shes bcom ldan 'das dab chen gsung gi dkyil labor la mthon mthing ral bas bayo de 'dud pad+ma rol ba'i rgyud bskang na sbyar sbos dud spro rol mo sgrogs snyan pa' byangs kyi rta la drangs gdung shugs mos gus tshad med pas hūṃ rdi ka dag spre sa bral chos sku mngon gyur pa'i:rgyal ba dgongs brgyud blama'i thugs dam bskangs rang bzhin 'od lnga'i dbyings su byang chub pa:rig 'dzin brda brgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskangs:lta sgom spyod 'bras man ngag mthar phyin pa'i:gangazag snyan brgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskangs:dre med 'garo|sa gzigs pa mtha' yas pa:gdod ma'i mgon po yab yum thugs dam bskangs:gsang chen bstan pa'i mdzoda'adzin sdud pa po:rdo rje chos kyi dbang phyug thugs dam bskangs:theg pa'i rtse mo a ti'i zab gnad bkrol:rig 'dzin dga' rab rdo rje'i thugs dam bskangs:dze+elta dzirnyed mkhyen gzigs blo gros rgyas:mkhas grub 'jam dpal bshes gnyen thugs dam bskangs ye shes sgyu ma'i 'od lus mngon gyur pa:rig 'dzin shrī seng ha'i thugs dam

—8/sde: bskangs:rang byung ye shes mngon gyur bka' srol 'dzin:mkhas mchog dzña na su dra'i thugs dam bskangs:snyig thig dgongs pa'i rang bzhin 'ja' skur sbyor:paṇa chen bi ma mi dra'i thugs dam bskangs:brdzus skyes sprul sku gsang sngags ston pa mchog skyid rgyan slob dpon pad+ma'i thugs dam bskangs:dbang chen gsung gi bka' bab bstan pa 'dzin:rig 'dzin nā gardzu na'i thugs dam bskangs bde ba kun gyi mthar son he ru ga:grub mchog ro langs bde ba'i thugs dam bskangs:'jam dpal sku mchog rol ba'i gsang mdzod 'dzin:sgob dpon mañdzu mi dra'i thugs dam bskangs:bdud rtsi yon tan grub pa'i rig pa 'dzin:slob dpon thod 'phreng rtsal gyi thugs dam bskangs:thugs mchog yang dag ye shes mngon gyur pa:rig 'dzin hūṃ chen kwa ra'i thugs dam bskangs:thal 'byin 'phrin las nus mthu'i dpal thob pa:slob dpon pra bha hasta'i thugs dam bskangs chags med bde ba chen por mnga' brnyes pa:rig 'dzin dha na saṃ shrī'i thugs dam bskangs:nus mthu'i stobs rdzogs gzhan snang zhil gnon pa:

rig 'dzin sharnyi ghar+bha'i thugs dam bskangs:mngon spyod drag pos bdud dpung 'thar mdzad pa'i slob dpon ram bu gurgya'i thugs dam bskangs:rig 'dzin bla ma 'dus pa'idapal thob pa mkhas mchog dri med bshes gnyen thugs dam bskangs:brtul zhugs bde ba chen po'i dpal thob pa:grub mchog sa ra ha pa'i thugs dam bskangs:gangasaljongs bod kyi rmongs mun bsal mdzad pa'i:mkhan slob chos rgyal rnam gsum thugs dam bskangs:bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dngos grub mtshog thob pa:tshangs pa lha yi me tog thugasadam bskangs:ye shes thugs mchog rol ba'i dpal brnyes pa:gnubs ban nam mkha'i snying po'i thugs dam bskangs:bde gshegs sku yi brtul zhugs mthu thob pa gnyags chen dzña na ku ma'i thugs dam bskangs:dbang chen gsung gi khams gsum bde klong bsgyur:ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs thugs dam bskangs mngon spyod 'phrin las bdud 'dul dpal thob pa:mkhar chen ye shes mtsho rgyal thugs dam bskangs:bde spyor ma mo rol pa'i mthu grub pa:'brog mi dpal gyi ye shes thugs dam

gtsasdo: bskangs mngon spyod drag pos gzhan snang zil gyis gnon:rlangs chen dpal gyi seṅge'i thugs dam bskangs:drag sngags dbang phyug nus mthu stobs 'dzom pa:rig 'dzin be+e ro tsa na'i thugs dam bskangs:sgra dang yi ge'i gnas la mnga' brtes pa ska cog ldan ma rtse mang thugs dam bskangs:gsang sngags snying po chos kyi bstan mdzod 'dzin:sngags pa rdo rje bdud 'joms thugs dam bskangs rig 'dzin bla ma 'dus pa'i byin rlabs pa'i:grub mchog khye'u chung lo tsa'i thugs dam bskangs:smon lam mnga' brtes gangs ljong bstan pa'i bdag:lo paṇa rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskangs:pad+ma'i zab bcud gter gyi bstan pa skyongs:rig 'dzin gter ston rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskangs:byin rlabs sprin 'khrigs daro sa grub dpal stsol ba'i:rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi thugs dam bskangs:rang byung ye shes maro na sum gnang mdzad pa'i:bka' drin gsum ldan bla ma'i thugs dam bskangs:/ —8gzung ba rang sar dag pa'i thugs dam bskangs:'dzin pa rnam par grol ba' thugs dam bskangs:re 1gas

ro snyoms lta bas thugs dam bskangs 'khor 'das mnyam nyid sgom pas thugs dam bskangs: rnam rgyal spyod pa dag pas thugs dam bskangs gang shar rang grol dgongs pas thugs dam bskangs: bskang bya skong byed dngos 'dzin dag pas bskangs 'khor 'das rang grol chos dbyings lhug par ā de ltar dgyes bskangs gzi byin 'bar don gnyis lhun gyis grub par 'gyur nyams rtogs yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel tshe 'dir rig 'dzan sa la sbyor sa ma yu ye ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la thugs brtse chen po yas thugs gyi thig le zab gsang rdor snyingaskor grub pa 'i dbang phyug 'brog ban khyod la gtad da dung ma spel rin chen brda la bstams mdo khams bkra shis rdzong la dgongs bra sdoms ma 'o sa snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus dpa' po khyod sprul nus ldan rdo rje dang 'phrad nas bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde spel don gnyis yid bzhin 'byung ba'i rten 'brel yod bka' gsang thub par srungs shig tsa ma ra bka' log lag tu ma shor dam tshig rgya las can thugs kyi sras da 'phrad pa ra shog sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya brgyud bskang yid bzhin nor bu rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda jim lha ces pa

— mi 'di'ang lug zin dam pa sog sprul rin po che bskul ngor bdag 'dra'i rgyal mchog bzhad pa rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro'i gsang brda zab mo dag pa ra phab pa 'i yi ge pa ni chos bdag nyad kyis bgyis pa'o/sarbam lo/
44྾sam྾ཿ ma྾na nyitshu zab gsang rdo rje snying po lasaḥdabang chen rta phag zung khrug bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal gyi bskang ba rin chen 'phreng mdzes bzhugs soḥ

—8rdo: na mo gu ru pad+ma kā ra ye:snyiḥstesgo sa dbang chen gtsug rgyan rta glus bdud dpung 'dul zab byed phag skad ngur sgras sa gsum g.yo gnyis med mnyam pa'i brtul zhugs 'khor la ngom he ru ka dpal gsang gsum klong la 'dud dbang chen dgyes bskangs tshogs gnyis ོgas pa'i thang sa snang srid snod bcud dpal yon dngos po kun chos nyid mnyam pa chen por dang blang nas bde chen bde ba' gzi 'bar wa rnams bskangs 'byor tshogs yo byad gzhung dang mthun par bsags bas sa sbya spel bsgyur ti nge 'ad na gyis 'phrul rol mo sgrogs shing snyan pa 'i dbya sa bcas te dgongs mnyam de ba nyid kya gde bskyang nas hūṃ trīḥbade stong spros dang bral ba'i pho brang nas:ma chags dri bral pad+ma dbang gi sku:rū tra 'dul mdzad rta skad rngam glu sgrogs:ye shes bzhi ldan zhal gyi dkyil 'khor rgyas:'dza ra 'das sa ler gzigs pa'i spyan rnams bsgrad:dug gsum gdon 'dul khro gtum gar dgus 'khrud 'brin las brgyad ldan phyag gis mtshon cha gdengs:'jigs lta zil gnon zhabs rnams gyad stabs bsgrad:'khor 'das rgyan shar dur khrod dpal chas klubs:'bar ba'i 'od zer phyogs rnams kun tu 'khyil:bde stong dga' bzhi'i

btsasdo dpal ster phag mo yum sku mdog be+eḍūr+ya yi lhun ltar brjid:dgyes sbyor gad rgyang nam mkha'i 'brug ltar sgrogs:tshad med phyag mtshan 'gro ba'i dpal du ngom:ye shes drug rdzogs rus rgyan dar dpyangs mdzes:bde stong gzi 'bar gdul bya'i re ba skongs:che ba'i yon tan nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam:dbang chen rta phag yab yum thugs dam bskangs:hūṃ trīḥthugs dam gnyan po bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni:sha chen lnga dang bdud rtsi rnam pa lnga:rtsa brgyad stong sbyar pañtsa a dṛ ta:nyon mongs rgyu bsgral rak+ta bde ba'i skyems:khams drug lha mor spro ba'i bha ling ta:bza' ba tshogs pa'i longs spyod nam mkhar mnyam:rnam rtog gcod pa'i 'khor lo ro snyoms ngang:mchog chen mchog phran mtshan ldan za le 'bri:shel gong lug dang tsa ra mkha' lding dang:rdo rje zil ba dpal mo dgyes pa'i rdzas:pad+ma rak+ta dpa' bo bskul ba'i skyems:spros bral lta ba don dam gsang mchod dang:nyag gcig zang thal sgom pa gsal ba'i me:rnam rgyal sprod pa brtul zhugs che ba'i mchog:rdo rje'i rig ma bud+dha bskul ba'i dbyid:rtogs pa'i gla

dbyangs mtshan ma gcod pa'i tshig ye shes bro ni bdud dpung rtsad gcod thabs: shes rab gar ni 'khor ba dong sprugs lam dza gad a mṛ gsang chen sngags kyi rdzas: bkra shis rdzas rtags rig pa'i rgyan shar srid rgyal srid nor sna phun tshogs dpal 'byor ste: rang byung rang shar kun bzang mchod sprin gyis: pad+ma dbang gi lha tshogs thugs dam bskangs: thugs dam bskang gyur bde stong dngos grub stsol: hūṃ nyi rigs kyi bdag po pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal: 'char ga'i mdangs 'bar bcu drug lang tshos 'khyud: bde ba'i rnam 'gyur rnal 'byor chen mor tud dga' bzhi'i rol rtsed lo paṇa rig 'dzin 'byed: bcu drug 'dzum bzhad dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rdzogs: snang stong zung 'jug ye shes rgyu 'phrul ngang: rigs 'dus pad+ma yab yum thugs dam bskangs hūṃ nyi thugs dam gnyan po bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni: sha chen lnga sogs gong bgi 'gre'o dngos grub stsol: — treḥ gzung ba'i mtshan ma gcod pa'i brtsal zhags can: thabs kyi cha 'dzin byi la'i mgo bo can: dbyings las ma g.yos spral ba smog ltar 'byug: dgyes pa'i spod pas 'khor

—8rdo: ba dbyings su sgrol:dpal ldan mkhas btsun chen po'i thugs dam bskangs:hū hrībadag 'dzin g.yul ngo 'joms pa'i brtul zhugs can:shes rab cha 'dzin pu shud mgo brnyan 'chang:ngang las ma g.yos pho nya rdul ltar 'khrigs:'dzum zhal ngom pa'i rlung sems dbu mar za 'byed mkhas mig rtsi ldan ma'i thugs dam bskangs hūṃ hrī thugs dam gnyan po sogs gong ba' 'gres lahū nyiphyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad gdug pa 'dul mdzad pa'i:zil gnon khro bo chen po rnam pa brgyad bde stong dga' ster rang rang yum dang sbyor:phyag gi mtshon cha bar chad bdud la 'debs:'jigs byed dkyil 'khor bltar mi bzod pa'i sku:drag po'i hi ya ma rung tshar gcod sgrogs ye shes thugs mchog mkhyen brtse'i 'od stong 'bar:thabs shes rigs las ngom pa'i he ru ga:rdo rje bde sbyin lha tshogs thugs dam bskangs:hū nyithugs dam gnyan so sogs 'gre'o hūm̐ trīḥgadug sems can 'dul dpal gyi khyi brgyad dang:rngams sems can 'dul bka' nyan spyang mo brgyad:rdzu 'phrul stobs ldan 'byung bzhi'i 'dab ma can

las la thog ltar myur ba'i drwa glog ma: srid gsum ldog pas gnon pa'i dmus long tshogs: dbang chen lha tshogs yongs rdzogs thugs dam bskangs: / ༷ thugs dam gnyan po sogs 'gres so hūṃ hrī 'phrin las bzhi yis ma rig 'gro ba 'dul: tshad med rnam bzhis gang 'dul phan bde ngom: phyogs bzhi'i dmag bzlog dus kyi rgud pa skyobs: ye shes sgo ba bzhi yi thugs dam bskangs: hūṃ trīḥ rdzu 'phrul mthu stobs nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam: dgra bgegs 'byung po'i srog la za kha rngams sha khrag dron mor spyod pa'i brtul zhugs can mngag na las myur rbad na mthu che tha ke da cig stong gsum nyul ba'i bya ma rta: gnod sbyin tsa dmar 'khor bcas thugs dam bskangs ྅ nyi thugs dam gnyan po bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni: sha chen lnga dang bdud rtsi rnam pa lnga: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar pañtsa a dṛ ta: nyon mongs rgyu bsgral rak+ta bde ba'i skyems: khams drug lha mor spro ba'i bha listo: bza' ba tshogs pa'i longs sprod nam mkhar mnyam: rnam rtog gcod pa'i 'khor lo ro stoms ngang: mchog chen mchog phran mtshan ldan za le 'bri: shel gong lug dang

sa6/sdo: tsa ra mkha' sding dang:rdo rje zil ba dpa' mo dgyes pa'i rdzas:pad+ma rak+ta dpa' bo bskul ba'i skyems:spros bral lta ba don dam gsang mchod dang:nyag gcig zang thal sgom pa gsal ba'i me:rnam rgyal spyod pa brtul zhugs che ba'i mchog:rdo rje'i rig ma bud+dhā bskul ba'i dbyid rtogs pa'i glu dbyangs mtshan ma gcod pa'i tshig ye shes bro ni bdud dpung rtsad gcod thabs:shes rab gar ni 'khor ba dong sprugs lam:dza gad a dṛ gsang chen sngags kyi rdzas bkra shis rdzas rtags rig pa'i rgyan shar srid:rgyal srid nor sna phun tshogs dpal 'byor ste:rang byung rang shar kun bzang mchod sprin gyis:bka' nyan pho nya'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskangs:nad gdon 'jigs tshogs ma lus zhi ba dang:tshe dpal nyams rtogs yar zla ltar 'phel rgyas:khams gsum srid gsum mos bzhi dbang du bsdus:gnod byed dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlog bde stong mi 'gyur 'od gsal dngos sdo/ba (65:de ltar lha tshogs bskangs ba'i byin rlabs kyas 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub pa da nyams rtog yon tan mthu stobs gzi byin 'bar don gnyis lhun gyis

grub par the tshom med sa ma yu om rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha wa' ma 'ongs 'gro la shin tu brtse sems kyis thugs kyi thig le zab gsang rdor snying bskor grub pa'i dbang phyug 'brog ban lo tsā da dbang tshan bka' bab rgyal ba mchog dbyangs la gtad rgya'i dpal sbyin spel ba'i dus min gsungs rin chen brdar bsnyims mdo khams gsham du sbos ma 'ongs dus kyi rgud pa 'khrugs pa' tshe dpa'abakhyed gnyes sprul pa las ldan gyis rted nasabastan dang 'gro la phan bde spel rten 'brel legs na mtha' dmag cha shes bzlog bka' 'di thub par srungs shigartsa ma ra sgod min lag tu ma shor a the rgya las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad pa ra shog sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya bskang ba rin chen 'phreng mdzes rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ rte wa' bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa 'o brda thim dzi ces pa 'di yang lung zan chos kya bdag popad+ma dga' ba'i rdo rjes bkra shas dge ba' skyes bzang du ma dang bcas yang yang bskul ngor kho bo dbang chen dgyes pa' rdo rjes mdo khams tsa ri dra'i gnas mdun nas mkha' 'gro'i gsang brda zab mo dag par phabapa'i yi ge pa ni lung zin nyid kyi bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba la le/

gtsasdo: themamed bskang balha: ga24zla dngosalor yid sprul kun bza mchod sprin spel la sngags ting 'dzin rab gsal dbyangs snyan pos hūṃ hrīḥ mtha' bral nam mkha'i dbyings kyi 'khor lo na: sku yi bdag nyid 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: spyor sgrol yum chen khro rgyal gshed bzhi dang: phyogs skyong bcu gnyis ging bdud rtsis shan sogs:pho nya yongs rdzogs za byed gtum rngam can: 'jigs byed rnam par rol ba'i thugs dam bskangs: / ni bde stong rab 'bar dga' ba'i 'khor lo na: dpal chen yongs 'dus che mchog he ru ga: gnam zhal dbyings phyug kro ta rigs bzhi dang: he ru mched dgu bka' nyan sgo ba bzhi: las mdzad pho nya lce spyang ma brgyad sogs: yon tan bdud rtsi 'byung ba'i la tshogs ni: gnyis med mnyam pa chen pos thugs dam bskangs hūṃ 1 ye shes bde mchog thugs kyi 'khor lo na: 'gyur med yang dag khrag 'thung he ru ga: bde ba'i dpal spin kro ti shwa ri yum: khrag 'thung rigs bzhi yab yum smo ba bzhi: gnas ma yul ma dbang phyag nyi shu brgyad: ye shes thugs kyi dkyil 'khor bsam mtha' yas:

bde gshegs bkod pa'i rgyal po'i thugs dam bskangs: hū nyi rngam byed mkha' 'gro bde ba'i 'khor lo na: 'phrin las dpal 'dus rdo rje gzhen nu yab: gnyis med bde klonga'akhor lo rgyas 'debs dbyings: thugs sras rigs bzhi khro rgyal yab yum bcu: za gsod khra thabs sgo skyong mkha' 'gro bzhi: bka' nyan pho nya ma mo bcu gnyis dang: skyes buging bzhi bdud rgyal las byed bzhi: 'byung po sna yon yang sprul bsam mtha' yas: snyang rje'i 'gal zlar khros pa'i he ru ga thal 'byin 'phran las lha tshogs thugs dmabaskangs: hūṃ trīḥ bde rol mnyam nyid gsang ba'i 'khor lo na: stobs kyi dpal chen bla med he ru ga: nyid bzhi mu kha kun bzang zhal lnga yum: rje mo drug dang rgyal mo bcu gnyis zhal: sman mo lnga bcu yang sprul bsam mtha' yas dgongs pa dbyings su thig le chen por bzhugs: rnam rol thugs rjes gdul bya'i mos mtshor gzigs: bde ba'i zhal bzang dad ldan bu la ngom: mchog tu mi 'byur dbu ma'i dbyings su skyol: srid pa ma mo'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskangs: hūṃ nyi 'bar ba'i rang bzhin bde ba'i 'khor lo

bskye/sdo: na: 'jig rten dregs pa zil gnon he ru ga khams gsum spyi 'dul bde ba'i dbang phyug yum: sde dpon sum cu 'jigs pa'i mtshon cha rngams: ye shesalus can gar yang thogs med rgyu: rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis sangs rgyas bstan pa srung khro rngams gshe bas zhing bcu'i don snying 'byin: sha khrag dpa' zas stobs bzhin sgrub labartse: mchod bstod dregs pa 'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskangs: je sdi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin bde spyor 'khor lo na: dpal chen yong sa 'dus stobs ldan he ru ga dga' bzhi'idapal stsol 'byung bzhi'i bdag mo yum: dregs pa bco brgyad dpa' rngams brtul zhugs ldan: rdzu 'phrul thogs med las myur pho nya ba: sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i dmatshig can: rnal 'byor sgrub pa po yi grogs su rgyu: smon log rgya 'dre srin po 'thar mdzad pa'i: drag sngags dmod pa'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskangs:hū nyi bde chen gar dbang pad+ma he ru ga'i: sku yi gsang ba bsam mi khyab pa'i char: bde gshegs tshom bu dgu yi pho nya ba: ma bdun sring bzhi dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad: sa bdag so gnyis 'bum phrag

mkha' 'gro dang: gdab phur brgya rtsa rtogs byed 'joms byed tshogs: bde stong dga' bzhi bskyed pa'i gsang sgog mchog: legs nyes stong 'dzin dam tshig rjes su gcod:'phrin las shugs ldan bka' sdod thugs dam bskangs:/ shrī thugs dam gnyan po bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni:sha chen lnga dang bdud rtsi rnam pa lnga: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar pañtsa a dṛ ta: nyon mongs rgyu bsgral rak+ta bde ba'i skyems: khams drug lha mor spro ba'i bha lirnyi: bza' ba tshogs pa'i longs spyod nam mkhar mnyam:rnam rtog gcod pa'i 'khor lo ro snyoms ngang: mchog chen mchog phran mtshan ldan za le 'bri:shel gong lug dang tsa ra mkha' lding dang:rdo rje zil ba dpa' mo dgyes pa'i rdzas: pad+ma rak+ta dpa' bo bskul ba'i skyems: spros bral lta ba don dam gsang mchod dang: nyag gcig zang thal sgom pa gsal ba'i me:rnam rgyal spyod pa brtul zhugs che ba'i mchog:rdo rje'i rig ma bud+dha bskul ba'i dpyid:rtogs pa'i glu dbyangs mtshan ma gcod pa'i tshig: ye shes bro ni bdud dpung rtsad gcod thabs:shes rab gar ni 'khor ba dong sprugs lam: dza gad a dṛ gsang

—8/sde: chen sngags kyi rdzas: bkra shis rdzas rtags rig pa'i rgyan shar srid: rgyal srid nor sna phun tshogs dpal 'byer ste: rang byung rang shar kun bzang mchod sprin gyis bde gshegs bkod pa'i rgyal po'i thugs dam bskangs rtogs ba mngon gyur mchog thun dngos grub stsol de ltar bskang bas tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho rdzogs sgrib pa kun dag don gnyis lhun gyis grub nyams dang rtogs pa 'i yon tan 'phel rgyas dpyor the tshom med do rdo rje pa d+ma'i bka' sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya chos kyi bdag po pad+ma dgyesapa'i ro ra kho bo rgyal mchog bzhad pa rtsal gyis so sarba maṅga lo/ bkra shis/

badz+ra: zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: gnam phud gnas yul srung ma'i bskang ba bde stong dga' ster bzhugs so:a: na mo gu ru pad+ma kā ra ye: za sgo 10 dga' ston tshogs kyi longs spyod bsags ye shes ting nge 'dzin gyis spel snyan 'gyur mgrin glu rol mo'i sgra chos nyid mnyam pa'i brtul zhugs bcas hū ༷tsho 'og min gnas dang mkha' spyod zhing: bde chen sbyor ba'i dkyil 'khor na: gnas dang nye ba'i gnas mchog dang: tshan+dho nye ba'i tshan+dho ha: zhing dang nye ba'i zhing la sogs: he ru ka yi gnas bcu na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma bde stong tshogs kyi mchod pas bskangs: spyi bor dza lasto ra dang: longs spyod 'khor lo lam pa ga snying ga gnyi ka yi yul: lte ba dri sha ku na'i grong: mtshan ma pre ta pu ri sogs: gnas mchog nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni: rdo rje phung po'i grong khyer dang: 'brel ba'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams bde stong tshogs kyi mchod pas bskangs: bsil ba tshal dang sku la rdzogs: pad+ma brtsegs dang liṅga brtsegs: bde chen brdal dang ro mnyam tshal dur khrod brgyad dang 'brel ba yi phyi

nang rten dang brten pa'i tshul dpa' bo dang ni rnal 'byor ma: bde stong tshogs kyi mchod pas bskangs: gsang ba brda' shod ud+dha ya: sham+bha la dang ne+e ku tsi: bde ba'i tshal dang dga' ba'i mdangs: ro gtun gram dang brdal ba can: phyi nang gnyis med bde ba'i yul: rang bzhin sum cu rtsa gnyis na: bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma: bde stong tshogs kyi mchod pas bskangs: gzhan yang mi mjed bye phrag brgya: rang bzhin dag pa'i gnas rnams dang sa spyod mkha' spyod gnas nyul ba'i: dpa' bo dang ni rnal 'byor ma:zhing skyong mkha' 'gro sngags skyes sogs bde stong spyod pa'i brtul zhugs can 'du ba tshogs kyi 'khor lor gshegs: bde stong dga' bzhi'i rol ston bzhes: sdom dang dam tshig nyams pa bshags: rtsa rlung thig le gnad bsnun pas: ma dag mtshan ma'i mdud pa grol: spang rtogs yon tan mthar phyin te: bde stong spros bral 'od gsal klong: lhan skyes mkha' la spyod pa'i zhing: skad cig nyid du mngon gyur regag: de ltar phul bas gnas yul gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dgyes bska sa nas lhan skyes rtogs pa mngon gyur te bde stong phag mo'i gsang gsum

bas/: spyod sa ma yā e ma rgyal ba' dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la shig tu thugs brtse bas zab pa 'i ya nga snyi rdo rje snying po' skor dbang chen rgyal ba mchog dbya sa nyid la bstsal spel ba'i dus tshags ma 'ongs 'gro phyir bstan dgyes ste chen mos brda yi ris su phab 'phrin las mi nub gu rus smon lam gan dus kyi snyigs mar 'khrug rtsod gze sa langs tshe dpa' bo khyod ni nus ldan rdo rjer bzhengs skyes bu de dang gdams pa 'di 'phrad nas 'gro don 'phrin las bsam mi khyab pa 'byu bka' 'ad thub nga ra sru sa shig btsan rgod rgyal dam med lag tu ma shor sa ma mā las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par sgo ga sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya gnam phud gnas yul srung ma'i bskangs ba rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gya slob dpo na pa d+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o bdo thim 3 ) ces pa 'di'ang lung zin pad+ma mkha' spyod dgyes 'i rdo rjes ro mtshar dge ba'i skyes bza du mar bcas te bskul ro ra kho bo dbang chen dgyes pa 'i rdo rjes mkha' 'gra'i gas brda zab mo dag ra phab pa 'i yi ge ni chos bdag nyid kyis bgyis pa 'o/sarba maṅga la/
badz+ra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las dbang chen khros pa'i rgyal po'i: mdun bskyed bdud dpung zil gnon byad ma 'bum tshogs brlag pa'i tho lum ngar ma bzhugs so:

pa(: na mo gu ru pad+ma kro dha bṛ he ru ka ru lu ru lu he ya byu1347 sa (6khu sgo dmar nag dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba'i sku grags stong bag glus dregs tshogs 'dar zhing sngangs ye shes thugasakyi 'gro ba thabs kyisa'adzin pad+ma he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo gdul dka' nyon mongs rgyas pa'i sems can rnams 'dul byed dbang chen khro rgyal he ru ka pad+ma gar dbang gzi ldan phag mo yum ye shes 'phrul 'khor gyi rol rtsed bsgyur gdul 'bras pad+ma dbang chen he ru ga' gsang gsum 'khor lor dbyer med 'dres pa'o sa ma wā rnal 'byor dbang phyug pad+ma rgyal po yi 'phrin lasalam byed skal bzang pho mo rnams lta ba' rjong 'dzan sgom pa' 'phrang bsal te spyod pa'i srog sdom ting 'dzan gsal snang bskyed snying po'i sngags gzer 'phro 'du 'phrin las gzer dgongs pa mi 'gyur mchog dang ldan gyur na 'khor 'das thams cad rag pa nyad du mthong rig pa'i rgyal po pad+ma he ru ka log pa'i khrag 'thung la sogs zil gyis gnon dur khrod 'dre mo sgrub kyang kun bzang mo ye shes thugs kyi byin rlabs dbang bskur stsol lta ba'i gnad med a 'thas la gol na myog pa'i sar spyod 'khor ba'i chos dang 'dres de la mi rtog ye shes thob mi 'gyur dug lnga rang ma' spyod cang rmongs par 'gyur de phyir theg pa kun gyi rtse rgyal mchog rmad byung a ti'i lta bas sa bzung ste 'od gsal rig pa' ting 'dzin dari

btsa/ 'grogs shing phyi nang gzhan gsum dbang chen he ru ga'i gsang gsum rgyu 'phrul 'khor lor sgrub pa ni yi :chos dbyings khyab brdal dbyings phyug chen mo'i mkhar:dag grolamanyam nyid dam tshig sgrol ma'i klong:gsal khyab brdal ba mā ma ki yi mkha':ro mnyam bde chen sangs rgyas spyan ma'i klong:rab 'bar ye shes gos dkar mo yi mkhar tshogs brgyad rang grol rus pa'i ri rab khar:phra yul rnam dag dur khrod brgyad bkod rdzogs:phra rtog rang grol sha za lce spyang rgyu:thams cad ro mnyam bde chen rdo rje'i klong sku gsum lhun rje gas thod mkhar gru bzhi pa:bde stong zung 'jug glad zhag thabs kyis sbyar chags pa dbang bsdud rak+tas kun tu 'khyud rgyu brgyad sems rtog zil gyisaganon pa'i phyir:theg pa brgyad mtshon ka ba rnam pa brgyad:'bras bu mtshon phyir gdung ma brgyad du bkal:chos phung brgyad khri mtshon pa'i gral kheb bkram:ma rig mun selanyi zla'i seng skar mdzes:tshad med bzhi mtshon sgo rnams las bzhi'i dbyibs:zhing gi thog phub bam ro'i rgyal mtshan dang:bum pa tshad med chos 'khor nor bu'i tog:'dod

snam la ni dga' ster lha mo 'gyed:yongs rdzogs rta babs rnam pa bzhi dang ldan:phyi gsal nang gsal dri med 'od kyi dal:rnam rtog bdud bzhi'i mtshan ma dag phyir shar dedabus rin chen zur brgyad khri rkang ni:byol song gtso bo brgyad kyis btegs pa'i steng:rdul bral pad+ma thabs shes nyi zla'i khar:rig pa'i ngo bo/ yigahṝ mtshan pa:de lasa'od 'phros phyogs bcu'i zhing khams kyi:bud+dha bo dhi sa twa thams cad bskul mkhyen nus brtse ba'i ye shes yon tan kun 'od dang thig le'i rnam par bsdus te bstim 'odazer mar 'phros ngan song dong sprugs te:tshe bsod dpal yon bkrag mdangs thams cad kun:'od kyi rnam par bsdus te yi ger bstim:sgo ngas gyur dpal chen pad+ma he ru ka sku mdog dmar gsal rā ga'i lhun po la:nyin byed 'bum gyis 'khyud pa'i bkrag mdangs 'bar gar dgu'i dpa' brjed ngom pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis:chos can mtshan ma'i khalo dbyings su bsgyur:sgeg bzhad ha hi hūṃ phaṭa 'brug ltar sgrogs khams gsum rū tra skye med dbyings su sgol:g.yas zhal sgrug nag longs spyod rdzogs sku'i dal:bde chen

ba:tshu sbyin pa'i khro 'dzum sgeg nyams 'bar:dregs pa'i tshogs rnams zil gnon ar la gtad:ye shes mkhyen brtses sa lam dgongs don ston g.yon zhal dmar nag thabs mkhas sprul pa'i sku:gtum rngams gzigs pas gdon tshogs zil gyis gnon:bde stong glu yis ḍak+ki dbang du bsdud:ye shes thugs kyis gzhan snang dbang du bsgyur:'phrin las lhun grub rgyab zhal ljang gu ste:ma rig mun sel ye shes 'od zer 'bar:lta dman zil gnon rdo rje'i gzigs stangs ngoms:'bar ba'i dpa' brjid ngom pa'i dal du shar:kun kyang khro gtum spyan gsum sdang mig bsgrad zhal gdangs ljags 'dril rno dkar mche bzhi gtsigs:drag po'i gad rgyang nam mkha'i 'brug bzhin ldir:smra smin me 'bar ral pa dmar ser brdzes:thod skam dbu rgyan dar sna'i cod pan bcing thabs shes zung 'jug nyi zla'i snyan cha mdzes skra gseb rta zhal rigs lngas bzhad glu sgrogs:rgyud lnga'i 'gro ba dbyings su 'dul bar byed:rngog ma le brgan ye shes me ltar 'bar:chos phung brgyad khris gdul bya 'dul zhing skyongs:'bar ba'i

phyag brgyad ma 'dres sa ler gsal g.yas kyi rtsa phyag shes rab gri gug 'dzin g.yon gyi rtsa phyag bde stong bhan dmar bsten: g.yas 'og gnyis pas shes rab ral gri phyar:srid pa'i rtsa ba mtshan ma med par gcod gsum pas dbang sdud lcags kyu 'gro la gzir: thabs mkhas thugs rjes gdul bya zin par byed: bzhi pas brdung byed dbyug do 'bar ba thogs: nga bdag mtshan mar 'dzin rnams 'thag par byed: g.yon 'og gnyis pas rnge'u chung mkha' la gdeng: dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang phyug las la 'gyed: gsum pas sbrul nag zhags pa dam du bsdams: thogs bcas snang ba chos nyid mnyam par sbyor: bzhi pas dug gsum rtsad gcod kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin: a 'thas sems kyi 'dzin stangs rtsad nas gcod: phar phyin drug rdzogs rus pa'i rgyan drug spras zhe sdang rgyan shar stag gi sham thabs klubs 'dod chags rang grol mi lngags sked bcing bsdams: nga rgyal rnam dag glang gos stod g.yog byas: gti mug rnam dag sbrul gyi do shal la: phrag dog rang grol mgo 'breng brgyad cu 'phyangs bya ba lhun grub dar gyi dpyangs pa 'phur: rū tra

bsgo/: bsgral ba'i dpa' rtags thal tshom bkod: chags pa dbang bsdus mkhur tshos khrag thig byugs: 'khor 'das ro mnyam zhag gi zo ris chags: zhabs bzhi bsgrad pas bdud bzhi zil gyis gnon: 'bar ba'i 'od zer phyogs rnams kun tu 'khyil: dgyes bskyed gar dbang rdo rje phag mo ni mthing gsal be+eḍūr+ya yi lhun po la nyi ma 'bum 'od 'khyug pa'i gzi 'od 'bar: zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum khro 'dzum sgeg: in+d+ra ni la'i ral pa sku rgyab 'phyangs dmar ser ral gseb phag zhal ngur sgra sgrogs ma rig rmongs pa'i 'khrul 'khor stong par byed: gzigs sham rus rgyan me long dril g.yer dang: dar dmar dpyangs pa mi lpags g.yang gzhi klubs: dbu rgyan cod pan rin chen snyan cha mdzes: rtsa phyag gri thod 'dzin cing yab mgul 'khyud: tha ma'i phyag gnyis spu gri zhags pa bsdams: zhal sbyor drag po'i gad rgyang 'brug ltar sgrogs g.yon bskum g.yas brkyang srid pa zil gyis gnon: snang stong zung 'jug bde ba'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs: rang byung lhun grub rang shar tshul du gsal: yab yum gnyis med

bde chen sbyor ba'i sgras phyogs bcu'i dkyil 'khor lnga ldan zhing rnams bskul thams cad bde chenahūṃ gi sgra yis khyab: 'bar ba'i gar mdzad rol ba'i skur bzhengs pa dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor rtog med ro yi khar: sku mchog grub pa'i rdo rjeg na rje'i gshed ser nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis khro gtum sgeg: g.yas pas ral gri g.yon pasathod khrag brten: dur khrod chas rdzogs gyad kyi thabs su bzhengs: dur khrod bdag mo sku la 'khril sbyor rol: ha la nag po ka dur mu kha dang: rdo rje gdong drug bzhad pa'i sgrachen sogs: bde ba'i sku can 'bar ba'i gar mdzad pa'i: sku yi lha tshogs ma 'dres lam mer gsal: ro 'dus 'khor 'o ra klu rgyal nyi zla'i khar: 'khor 'das dpal rdzogasache mchog he ru ga: skrug nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis khro zhing gtum: g.yas pas rdo rje g.yon pas bhan dmar 'dzin: dur khrod chas rdzogs zhabs gnyis gyad thabs rol gnam zhal dbyings phyug sku la gnyis med 'khril: za byed tshe 'phel ro langs spyan gcig sogs: yon tan lha tshogs bde sbyor mnyam pa'i sku: ma 'dres 'ja' tshon shar bzhin

badz+ra: lam mer gsal: dran 'dus 'khor lor rū tra bsnol ba'i khar: yang dag he ru mthing nag rngams pa'i sku zhal gcig phyag gnyis khro zhing gtum pa'i zhal:g.yas pas gri gug g.yon pas bhan dmar 'dzin: dpa' ba'i chas rdzogs zhabs gnyis gyad thabs rol: kro nyi shā ri bde chen mnyam par sbyor: rab gtum gtum byed gtum 'bar gtun khung sogs: thugs kyi la tshogs rdul dab bral ba'i sku: thams cad ma 'dres mnyam pa nyid du gsal: skyed byed 'khor lor dam sri bsnol ba'i khar: rdo rje gzhon nu mthing nag rngam pa'i sku: zhal gcig phyag gnyis khro gtum rngams pa'i zhal: zhal gdengs ljags 'dril rno dkar mche ba gtsigs g.yas pas rdo rje g.yon pas lcags phur gzir: dpa' ba'i chas rdzogs zhabs gnyis gyad thabs rol: 'khor lo rgyas 'debs sku la mnyam par rol: gdong pa zur zhal gtum rngams lag brgyad sogs: 'phrin las lha tshogs ma 'dres lam mer gsal: skul byed 'khor lor ma bdun bsnol ba'i khar: bla med he ru mthing nag khro 'jum sgeg: zhal gcig phyag gnyis gar gu'i nyams

rdzogs pa: g.yas pas lcags kyu g.yon pas bhan dmar 'dzin: dur khrod chas rdzogs zhabs gnyis gyad thabs rol: dbyings kyi yum chen kun bzang zhal snga dang: sku la nye ba'i mu kha 'khril sbyor rol: ro ma dud ma skyang ma kha kha'i gdong kā li dur byed lcam mo sman khrag sogs gzi brjid ma mo'i lha tshogs yongs rdzogs pa: ma 'dres rang byung rang shar tshul du gsal: 'bar ba'i 'khor lor rū tra pho mo'i khar: khros pa'i dbang phyug dregs pa kun 'dul ni: mthing gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum bsgrad: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril rno dbal mche ba gtsigs: g.yas pas lha chen mgo bo bsdam par byed: g.yon pas bhan+ta dmar chen sku la brten: dur khrod chas rdzogs zhabs gnyis rgyad thabs rol: khams gsum spyi 'dul sku la gnyis med rol: gtum ma rngams zhal bzhad gdong 'khrugs pa sogs: dregs pa'i lha tshogs ma 'dres lam mer shar: bskyod pa'i 'khor lor dgra bgegs pho mo'i khar: dregs pa'i che btsan stobs ldan nag po ni: mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis khro zhing gtum: g.yas pas lha glu'i snying dang g.yon

pa(: bhan dmar: dur khrod chas rdzogs zhabs gnyis gyad thabs rol: 'byung lnga'i bdag mo sku la 'khril spyor rol: 'dzin pa rgyu ba stobs byed 'thag byed sogs: stobs ldan lha tshogs ma 'dres lam mer gsal: gzhan yang rtsa khams thig le zhal sbyor klong rdo rje phra ba'i shugs can dam tshig 'dzin: ye shes gsang sgog bde chenamanyam pa'i gar: rdo rjo sgeg byed tshogs rnams gar la dgyes: 'thar byed stobs ma'i tshogs rnams glu la spro: zung 'jug ging pa thams cad bro la dgyes: nyi ma'i zhal can zlaba'i gnas su 'khod: zla ba'i zhal can nyi ma'i dal la gnas rlung gi shugs can gnyis ga'i gnas su 'gro: 'bar ba'i stobs can bde ba'i gnas su 'khod: kun kyang dbang chen 'dzum pa'i tha tshig bzhin phrin las bde chen stsol la rtag tu gnas: ma 'dres rang gsal mnyam pa nyid du shar: / hūṃ bdag nyid dbang chen pad+ma he ru ga'i: g.yasasu zhe sdang pho gdon 'dul ba'i lha: thabs kyi cha 'dzin za byed byi la'i mgo: zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdzu 'phrul stobs ldan pa: dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i mtshon cha phyag na brnams

thogs med myur mgyogs rlung gi bang rtsal can: zhe sdang las byung dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i phyir ye shes gzugs kyi phyag rgyar lam mer gsal:yum chen gar dbang gzi ldan phag mo yi: g.yon du 'dod chags mo gdon 'dul ba'i lha:shes rab cha 'dzin gsod byed pu shud mgo:srid gsum gzigs pa'i ye shes spyan ldan ma: zhabs gnyis gar bsgyur 'byung ba'i khams la rgyu: gdug rtsub mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams: gar bskul de ru thogs med rgyug mdzad pa'i: pho nya chen mo sngon gyi dam tshig can: 'dod chags las byung dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i phyir: ye shes gzugs kyi phyag rgyar lam mer gsal: ye shes dwangs ma gtsug tor 'khor lo ru bde ba'i sku can rdo rje chos dbang phyug: dkar dmar mdangs ldan rdo rje bhan+ta 'dzin: dgyes bskyed rnal 'byor dbang mo 'khril sbyor rol:rnam smin tshe dbang phyag rgya lhun grub pa'i: rig 'dzin yab yum dpa' bo dpa' mo ging: thams cad ma 'dres 'od kyi gong bur gsal bdag nyid dbang chen rtsa ba'i thugs ka nas: nyuXdamar 'od zer phyogs mtshams steng 'og bcur spro bsdu

'amatshu 'od zer dbab bstim byin rlabs las:yongs gyur shar du rdo rje rta mjen ni:dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis khro 'dzum sgeg:g.yas pas rdo rje g.yon pas bhan dmar 'dzin:dur khrod chas rdzogs zhabs gnyis gyad thabs rol:lto ru rin chen rta mgrin ser gsal brjid:zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhi ma khro 'dzum sgeg g.yas pas be con g.yon pas bhan dmar 'dzin:dur khrod chas rdzogs zhabs gnyis gyad thabs rol:nub tu pad+ma rta mgrin dmar nag gtum:zhal gcig phyag gnyis khro gtum bzhad pa'i zhal:g.yas pas pad+ma g.yon pas bhan dmar 'dzin:dpal gyi chas rdzogs gyad kyi thabs su rol:byang du garma rta mgrin ljang nag rngams zhal gdengs ljags 'dril rno dbal mche ba gtsigs:g.yas pas rgya gram g.yon pas bhan dmar 'dzin:dpal gyi chas rdzogs gyad kyi thabs su rol:kun kyang ye shes me klong brjid par 'gying:bdud bzhi 'dul ba'i gar la rtag tu gnas:tshad med rnam bzhi'i ngang la rab gnas shing:'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub dpal du bskyed de yi phyi rim 'khor lo

rtsibs bcu la: shar stod khro bo chen po hūṃ ka ra zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje bhan dmar 'dzin: lha yi gdon tshogs zil gnon dpa' bor gsal: shar phyogs khro bo rnam par rgyal ba ni dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis khro zhing gtum: g.yas pas gri shul g.yon pas bhan dmar 'dzin: dri za pho mo zil gnon sku ru gsal: lto phyogs khro bo gshin rje'i gshed po ni: ser nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis khro gtum sgeg: g.yas pas dgra stu g.yon pas bhan dmar 'dzin: 'byung po yi dwags zil gnon sku ru gsal:nub phyogs khro bo rta mgrin rgyal po ni: dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis khro gtum sgeg: g.yas pas ral gri g.yon pas bhan dmar 'dzin: chu lha pho mo zil gnon sku ru gsal: byang phyogs khro chen bdud rtsi 'khyil ba ni ljang nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis khro 'dzum sgeg g.yas pas rgya gram g.yon pas bhan dmar 'dzin: sa bdag gtod tshogs zil gnon sku ru gsal: shar lhor khro chen dbyug pa sngon po ni zhal gcig phyag gnyis khro gtum sgeg pa'i sku: g.yas pas dbyug to g.yon pas bhan dmar 'dzin: drang srong

ba:tshu pho mo zil gnon sku ru gsal: lho nub khro chen mi g.yo mgon po ni: dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis khro 'dzum sgeg: g.yas pas spu gri g.yon pas bhan dmar 'dzin sna tshogs pho mo zil gnon sku ru gsal: nub byang khro chen 'dod pa'i rgyal po ni: spug nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis khro 'dzum sgeg: g.yas pas ba dan g.yon pas bhan dmar 'dzin: rlung lha pho mo zil gnon sku ru gsal: byang shar khro chen khams gsum rnam par rgyal: mthing skya zhal gcig phyag gnyis gtum rngams sgeg: phyag g.yasardo rje g.yon pas bhan dmar 'dzin: bgegs tshogs pho mo zil gnon sku ru gsal: nub rmad khro rgyal stobs chen mthing nag rngams: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril rno dkar mche ba gtsigs: g.yas pas tho ba g.yon pas bhan dmar 'dzin: sa bdag 'byung po zil gnon sku ru gsal kun kyang dur khrod chas rdzogs gar dgus 'khyud: za byed khro bo'i tshogs rnams g.yas su ngoms gsod byed khro mo'i tshogs rnams g.yon du 'byed sprul pa rdo rje'i phra men rdul ltar 'khrug: ye shes me rlung 'tshubs ma'i dbus su bskyed: de yi

phyi rim 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi la: shar du pradzña ta kṛta lcags kyu 'dzin: lho ruya marnya kṛta zhags pa bsdams: nub tupad+ma ta kṛta lcags sgrog 'dzin byang du2snan ta krota drilabu dkrol: kun kyang khro 'dzum sgeg pa'i rnam 'gyur can: dur khrod chas rdzogs zhabs rnams gar bsgyur rol: ye shes me rlung 'tshubs ma'i dbus su bskyed dosaphyirem rdorje'i bka' skyong ba: khams brgya ma drug dmus long rgyab sbrel tshogs: khyi spyang bcu drug drwa ba glog 'gyu ma 'brug bzhi 'dab gshog can sogs rang rang gi: bka' 'khor sprulapa yang sprul bsam mtha' yas: nyi rdul 'khrigs bzhin ma 'dres lam mer gsal: gzhan yang bka' 'khor dregs pa sde brgyad ni: 'jigs pa'i mtshon 'dzan dpa' ba'i rnama'agyur ngoms: pho nya rdzu 'phrul shugs ldan chibs su bcibs: 'brin las thogs med sgrub pa'i grogs su gsal: kun kyiganas gsum rdo rje'i sa bon las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum dpag yas 'phros: rab 'byams rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus pa: kha ba bu yug 'tshubs bzhin spran drangs nas: bdag mdun bskyed pa'i lha la sib sib

badz+ra: bstims: o badz+ra gu ru pad+ma kro ta h+ya shrī wa badz+ra wa ra hi badz+ra rat+na pad+ma garma kro ta hūṃ ka ra bi dza ya ni le tan+d+ra ya man+ta ka ār+ya a tsa la h+ya shrī wa a pa ra tsit+ta a mṛta kusnyo li tre+e ma kya bi dza ya ma hā ba la dza hūṃ baṃ ho sarba dharma pā la k+ṣe ṭa pā la ma ka pā la sarba sa pa ri wa ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza dzñā na dhartu mu tā a be sha ya a yis de nas dbang bskur rgyasagadab bya spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag mchod bstod slar ya 'dzab kya gzul 'khar ni bdag nyid dbang chen he ru ka yab yum mnyam par sbyor ba'i thugs sgog las 'od zer spros yab yum zhal gsang bar du mgal me'i 'khor lo ltar dmar kyi li li 'khor ba'i 'od zer gyis bde chen mchog du mi 'gyur ba'i 'od gsal mngon du gyur bar dmigs: yang bdag mdun gyi zhal gsang bar du sngags phreng mchod pa'i tshul can dpag tu med pa spro bsdu mdzad pas 'khor 'das brtan g.yo thams cad mkha' ru bsdud cing mnyam nyid bde ba chen po'i ye shes rab tu 'bar zhing rgyas par dmigs la: rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa ci 'grub bzla yang bdag mdun gyi zhal gsang bar du sngags kyi 'phreng ba mgal me'i 'khor lo ltar dmar

kyi li li 'khor ba'i 'od zer gyis: 'khor 'das kyi dpal yon thams cad dbang du sdud cing rtsa khams na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyis bde ba chen po'i rol rtsed bsgyur bzhin chags thogs dang bral ba'i ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngang 'phel zhing rgyas par bsam la sgrub pa'i bsnyen pa ci 'grub bzlo yang bdag mdun gyi sku yi cha thams cad nas: 'od zer rdo rje mtshon cha'i char chen po 'bab pas gnyis snang dam sri log par 'dren pa thams cad tshar bcad: tshe bsod dpal 'byor ye shes yon tan thams cad 'phel zhing rab tu rgyas: rlung sems ting nge 'dzin dang rig pa ye shes la rang dbang thob: srid na ya mtshan du bsngags pa'i dbang chen he ru ga'i gsang gsum sgyu 'phrul gyi 'khe ra ma la 31ngas spyod par dmigs: mngon spyod las sngags ci rigs brjod rjes su 'dzab bsnyen mchod bstod 'bul dngos grub bskul zhing dbang bzhi len thugs yid ro mnyam ngang bskyang ste mabacos rjen pa'i brtul zhugs spyod sa ma mā rnal 'byor lam gyi rim pa yi bdag mdun dbyer med zung 'jug bsgrub lha la lha thim tshul du spyod ting 'dzin rig pa'i gzi byin bskul gsal snang 'gyur med don la bslabs

gas/: snying po dgongs pa'i mthil du bcug spro bsdus 'od zer ci ya bsgyur des ni sa lam mthar phyin te dbang chen he ru'i gsang gsum mazong rig 'dzin rnam bzhi'i sa bsgrod nas kun tu 'od la byang chubaso sa ma yu ye ma rgyal ba' dbang po pa d+ma saṃ bha wa'i ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis thugs kya zab bcud rdo rje snying po' skor grub pa'i dbang phyug rgyal mchog khyad la gtad da dung ma spel rin chen brda la bstim mdokhams bkra shis rdzong der dgo sa bra sdoms ma 'ongs snyigasamar nad mtshon gzengs lang tshe dpa' bo khyod nyid 'dusapa rtsal du bzhengs skyes bu de dang gdams pa 'ad 'phrad nas bstan pa 'i 'gro don byang ga phyogs su rgyas 'brel tshad don ldan pad+ma 'od du 'god bka' 'di srungs shig gajod sbyan btsan rgod rgyal dam nyams lag tu ma sgo ra sbu gri gsum thugs sras tshogs la spel cig king dmar nag sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya mdun bskyed bdud dpungazil gnon byad ma rdul brlag zab mo rngo gas so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda tham snyi ces pa 'di'ang lung zan sku skyesapad+ma dga' ba'i rdo sa shan tu dge ba'i skyes ya mtshan can du mar bcas te nan tan chen po sa bskul ngor kho bo rgyal mchog bzhad pa rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i 'phrul brda las zhal bshus te dag pa ra phab pa 'i yi ge
tha ni chos bdag nyid kyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba masgo la/
ba:tshu zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: dbang chen bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal gyi bstod pa gzi byin gnad bskul bzhugs so:

gas/: na mo gu ru pad+ma kwa ra ye: sgomaspyosgo1117 bde chen rdo rje gar gyi ye shes sku rgeg bzhad gshe bas sa gsum du tra 'dul dpa' ba' chas rtags rta phag gtsug na spa dab chen yab yum gras bcas gtsug gi mchog dpa' bo dbang chenadagyes pa'i bstod dbyangs ni rol mo sna tshogasasnyan pa 'a dbyangs dang bcas dad mos spro ba' rnam 'gyur rgya cher bskyed la tshogs ma 'dres yan la lam mer gsal lta ba' gdeng dang brtul zhugs shugs bskyed de hū trīX ma chags pad+ma 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas 'chi med ye shes grub pa'i rdo rje ni: dbang gi 'od khyim phyogs bcu kun tu g.yo: bde stong snang mtha' yas la phyag 'tshal bstod: ling ga la sogs phyogs bcu'i gnas yul la: dbang bsgyur nye zhing rigs kyis khyab par kun: bde chen rol ba'i mkha' la mnyam sbyor ba'i: khro rgyal 'chol byed chen por phyag 'tshal bstod: dbang gi sku mchog pad+ma rwa ga'i mdangs: bde ba'i rnam 'gyur sgrub mchog bu la ngom: ye shes thugs rje phyogs ris mi dmigs pa: rta mgrin dbang gi sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: khams gsum rol rtsed chos nyid mkha' la bsgyur: glu gar bro yi brtul zhugs dpa' mtshan ngom: ma rig du tra sgrol

btsasdo ba'i las la mkhas:rdo rje rta skad bzhad la phyag 'tshal bstod zhe sdang gdon 'dul dpa' ba'i gos gsum bgo:chags pa'i g.yul 'joms byug pa'i rdzas gsum mdzes:gti mug rang grol btags pa'i rgyan gnyis 'chang:dur khrod dpal chas rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod:sneg dpa' 'jigs rung mi sdug sku yi dpal:rgod gshe drag shul ldan pa rdo rje'i gsung:snying rje rngams zhi ye shes thugs kyi klong:che mchog gar dgus 'byud la phyag 'tshal bstod rgyud brgyad rtog pa dbyings su rab sgrol zhing:theg brgyad dgongs pa ye shes gcig tu stob:lhun grub sgo brgyad mtshan ma med pa'i phyag:ye shes rang bzhin phyag rgya 'chang la bstod dbang chen yab la bde stong dgyes sprin stobs:mkha' khyab 'od zer byang chub sems bcud 'khyil:bde chen thugs rje gzhan snang 'gro ngor bskul:za byed phag mo yum la phyag 'tshal bstod:ma dag rlung khams ye shes dbyings su za:chags med bde ba'i 'dzum la gnas yul gyi:dpa' bo mkha' 'gro nyi rdul 'khrigs bzhin bskul:kun 'dus 'khor lo'i dwangs ma

dbyings la bstod:ro la dgyes pa'i gzigs pa g.yas su ngom:rtog med phra ba'i gzigs pa g.yon du 'byed:mtha' bral bde ba'i gzigs stang sa dbyings su brdal:'khora'adas byed po ma chen 1nga la bstod bde gshegs bskyed pa'i mkha' klong yab la bsre:srid zhi'i sgo 'phar bde ba chen por gnon:thabs shes zung 'jug phyag rgyasa.aho bskul:dgyes sprin pad+ma gzi ldan yum la bstod bde ba'i rang bzhin sbyor ba lnga ldan gyis:chags pa'i gdul bya mtha' bral dbyings su sbyor:rngams pa'i brtul zhugs rta phag 'dul glu yis ma rig rū tra sgrol la phyag 'tshal bstod che btsan dregs pa gdan bting dpa' stobs can:dbang gi 'od khyim g.yo ba'i gzi byin 'bar bde sbyor mtha'asgrol stan gaṇa dgongs pa can:dbang chen yab yum gnyis med klo la bstod:bde ba'i sku can ye shes gzigs stangs gsal:thabs dang shes rab 'brel bas gri thod 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rig 'dzin sku la btud:pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstod:chos can ro la za ba'i dpa' rngams can:bdag rtog dbu mar gsod pa'i

gtsaji brtul zhugs ldan:gdul zhing yongs khyab 'phrin las bsam mtha' yas:sras mchog byi la pu shud zung la bstod:rang bzhin dregs pa sde brgyad zilaganon zhing:khyad par gza' klu rgyal po dam la 'dogs:che btsan nus stobs dbang chen nyid dang mnyam:rigs bzhi zil gnon brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod tshad med rnam bzhis gdul zhing ma lus skyongs 'phrin las rnam bzhis gang 'dul phan bde spel:gzhan phan mjad skyong dbang chen he ru ga'i:bka' nyan pho nya yongs rdzogs sgo bzhirabastod:hū nyidabang chen pad+ma brtsegs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi:nam mkha'i 'khor lo rang bzhin sku yi gnas:mdzad phrin thugs rjes 'chi bdag 'thar mdzad pa'i:sku mchog heru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod:sdo rnams 'dus pa bde ba'i 'khor lo sadapal chen stobs 'dus che ba'i dbang phyug rgyal:gar dgu'i nyams rdzogs spro bsdu'i bdag nyid can che mchog he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod:ye shes thugs mchog dwangs ma'i 'khor lo phu'apho med thugs rjes 'od zer glog ltar 'khyugs:mdzad 'phrin thugs rje bsam ltar

mi dpog pa:yang dag he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod:rngams byed mkha' 'gro bde ba'i 'khor lo phuthal 'byin 'phrin las nus pa'i gzi byin can mngon spyod drag po'i las kyis bdud dpung 'dul:dpal chen kai la ya la phyag 'tshal bstod:rang bzhin bde ba 'gyed pa'i 'khor lo phumakha' klong mnyam pa chen po'i rol rtsed bsgyur:'bar ba las kyi brtul zhugs rak+ta'i gzi:don gsum 'phrin las stobs mchog 'gyed la bstod:'phrin las mi nub 'bar ba'i 'khor lo dra/che btsan dregs pa ma lus zil gnon zhing:gdug pa'i dpa' bskong bdud bzhi'i don snying 'byan:dregs pa kun 'dul rgyal la phyag 'tshal bstod:sna tshogs bskyod byed bde ba'i 'khor lo dra/drag rtsal rdzu 'phrul nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam:sbyor sgrol thabs kyi gsang sngags bstan pa skyongs:dmod pa drag sngags lha la phyag 'tshal bstod:dam tshig rang bzhin dag pa'i 'khor lo dra legs nyes stangs 'dzin dam tshig rjes gcod cing:'phrin las glog ltar myur ba'i pho nya ba:bka' sdod yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod:ye shes thugs ni rang bzhin

badz+ra mnyam pa nyid: rol ba dpal chen khrag 'thung he ru ga dbyer med bde sbyor bde ba'i rol rtsed can: rtsa gsum zhi khro rab 'byams klong la bstod: mi 'gyur sku yi mdzad chul bsam mtha' yas 'gag med gsung gi 'od zer phyogs kun khyab: res med thugs rje phyogs ris mi dmigs pa: dbang chen gsang gsum klong la phyag 'tshal lo: ho: lhag pa'i lha mchog pad+ma he ru ga: bsnyen zhing sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pho mo la: srid na che ba'i mthu stobs nus 'byin dbang: da lta nyid du stsol bar mdzad du gsol: mthong thos dran pas yid can pho mo kun dbang chen rta yis thabs mang la drangs nas bde stong he ru ka dpal mngon gyur te: khams gsum 'khor ba dong nas sprugs par thegag de lta ra rda rje glu bstod kyis dbang chen gsung gi dkyil 'khor bska sa dngos grub sgrub pa po la stsol dge legs skye rgu yongs kyis spyod 'phrin las gsang sngags bstan pa dar tshegs chung don che mthu btsan pa'i dab chen gsu bskor e ma ho skal ba can gyi dpa la du shog sa ma yu ye ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pa d+ma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la shin tu brtse sems kyis snyi gi yang bcud rdo rje snying po 'i skor grub pa 'i dab phyug 'brog

ban lo tsā dang gsung gi bdag nyid rgyal ba mchog dbyangasal bka' rgya gtad pa'i dam tshig gnyer sbyin nas spel ba'i dus tshigs bskal ba snyigs ma'i dus nad mug mtshon 'khrugs rgud pa gzengs lang tshe dpa' bo khyed zung sprul pa las ldan gyi mdo khams gshams nas ran chen brda 'di 'aton skal bzang las can rig pa 'dzin la sprod 'gro don 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa rten 'brel smon lam dag na sa ma yā las dbang bsod namasadaman na de las bur gang yang sgo 'di srungs shig btsan rgod rgyal skal med log lta can la gu rgya rgya sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya dab chen gsung gi bstod pa rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pa d+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda tham lha ces pa 'da'ang lung zin dam pa pad+ma dga' ba'i rdo rjes bkra shis dge ba'i skyes du ma dang bcas skul ngor/ kho bodabang chen dgyes pa'i rdo rjes mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i 'phrul brda zhal bshus te dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni bskul ba po nyid kyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba masgo la/
badz+ra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las dbang chen bdud dpung zil gnon gyi: spros med don gyi nyams len la mkho ba'i gsol 'debs gzhan phan thugs rje'i nyi ma bzhugs so:

—4(ji na mo gu ru pad+ma kā ra ye:za 2) dbang chen lha tshogasamadun gyi nam mkhar gsal mos gus gdung shugs drag pos gsol gdab ni e ma ho: rdul bral bde chen rgyal po 'od mtha' yas: dbang chen gsung gi rdo rje klu sgrub snying: bde stong mchog stsol pad+ma rgyal po la: gsol ba 'debs so dgongs rgyud rtogs pa spor: lhan skyes dbang chen gsang gsum mngon gyur shog: mi brjed gzungs thob ye shes mtsho rgyal dang: grub pa'i dbang phyug rgyal ba mchog dbyangs rtsal: smon lam mthu btsan rje 'bangs nyer lnga la: gsol ba 'debs so dgongs rgyud rtogs pa spor: lhan skyes dbang chen gsang gsum mngon gyur shog: phan bde'i nyi ma rgyal mchog bzhad pa rtsal: bstan pa 'dzin srung smon lam mthu mdzom pa'i: chos bdag rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshogs bcas la: gsol ba 'debs so dgongs rgyud rtogs pa spor: lhan skyes dbang chen gsang gsum mngon gyur shog:gzung 'dzin du tra'i gshed gyur he ru ga: zil gnon dbang chen za byed phag mo yum: rtsal snang sgyu 'phrul 'khor gyi tshom bu la: gsol ba 'debs so dgongs rgyud rtogs pa

btsan spor lhan skyes dbang chen gsang gsum mngon gyur shog: phyi nang zung 'brel gnas yul mkha' 'gro dang: bde sbyin dbang phyug drod skyong bka' sdod tshogs rdul snyed dbang chen gsung gi dkyil 'khor la: gsol ba 'debs so dgongs rgyud rtogs pa spor: lhan skyes dbang chen gsang gsum mngon gyur shog: khams gsum mtshan 'dzin 'khrul ba ka dag ste: chos nyid glu gar rta yi brtul zhugs kyis: srid zhi'i sa rnams ldog pas rab bsgyur te: dbang chen bde klong rol bar byang chub shog: de ltar gsol babatab pa yis nyams rtogs mkha' lta ra 'phel rgyas 'gyur sa ma yā ye ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pa d+ma sam+bha was ma 'o sa gdul byar shin tu brtse sems kyis yang zab rtse shod gsham du dgongs bra btabs dus su thugs sras bud 'phrad pa ra shog sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gsol 'debs gzhan pha na thugs rje'i nya ma rjo gas so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpo na d+ma sam+bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda thim ñtsā zhes pa 'di' sa 1nga mi dbang dam pa dbang chen lha rgyal nas bskul ro ra/ kho bo rgyal ma ga bzhad pa rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod kyi sgrom rgya las dag par phab pa 'i yi ge pa ni sa man+ta bha dra ma
ṇis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga le/

btsasdo byan 'bebs ni hūṃ hrīḥ mi gnas zla gam dgu rdzogs pho brang nas: bde ba chen po pad+ma dbang gi sku: rnam kun mchog ldan ye shes phag mo yum: zung 'jug rolagar byi la pu shud zhal: zil gnon khro rgyal yab yum sprul 'khor g.yog: skye med dbyings las ye shes gzigs pa ngoms: rjes chags bzhad pa'i dpa' rtag gar ngoms bzhin: bde ba mchog gi gnas 'dir dbang byin phob: ma rig rū tra'i dpung tshogs zil gnon zhing don dam pad+ma dbang chen mngon gyur mdzod: pad+ma krota e a ra li tho a we ro/ ya 65 āḥ
g.yisgom sgo4rnyimaskuso11gasgro/grubashe skuzezugye/4khyashāgatā tshu zab gsang rdo rje snying po las:dbang chen zil gnon rtsal gyi spros med don gyi myur lam bde stong 'ub chub bzhugs so:

ba rte na mo gu ru pad+ma kā ra ye: 1/sgo // bde stong 'ub chub pad+ma gsung gi dal ye nas gnyis med thag le' ngang du mchod rnal 'byor bde chen ye shes mngon gyur bas rtag tu 'od gsal donagyi nye lam skyongs sa ma wā dben pa'i gnasasu bde ba'i stan la 'dug blo sems bag phab ma dag rlung dug dbyung sbyor ba bzhi ldan 'byung ba'i da sa ma bsre tshogs chen rab rdzogs gtum mo 'bar 'dzag bsgom lan skyes bdestong rtogs pa mkha' ltar rgyas sa ma yu bde stong chas rgyan sku'i rtags su bsgo ma bcos thad nar bskyang la skyabs sems ni: na lnga : gdod nas ma bce sa rig pa byang chub sems ye yin dbang chen 'khor lor skyabs su mchi gzung 'dzin snang ba sems kyi byed las ste: gzhi med rtsa bral rang byung gsal stong sgom lan gsum rjes su bka' bsgo ni hūṃ nyi gdod nasarnam dag chos sku'i dkyil 'khor la: 'phral byung gdon gyi mtshan ma ka nas dag: 'on kyang gnyis 'dzin 'byung po rang rgyud can: mtha' bral bde chen dbyings su rtogs pas bsal: nyu hūṃ phaṭa gzhom med srung ba'i rā gur ni trī phyogs mtha' mi dmigs de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings: kun zlum thig le spros pa'i grwa zur bral: gzhom gzhig 'pho 'gyur med pa rdo rje'i gur 'di

gtsaji: la rnam rtog gdon gyis glags mi rnyed: dzñā na dhartu rak+ta sne sna tshogs mchod rdzas byin rlabs ni o āXhūṃ: dbang po yul gyi gsal sgor shar ba'i chos tshogs drug lha mo bde ba'i rol gar bcas: sna tshogs rgyan mchod kun tu bzang po'i spren: mi zad nam mkha' mdzod kyi 'khor lor spel: ma badz+ra spa ra ṇa khaṃ: de nas la bskyed ni hūṃ hrīḥ snod bcud brtan g.yo dbang chen bde pa'i dal: ma chags dri bral chos 'byung e yi dbus: snang stong nyi zla rtog med ro gdan steng: bdag nyid ma brtsal ra byung ye rdzogs sku:pad+ma dbang chen 'char ga'i gzi mdangs can: gar dgu'i nyams 'khyud bzod dka'i gzi brjid 'bar: dmar ser ral dbus rta zhal ljang sngon bzhad: 'khor 'das che btsan dregs pa dbang du bsdud: phyag g.yas gzung 'dzin rgyud gcod ral gri phyar: g.yon pa khams gsum rgyan rol thod khrag 'dzin: dur khrod dpal chas dpa' bo'i rtags su bgo:zhabs gnyis bgrad pas ste ba rnam bzhi gnon: ma rig mun bsregs ye shes me chen 'bar: bde stong dpal bsted rdo rje phag mo mthing: khro 'dzum nyams rgyas bde ba'i gzi

byin 'bar: phyag g.yas gri gug dpa' bo'i mgul nas 'khrud: g.yon pas dung dmar dbang chen yab la stobs: 'khas g.yon yab btud g.yas pas 'dza ra ba gnon: zhal sbyor gad rgyang hi ya ru lu sgrogs: gzig sham rus rgyan dar dpyangs dril g.yer mdzes: dmar ser ral gseb rdo rje phag gdong ngur sa gsum 'gro ba ma rig smag las bsgral: 'khor 'das gnyis med bde chen mkha' ru sbyor: / sno shin tu dngas ma chos kyi 'khor lo ru bde ba'i sku can pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal: dmar smug zhi ma khro 'dzum gra thod 'dzin: rus rgyan dar dpyangs he ru ka pa'i chas: ma 'dres mnyam nyid bde ba chen por brgyan: dbang phyugardo rje rnal 'phyor gnyis med 'khril: gcer bu rin chen pad phrengartags su bsgo: rdo rje dril 'dzin gdos bral 'od kyi sku: ye shes lnga ldan 'ja' thig klong du bzhugs: bde stong spros bral thugs rje'i gzi 'od kyis: rdul rted zhing khyab bde gshegs spro bsnga 'gyed: don gnyis mdzad pas 'gro ba'i gnas rnams stong: hūṃ stso brtse byed gsum mar yang dag yab yum shar bde chen 'dod mar 'jam dpal gshin

badz+ra: rje'i gshed: 'od gsal 'byud mar bla med he ru ga: shes rab dbyings mar rdo rje gzhon nu'i dal: ro stong chen mor che mchog he ru ga: gnas ma chen mor dregs pa kun 'dul rgyal: byin chags chen mor stobs ldan drag sngags lha: shin tu mnyam mar bka' nyan pho nya'i dal: kun kyang chags pas ma gos don dam par: bde ba chen po'i rol rtsed rlabs g.yos te: he ru'i gnas khyab mdzad pa'i mnga' dbang phyug: gnas yul thams cad byang chub sems sprin 'khyugs: kun kyang bde ba chen po'i rol ston spro: phyi nang gnyis med mnyam pa nyid du bsgyur: dur khrod brgyad kun brtul zhugs spyod pas skyongs: yul dang yul can kha lo gcig tu sbyor: 'khor ba'i sa dang ldog pa'i sa rnams gnon: ye shes pa da chos nyid pa rnams 'byed: 'khor ba'i bde ba mtshan ma'i 'khor lo stong: don dam bde ba'i rigs dang dkyil 'khor sprin: hūṃ hūṃ mkha' khyab sbos pa'i 'khor lo zung 'jug 1nga: bde ba'i dkyil 'khor 'bar ba'i smin rab 'byams: gnyis med mnyam pa'i gnas su 'dud par byed: rigs da dkyil 'khor gtso
