mchog mnga' dbang bsgyur: hi ya: 'og phyogs dkyil 'khor rdul chen bkod pa zung: sna tshogs 'bar dang g.yo ba kha lo ba: don la gnyis med rdo rje'i gar la dril: ye shes gsang chen thig le gcig tu phyogs bde chen mdzad pa'i sbyor sgrol 'phrin las 'byung: gang 'dul ye shes gzigs rol bsam mtha' yas: hrī sno dbang chen bde klong zla gam thig le gsum: bde gshegs sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bor bzhugs: phyag rgya'i rang bzhin spros pa'i 'od zer gyis: mkha' khyab rgyal kun dbyer med gcig tu bsre: de nasaspyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal ni hūṃ hrīḥ bde stong spros bral thig le chen po'i dbyings: rang bzhin 'od gsal sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i dpal: bdud dpung zil gnon dbang chen he ru ga: gnyis med bde ba'i 'khor lor spyan 'dren gshegs: nyi zla kha sbyor dpa' bo'i dal stong bzhugs: rab 'bar ye shes gsal ba'i phyag bgyi'o: snyed pad+ma kro ta hi baṃḥs ma ya dza dza: dzña na tiṣ+ṭha lhan na mo pu ru sha ya ho: de nas mchod 'bul ni hūṃ trīḥ gzung 'dzin mtshan ma'i rā tra bsgral ba yi: dbang yul phung khams skye mched ma lus pa: mnyam nyid

ba:tshu bde chen dgongs pas dang blang nas:dbang chen pad+ma gsung gi lha la 'bul:bdag med mnyam pa nyid du 'dren rol nas:'khor ba ka nas dag pa'i dngos grub stsol:oṃ mahā su kha pū dza ho:de nas bstod pa ni hūṃ hrī zla gam dbang chen bde ba'i thig le'i klong:tha snyad mtshan ma shes rab dbyings su gnon:ye shes bde mchog mnyam nyid mdzad pa ston:dbang chen he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod:chags pas ma gos pad+ma rgyas 'dra'i zhal:ye shes gzigs ldan spyan gyi dkyil 'khor gsal:bdud dpung zil gnon dur khrod dpal chas klubs:che ba'i dbang phyug pad+ma drag por bstod shin tu phra ba bde chen ga'u ru ye shes bzhi sbyor sgrub sde'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs:gnas yul dur khrod he ru'i mnga' dbang phyug 'bar ba'i khro rgyal rdo rje'i sprin la bstod:'di bzung ji srid byang chub mchog thob par:he ru ka dpal pad+ma rgyal po yis:skad cig 'bral med bde stong zhal bzang ngom:khams gsum rol pa'i brtul zhugs mngon gyur nas:dbang chen gsang gsum ye shes mchog thob 31ga:he ru ga'i yag brgyas bzod

gsol phul de nas 'dzab dmigs ni hū hrīX bde chen dbang drag rol pa'i dkyil 'khor kyi sum brtsegs 'dod 'khyil stong pa'i ga'u rtsa rig stong ngo bo bla ma yab yum gyi: thugs klong pad+ma rā ga'i rdo rje'i sbubs nyi zla kha sbyor snying po trīḥyig dmar: shin tu phra ba sngags kyi 'phreng bas bskor: bzlas pas 'od zer bde ba'i chen por 'gyed: dpa' bo yab yum kun gyi thugs rgyud bskul: gnyis med bde ba chen po'i rol rtsed bsgyur: dbang mchog phra ba'i 'od gsal thig le'i bcud skur thob bral ba'i gnas lugs mngon gyur te gang shar rang grol kun bzang dgongs pa'i ngang: sa pad+ma kro ta h+ya shrī wa hi baṃ ma hā su kha sirnyi pha la hūṃ: ting 'dzin 'gyur med ye shes dgong sapa skyongs shesarab bde chen don gyi rtogs pa rgyas sa ma ā sgrub sngagasan o pad+ma kro ta hrīḥbaṃḥbadz+ra tsasgosarba duṣ+ṭi da ka ha na da ha pa tsa khrom gha ru ṭa sarba yak+ka ḍāk+ki ni garma bh+yo dza: panyu ma hā shrī he ru ka dzñā na dhartu nyibaṃ: sarba sidhi pha la hūṃ yi bye ba bzlas bas snang srid bran du bkol rdzu'aphrul mthu stobs nam mkha' mtha' dang mnyam bde stong spros bral 'od gsal rtogs pa rgyas rag 'dzan mchog gi sa la nges par sbyor sa ma yā las sngags ni snyen ba11 ma

—41 hā kro ta pad+ma kro ti shwa ri badz+ra gī li gī la ya mahā yak+ka ka la ru pa garma ram̐ ram̐ dz+wa la ram̐ hūṃ phaṭa: pad+ma ta kṛt+ta ma hā su kha rā ga sa ma ya ho: khro rgyal stobs 'dus me yi 'bor lo 'di 'bum phrag bzlas pa sa dregs pa zal gyis gnon nad gdon grib yams ga gis glags mi snye da pha lam ji bzhan nus mthu stobs da ldan gas sngags rgyal po 'di da mtshungs daze bral nyams su blangs tshad ban bon byad las grol che bcan dab phyug kun gyi gtsug na spa bde rdzun lag tu longs dang res shes gsal dkon mod rgyal khams 'grams la ltos da mtho sa ma yā de nas mchod ceng bstod pa ni dbyangs gsal yig brgyas lug chad bska sa rten snying mthu yis nus ba gso 'dod gsol gdab sa re 'bras bska sa rol mo snyan pa 'i dbya sa bcas te hū ༷tsho bde sde nga mnyam nyid mchod pa che ba'i mchog: kun khyab lha mo 'jum pa 'i rol ston bcas dbang chen pad+ma gsung gi lha la 'bul: bcu drug ye shes rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol: ma hā pañtsa byu tsa ho: hūṃ nyi dbang chen bde ba'i gzi byin me ltar 'bar gar dgu rngams pa'i bstul zhugs glog ltar 'byug: hi ya bzhad pa'i 'dul gla 'brug ltar sgrogs: pad+ma gsung gi sku gsung thugs la bstod: ho: bde ba'i dbang

phyug pad+ma he ru ka ye shes sgog gi dang blang rnal 'byor la: shin tu phra ba gnyug ma'i 'od gsal rgyun: bde mchog bde ba chen po mngon gyur shog: stong nyid gar dbang shesarab phag mo yum: rtag tu blo yid 'khri zhing phyogs pa'i mod: lhan skyes gnas yul dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma'i: ye shes gzigs pa'i zhal bzang bstan du gsol chos kyimadzod chen dwangs ma'i 'khor lo na ye nas rang byung dpal chen 'dus pa'i zhal: lkog tu ma gyur shes rab gsal ba'i mthong tha snyad spros bral dbu mar byang chub shog blo yis spros pa'i sa lam bsam yas kyang: cig chod bde stong rta yi 'gros mgyogs kyis myur brgal dbang chen pad+ma rgyal po'i lhums: dka' ba med par bde chen mchog thob sgo ga bdag ni mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba yi: rgyud la dbang chen bde bas rgyas theb nas: ma chen gar dbang phag mo'i gsang lam la: drangs nas tshom bu gcig tu sangs rgyas regag gzhan yang bsngo smon rgya yis btab shis pa brjod cing dga' ston bya de mthus nyams rtogs nyi ltar rgyas: tshe ring nad med dbang phyug thob sa ma wā ༅ma rgyal ba' dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la

bsgo/: lag par thugs brtse bas shin tu zab pa rdo rje snying po 'i skor grub pa'i dbang phyug khye'u chung lo tsā da dbang chen bka' babargyal ba mchag dbyangasal pha nor bgo skal smon lam 'phro bcas gtad da lta spel ba'i dus la ma bab pa 'i rin chen brda la bstims shigasor bye mdo khams bkra shis rdzong der dgongs pra sdoms ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus nad mug mtshon chas gzing pa lang pa'i tshe dpa' bo khyed zung sprul pa las lngan gyis zab gas 'di rnyed bstan 'gro'i rgud pa sel 'gro don rlabs chen rma smad byang rong 'gyed 'brel tshad don ldan pad+ma 'od du 'god don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub pa ra the tshom med bka' 'di srungs shigaganod sbyan btsan rgod rgyal dam nyams lag tu ma shor a dam rgya las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya spros med don gyi nyams len rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu h+ya o rgyanagyi slob dpo na pad+ma sa bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda thim snyi zhes pa 'di' lung zen chosakyi bdag po sog sprul rin po che pa d+ma dga' ba'i rdo rjes bkra shis dge ba'i skyes bza ngo du ma da bcas te 'bad rtsol lhun len gyis bskul ro ra/ kho bo rgyal mchog bshad pa rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i 'phrul bdo las zhal bshus de dag par phab pa 'i yi ge pa ni chos kyi bdag po nyid kyis bgyis pa dge legs 'aze la/ sarba make la/

badz+ra: rab gsal shel gyi me longalha sgrib bral bde ba chen ngo 'i sprin la phyag 'tshal lo ye: tha snyad mtshan ma'i chos rnams bdag tu bzung: ma rig rdul gsum rkyen gyis ye shes bsgrib bde stong spros bral 'khor ba'i bde bar gol: dbang chen bde klong ma rtogs mthol lo bshags: hi: rū tra sgrol ba'i brtul zhugs bog ma thon bdud bzhi lam slong phyag rgya gnas ma stobs: gzung 'dzin dbyings sgrol gar chen bsgyur ma nus mnyam nyid thig le spros dang bral bar bshags be bde chen dbu mar 'dzag med bcing ma nus: shes rab bde ba'i ro la spyod ma shes: chos nyid rtog bral 'od gsal rgyun ma brkyangs: thams cad ma chen mkha' 'gro'i dgongs 1nga bshags: she: bde chen nam mkha'i thig le bskul ma shes: mkha' 'gro bde ba'i me chen sbar chul 'chol bskyod byed rgyu ba brtul zhugs thabs ma mkhas: kun kyang lan skyes dpa' bo mkha' 'gror bshags: yas gzhi rtsa dag pa'i chos sku chen po na dam tshig chags nyams gdos mtshan ka nas dag: bshags dang bshags bya bshags byed ye sangs rgyas: gnas

sdo/gas chenags pa chen rngo ra mnyam brdal bzhag: de ltar gzhi rtsa dag pas bshags pa bya don gnyis lhun grub 'bras bu' rgyal po thob sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya dri med nam mkha' dag pa 'i dgo sa mnyam 'ad riga'adzin 'ja' lus rdo rjes bskul bzang po dam tshig las smon dag pa'i sku skyes la gces pa'i snying noranusaldan rdo rjesaphul bslab gsum rnam dag rgyan 'chang tshogs bzang pos bstan pa 'di nyid 'dzan skyongs spel bar shog sarba masgo lo/ bkra shis/

bsnye: zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: dbang chen bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal gyi dgyes bskyed rdzas bzhi'i bskang ba tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho bzhugs so:o: na mo gu ru pad+ma kā ra ye: 〉〉114) bdud dbung zelaganon dab chen gas ba'i dal mi shig dwangs ma'i thig le'i ze'u 'brur rol skal ldan tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho rjogs pa 'i phyir rdzas bzhi'i bska babasod nams mtha' yas 'bul sa ma yā hūṃ sgyi bde stong spros bral 'od gsal dkyil 'khor du: dbang chen pad+ma gsung mchog bska ba'i rdzas: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar pañtsa a mṛ ta mnyam nyid bde ba chen por 'bul gyis bzhes: mtshan ldan bhaji lcang lo can gyi nang srid pa skyed byed rgyu yi khrag chen po pad+ma rak+ta zhing bcu bsgral ba'i khrag: rtsi bcud 'byung ba'i dwangs ma shes rab rdzas: dbang chen gsung gi dkyil 'khor dgyes phyir 'bul: gtor gzhong rnam dag rat+na'i sgod yangs par: 'khor 'das dwangs ma dpal gyi gtor chenapo brjid ldan 'dod yon lnga yi rgyan gyis mdzes: gzi byin bskyed phyir yi dam lha la 'bul: dbyingasarig gnyis da bde chen skong bu rtsa zag med byang chub sems kyi bcud

chen bskyil: ye shes lnga yi 'od stong sgron me sbar ma rig mun pa sangs phyir 'bul bar bgyi dpa' bo dgyes bskyed dza gad sbreng ba yang: 'khor ba ru bzlog ye shes dbyings sbyor phyir: yi dam pad+ma dbang chen lha la 'bul a la la ste dgyes pa chen por bzhes: de ltar phul bas tshogs gnyis rdzogs sgrib dag don gnyis lhun grub 'gyur sa ma mā yim rgyal dbang pad+ma'i thugs bcud skor bla med rdo rje snying po'i sgo ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i rgud skyobs phyir rin chen sa yis gter du sbos dus bar nad mtshon gzeng lang tshe rgyal mtshag sprul ba'i dpa' bo yas rnyed nas phan bde'i dpal kha ngom debar srungs shig btsan rgod rgyal bka' log lag tu ma shor zhig sam ya rgya rgya rgya dzosabarkang tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyislob datsan pad+ma saṃ bha wasabaka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzasabakod pa'o brda thim snyi zhes pa 'di'angalung zen sku skyesapad+ma dga' ba'i rdo rjesabaskul ngor/ bdag 'dragu ldan rdo rjes mkha' 'gro'i 'phrul brda dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni chosabadaganyid kyis brgyas pa'o/ sarba ma le/

gtsa/: tshogs bsdus ni ma dwa na dang ma sa gtso bor gyur ba'i bza' bca' bayi ba'i rags rnams dum gcig snod du bsags te hūṃ trīḥ lhan skyes rdo rje phung po'i grong khyer du: ye mnyam pad+ma dbang gi dkyil 'khor la bde stong dga' bzhi'i tshogs ston 'bul lags na: bdag gzhan ka dag nang dbyings mngon gyur thegag: de ltar phul bas tshogs rdzogs 'gyur sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya zhes dbang thugs rgyud gcig pa ga des bskul ro ra nusaldan pas so/ sarba maṅka la/

badz+ra them medaphyog: zab gsang rdo rjesnyingapolas tshogs chen rab rdzogs bsod nams sprin phung zhes bya ba bzhugs so:badz+ra: na shā ma hā gu ru shrī pad+ma kro ta h+ya sgri wa ye ga444ske kun khyab bde chen mtha' dbus mi dmigs pa pad+ma dbang chen ye shes gsang chen mdzod bde gshegs rab 'byams sprin gyi phungango ra bcas mi shig snying dbus ze'u 'thur dad brgya'i mchod ma 'o sa las ldan skal bzang pho mo yis gsang chen bsnyen sgrub lhur len byed pa'i tshe tshogs chen rab rdzogs bsod nams 'dir brtson na nyams chags rtogasasgrib sbyang zhing dngo sa grub thob sa ma yu ma dwa na da me sa gtsor gyur pa 'i bza' bca' btung ba'i rags rnams kun bsags te sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzan gyis spel lhar gsal ting 'dzan ldan pas 'ad skad do hū ༷sachos nyid sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis: snod bcud 'dod rgu'i dpal yon bcud dril ba'i: tshogs rdzas kun tu bzang po'i sprin du spel: ngo mtshar smad byung rgyal ba'i zhing khyab spro re ye khe: cha a (: kun btags 'khrul ba'i dri ma dbyings su bcom: ye shes sgyu 'phrul ltad mo bsam mtha' yas: gang shar rang grol lha mo'i rol ston bcas 'di na

phun tshogs zhing bkod spros mtha' bral: sa(badz+ra spa ra ṇa kho: de nas tshogs zhang spyan 'dren ni hūṃXs bad stong spros dang bral ba'i pho brang nas dang po'i sangs rgyas kun bzang yab yum dang: dbang chen bde ba'i dkyil 'khor sras dang bcas: dgongs pa'i dbyings las thugs rje'i rtsal mdangs ngom: 'du ba tshogs kyi 'khor lor spyan 'dren gshegs zag med bde ba chen por bzhugs su gsol: kun khyab rig pa rjen pas phyag bgyi'o: dam bskangs tshe dbang mchog thun dngos grub stsol: a ru lu ru lu hūṃbh+yohūṃ: pad+ma krota sarba sa ma ya dza dza: de nas tshogs phud 'bul ba ni hūṃ trīḥ chogs kyi rang bzhin sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga: kun khyab lha mo'i spro bsdu bsam mtha' yas: gnyis med pad+ma dbang chen lha la 'bul: ro mnyam zim pa'i tshul kyis dgyes par bzhes: mahāg tsakra pū dza khā hi: de nas bar bshags ni to lta ba dman zhing spyod pa 'chol dbang gis: sor byang sngags kyi sdom pa dam tshig la chags nyams zhig ral gang song nongs pa kun: mi 'chab mi sped rig pa chos skur bshags: badz+rasamaya āḥ de nas tshogs bsgral ni hūṃ bye dbang chan zla

badz+ra: gam e yi dkyil 'khor nas: bdud dpung zil gnon pad+ma dbang gi sku: rngam brjid srin po khros pa'i tshul du bzhengs: zhing bcu sgrol ba'i las la ma g.yel zhig: ma badz+ra kro ta rbad sarba sha t+t+waṃ ma ra ya phaṭa: de nas bstab mchod ni hūṃ trī dbang chen bde rol zhal gyi hom khung du: log rtog bsgral ba'i phung khams skye mched bstabs: mnyam nyid bde ba chen por darnyis rol nas: 'khor ba ka nas dag pa'i phrin las mdzod: 3 sarba rū tra a la la kha ram̐ khahi: de nas lhag ma 'bul ba ni bh+yo: rdo rje khrag 'thung pad+ma he ru ga'i bka' dang dam tshig gtsug tu 'chang ba yi: dbang phyug ma sring king ling 'bar ba rnams: glog ltar myur ba'i shugs kyis 'dir byon la: pham 'bab bka' yi lhag gtor mchod pa bzhes: sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen sgrub la 'gal rkyen sol: rnal 'byor tshe dab nyams rtogs ting 'dzin bskyed: gang bcol thog med sgrubs shig dam tshig can: skyid ma ma ḍāk+ki ni hrī ba lirnya kha kha kha hi khā hi: de nas bskul ba ni nyi yā bde stong spros bral zla gam e 1nga nas: du tra bsgral ba'i rdzu 'phrul mthu stobs can

dgongs pa'i dbyings las gzugs kyi phyag rgyar bzhengs: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dpa' skyems gtor ma bzhes:mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las 'grub pa dang: rgyalabasen dam sri ming gi lhag mar mdzod:'jig rten rgud pa mtha' dag gzhom pa dang:gang bcol 'phrin las mdzod cig thugs dam can:de nas chad mdo ni hūṃ bh+yo sgog mtha' bar gsum dus tshig lnga pa la:rdo rje rgyal po'i spyan sngar dam mnos pa'i:pho mo ma ning dregs pa'i tshogs rnams kyis sngon tshe zhal bzhes las rnams sgrub pa'i slad bka' yigator ma phud mchod 'di bzhes la:rgyal bstan srung zhing de 'dzin 'dus sde spel:sbyin bdag 'byor ldan bshad sgrub nyi ltar gsal:nag phyogs sma phob dgra bgegs mgo bo non:bskyed rdzogs sgrub pa'i mthun snang legs tshogs spel:bka' dang dam las ma 'da' sa ma yā:de nas bstan ma ni bh+yo:tshogs bdag bka' yi gnyer skyong dam tshig can gang ljongs bod khams srung ba'i sa 'dzin ma:rdo rje kun grags gangs kyi g.yu bun sogs:bstan ma ya ma skyong ma'i tshogs rnams kun:lhab lhub brgyan bcas skad cig 'dir

btsaji: byon la rang rang mthun snang bshos bu bshal chu bzhes: mtha' dmag dus 'khrug rgud pa mtha' dag sol: bod khams bkra mi shis pa'i nyer 'tshe bzlog:rnal 'byor sgrub pa po yi mthun rkyen spel: bka' 'das dam nyams rigs la chad pa chod: legs nyes so kha srungs la ma g.yel cig khyed rnams nyams na khrag 'thung chen pos mnar: de bas dam tshig gnyan po gtsug tu 'chong: 'phrin las gang bcol sgrubs shig bstan ma'i tshogs: 31 ma ma sring 'gro ma e dam ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: de nas rta bro ni hū hrīḥ rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'i e klong du: gzung 'dzin rū tra dam sri 'byung po brub: mnan no ldang med rta yi brtul zhugs 'debs: dbang chen bde klong mngon gyur bar du rgya: oṃ āX hūṃ swā hā: s+t+waṃ bha ya nan: ma ra ya nan: de nas dngos grub na hū trīḥ mi gnas ye shesathugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas: dbang chen bde klong sku gsung thugs kyi dpal: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus pa da lta nyid du sgrab mchog bdag la stsol: rtsa sngags mthar ma hwa su kha sirnyi pha la a la la ho: de nas bshags pa na ho gnyis

'dzin sems kyi dbang du gyur bas nongs: gzhi snang chos sku'i don la sgrib byed kun ye shes chos sku'i dbyings su bshags bgyi'o: shes rab dgongs pas rdul tshogs mkha' la gtor: a āḥ yigebargya pa bzlas la lhag chad bskangs de nas bsngo ba smon lam ni hūṃ hrīḥ tha snyad mtshan ma'i dge ba ma lus pa: kun khyab rig pa chos sku'i dbyings su bsngo: zag dang zag med spros pa rnam dag nas: sku gsum 'bras bu'i rang sa zin par re ga: lan gsum de nas bsdu ldang ni ho: tha snyad mtshan ma'i tshos rnams ma lus pa: ye shes dbang chen thig le'i klong du bsdu slar yang rig stong pad+ma he ru ga'i: du tra sgrol ba'i brtul zhugs spyod lam bya: a yi phaṭa phaṭa: de nas shas pa brjod pa ni na mo dbang chen bde ba'i zhal bzang byin rlabs mdzod: chos nyid rta yi dgongs nyams dngos grub gter bde chen 'bar ba'i gzi mdangs dga' bzhi'i dpal: mchog thun grub gnyis char 'bebs bkra shis 〈snag: gzhan yang bsngo smon rgya yis gdab shas pa brjod cang me tog 'thor des ni don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub the tshom med do sa ma mā yi ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha las ma 'o sa 'gro la shin tu thugs brtse'i phyar

gtsaX mtha' dbus thams cad rin chen gter gyis gtams khyad par zab gsang rdo rje snying po'i skor dbang chen bka' bab rgyal marngog rgyod la gtad da lta ma spel rin chen brda la bstems mdo khams bkra shis rdzong der dgo sa rgya sdoms ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus nad mug mtshon chas gzeng pa la pa'i tshe dpa' bo khyod sprul mdzam gli dbang rgyal dang 'phrad nas bstan pa rin chen 'dzin skyong spel 'gro don 'phrin las bsam ma khyab pa 'byung bka' 'di srungs shig gnod sbyin btsan sgod rgyal dam nyams lag tu ma shor thub par mdzod sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya them med tshogs mchod 'bul ba bsod nams sprin phung rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gas rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas brkod pa'o brda thim snyi zhes pa 'di'angalung zan sku byes pad+ma'i mtshan can gyis bskul ngor/ kho bo dbang chen gsung ga rnal 'byor 'jam gling dbang rgyal rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro gas ba'i 'phrul brda las dag par tha ba pa'i yi ge pa ni chos bdag nyid kyis bgyisapa dge legs 'aze la/ sarba masgo le/ dge'o/ bkra shis/

badz+ra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las dbang chen gsung gi dgyes bskang dgos 'dod char 'bebs bzhugs so: them medasnyi:rmi: na mo gu ru pad+ma kā ra ye: —1ches / bde ba'i gze byen 'byug pa 'i he ru ka pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug rtsal la 'dud gdul zhing snyigs ma'i 'gro khams smin grol phyir dab chen dgyes bskang bdud rtsi'ichar 'bebs bstan sa ma yā sgod bcud dpal 'byor 'dod rgu'i longs spyod kyi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes ba bskang bar bya thod rnga bcu drug ltag sprod mi skang gis dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam gnad nas bskul sa ma yu hūṃ trīḥ ka dag spros bral gnas lugs mngon gyur pa'i: rgyal ba dgongs brgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskang: rang bzhin ma 'dres 'od gsal thig le'i ngang: rig 'dzin brda' brgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskang: bka' lung dbang dang man ngag stsol mdzad pa'i: gang zag snyan brgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskang: gter rigs bco brgyad zab mo'i chos char 'bebs: shog ser tshig brgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskang 'gro kun rang byung ye shes mngon mdzad pa: smon lam las 'phro'i bla ma'i thugs dam bskang: brtse bas rjes bzung

man ngag snying khu sbyin: rtsa brgyud rig 'dzin bla ma'i thugs dam bskang: / hrīḥ dbus mtha' med pa chos kyi dbyings nyid las: bde gshegs zhi ba'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: dngos kun bdud rtsir 'byung ba'i gnas gcig pu: che mchog yon tan lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: ye shes thugs kyi dkyil 'khor spros dang bral: yang dag yab yum sras 'khor thugs dam bskang: yon tan rgya mtsho'i gsang mdzod he ru ga 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: mngon spyod drag pos dgra bgegs rdul brlag pa'i:thal 'byin 'phrin las lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: bde stong spros dang bral ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: ma mo rbod gtong lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: 'jig rten dregs pa las la slog ltar 'khyug: dregs pa kun 'dus lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: dmod pa'i mtshon cha zhing bcu'i srog la 'bebs: stobs ldan las kyi lha tshogs thugs dam bskang:tshom bu dgu yi bka' skyong dam tshig can: rdo rje pho nya yongs rdzogs thugs dam bskang: dkyil 'khor mtha' dbus mi dmigs yangs pa cher dbang bsgyur gtso 'khor sprul

ba:tshu ba'i thugs dam bskang:hūṃ hrīḥdamar nag chos 'byung zla gam e slong nas rta mgrin bdud dpung zil gnon thugs dam bskang:dbang chen yab la bde bas rgyas 'debs pa'i:dbang phyug rdo rje phag mo'i thugs dam bskang:za byed thabs kyi cha 'dzin pho gdon 'dul:bka' nyan byi la'i mgo can thugs dam bskang:gsod byed shes rab rang bzhin mo gdon 'thar las byed pu shud mgo can thugs dam bskang:phyogs mtshams dregs pa bran bkol 'phrin las myur:zil gnon khro chen yab yum thugs dam bskang:tshad med rnam bzhi'i g.yin snang rjes su 'dzin:bka' sdod sgo ma bzhi'i thugs dam bskang:ma rig rmongs pa'i 'gro ba dbyings sgrol phyir:dmus long rgyab 'brel tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang bde chen sbyor ba'i las la mdzad tshul mkhas:dpal gyi khyi spyang bcu drug thugs dam bskang:mngon spyod drag pos dam nyams zhing bcu sgrol:drwa ba glog 'gyu 'dab bzhi'i thugs dam bskang:'phrin las thogs pa med pa'i rdzu 'phrul can dregs pa dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang bstan dang 'gro la 'tshe

ba'i sgog dbugs bsdud: gnod sbyin tsi'u dmar po'ithugs dam bskang: zab gsang snying po'i bshad sgrub rtag tu skyongs rgyud mgon legs ldan yab yum thugs dam bskang:phyogs bzhi mtshams kyi dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa'i: las mkhan lha srin sde brgyad thugs dam bskang: hūṃ hrīḥthugs dam gnyan po bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni: phyi mchod gzung ba dag pas thugs dam bskang: nang mchod 'dzin pa grol bas thugs dam bskang gsang mchod bde ba chen pos thugs dam bskang: dug gsum rnam dag sman gtor rak+tas bskangs: dgra bgegs bsgral mchod sha khrag rus pas bskangs dga' bzhi kha sbyor byang chub sems kyis bskangs: grag stong chos sgra rol mo'i tshogs kyis bskangs: nyams pa gso phyir gā ṇa tsakras bskangs: lta ba mkha' ltar dag pas thugs dam bskang: sgom pa nyi ltar gsal bas thugs dam bskang: spyod pa 'ja' ltar bkra bas thugs dam bskang:'bras bu sku gsum slong yangs thugs dam bskang: bskang bya skong byed dngos 'dzin dag pas bskangs:khyab brdal rig stong rdzogs pa chen por u de ltar bskang bas tshonas

gsaX chen rdzogs rnal 'byor nyams pa sor chud 'gyur rtogs pa 'i yon tan mkha' ltar rgyas dngos grub chu bo rtsol med 'byung sa ma wā ye ma rgyalaba' dbang po pad+ma saṃ ba was ma 'ongs 'gro la thugs brtse chenango yis snyi dang 'dra ba'i yang zab smad byu ba grub pa'i dbang phyug rgyal mchog khyod la gtad da lta ma spel ran chen brda la bsnyims dgos sa 'a sgrom rgya bkra shis rdzong der mdzod ma 'o sa snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus nadamug mtshon gya gzeng pa lang ba'i tshe dpa' bo khyod sprul 'dzam gli dbang rgyal dang 'phrad nas bstan pa 'i 'gro don bsam yas byed gdul zhing ma lus lho nub dpa la rir 'god don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa' rten 'brel yod bka' 'di srungs shig gnod sbyin bcan rgod rgyal dam nyams lag tu ma shor sa ma yā las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya dgyes bskang dgos 'dod char 'bebs rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbasargya zab rgya gas rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyislob dpon pad+ma 'byu gnas kyi bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa 'o brda tham snyi zhes pa 'di'ang lung na chosakya bdag po sku skyes pad+ma dga' ba'i rdo rjes bkra shas pa 'a jos dumar bcas te ya ya bskul ro ra/ kho bodabang chen bka' bab 'dzam glang dbang rgyal rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i 'phrul brda las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni chos bdag nyid kyis bgyis pa 'o/ sarba ma ṅga lam̐/

badz+ra: zab gsang rdo rje snying po las dbang chen bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal gyi 'brin las gtor ma 'bul ba thugs dam dgyes bskang bzhugs so:a: na ma gu ru pad+ma kro dha h+ya ṣ+ṭṛ wa ya: rten11/mi mi bzad bde ba' sku mchog he ru ka dbang chen gsung gi rdo rjer phyag bgyi'o las ldan sgrub mchog dam tshig dag pa yis dbang chen sgrub cing 'phrin las gtor ma'i las thugs dam bska phyar 'di ltar 'bul bar bya bhasto'i nang du sha khrag gtor chung bshams sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs zad med spel rang nyid lar gsal ting 'dzin brtan po yis lha tshogs dbyings nas spyan 'dren bya ba ni hūṃ hrīḥ bde chen klong yangs pad+ma 'khyil ba nas: bdud dpung zil gnon gar dgu'i nyams rdzogs pa: rta phag zhal sbyor 'khor 'das bde mnyam klong: ye shes sgyu ma'i phyag rgyar rab bzhengs te: sgrub mchog mos ngor spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol sna tshogs pad nyi rū tra'i gdan la bzhugs: bde chen chags pa'i rdo rjer phyag bgyi'o:o pad+ma kro ta h+ya shrī wa sarba sa ma ya dza ja: dzñā na tiṣ+ṭha lhan: na mo pu ru sha ya ho: de nas gtor mchod 'bul ba ni ma uhū: dum gcig ka pā la yi snod nang du brtan gamo'i dwangs

bcud sbyar ba'i bha lirnyi:ro mnyam rdo rje bde stong a pra ta:'khor ba dbyings sgrol rak+ta khrag skyems bcas:dbang chen bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal la 'bul:dgyes bskangs mthu dbang tshe yi dngos grub stsol:61 pad+ma kro ta h+ya hṝ wa badz+ra wa ra hi ru lu ru lu sarba sa pa ri wā ra e dam bha larnyi kha kha khā hi khā hi lan bdun gyas phul lha tshogs rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bas thugs bde stong gi ros tshims nas sgrub pa po la mchog thun mong gi dngos grub stsol bar dmigs la: 'phrin bcol ni hūṃ trīX dmar nag zla gam e ya klong dkyil nas: bdud bzhi zil gnon pad+ma he ru ga:chags sogs rdul bral dbang gi zhal bza ngom: bde chen gsung gi rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod: dam rdzas brgyan ba'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:smon log dgra 'dres rgol ba dbyings su bzlog: bslu brid chos brgyad brel long zhi ba dang:nyams rtogs tshe bsod yon tan rab rgyas te:lha 'dre mi gsum dregs pa dbang sdud cing: byang chub bsgrub pa'i nyer 'tshe ma lus pa zhi ba chos nyid chen po' dbyings su bzlog:mi zad bde

btsasdo ba'i sku mchog khro gtum bzhad:'khor 'das mnyam nyid sku yi dbyings su sbyor:gnyis snang 'byung po za ba'i drag shul can:bde chen rdo rje phag mor phyag 'tshal bstod:dam rdzas brgyan ba'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la smon log dgra 'dres rgol ba dbyings su bzlog:bslu brid chos brgyad brel long zhi ba dang:nyams rtogs tshe bsod yon tan rab rgyas te:lha 'dre mi gsum dregs pa dbang bsdud cing:byang chub bsgrub pa'i nyer 'tshe ma lus pa:zhi ba chos nyid chen po'i dbyings su bzlog:rang bzhin dag pa gtsug tor 'khor lo dra ye shes gzigs pa ngom pa'i he ru ga:rdo rje chos kyi dbang phyug thod phreng rtsal:yab yum gnyis med sku la phyag 'tshal bstod:dam rdzas brgyan ba'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:smon log dgra 'dres rgol ba dbyings su bzlog:bslu brid chos brgyad brel long zhi ba dang:nyams rtogs tshe bsod yon tan rab rgyas te lha 'dre mi gsum dregs pa dbang bsdud cing:byang chub bsgrub pa'i nyer 'tshe ma lus pa:zhi ba chos nyid chen po'i dbyings su bzlog:gdos bral dngasam dbying sa kyi 'khor lo dra

rdul bral ye shes sku mchog gshin rje'i gshed sbyor sgrol yum chen gshed bzhi phyogs skyong sogs:dri med rdo rje'i gar la phyag 'tshal bstod:dam rdzas brgyan ba'imachod gtor 'di bzhes la:smon log dgra 'dres rgol ba dbyings su bzlog:baspu brid chos brgyad brel long zhi ba dang:nyams rtogs tshe bsod yon tan rab rgyas te:lha 'dre mi gsum dregs pa dbang bsdud cing:byang chub bsgrub pa'i nyer 'tshe ma lus pa:zhi ba chos nyid chen po'i dbyings su bzlog:bdamatshag chags pa bral ba'i dkyil 'khor nas:zil gnon khro chen che mchog he ru ga:gnam zhal dbyings phyug kro ta rigs bzhi sogs:stobs kyi dbang phyug mchog la phyag 'tshal bstod:dmardzas brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la smon log dgra 'dres rgol ba dbyings su bzlog:basmu brid chos brgyad brel long zhi ba dang:nyams rtogs tshe bsod yon tan rab rgyas te:lha 'dre mi gsum dregs pa dbang bsdud cing:byang chub bsgrub pa'i nyer 'tshe ma lus pa:zhi ba chos nyid chen po'i dbyings su bzlog:shaṃnatudwangs ma kun 'dus 'khor lo dra mi bzad

ba tshu dpal chen yang dag he ru da:kro ti shwa ri khrag 'thung rigs bzhi dang:gnas yul spor ma dbang phyug nyer brgyad sogs:thugs mchog 'gyur med slong la phyag 'tshal bstod dam rdzas brgyan ba'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:smon log dgra 'dres rgol ba dbyings su bzlog:bslu brid chos brgyad brel long zhi ba dang:nyams rtogs tshe bsod yon tan rab rgyas te:lha 'dre mi gsum dregs pa dbang bsdud cing:byang chub bsgrub pa'i nyer 'tshe ma lus pa:zhi ba chos nyid chen po'i dbyings su bzlog:yon tan lhun 'thug mnyam pa'i 'khor lo rtsasrid pa 'thar byed rdo rje gzhon nu dang:'khor lo rgyas 'debs sras lnga khro bcu sogs:'phrin las yongs rdzogs dpal la phyag 'tshal bstod:dam rdzas brgyan ba'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:smon log dgra 'dres rgol ba dbyings su bzlog basmu brid chos brgyad brel long zhi ba dang:nyams rtogs tshe bsod yon tan rab rgyas te:la 'dre mi gsum dregs pa dbang bsdud cing byang chub bsgrub pa'i nyer 'tshe ma lus pa:zhi ba chos nyid chen po'i dbyings su bzlog:khams

gsum rol ba las kyi 'khor lo na srid pa bde sbyor bla med he ru ga: nyid bzhi mu kha dbyings kyi ma lnga sogs srid pa ma mo'i dal la phyag 'tshal bstod: dam rdzas brgyan ba'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: smon log dgra 'dres rgol ba dbyings su bzlog bslu brid chos brgyad brel long zhi ba dang: nyams rtogs tshe bsod yon tan rab rgyas te: lha 'dre mi gsum dregs pa dbang bsdud cing: byang chub bsgrub pa'i nyer 'tshe ma lus pa: zhi ba chos nyid chen po'i dbyings su bzlog: shin tu 'bar ba chen po'i 'khor lo dra/ mthu stobs rmad byung dregs pa kun 'dul rgyal: khams gsum spyi 'dul sde dpon sum cu po: mchod bstod dregs pa'i rgyal la phyag 'tshal bstod: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: smon log dgra 'dres rgol ba dbyings su bzlog: bsgru brid chos brgyad brel long zhi ba dang: nyams rtogs tshe bsod yon tan rab rgyas te: lha 'dre mi gsum dregs pa dbang bsdud cing: byang chub bsgrub pa'i nyer 'tshe ma lus pa: zhi ba chos nyid chen po'i dbyings su bzlog: rab tu bskyod cing g.yo ba'i 'khor lo na nus mthu drag

bsgo/: rtsal stobs ldan nag po dang dgyes bskyed 'byung lnga'i bdag mo dregs pa'i tshogs:drag sngags dbang phyug rgyal la phyag 'tshal bstod dam rdzas brgyan ba'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:smon log dgra 'dres rgol ba dbyings su bzlog:baspu brid chos brgyad brel long zhi ba dang:nyams rtogs tshe bsod yon tan rab rgyas te:lha 'dre mi gsum dregs pa dbang bsdud cing byang chub bsgrub pa'i nyer 'tshe ma lus pa:zhi ba chos nyid chen po'i dbyings su bzlog:gzhan yang sku yi rtsa gnas bsam yas pa:gnas yul dur khro he ru dang 'brel ba'i:rig sngags zhing skyes dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sogs:bka' sdod dregs pa'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod:dam rdzas brgyan ba'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la smon log dgra 'dres rgol ba dbyings su bzlog:bslu brid chos brgyad brel long zhi ba dang nyams rtogs tshe bsod yon tan rab rgyas te:lha 'dre mi gsum dregs pa dbang bsdud cing:byang chub bsgrub pa'i nyer 'tshe ma lus pa:zhi ba chos nyid chen po'i dbyings su bzlog:dbang chen he ru'i thabs kyi cha 'dzin pa:za byed chen

po byi la'i mgo bo can:yum gyi sprul pa gsod byed pu shud mgo:snang stong zung 'jug gar la phyag 'tshal bstod:dam rdzas brgyan ba'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:smon log dgra 'dres rgol ba dbyings su bzlog bslu brid chos brgyad brel long zhi ba dang:nyams rtogs tshe bsod yon tan rab rgyas te:lha 'dre mi gsum dregs pa dbang bsdud cing:byang chub bsgrub pa'i nyer 'tshe ma lus pa:zhi ba chos nyid chen po'i dbyings su bzlog:ma rig rtsad gsad khro rgyal rigs bzhi dang:dregs pa ar gtad zil gnon yab yum tshogs:bka' nyan tshad med rang mdangs sgo ba bzhi:yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor lha la phyag 'tshal bstod:dam rdzas brgyan ba'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:smon log dgra 'dres rgol ba dbyings su bzlog: bslu brid chos brgyad brel long zhi ba dang:nyams rtogs tshe bsod yon tan rab rgyas te:lha 'dre mi gsum dregs pa dbang bsdud cing:byang chub bsgrub pa'i nyer 'tshe ma lus pa: zhi ba chos nyid chen po'i dbyings su bzlog kye:dgongs shig pad+ma dbang chen he ru da: gson cig skyabs kyi mchog gyur bde ba'i sku:

bsnye 7 ye shes zang thal dri med spyan mnga' ba: he ru ka dpal bdag la dgongs su gsol: bsnyen cing sgrub pa'i skal ldan pho mo la: mi zad sku yi dngos grub stsal du gsol: 'gags med gsung gi dngos grub stsal du gsol: 'khrul bral thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol: re skong yon tan dngos grub stsal du gsol: 'gro 'dul 'phrin las dngos grub stsal du gsol phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub stsal du gsol: pad+ma dbang chen gsang gsum mngon gyur te: tshe 'di nyid la rig 'dzin mchog bsgrod nas: he ru ka dpal sras su byang chub regag: bya( pad+ma kro ta sa pa ri wā ra kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sirnyi pha la a la la ho: de ltar gtor 'bul 'phrin bcol zab mo 'di skal ldan sgrub pa po yis gces par zungs 'gal skyen sel zhing nyams rtogs 'phel bar byed the tshom med do rdo rje pad+ma'i bka' sa ma yu e ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis thugs kyi zig le rdo rje snying po' skor grub pa'i dbang phyug rgyal mtshog dbyangs la gtad da dung ma spel rin chen bdo la bstem mdo khams bkra shas rdzong der dgongs pra sdoms ma 'ongs snyigs mar nad mtshon gzengasalang tshe dpa' bo khyod nyad 'dus pa rtsal du bzhengs skyes bu de dang

gdams pa 'di 'phrad nas bstan pa'i 'gro don byang gi phyogs su 'byung rten 'brel legs na ya mtshan rmad byung 'byung bka' 'di srungs shig gnod sbyin btsan rgod rgyal dam nyams lag tu ma shor spu gri gsum las can yongasal sprod cig ging dmar nag sam mā rgya rgya rgya mngon spyod gtor ma 'bul ba'i rim pa rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chenabazas bkod pa'o brda thim snyi zhes pa 'di'ang lung zen sku skyesapad+ma bsod nams grub pa' rdo rjes bkra shis lha reg shin tu dge ba'i skyes ya mtshan can du mar bcas te bskul ngor/ kho bo rgyal mchog bzhad pa rtsal gyis mkha'a'agro gsang ba' 'phrul brda las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni chos bdag nyid kyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga le/

badz+ra: zab gsang rdo rje snying po las dbang chen pad+ma he ru ga'i bka' sdod lcags ging nag po'i sgog sgrub spu gri'i 'khor lo bzhugs so:a: na mo gu ru pad+ma kro dha h+ya sgro wa ya:cha chermi spyortes mi bzad bde ba' sku mchog he ru ka pad+ma dab gi garal phyag 'tshal bstod gdul dka' nyon mongs rgyas pa 'a sems can rnams 'dul byed dpa la lan mgon po' sku ru bzhe sa 'phran las rnal 'byor pa la snyang nye zhing rgyal bstan srung ba'i byed po dam tshag can legs ldan sgru pa' man —ga zab mo bstan sa ma yā thugasamathun yo byad mchod bska brten sgrub rdzas mi lus phun sum tshogs pa ra 'tshogs byas te bdag nyid pad+ma drag po'i ting 'dzan gyis mdun du las byed pho nya gsal ba na rang mdun me rlung dud sprin 'khrugs pa 'i dbus:rab 'jigs thod mkhar rngams brjid 'bar ba'i klong:dgra bgegs dam sri pho mo bsnol ba'i khar:hūṃ:yig mthing nag 'khor 'das dwangs bcud dril:yongs gyur rgyud mgon legs ldan nag po ni khro gtum char sprin 'khrigs 'dra'i gzi mdangs 'bar:dar nag ber chen me tog tshom bu can:sku la bgo zhing bzheng sa pa'i stabs kyis 'gying:phyag g.yas nyon mongs rgyun

gcod gri gug phyar g.yon pas dgra bgegs rdul brlag thod khrag 'dzin: dug gsum rtsad gcod kha ṭ+wāṃ mchan g.yon brten: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril rno dkar mche ba gtsigs mthing nag ral pa nam mkha'i dbyings su gzeng: thod skam dbu brgyan dar sna'i cod pan bcing: rin chen snyan cha dar gyi dpyangs pa 'phur: thod 'phreng sbrul chun do shal tshul du mdzes: g.yon du yum mchog kro ti shwa ri ma: gzig sham rus rgyan mi lngags stod g.yog klubs: spu gri g.yas la bhan khrag g.yon du bsten: sku la btud cing bde ba'i rnam 'gyur 'bar: 'bar ba'i 'od zer phyogs rnams kun tu 'byed: phyi rim dregs pa'i dmag tshogs bsam mtha' yas: ma 'dres rgya mtshor gza' skar bkra ba bzhin gtso bo'i bka' la nyan pa'i tshul du gsal: kun gyi thugs sgog rdo rje'i sa bon las: 'od 'phros rang bzhin gnas nas rang 'dra ba: dpag tu med pa spyan drangs ro gcig bsre spyan 'dren ni hū bh+yo: bdag ni rig 'dzin sgrub pa po: bdag ni rnal 'byor dam tshig can: chos skyong dam can las la 'du: srung ma rgya mtsho dam la gnas: gsang ba'i snying po la

badz+ra: gnas bzhin: tha tshig bsgrags nas 'bod lags na: laṅka'i yul gyi grong brdal gyi: dbus kyi ri bo ma la ya: ko kha thang mar rgya mtsho'i spor: drag shul yod pa'i rtse mo dra bdud kyi sde tshogs pham mdzad pa'i: legs ldan lcam dral bka' 'khor bcas: dam tshig gnas 'dir da tshur byon: dgyes pa'i zhal bzang bstan pa dang:'phrin las yongs kyi byed po mdzod ma bhurkur mahā kā la kro ti shwa ri sarba sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: bzhunas gsol ni hūṃ hrīḥ bla rdo srog 'khor brten pa'i rdzas: 'dod yon mchod sprin dgyes skong dpal: dgongs pa 'gyur med spro dga'i gnas: dam tshig mchog la bzhugs su gsol: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: dam bsgrags ni sa dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: bstan pa'i snying po bsrung ba'i phyiraḥ dbang rtags lcags kyi rdo rje yi: khyod la dam rtags mchog tu 'bul o badz+ra sa ma ya ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa: mgon po'i sgra 'tshams su lcags kyi rdo rje rtse lnga bas brgyan par bsam la: gyi 'di ni khyod kyi mna' chu ste: nyams na snying bsregs dmyal bar lcang: dam bsang byang chub mchog la spod: ye

shes gsang ba'i tha tshig la rtag tu gnas mdzod dam tshig can:pakru su hūṃ na ra gan:phyag 'tshal ni na mo:rgyal bstan spyi dang gsang ba sngags:khyad par don gyi rgyud sde yi:bstan pa bsrung bar gnyer blangs ba'i lcam dral bka' 'khor bcas la 'dud:na mo pu ru sha ya ho:mchod pa ni hūṃ hrīḥdabang po yul drug bskang ba'i byir:mdzes pa'i gzugs dang snyan pa'i sgra ngad ldan dri dang bcud mchog ro:'jam mnyen reg bya lha yi gos:dug gsum rnam dag sha rus khrag dam tshig brten rdzas sman gtor raka:dgyes bskangs lha mo'i gar chen po mi rkang rba dkar gling bu dang:snel mo' mgo dang g.yang gzhi'i rgyan:chos skyong thugs mthun rol mo'i sgra:phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang gi:mchod bskang brten sgrub dam rdzas kyis legs ldan nag po'i thugs dam bskangs:kro ti shwa ri'i thugs dam bskangs:dregs pa'i dmag tshogs thugs dam bskangs nyams pa bskang ngo bzod par bzhes nasal snang dri ma tshogs kyis sprangs:dgyes brtse'i dam tshig gnyer bzhin du:las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod ma byurkur ma hwa ku la kro ti

badz+ra shwa ri sa pa ri wā ra pañtsa a dṛ ta rak+ta bha lirnyi sarba pū dza khāhi: 'dod gsol ni ho: rdo rje 'chang gi bka' nyan: liṅka'i yul gyi srung ma rig 'dzin kun gyi sgog shing: rnal 'byor yo sa kyi dgra bla: chos 'khor skyong ba'i srung ma: gtsug lag kha gi dkor srung: dug gsum nad kyi sman pa: mthu ldan yongs kyi rje bo: dpal legs ldan lcam dral bka' 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis mchod sbyin kyi gtor ma dam pa 'di bzhes la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs: sems can la phan bde spel: 'jigs pa brgyad dang bsnol: legs tshogs dpal yon dang sprod: gzhi byes kun tu srungs: bshad sgrub la mel rtse mdzod rnal 'gyer ba bdag gis ci re ba dang ci smon pa'i las thamasacad yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i 'phrin las dam pa mdzod cig: bstod pa ni hū spyo ma rungs bdud kyi dpung tshogs 'joms mdzad cing: sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i dam tshig can: sems can phan bde spel la thabs mkhas pa'i: he ru ka dpal mchog la phyag 'tshal bstod: rā tra'i lus la rdo rje'i rdul bskrun tshe: khyod nyid byang chub sems kyi mgon

por byung: nang rgyud bstan pa bsrung ba'i gnyer byang gtad: dpal ldan rdo rje drag shul 'chang la bstod li liyul rnams kun la dbang bsgyur zhing drag shul yod pa'i rtsemor brten mdzad cing: 'phrin las mi nus dam ldan yongs kyi dpal: chos skyong myur mgyogs bdag por phyag 'tshal bstod: khros na dgra bgegs srog gcod gri gug phyar dgyes tshe rten 'brel khrag la rngam rol mdzad: bskul tshe pha rol dgra dpung brlag mdzad pa'i: mthu ldan drag shul can la phyag 'tshal bstod:thabasakyirang bzhen ma hā kā la'isku: shes rab rnam rol kro ti shā ri yum bde stong zung 'jug rnam rol dregs pa'i tshogs: bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod:rtsisred byang chub snying po ma thobapar: rgyud mgon lcam dral grogs su brten lags na: tshe bsod nyams rtogs dge legs dpal yon bskyed mi mthun phyogs kun bzlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzod: snyen bhurkur ma hā kā la 11 ti shwa ri hūṃ phaṭa yak+ka rakru sarba sa ma ya 11 dza: ting 'dzin ldan pas ci nus bzlo skabs su gsol mched 'bul ba ni mchod rdzas yo byad kun bsags te sngags dang phyag rgyas bsangs sbyangs spel

badz+ra: pa ra gsal ting 'dzin brtan ngo yis hūṃ: dam tsheg can 3 srung ma ni: laṅka'i yul gyi bka' sdod pa: gsang sngags chos kyi gnyer 'dzin pa'i legs ldan lcam dral bka' 'khor bcas dam tshig gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: bla rdo sgog 'khor rten la bzhugs bstan pa bsrung phyir gus phyag 'tshal: dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul ba'i: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa dang: bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid bdun: ga ṇa tsakra'i dga' ston dang: thugs mthun mchod sprin mtha' yas pas: legs ldan nag po gsol mchod bskangs: kro ti shā ri gsol mchod bskangs: dregs pa'i dmag dpon gsol mchod bskangs: bka' 'khor bsam yas gsol mchod bskangs: dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur zhal bzang ston: dgra dang bgegs la bka' chad chod: rnal 'byor yongs kyi srung ma mdzod: bshad sgrub gzhi tshugs dar rgyas mdzod: 'jig rten bde ba'i 'phrin las la: rtag tu mel rtse mdzad du gsol: dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā: gra sa bsogs phud gtor gtsang sar mchod des na rnam bzhi'i 'phran las rgyas bar chad dgra da bgegs las rgyal don gnyasalhun

grub the mi tshom sa ma rwa ye ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pa d+ma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen ro yis shin tu zab pa rdo rje snyi po 'i skor grub pa 'i dab phyug rgyal mchog khyod la gtad da du ma spel rin chen brda la bsnyims mdo khams bkra shis rdzo der dgongs pra sdoms ma 'ongs snying mar nad mtshon gzeng lang che dpa' bo khyod nyid 'dus pa rtsal du bzhengs skyes bu de dang gdams pa 'di 'phrad nas 'gro don 'phrin las bya nas bya du rgyas 'brel tshad don ldan pad+ma 'od du 'god don gnyas lhun gyis grub pa'i rten 'brel yod sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya lcags gang nag po' zab sgrub spu gri 'bar ba rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gas rgya gu rgya o rgyan gya slob dpo na pad+ma sa bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa 'o brda thim snyi zhes pa 'di'ang lung zin chosakyi bdag po sku skyes pa d+ma bsod nams grub pa 'i rdo rjes bkra shis dge ba'i skyes ya mtshan can du mar bcas te bskul ro ra/ kho bo rgyas mtshog bzhad pa rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro gas ba' 'phrul brda las zhal bshus te dag pa ra phab pa 'i yi ge pa ni chos kyi bdag po nyad kyis brgyas pa dge legs 'aze la/ sa rba masgo lo/

btsa/: gsol bsdus ni ྅: gnam lcags ma la ya yi rtse mo dza rū tra'i sde dpung ma lus 'joms mdzad cing: gsang sngags bstan pa srung ba'i dam tshig can: lcags ṭ+wāṃ/rdo ༷༷ra ba chen po gtso 'khor bcas: 'dod yon dga' ston sprin gyis thugs dam bskangs bshad sgrub yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel rgyas mdzod: zhes grangs bsog go 'di yang nus

badz+ra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las dbang chen pad+ma he ru ga'i bka' sdod zangs ging dmar po'i srog sgrub las kyi spu gri bzhugs so a: na 31 gu 〈co pad+ma 11 dha h+ya shrī wa ya: zugarten//la ma bzad bde ba'i sku mchog nye ru ka pa d+ma gsu gi gar la phyag 'tshal lo dam ldan sgrub mchog drag po' pho nya ru zangs gi dmar po' srog sgrub zab mo bstan sa ma yu de yang bla rdo srog 'khor rdzas ldan bkod dmar gtor rtse 'go lkog ma hū gis btsang mchod gtor po byad phun sum tshogs par bkod rang nyid pad+ma he ru'i rgyal gyis mdun du srung ma dam can gsal ba na hū mdun du me rlung dud sprin 'khrigs pa'i klong khrag mtsho dmar po rba rlabs g.yo ba'i dbus: raX las drang sgong spug nag 'od 'phros ni: sku mdog dmar nag me yi 'od zer 'bar: sku stod srin po'i gzugs can 'jigs rngams bzhad: dbu dgu bya rog gdong dang bcu ru gzigs: lto bar zhal hom ri rab zom 'dra bas: zhing bcu tshang rnams chub kyis rdzub par byed: sku smad gla lcam spral mjug rnam par 'khyil: me 'byug dmar po rjang gi shugs ldan bcibs mgo lus thams cad gzigs byed mig gis gang: phyag bzhi

rwa yi mda' gzhu dgra snying zhags: rnam par 'dzin cing bstan pa'i dgra sde gsod: bka' nyan gdong mo bzhi dang gza' chen brgyad rgyu skar nyer brgyad sku yi 'khor du ngom rang rang thugs srog rdo rje'i sa bon las: 'od 'phros dregs pa rgya mtsho spyan drangs bstim: spyan 'dren ni dza dza theg chen bstan la rtag tu mel rtse byed: dam ldan yongs kyisa'aphrin las gang bcol sgrub: nyams pa can la bka' chad gcod mdzad pa'i: gza' bdud 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol: hrītram̐ shag ru re nā ga tsit+ta kre ma ma yo za'agram ha he ke sha la dza ja: bzhugs gsol ni dza: thugs mthun dam rdzas bla rdo sgog 'khor dang: rten sgrub gtor ma dar nag sku gzugs la: drang srong chen po 'khor bcasabazhugs su gsol: dam log slob ma'i snying khrag khung kyis bzhes: badz+ra rak+ka rā hu la sarba sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: phyag 'tshal na na mo rgyal bstan spyo dang rdo rje theg pa yi: bstan pa'i gnyer 'dzin drang sgong rā hu la: u rgyan chen po'i bka' dam gtsug khur ba'i: dam ldan khyod la mos pas lha phyag 'tshal: na mo sarba a ti pu ho: mchod 'bul ni hrī dri med

badz+ra: rig pa'i ltad mor 'phrul ba ni:yul drug skong byed dbang lnga'i me tog dang:tshil chen bdug spos zhun gyi mar me'i 'od:mkhris pa'i dri chab sha rus zhalazas dang rkang gling thod rnga sngags tshig bshug pa glu:snying sna khrag sna rwa yi dbang lnga dang:mnyes bskang dam rdzas nam mkha'i mthar mnyam pa'i:ngo bo dag chen rang bzhin snatshogs pa:rol ba chos skyong bskang ba'i yo byad kyis drang che nga spug nag 'od 'phros thugs dam bskangs:sprul pa gdong bzhi gza' brgyad thugs dam bskangs:rgyu skar dragapo'i dmag tshogs thugs dam bskangs bdag gi khyod la 'phrin las gang bcol dang:dgos su mngon spyod 'bad med lhun grub mdzod:sarba pañtsa a pra ta pū dza khā hi:bstod pani dza:skye med nam mkha'i khams la dbang bsgyur zhing:'gags med sgyu ma'i sku ru mngon snang ba:dregs ldan yongs kyi spyi rje rā hu la:gzas po'i srog dbugs sdud la phyaga'atshal bstod:spyan stong gzegs pas srid gsum legs nyes gsal:zhal hom gdangs bas 'gal zla'i dpu tshogs rngub:ye shes mtshon chas zhing bcu'i don snying 'byin

srog bdag mthu rtsal can la phyag 'tshal bstod: phyogs bzhi'i bdud 'joms gdong bzhi las la 'gyed dregs pa gza' brgyad sku yi 'khor du ngomaḥ rgyu skar nyer brgyad bstan pa'i bya ra ba: gtso 'khor sprul bar bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod gar dmigs yul du skad cig thog ltar 'bebs: dgra bsad shan pa spu gri rno ngar can legs nyes rtsad gcod drang srong dam tshig ldan: khyod nyid bdag gi grogs su sgrub lags na: snying ma ring la brtse bas zhal bzang ston: lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs mdzod sa ma yā: sa nā ga rak+ka rā hu la hūm̐ sa ma ya dza dza: 'bod sngags chu bo' gzhung bzhin bzla 31 nā ga raka rā hu la ha la ha la dgra la rbad: rbad sngags do gal da bstun bzla snyen nā ga rak+ka rā hu la ha la ha la dgra bo sgo dresad: bsad sngags las la gnad tshe bzla skabs su bskang gsol 'bul ba ni mchod gtor bsangs sbyangs bsgyur spel nas rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal kyis dza dza: drang 11nga 11ga bdag rā hu la: srid pa gsum gyi legs nyes mkhan bka' chad dgra la 'bebs mdzad pa'i dam tshig can gyi srung ma khyod mi 'bral grogs su da tshur byon thugs mthun mchod rdzas yo byad dang bskang

bsnye: bar 'os pa'i dam rdzas kyis: gza' bdud dug gi spu gri mchod bka' nyan gdong mo mched bzhi mchod: rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad mchod: yang g.yog dregs pa sde brgyad mchod: 'khor bcas gsol mchod thugs dam bskangs: dgyes pa bskyed pa'i byin rlabs kyis: nad mug mtshon gyis rgud pa sol: dgra dang bgegs kyi sgog rtsa chod: mngon spyod 'phrin las lhun grub cing: sgrub pa po la brtse bas skyongs: bshad sgrub chos kyi gzhi 'dzugs shing: phyogs las rnam rgyal 'phrin las sgrubs dam la ma 'da'as ma yā: gra sa bsogs phud gtor gtsang sar mchod drang sro dgyes nas ga bcol las thogs med yid bzhin stsol ba dang dgra la bka' chad gcod pa ra 'gyur sa ma yā ye ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pa d+ma saṃ bha was ma 'o sa 'gro la thugs brtse chen po yis snying da 'dra ba'i gdams zab rmad byung ba grub pa 'idabang phyug rgyal mchag khyod la gtad da du ma spel rin chen brda la bstims mdo khams bkra shis rdzo der dgo sa bra sdoms ma'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus dpa' ro khyod sprul thugs kya bu chen da 'phrad nas bstan dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid spel gdul zhi 'phrin las byang gi pha mthar rgyas bstan pa 'i gzhi ma btsan rgod 'bar bas spel bshad

sgrub rgyal mtshan dmar nag ging gis tshugs legs nyes shan drang spu gri gsum gyis phyes 'brel tshad rig 'dzin zhing du skyel ma mdzod sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya bka' sdod zangs ging dmar po' srog sgrub las kyi spu gri rdzogs so gterargya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa' bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda thim dzi ces pa 'di yangayung zen chosakyi bdag po sku skyes pad+ma bsod nams grubapa'i rdo rjes bkra shis dge ba'i skyes ya mtshan can du mar bcas te bskul ngor/ kho bo rgyalamatshag bzhad pa rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i 'phrul brda las zhal bshus te dag pa ra phab pa' ya ge pa ni chos bdag nyid kyis bgyis padage ltegs 'phel/ sarba ma lo/ba tshu gsol bsdus ni trīḥ srid gsum srog rtsa lag na 'chang ba yi drang srong legs nyes shan 'byed rā hu la: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus pas mchod thugs dam dgyes bskang zab gter bstan pa srungs: zhes grangs bsog go 'di yang blo gros pad+mor rdal phyir nus ldan pas so/

badz+ra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las dbang chen pad+ma gsung gi bka' sdod:btsan rgod rdo rje yang le ber gyi las gzhung bsrings ba 'brin las lhun grub bzhugs so rmi na 31 gu ru pad+ma kro dha rā dza ya:rnam10cha gsung mchog pad+ma dbang gi he ru ka mi 'bral bde chen rgyan du mchod par brgya ma 'ongs skal ldan sgrub la snyang rus canaḥdagra da bgegs gyi g.yul las rgyalaba'i phyir btsan rgod 'bar ba rdo rje dgra 'joms kyi zab pa'i las gzhung 'phran las lhun grub bstan sa ma yu de yang sgrub jos bla rdo srog 'khor sogs rgyud las byung ltar mtshan lngan dal dbus bkod gtor ma nyer spyoda'adod rdzas yo byad bkram bsangs khrus byan rlabs phun sum tshogs pa'i sa dam rgya bsdam te lha yi nga rgyal gyis yin ma hā shu h+ye ta dzñā na badz+ra su bha wa ad+ma ko3nya:rang mdun me rlung dud spran 'chubs ma'i dbus:zangs mkhar dmar po rtse mo dgongs la reg:mi rta bam ro gsar rnying mang du bsnol:dur bya lce spyang sha zan nyul zhing 'tshubs:de dbus 'jigs byedardo rje btsan rgod ni:dmar nag khro gtum e tsigs rab tu bsdams:spyan mig glog 'khyugs dar gyi la thod mdzes sma ra las spros me yi tsha tshwa 'phyo dbab gi dar ber dmar po sku

la klubs rin chen mgul rgyan snyan cha do shal mdzes phyag g.yas btsan zhags dam nyams ske la bskor: g.yon pas mdung dmar zhing bcu'i snying la 'debs zhabs gnyis sag lhum dang bcas phyed 'gyeng gis bra bo g.yu rngog gser gyi sga gong rol: me yi tshwa tsha glog dang thog ser 'khrug: de yi g.yon phyogs dgyes bskyed chen mo ni: dmar nag khrag ral gzeng shing khro zhing gtum: spu gri dang ni dgra snying dmar rlon 'dzin: dar sngon ber bgos sbrul chun mgo 'phreng spras: me rta dmar po rlung gi gshog ldan bcibs skad cig yud la stong gsum bya ra byed de yi phyi rim sku las spros pa'i btsan rus btsan dkar po 'byung ba rdo la rgyu: sdom sdig sbal sbrul nya gcong sna tshogs dbus klu rta bcibs shing btsan mdung sbrul zhags 'dzin sha btsan ser po 'byung ba sa la rgyu sa bdag gnyan gtod 'khor tu ngom pa'i dbus: gza' rta bcibs shing btsan mdung gser zhags bsdam: drod btsan dmar po 'byung ba me la rgyu: drang sgong dregs pa 'khor du ngom pa'i dbus bdud rta bcibs shing btsan mdung me zhags 'dzin: dbugs

badz+ra: btsan ljang gu 'byung ba rlung la rgyu: gnod sbyin 'khor tshogs sprul bar ngom pa'i dbus: chu rta bcibs shing btsan mdung rlung zhags bsdam: rtsa btsan khra bo skye 'gro'i dbugs la rgyu: rā dza dregs pa 'khor du ngom pa'i dbus: rlung rta bcibs shing btsan mdung rgyu zhags 'dzan: rgyus btsan spug po 'byung ba zung la rgyu: srin po'i dmag tshogs 'khor du ngom pa'i dbus 'phur ldan rta bcibs btsan mdung glog zhags bsdams: khrag btsan dmar nag 'byung khams chu la rgyu: dbang ldan dmag tshogs 'khor du ngom pa'i dbus: btsan rta bcibs shing mdung dmar thog zhags 'dzan: kun kyang khrab rmog 'khor gsum rgyan du 'chang: khro 'dzum sgeg nyams ma nges rnam 'gyur ngoms:sngags la gdung zhing sgrub pa po la brtse: pad+ma'i bka' nyan rje yi rim gro ba: 'bod pas snyan gsang bskul na las la myur: bka' nyan dam tshig srung ba'i pho nya ru mdun na sngags tshogs mang pos sngags ston byed: g.yas na skyes pa sna tshogs mda' 'phen 'ur: g.yon na byis pa bud med rtse 'jo rol rgyab na btsun pa khrims ldan bshad sgrub 'ur:

gar ging 'bag seng spra dang spre'u'i tshogs: blon po'i tshogs kyis dpa' bo'i dgyes pa bskangs: sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las rgyal chen lngas: sangs rgyas bstan srung skye rgu sems can la: legs nyes bka' khrims yo drang thig gis 'byed: mthu ldan dregs pa'i dpung tshogs bsam mtha' yas: ma 'dres rgya mtshor gza' skar bkra ba bzhin: rnal 'byor mos ngor gsal ba'i srog yig las 'od 'phros rang bzhin gnas nas rang 'dra ba: dpag tu med pa spyan drangs ro gcig bstims de nas snyan gsan dbab pa ni ho dgongs su gsol lo gsan tu gsol lo: o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi bka' tha tshig la gnas pa'i: btsan rgod rdo rje yang le ber rgyal chen sku lnga yab yum: sku las spros pa'i 'bar ba spun bdun: ru 'dren sde bzhi'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad btsan gyi yul na bzhugs sam: gnod sbyin gyi yul na bzhugs sam: 'byung lnga'i dbyings na bzhugs sam: bha dra hor na bzhugs sam: sham bha la na bzhugs sam: li yul lcags ra spug po na bzhugs sam: be har dkor mdzod gling na

badz+ra: bzhugs sam: 'on te sgrub pa'i gnas mchog dam pa gang na bzhugs kyang dad pas 'bod do: dam tshig gis bskul lo: rtse gcig tu brten sgrub mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs shig: byon cig: tsa tu shu la dri badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: bdud pa ska gling rol mo' sgras bskul te kye: phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha gi na: nyi ma nub phyogs pha gi na:btsan yul zangs thang dmar po nas: sku mkhar rdo rje ldem pa'i klong me rlung 'tshubs ma'i dkyil 'khor nas: pad+ma dbang gi bka' nyan pa: btsan rgod rdo rje yang le ber sprulapa btsan dmag dpung dang bcas skad cig yud tsam gshegs su gsol dam la gdung bzhin gshegs su gsol: sgrub la brtse bzhan gshegs su gsol: 'phrin las bsgrub phyir gshegs su gsol: tsā tu shu la tri badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: bzhugs gsol ni bh+yo dam tshig rten gyi sku mkhar nang: bla rdo sgog 'khor rten pa'i rdzas: ma tshang med pa'i yo byadal: rtag tu nye bar bzhugs su gsol: badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: phyag 'tshal ni ho: dgongs pa dbyings su ye dag kyang: rnam rol 'brin las bstan pa'i dpal: bshad sgrub

thongs kyi gzhi 'dzin pa bstan srung rgyal por phyag 'tshal lo: na mo na maho: marna 'bul ni shāje dbang cen pad+mahe ru ga'i: bka' sdod rdo rje yang le ber: khyod kyi thugs dam bskang ba'i phyir: dgra bgegs dbang lnga'i me tog dang tshil chen dud pa bdug pa'i sbos: zhus chen rkang mar bstam pa'i me: mkhris pa mnyam par sbyor ba'i chab: sha rus sgrungs ba'i zhal zas dang rkang gling thod pa'i rnga sgra yis: thugs dam gnyan po bskang gyur cig: gzugasakyi gzugs mchogargyang zhags dbang: sgra yi mchog gyur sgra 'dzin 5khan: dri yi mchog gyur dri 'dzin sgo ro yi mchog gyur ro 'dzin dpal: reg bya'i mchog gyur reg shes kyis thugs dam gnyan po bskang gyur cig: dam tshig gcig tubasre ba'i sman: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dpa' skyems zas: nyon mongs dug lnga bsgral ba'i khrag: 'khor ba dbyings su stong byed skyems: rin thang bral ba'i chang phud kyis: thugs ) ma gnyan po bskang gyur cig: dgra tho'i sha nizan bas zhim: de bzhin khrag ni chang bas mngar: rus pa mar bas sla ba ste: dug gsum rnam dag mchod pa yis thugs dam

badz+ra cha gnyan po bskang gyur cig: gzhan yang ja chang mtsho ltar bskyil: sha khrag longs spyod ri ltar spungs 'dod rgu'i dpal yon 'ja' ltar 'byug: rdo rje lha mo sprin ltar gtibs: rol mo sna tshogs 'brug ltar sdir: bshud glu rnyan pa'i dbyangs bcas te: btsan rgod 'bar ba'i thugs dam bskangs: sgog len dmar mo'i thugs dam bskangs: rol pa skya bdun thugs dam bskangs: 'bar ba spun bdun thugs dam bskangs 'byung lnga'i btsan rgod thugs dam bskab sa: ru 'dren sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskangs: 'khor tshogs sprul ba'i thugs dam bskangs: thugs dam gnyan po bskang gyur cig: g.yar dam nyams pa sor chud mdzod: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i las mdzod cig oṃ ma hā byu dza swā ra ṇa sa ma ya ho: bstod pa na bh+yo: sku mkhar mjes pa lha'i gzhal yas: khros na dregs pa'i thod mkhar rngams: brjid ldan de yi 'od klong nas: 'bar ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod yab ni khrims ldan lha yi lus: yum ni sngags pa mthu ldan rigs: sras po bstan gnyis srung ba'i bdag: legs nyes shan 'byed de la bstod:

o rgyan pad+ma'i dam tshig gtad: zab gter yongs kyi srung mar bskos: dgra bgegs sgol ba'i shan par gnyer: mthu ldan khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: sku ni me yi dkyil 'khor las: zer gyis 'byung po'i tshogs rnams bsregs: khams gsum yul la thogs pa med: dpa' bo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: bshad pa ha he 'brug ltar sgogs: dgra dang 'byung po'i glad pa 'gem: gsang sngags bshad sgrub 'byung ba'i gzhi: dregs pa'i gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod: brtse ba chen po'i thugs rje yis: sems can yongs la ma ltar byams sgrub pa po rnams bu bzhin skyongs: legs nyes ltong 'dzin thugs la bstod: bskul na nam mkha'i glog las myur: rbad na dgra dpung rdul du brlag: rdzu 'phrul stobs ldan rdo rje'i ging gtso 'khor sprul bar bcas la bstod: 'dzab dmigs ni bdag nyid pad+ma dbang chen gyi thugs las 'od zer dmar gsal spros: mdun du chos skyong thugs gar phog: thugs dam rgyud bskul srog snying ni 'od zer tsatri'i rnam par byung: bdag nyid yi dam thugs gar phog: chos skyong sgog la dbang bsgyur bsam: yi dam kyi rtsa sngags

—41: mjug 1 tsa tu sdo/ la tri sa ma ya pho dza: bzla sngags chu bo' rgyun bzhin bzla smra bcad mi da ma 'phrad pa ra bdun zhag gsum bsgrub grub rtags 'byung sru ma lus dang grab bzhin 'grogs ba na rdzas khyog na 'dod yon 'byor rtag sgrub rno meda'u ltar du shes sngags pa mthu dang ldan pa gnas chos skyong las la bcun pa gnad dgra mgo yan par btang gyur na bstan dang bstan 'dzin yongs la rgol de phyar mngonaspyod las la brtson drag po mthu yi rtags mtshan ston 'di la stoms las mi bya bar brtson 'grus drag po sa rtag tu 'bad 'bras bu legs par ma smin tshe phyi rabs rgyud 'dzin bdag gis bslus spro ba bskyed la yid ches mdzod sa ma wā rme ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la shin tu brtse ba yis snying dang 'dra ba'i yang zab rmad byu ba grub pa' dbang phyug rgyal mchog khyod la gtad da dus spel ba'i dus la ma bab pa sa rin chen brda la bstems shig sa ra bye mdo khams bkra shis rdzong der dgongs pra sdoms ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus nad mug mtshon chas gzeng pa lang pa'i tshe dpa' tho khyod sprul rig 'dzin 'dus pa rtsal skyes bu de dang gdamasapa 'di 'phrad nas 'gro don 'phrin las byang gi pha mthar rgyas 'phrin las che chung rten 'brel legs nyes yin don la 'brel tshad don ldan dpal rir 'god rgo 'di srungs shig ging chen dmar nag dang spu gri mched gsum btsan

rgod 'bar bar gnyer sgod min lag tu ma shor thub par srungs las can skal bzang rnams kyi phyag tu sprod sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya btsan rgod 'bar ba' sgrub gzhung phrin las lhun grub rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya yorgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda thim snyi zhes pa 'da'ang lung zin chos kyi bdag poskucasapad+ma bsod nams grub pa'i rdo rjes bkra shis dge ba' skyes ya mtshan can mang po dang bcas te nan tan chen pos bskul ngor/ khobargyal mchagabashad pa rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i 'phrul bdo las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni chos kyi bdag po nyid kyis bgyis pa dgelegs 'phel/ sarba ma lo/

badz+ra: zab gsang rdo rje snying po las:bka' sdod yang le ber gyi mchod thabs bsdus pa phrin las myur 'grub bzhugs so:a:na 31 gu ru pad+ma kā ra ye:2711)rte sha khrag gtor ma ja chang skyems phud bshams bsangs sbyangs spel la rol mo sna tshogs sgrogs snyan pa' dbyangs bcas lha yi rgyal gyis bdag nyid dbang chen rtamagran tu gsal ba' thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu ltar 'phros te gnod sbyan btsan rgod rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa la phog sngon gyi bka' tha tshag dran nas glog ltar myur ba' rdzu 'phrul gyis byon te rang nyid yi dam lar gsal ba'i mdun du dam tshag chen po dang ldan pa'i ngang nas 'bod par bsam rkye:gnod sbyin rgyal po tsi ma ra:bka' sdod ru 'dren sde bzhi dang:sku lnga blon bdun bye ba'i 'khor:dam tshig chen pos 'bod cing bskul glog ltar myur ba'i 'phrin las kyis:sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs:bla rdo sgog gsar rten la bzhugs:'phrin las sgrub phyir gus phyag 'tshal:dbu 'phang mtho phyir mnga' gsol 'bul:gro dmar bhe ta'i gsang mchod dang:gri snying za 'og nor snas phyur:ja chang sha khrag gtor skyems bzhes:dgyes pa'i

rkan sgra dang bcas rol: 'phrin las sangs rgyas bstan pa srungs: rnal 'byor lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs: dkor nor yongs kyi rdzi bu mdzod: mi nad nor gyi god kha chod zhing bcu'i dgra la gdug rtsub ston: rnal 'byor yongs la 'khu ma skyen: ngo srung zas phyir khyod ma 'brang: bdag cag bu sdug bzhin du skyongs: gang bcol 'phrin las g.yogaltar mdzod: 'o skol gnyis kyi dam tshig ni: bdag gi sgog la bab kyang sgrub: khyod kyang dam las ma 'da' zhig: tsayi shu la tri: e de bha ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: gra sa bsogasa'aphrin las ga bcol 'grub lus dang grib bzhin srung ma 'grogs sa ma yā ye ma rgyal dbang pad+ma thod 'phre gi thugs bcud rdo rje snyang po' skor grub mchog 'brog ban khyod la gtad da du ma spel brda la bstims bkrashis rdzong du dgo sa bra sdoms ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga yi dus khyod sprul las ldan gcig gis rted 'phrin lasabyang gi pha mthar brdal don gnyis lhun grub rten 'brel yod bka' 'ad srungs shig btsan rgod rgyal log lta bdudal ma shor cig sa ma wā rgya rgya rgya bka' sdod ya le ber gyi gsol mchod bsdus pa rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyis ba dpon pad+ma 'byu gnas kyi bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen

bzas bkod ba 'o bdo thim dzi ces chos bdag pad+ma'i mtshan can gyis bskul ngor/ kho bo 'dzam gling dbang rgyal rtsal gyis smras pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga la/pa( bh+yo dza dbang chen pad+ma he ru ka dpal gyi: bka' nyan rgyud mgon leg ldan yab yum dang: khams gsum sgog gi bdag po yang le ber lha gshin ma bdud rgyal btsan gnod sbyin klu: pho mo ma ning dregs pa g.yog 'khor dpung: rdo rje snying po'i bstan pa srung mdzad kun gsol lo mchod do bskang ro mnga' gsol bstod: 'phrin lasaX༈༷ ṭ+wāṃngs sems can phan bde spel: rnal 'dredar don sgrubs sbyin bdag bde rgyas mdzod: bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā: ces kyang dgo sa pa 'i rol mtsho las nus ldan pas so/

rwa(:zab gsang rdo rje snying po las:dbang chen pad+ma he ru ga'i:bka' sdod btsan rgod 'bar ba'i zhi bskang thugs dam dgyes bskyed bzhugs so:rmi: na mo pad+ma kro dha rā dza ya: 'dzi1140 lha tshogs thugs mthun yo byad bskang rdzas kyis bka' sdod dregs pa rgya mtsho'i dgyes pa bskyed hū ༷ pad+ma dbang gi bka' sdod yang le ber:mthu ldan dregs pa'i gtso bo ci ma ra las mkhan 'bar ba spun bdun rdzu 'phrul can:ru 'dren sde bzhi btsan dmag bsam mtha' yas:ma thogs bu yi mos ngos gshegs su gsol:dam tshig dag pa'i rten la bzhugs su gsol:bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid nor sna dang:sha khrag rus pa ja chang skyems kyi tshogs:sman gtor rak+ta 'dod rgu'i longs spyod kyis:gnod sbyin btsan rgod 'bar ba'i thugs dam bskangs:yum mchog srog len dmar mo'i thugs dam bskangs:rgyal chen sku lnga yab yum thugs dam bskangs:btsan chen rol ba skya bdun thugs dam bskangs:las mkhan 'bar ba spun bdun thugs dam bskangs:ru 'dren sde bzhi'i tshogs kyi thugs dam bskangs:sprul pa gar ging

tshogs kyi thugs dam bskangs: yang g.yog btsan 'khor rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskangs: ྅ nyi dbang chen gsung gi srung ma dam tshig can: khyod kyi thugs dam bskang la gnyerabacol ba rnal 'byor bdag gi 'jigs tshogs zhi ba dang: tshe bsod dpal 'byor mnga' thang rab rgyas shing: zas nor longs spyod mos bzhi dbang du bsdus: dgra bgegasa'abyung po mngon spyod las kyis rlog: sangs rgyas bstan srungs sems can phan bde spel: mtha' yi dmag bzlog dus kyi rgud pa sol: phywa g.yang 'byor ba mtha' dbus kun turgyas bkra shis chos kyi lam la kun sbyor ba'i: 'brin las dam pa dpa' bo khyod kyis mdzod: dam tshig ma g.yel badz+ra sa ma yā ces brjod skyems gtor 'dod rja sa bsang nang 'bul 'phrin las gang 'dod stsol bar the tshom med sa ma mā ye ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis thugs kyi zab bcud rdo rje snying po' skor:grub pa'i dbang phyug rgyal mchog khyod la gtad dadu spel ba'i dus la ma bab pas ran chen brda la bstims shigs ra bye snyigs ma'i dus su41da sprul dpa' bo yis 'gro don 'phrin las bsam mi khyab pa 'byung sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya bka' sdod btsan rgod 'bar ba'i zhi bskang

bsgo/: zab mo rngo gas so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma sa bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda tham snyi zhes pa 'di'ang lung zan sku skyes dam pa sa bskul ngor kho bo rgyal mchog bzhad pa rtsal gyis smras te ya ge'i ris byed chos bdag nyid kyis bgyis pa maṅga lam̐/pa(: gsol bsdus ni tri:pad+ma dbang gi btsan rgod yang le ber:skye 'gro'i sgog bdag 'byung lnga'i btsan dmag 'khor:ma lus 'khor bcas thugs dam dgyes bskang phyir:'dod yon sprin gyi phung pos thugs dam bskangs:dgra bgegs rdul du rlog pa'i las mdzod cig:ces grangs bsog go nus lan pa sa so/

pa(: zab gsang rdo rje snying po las:dbang chen pad+ma he ru ga'i:bka' sdod btsan rgod chen po'i drag bskang dgra dpung gzhom byed zhes bya ba bzhugs so:a: na 31 gu 〈co pad+ma kro dha rā dza ya: 69skem / dgra bgeg phung khams la dmigs te gtor ma la ni 'gugs bstems bya sha ra khrag gi rgya mtshor dmigs bsangs sbyangs bsgyur la spel byas te hrī dza/bde stong gar bsgyur pad+ma he ru ga'i bka' nyan btsan rgod rdo rje yang le ber:rdzu 'phrul stobs bcas skad cig 'dir byon la rngams pa'i nyams kyis dgra la za kha ston:zhing bcu bsgral ba'i dpa' skyems mchod pa yis:mngon spyod mdzad pa rgyas phyir drag tu bskangs:yid brnag dgra dang bgegs la mthu ma chung:sha khrag rtsa rgyus rus pa rkang mar gyis:sprul pabatsan rgod bdun gyi thugs dam bskangs:'byung ba lnga la brten pa'i dgra bgegs sod:mthu rtsal nus pa ma g.yel dam tshig can lhag par nyon mongs rgyas pa'i 'dod rtsa yis:yum chen sgog len dmar mo'i thugs dam bskangs:chos mdzad yongs la 'tshe ba'i dgra sde rlog mngon spyod 'phrin las sgrub la stobs ma zhan:snyigs

ma'i sha khrag khrol bu'i mchod pa yis: bka' sdod ru 'dren sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang bshad sgrub gtsug lag chos skor la gnod pa'i: dgra bgegs 'byung po thal ba rdul du rlog: ja chang khrag skyems ba ling sbungs ba yis: btsan 'khor bye ba 'bum sde'i thugs dam bskangs: nyes byed dgra la ltas ngan ye 'grogs thongs: mngon spyod drag rtsal srid na snyan par mdzod khyed rnams thugs dam—1na gyi zhal bzhes bzhin: sangs rgyas bstan srung sems can phan bde spel bshad sgrub gzhi tshug chos mdzad sku tshe bsring: dge 'dun 'du ba rgyas shing thugs mthun zhing khrims gtsang dam tshig dag pa'i ngang gnas te: theg chen snying po'i chos kyi gzhi 'dzug cing: nyams rtogs rab spel 'od lus dwangs mar sbyor: dgra bgegs byung na bka' yi chad pas chod: nyes byed yul du than gyi char ba phob: bsad rtags don snying sgrub pa po la sprod: rnam shes skye med dbyings su bsre 'pho ma10da: thugs dam dus la bab 21 sa ma yā: zhes brjod phud bshar 'dod yon sprin rgyas bskangs dgra dang bgegs la bka' chad 'bebs par nges sa ma wā e ma rgyal ba'i dbang po d+ma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs

bsgo/: 'gro la thugs rje brtse ba yas shin tu zab pa rdo rje snying po 'a skor grub pa 'i dbang phyug rgyal mchog dbyangs la gtad da dung ma spel ran chen bdo la bstims mdo khams rtse shod gsham du dgo sa prasdoms ma 'o sa snyigs mar rtsub 'gyur gzeng lang tshe dpa' bo khyod sprul rig 'dzan bzhad pa rtsal skyes bu de dang gdams pa 'ad 'phrad nas bstan pa 'i 'gro don lho dang byang nas 'byu 'brel tshad don ldan rig 'dzan zhing du'agod bslu ba med do rdo rje'i gtan tshig go sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gnod sbyin btsan rgod chen ngo 'a drag bskab dgra bgegs tshar gcod rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi mkhan ngo pad+masaṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda thim snyi ces pa 'da'angasung zan chos kyi bdag po sku skyes pa d+ma bsod nams grub pa 'i rdo rjes bkra shis pa 'i skyes ya mtshan can mang por bcas te nan tan gyasabaskul ngor/de nge rgyal mcheg bzhad rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro gas ba'i 'phrul brda las zhal bshus te dag pa ra phab pa' yi ge pa ni chos rkya bdag po nyad kyis bgyas pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga le/

badz+ra zab gsangado rjesnying po las dbang chen pad+ma rol ba'i bka' sdod btsan rgod rdo rje yang le ber gyi 'brugs bskang nyes mkhon zhi byed bzhugs so:a : na mogu ru pad+ma kro dha shrī ya: 4113phyo 7 'dad rdzasathugs dam sko byed rnams sbyangs bsgyur nam mkha' mdzod du spel rang nyid dbang chen nga rgyal gyis srung ma mdun du gsal btab ste sku gsung thugasayon 'phrin las bskangs 'khru ldog nyes pa zhi bar dmigs hūṃ spyo snyemed dbyings las sgyu 'phrul gar bsgyur ba: mthu ldan dregs pa'i gtso bo yang le ber: rang las spros pa'i btsan rgod 'bar ba bdun: rje bor bzhengs tshe ru 'dren sde bzhi bcas: sprul pa yang g.yog bsam yas sa ya 'bum: kun kyang rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis 'dir byon la: dngos 'byor yidasprul mchod pa'i sprin gyis bskangs ma rig rmongs pas thugs 'gal nongs pa bshags: gro dmar bhe ta dgyes bskyed mchod pas bskangs: bdag rmongs 'khrul pas thugasa'agal mongs pa bshags: za 'og sngod mchog rin chen spyar bas bskangs:bdag rmongs na la pas thugs 'gal nongs pa bshags: btsan gyi rten mdung me lce 'phro bas

bskangs: bdag rmongs 'khrul pas thugs 'gal nongs pa bshags: rdo rje'i zhags pa lug rgyud 'bar bas bskangs: bdag rmongs 'khrul pas thugs 'gal nongs pa bshags: bla rdo sgog 'khor brten pa'i rdzas kyis bskangs: bdag rmongs 'khrul pas thugs 'gal nongs pa bshags: phyi mchod gzung ba dag pa'i sprin gyis bskangs: bdag rmongs 'khrul pas thugs 'gal nongs pa bshags nang mchod 'dzin pa grol ba'i ltad mos bskangs: bdag rmongs 'khrul pas thugs 'gal nongs pa bshags: gsang mchod sha rus khrag mtsho gtor mas bskangs: bdag rmongs gabrul pas thugs 'gal nongs pa bshags: yang gsang brten dar dgyes bskyed rdzas kyis bskangs: bdag rmongasam rig zhabrul bas dbang gyur te lta ba dman zhing 'byor tshogs chung ba dang: sgrub pa g.yel zhing spyod pa 'chol ba dang dam med rnams la dbang bskur chos bshad cing logalta can la man ngag bstan pa dang: 'dod sred mkhan por drag sngags las mtha' sbyin kun kyang srung ma 'khrugs pa'i rgyu yin pas: nongs pa gang mchis skye med dbyings su

btsasdo: 'chags 'ub chub thugs rje brtse bas rab bzhes la 'khu ldog snang ba ka dag dbyings grol nas: 'di phyi'i dge mtshan nyi ma rab gsal te: don gnyis yid bzhin malnga/ ba'i dge mtshan (skor: de ltar gra sa ldan phul ba yis thugs dam dgyes bskang 'khrugs pa zha nyams rtogs 'phel zhi 'byor ba rgyas don gnyis lhun grub ze mo tshom sa ma shā ye ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pa d+ma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs bstan 'gror phan pa'i thugs bskyed kyis shan tu zab pa rdo rje snying po'i skor grub pa'i dbang phyug rgyal mchog khyod la gtad da dung spel ba'i dus la ma bab pas rin chen brda la bstems shag sa ra bye mdo khams bkra shis rjo nga der dgongs bra sdoms ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus dpa' bo khyod sprul 'dus pa rtsal nyid dang 'phrad nas bstan 'gro'i rgud pa mtha' dag sel 'gro don 'phrin las byang nas bya phyogs rgyas 'brel tshad don ldan pad+ma 'od du 'pho the tshom med do rdo rje pad+ma'i bka' sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya btsan rgod 'bar ba' 'khrugs bskang nyes mkhon zhi byed rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda thim snyi zhes pa 'di'ang lung zen chos kyi bdag po sku skyes pa d+ma bsod nams grub pa 'i rdo rjes bkra shis lha reg gser mdog gos

bzang bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs rten ya mtshan can dang /dri med ras gzan dkar po kha tshar ma nyams pa'i skyesabazang po dang bcasate 'bad rtsol lhur len rgya chen pos bskul ro ra/kho bo rgyalamachog bzhad pa rtsal gyas mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i 'phrul brda las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/sarba maṅga le/

badz+ra: zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: dbang chen pad+ma he ru ga'i: bka' sdod btsan rgod 'bar ba'i mnga' gsol phan bde'i dpal ster bzhugs so:rmi: na mo pad+ma kro dha rā dza ye mirusasgo dngos su 'byar dang yid sprul dga' ston gyis bka' sdod rdo rje'i pho nya dgyes bskangs te ma āX: skye med dbyings su dgongs pa byang chub kyang thugs bskyed 'brin las bstan 'gro'i dpal bzhengs pa sbyor sgrol thabs mkhas mdzad pa bsam yas pa'i: chos skyong yongs kyi rje bor mnga' gsol lo: srid na dbang bsgyur 'khor los bsgyur rgyal bzhin: gang 'dul skyongs zhes dam bca' khur lci ba'i: smon lam mthu btsan o rgyan pad+ma yi: bstan pa bsrung ba'i byed por mnga' gsol lo smon log dug lce gnyis pa'i khong ldan pa'i: bstan zhabs bsdud cing bshad sgrub gzhi dmig pa'i: dgra dpung 'joms shing bgegs dpung 'thar mdzad pa'i mthu ldan yongasakyi gtso bor mnga' gsol lo dam chig can la pha bas brtse gdung ngom: zab gter bstan pa spyi bo'i gtsug tu bkur: u rgyan rgyal tshab bka' la rtag gnas pa'i: 'phrin

las kun gyi byed por mnga' gsol lo:'od dkar rgyal kyis gang ba'i bkra shis dus:phun tshogs bsam yas lhun grub gzhal med dbus:tse rgyan pad+ma'i zab gter gnyeragatad pa'i dus kyi skyabs chen srung mar mnga' gsol lo:rang snang mi zad pad+ma'i pha nor dpal: sa cha gnas la nges pa ma mchis kyang rten 'brel tsam du mdo khams tsa ritra'i:zab gter spel ba'i byed por mnga' gsol lo chos rgyal sprul ba'i sku tshe rtag brtan zhing mdzad pa 'phrin las phyogs bcur rab rgyas shing:'phrin las mjug ma byanganas byang gi rgyud mi nub spel ba'i byed por mnga' gsol lo:mtha' yi dmag dang phyi rol kla kle'i sde:bstan pa'i chom po dam nyams sgob log dang:mi kha bra mchu nyes byedangan gtong kun ming gi lhag mar byed por mnga' gsol lo:rnal 'byer yid la mdza' ba'i zas dang nor:'khor slob 'dus sde chos grwa sbyin bdag sogs:phyi nabhe bdog pa srung ba'i pho nya ba nyin mtshan mel rtse byed por mnga' gsol lo:tshogs drug rang grol sgyu ma'i dga' ston nor:dug lnga cer grol sha khrag rus pa'i sprin:rig pa'i rgyan shar

badz+ra: bkra shis rdzas rtags sogs: dpa' bo khyod kyi thugs dam bskang phyir 'bul: dgongs pa chos nyid don la mnyam mod kyang: bshad sgrub mdzad 'brin rtena'abrel rab rgyas te: rang rig pad+ma 'byung gnas spyan snga dzasgyu tshom bu gcig tu 'khod pa'i 'phrin las mdzod: bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā: dga' ston btegs la bsang chen dud pa spro rol mo'i sgras bskul sngags tshig glu yis bstod dpa 'a bo dgyes nas 'phrin las thogs med bsgrub: dgos 'dod longs spyod char ltar 'bebs par 'gyur sa ma rwa ye ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha was ma 'ongasa'agro la brtse ba chen ngo yis thugs kyi thig le man ngag zab bcud skor grub pa'idabang phyug rgyal mchag dbyangs la gtad da du ma spel rin chen brda la bstems mdo khams bkra shas rdzo du dgo sa pra sdoms ma 'o sa snyigasamar bstan 'gro'i don chen 'byung dgos pa che phyir snga gra gsum la gnyer rtag tu mel ces skyongs shig dam tshag can sa ma wā rgya rgya rgya btsan rgod 'bar ba'i mnga' gsol na bde'i dpa la ster rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gas rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda thim snyi ces pa 'da'ang lung zan pad+ma bsod nams grub pa'i rdo rjes bkra shis pa 'i skyes du mar
bcas te bskul ngor/ kho bo rgyal mchog bshad pa rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro'i gsang brda las zhal bdus te dag par phab pa 'i yi ge pa ni chos bdag nyid kyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba mabe le/

badz+ra: zab gsang rdo rje snying po las dbang chen pad+ma he ru ga'i bka' sdod btsan rgod 'bar ba'i za ngu bstan dgra'i dpung 'joms bzhugs so:rmi: na mo gu ru pad+ma kro dha rā dza ye: rdo 4734 gtor skyems bshams la 'gugs bstims nan du bya dmigs bsal dgra la rngams ba'i shugs bskyed de dza rje dbang chen pad+ma he ru ka dpal gyi: spyan sngar khas blangs dam mnos tha tshig can: btsan rgod 'bar ba rdo rje yang le ber gtso 'khor sprul pa yang g.yog bsam mtha' yas rdzu 'phrul thogs med stobs kyis 'dir byon la: dpa' skyems dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa bzhes khyod la 'phrin las bcol ba'i gnyer gtad ni: ma nyes rang khar 'dug pa'i rnal 'byor la: smon log dmasri'i rigs can dgra bgegs 'dis: mi 'dod nyes pa sna dgu rtag tu brtsam: bshad sgrub zab mor mkhon 'dzing bslang ste gtor: zhal lce 'beb cing chom rkun sna tshogs bstan: dpa' bo khyod kyi thugs kyis bzod nus sam: nus mthu 'phrin las thogs med gang na bzhugs gnad nas bskul lo thugs dam dus la babs: dgra bo'i pho rgyud

drungs 'byin za ngu gyis mo rgyud rtsad nas gcod pa'i za ngu gyis: chung gsum mngal nas skem pa'i za ngu gyis: yul sde phung brlag byed pa'i za ngu gyis: nang dme shi chad 'byung ba'i za ngu gyis: gri thabs bco brgyad ston pa'i za ngu gyis ming med rdul du brlag pa'i za ngu gyis drag rtsal srid na snyan pa'i za ngu gyis: mngon spyod lhun gyis grub pa'i za ngu gyis: 'phrin lasathogs pa med par myur 'grub cing: rnal 'byer thugs kyi bzhed don yongs bskangs nas: dpa' bo khyod la dga' ston gtang rag gis: sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las rab bskangs te: bdag gzhan 'dod don yid bzhin 'byung ba yi: thugs kyi dam bca' ma g.yel sa ma yā zhes brjod gtor skyems dgra bo'i phyogs su mchod dmod bor thal rdeb ral ba sa la dbab gnad des dgra dpung pha lam yin kyang 'jigs mthu ya grags pa sa sa ste yongs khyab 'gyur sa ma yu e ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pa d+ma saṃ ba was ma 'o sa bstan 'gror thugs bskyed rnam dag pa sa du bo bzha 'dus zab mo chos kyi gter bstan srung drag sngags las mtha' dang bcas pa grub pa'i dbang phyug rgyal mchog nyad la gtad da du spel ba'i dus la ma bab pa sa ran chen brda la bstims shigs ra bye mdo khams

gas/ bkra shis sheng der dgongs bra sdoms ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus dpa' bo khyad sprul rig 'dzan bzhad pa rtsal gang da gdams pa 'di 'phrad bstan 'gro yi phan bde yar ngos zla ltar spelabar 'gyur de bar bka' 'di sru sa shig spu gra gsum dam med lag tu ma shor sa ma yu las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad pa ra shog sa ma pā rgya rgya rgya btsan rgod 'bar ba' za ngu dgra bgegs rdul brlag rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpo na pad+ma sa bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda thim snyi ces pa 'da' lung 3na chos kyi bdag po sku skyes pad+ma bsod nams thub pa' rdorjes bskul ngor kho bo rgyal mchog bzhad — rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro'i gsang brda las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa 'i yi ge pa ri chos bdag nyad kyis bgyis pa dge legs 'aze la/sarba maṅka la/

badz+ra cha zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: dbang drag pad+ma he ru ga'i bka' srung btsan rgod 'bar ba'i drag bskul spu gri ngar ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so rmi: na mo gu ru pad+ma kro dha rā dza ya: 11dza/bya/ ma 'ongs las can skal bzang pho mo yis sangs rgyas bstan sru bshad sgrub gzhi 'dzug tshe nyes byed dgra da bgegs kyis 'tshe ba na tshar gcod rdul brlag dregs pa 'i bskul ba bstan sa ma yu de yang dmar gtor la na 'gugs bstams bya bas sa sbya sa spel la rngams pa'i yus bskyed de rol mo rngams sgrogs 'jigs byed rol ba'i klus tri dza: ṭa/ba khyedags btsan sdo/la zangs thang dmar po nas bka' sdod dregs pa'i gtso bo yang le ber: dmar nag khro gtum srin po khros pa'i sku bstan pa'i dgra yi gshed du da bzhengs shig: phyag g.yas mdung dmar nyi zla'i 'od la reg rno ngar nus pas dgra snying tshal bar gtubs: g.yon pas btsan zhags dmar po lhug la 'khril: yid brnag dam nyams 'chor med 'ching bar byed: dbang gi dar ber dmar po sku la gsol: khams gsum sgog gi bdag po dregs pa'i rje: rno mtshon 'khor gsum sku yi rgyan du mdzes zhing bcu 'chor med rdul

brlag nus pa'i mtshon:chibs su bra bo g.yu rngog gdan la 'gying:khams gsum yud kyis bskor ba'i rdzu 'phrul ldan:me rlung 'tshubs dbus las byed sprin ltar 'khrigs shin tu 'jigs byed pad+ma'i bka' sdod pa:dgongs pa'i dbyings las rnam rol khro tshul ston:dgra la rbad do nus pa ma g.yel zhig:bgegs la bskul lo za rngams ye ma zhan gtor ma 'di dang yid brnag byad ma gnyis:mnyam por bzhes la thal ba rdul du rlog:bh+yo gtum drag me ltar 'bar ba'i klong ya sa nas:skal ldan sa lam ston pa'i ma chenamo:dgra bgegs srog dbugs bsdud pa'i sha za ma:dpa' bo'i dgyes bskyed sgog len chen mo ni:dmar nag khrag sol bsres pa'i rnam 'gyur can khros na nyams pa'i tsit+ta zhal la bstabs:spyan mig nyi zla ltar sdeb 'byung po bsregs:rno dkar mche ba zhing bcu'i srog la 'bebs rdzu 'phrul shugs ldan me rta dmar po bcibs:skad cig srid gsum bskor ba'i shugs ldan ma:skye med dbyings las 'gags med gzugs skur bzhengs:bstan pa'i dgra la rbad do mthu ma chung:gtor ma 'di dang yid brnag dgra
