ba:tshu bgegs rnams:mnyam por bzhes la ming tsam med par rlog: bh+yo dregs pa'i sku las byung ba'i btsan rgod ni:rus pa las byung rdo btsan khro bor sprul:btsan mdung zhags pa dam nyams dgra la bzor: zhe sdang rgyas pa'i ma rig dgra srog chod: khrag las byung ba'i chu btsan dkar po yis mdung dmar zhags pa dam nyams rnams la 'debs:rtag tu bskul lo gnad nas da bzhengs shig:ma rig 'khrul ba'i dgra bgegs srog rtsa chod:sha las byung ba'i sa btsan ser po yis:btsan mdung gser zhags dam nyams rnams la 'debs:drag tu bskul lo gnad nas da bzhengs shig: nga rgyal rgyas pa'i dgra bgegs srog rtsa chod:drod las byung ba'i me btsan dmar po yis btsan mdung me zhags dam nyams rnams la 'debs:drag po'i las la bskul lo da tshur byon 'dod ci chags pa'i dgra bgegs srog rtsa chod:dbugs las byung ba'i rlung btsan ljang gu yis:btsan mdung rlubhe zhags dam nyams ske la skor:maro na spyod las la bskul lo da bzhengs shag:phrag dog 'tshubs pa'i dgra bgegs sgog rtsa chod:rtsa las

byung ba'i rgyug btsan myur mgyogs can g.yas pas mdung dmar g.yon pas glog zhags 'dzin:drag po'i las la bskul lo da tshur byon:do bsdo phod btsug byed pa'i dgra sgog chod:rgyus pa las byung dkar ba'i btsan rgod ni:khro gtum btsan mdung thog zhags dgra la 'debs:gnad nas bskul lo mngon spyod las la bzhengs:skabs lta glags tshol byed rnams rdul du rlog khyed rnams dam tshig can gyi srung ma ste:dam nyams zhing bcu yongs kyi gshed ma yin:mngon spyod drag po'i las la mi g.yel bar:gtor ma 'di dang 'gal zla'i dgra bgegs gnyis:mnyam por bzhes la ming tsam med par mdzod:bh+yo:dregs pa'i spyi rje gnod sbyin tsi ma ra'i:bka' nyan btsan rgod rol pa skya bdun ni:mchims phu brag btsan zhing bcu'i bla la 'jab:g.yu lung gangs btsan nyams pa'i dbugs la za:spa ri rba btsan gza' skar rnams dang sdeb:gong ma gri btsan dam nyams mtshon gyis gsod:spu ri phug btsan pad+ma'i dam la gnas:brag dmar rdzong btsan skye 'gro'i sgog la rgyu:stag ma rong btsan dgra bo'i bla srog gcod:kun kyang rlung las

gtsaji: mgyogs pa'i bang rtsal bskyed:yid la brnags pa'i tshe srog dwangs ma kun:gcig tu bsres pa'i dpal gyi gtor ma 'di:dgyes par bzhes la thal ba rdul du rlog:sto bka' nyan ru 'dren sde bzhi'i dmag tshogs kyis:dgra bo'i pho rgyud gri thabs mtshon gyis sod:mo rnams 'gags shing spyo 'bog brgyal du chug:chung gsum me tog sad kyis khyer bzhin rlog:'og rta nye 'brel dkor nor za ngu gyis:brngan pa'i dpa' skyems gtor ma 'di bzhes la:rbad cing bskul ba'i las la ma g.yel zhig bh+yo:btsan rgod chen po rdo rje dgra 'joms rtsal:myur mgyogs mthu ldan gnod sbyin yang le ber btsan 'khor sprul ba yang g.yog bsam mtha' yas:dgra la rbad do mngon spyod las la bzhengs steng nas thog ser 'brug sgra sgrogs bzhin chos:bar nas ki bswo cha sgra bcas te chos:'og nas mtshon cha'i bu yug 'tshubs bzhin chos:ltas ngan sum brgya drug cu'i cho 'phrul gyis:dgra bo'i yul khams gang la phu du chug:nang dme shi chad glo bur thog ltar phob:yul sde phung brlag gtor la ming med mdzod:shi shul mis stong ro

thog bya g.yel nas: bgegs kyi sgar thob yul gzhi stong gyur te drag rtsal khyad chos srid gsum la grags pa'i mngon spyod 'brin las mdzad pa'i dus la bab: bdag la las ka 'di ltar mi byed par: thabs dang dbang ni dgra yis ma ster bas: skabs lta 'gres tshol nyes pa sna dgu brtsam: mkhyen ldan dregs pa khyod kyis ma gzigs sam legs lan gtang rag nyes lan ma mnar na rten 'brel bslu med bden pa chud gsan no: dkon mchog mgon brten sgrub tshug rtag 'dzin pa mthu med dgra yis bcom na nyam re thag mthu ldan khyod nyid shi'am gang na bzhugs: nus pa yod tshe dgra la da rgyug cig: mthu rtsal byung la dgra srog da chod cig: stobs shugs bskyed la nyes pa dran du chug: dran bzhin smrar chug smra bzhin 'bogs su chug: 'bog bzhin brgyal nas thal ba rdul du rlog 'phrin las dus bab ma g.yel sa ma yā kyang badz+ra tsa tu shu la triḥ'ur ba 'urab rgyug pa rgyug pa dgra bo'i bla la 'ub srog la rub sha khrag rus pa la rbad rbad: sngags te brgya rtsa brjod la gtor ma de dgra phyogs rdeb cing ral ba sa la sprugs thal mo rdeb bzhin smre sngags dmod bcol

—41 gdabs des ni dgra dpung pha lam yin kyang 'jags bgegs tshogs ma lus rtsad nas gcod pa ra 'gyur rno nus yon tan lag tu longs dang gsal shin tu zab pa sa skal med rnams la sdoms sgrub papo yi grogs gyi tshul du 'chong bar chad srung bzlog nus nges dam tshag yin sa ma yu ye ma rgyal ba' dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la shan tu thugs brtse bas mtha' dbus thams cad rin chen gter gyas gtams zab pa 'i yang bcud rdo rje snying po' sgor grub pa 'i dbang phyug rgyal mchog khyod la gtad da du ma spel rin chen bdo la dril ma do khams bkra shis rdzong der dgongs pra sdoms ma 'o sa snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus dpa 'a bo khyodasprul rig 'ad na 'dus pa rtsal ga da 'di 'phrad bstan 'gro'i rgud pa skyobs 'brel tshad don ldan pa d+ma 'od du 'god 'gro don 'phran las byang nas bya phyogs rgyas bka' 'di srungs shig spu gri mched gsum po dam nyamasalag tu ma shor btsan rgod gya la las can thugs sras skal bzang rnams la sprod sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya — tsan rgod 'bar ba'i drag bskul spu gri ngar ma rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gas rgya gu h+ya o rgyan gyislob dpo na — d+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda thim ñtsā zhes pa 'di'ang lung zen sku skyes pad+ma bsod nams grub pa'i rdo rjes bkra shis la reg bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs rten ya mtshan

dang /dri med ras gzan dkar po kha tshar ma nyams pa'i skyes bcas bskul ngor kho skorgya mchogabazhad pa rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro gas ba'i 'phrul brda las zhal bdus te/dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni chos bdag nyid kyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/sarba ma le/

badz+ra: zab gsang rdo rje snying po las dbang chen pad+ma he ru ga'i: bka' sdod spu gri mched gsum gyi mngon rtog gsol mchod phrin las lhun grub bzhugs so/rmi: na re gu ru pad+ma kro dha shrī ya: 311naX/ gdul dka' nyon mongs rgyas pa'i sems can rnams 'dul byed pad+ma drag po la phyag 'tshal bstan pa'i gnyer 'dzin zab gter bstan srung ba'i spu gri mched gsumasgrub pa'i thabs mchog bstan sa ma yā mchod gtor bska rdzas yo byad phun tshogs bya sngags da phyag rgya tang nge 'dzan gyis spel pa d+ma nye ru'i ti 'dzan la gnas te mdun du dregs pa mched gsum gsal ba ni hūṃ bye rang mdun bskal ba'i dug rlung 'tshubs ma'i dbus: bdud kyi spu gri thog rgod 'bar ba rtsal: sku mdog smug nag lcags kyi khrab smog gsol: phyag g.yas btsan mdung g.yon pas rlung zhags 'dzin: bdud rta nag po rting dkar chibs su bcibs bya nag khyi nag mi nag las la 'gyed: rang 'dra'i tshogs kyis bdud mda' dgra la 'debs: de yi g.yas phyogs me dud 'khrigs pa'i klong: btsan gyi spra gri srog bdud 'bar ba rtsal dmar nag srin po khros pa'i rnam 'byur can: zangs rmog zangs khrab 'khor gsum lus la brgyan

phyag g.yas mdung dmar g.yon pas glog zhags 'dzin: btsan rta ka pa mig gsum chibs su bcibs: mi dmar bya dmar khyi dmar las la 'gyed sprul pa'i tshogs kyisabatsan mdung dgra la 'debs: g.yon phyogs dud sprin khu sbrang 'bebs pa'i dbus: klu yi spu gri thog rgyug 'bebs pa rtsal: ljang sngon khro 'dzum dung rmog dung khrab gsol: chudar lwa wu rin chen mdzes pas brgyan: phyag g.yas mdung dar g.yon pas sbrul zhags bsdams: 'khor gsum mdzes pa sku yi rgyan du bkod: chu rta sngo nag rlung gi gshog ldanabacibs: mi sngon rta sngon bya sngon las la 'gyed: sprul pa'i tshogs kyis dgra la dug rlangs 'bebs kun gyi sgog yig las spros 'od zer gyis rang bzhin gnas nas ranga'adra spyan drangs bstim: spyan 'dren na hūṃ spyo gtum drag 'jigs rung rngam pa'i pho brang nas: bdud kyi sbu gri 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: rab 'bar dgra bgegs bsgralaba'i khri steng nas btsan gyi spu gri 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: dbang chen rgya mtsho 'khyil ba'i klong dkyil nas: klu yi spu gri 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: rang rang

bsnye cha bka' nyan bstan pa srung mdzad pa'i: 'khor tshogs sprul bar bcas te gshegs su gsol: o dutsanayarba sa ma ya dza dza bzhugs gsol ni hū bh+yo: zhing bcu bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus gsum dang dgyes bskang nyer spyod yo byad bkram pa'i gzhi dge mchan yid 'ong dam tshig gzhal yas 'dir sgru gri mched gsum 'khor bcas bzhugs su gsol: badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: phyag 'tshal ni na mo: dug gsum rtsad gcod bstan pa srung mdzad cing: legs nyes lteng 'dzin bka' yi bya ra ba: zab gter gnyer skyo spu gri mched gsum la: la phyag 'tshal lo brtse bas zhal bzang ston: na mo pu ru sha ya ho: mchod 'bul ni hūṃ hrīḥ bgos nag 'bar ba snying gis mtshan pa can: bdud rtsa chang skyems dgra bgegs bsgral ba yi: sha khrag rus gsum 'dod yon rgya mtsho yis bdud kyi spu gri 'khor bcas thugs dam bskangs: btsan nga shas dmar po 'dab chags brgyan pa'i skyes: bdud rtsi ja phud sha rus khrag chen po: 'dod pa'i yon tan nam mkha'i mtha' klas pas: btsan kyi spra gri 'khor bcas thugs dam bskangs: gla bshos dkar po

bzang drug sman sbyar ba:bdud rtsi 'o phud dkar gsum mchod pa dang:bkra shis rdzas rtags nor sna mtha' yas pas:klu yi spu gri 'khor bcas thugs dam bskangs:dbang lnga'i me tog tshil chen bdug pa sbos:zhun chen mar me mkhris pa'i dri chab dang:sha rus zhal rdzas rkang gling thod rnga yis bdud kyi sbu gri 'khor bcas thugs dam bskangs:mdzes pa'i gzugs dang snyan pa sgra yi rigs:zhim pa dri dang mngar skyur ro yi rigs:'ad ma mnyen reg bya sman raka gtor chen pos:btsan gyi spu gri 'khor bcas thugs dam bskangs:ut+pal dbang lag chu srin sder mo dang dza ti 'bru sna bzang drug dkar gsum dang:'o chab klu sman bsres pa'i dam rdzas kyis:klu yi spu gri 'khor bcas thugs dam bskangs:'dab chags nag po mkha' la lding ba dang:rta nag rting dkar mdzes pa'i rgyan cha can:mi nag mtshon thogs dgra la rngams yus can:bdud kyi rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang phyir 'bul bya dmar 'dab ma bar snang gnas su bskyod:khyi dmar ngar zug zhing bcu'i srog la rgyu:mi dmar mtshon 'dzin mngon spyod shan pa ste:btsan gyi rgyal po'i

'a( thugs dam bskang phyir 'bul: bya sngon pad 'phreng 'dzan pa lding zhing 'phyo: khyi sngon zhing bcu'i bla la 'jab mkhas pa: mi sngon mtshon 'dzin dam nyams srog la gshe: klu yi rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang phyir 'bul: sdang ba'i dgra la rbad do mthu ma chung: gnod pa'i bgegs la rgyug cig rtsal ma zhan: mngon spyod 'phrin las mdzod cig dam tshig can dutsha shaXsarba sa pa ri wā ra arnya pabye puṣe dhub pe a lo ke ghadhe ni wi bye shabha pū dza ho: sarba rū pa sharte ghadhe ra sa spadhe dharma pū dza ho: sarba pañtsa a bṛ ta rak+ta bha lirnyi khā hi: bstod pa ni hūṃ bh+yo: sku mdog mthing nag char sprin 'khrigs 'dra'i zhal: dgra dang bgegs la za rngams dpa' rtsal 'gyed: bstan pa'i gnyer 'dzin dam ldan yongs kyi grogs: bdud kyi spu gri 'khor dang bcas la bstod: dbang chen me yi 'od zer glog ltar 'khyug: chags pa'i zur mig dam ldan bu la g.yo: rngam pa'i skan sgra dam nyams dgra la rdeb: btsan gyi snga gri 'khor dang bcas la bstod: bsod nams nor gter yon tan lcan ltar brjid: dgos 'dod char rgyan sgrab pa po la 'bebs kha rlangs dug

mda' nyams pa'i sgog la gzir: klu yi spu gri 'khor dang bcas la bstod: bdag ne+e zab gsang rdor snying bstan 'dzin pa: khyod kyang de yi gnyer 'dzin chen po ste dam tshigagasang sgog gcig tu gnas lags pa'i: gang bcol 'phrin las 'grub pa'i grogs mdzod cig: blang badz+ra dutsanaḥsarba sa ma ya sgo dza dza: smra bcad ting 'dzan ldan pas ci nus bzla skabasasu gsol mchod 'bul ba 'di ltar ro re ye kho: sa.ā hūṃ: bh+yo: zab gter gnyan gyi srung ma che: legs nyes bka' yi bya ra ba: spu gri mched gsum 'khor dang bcas: dam tshig gnasa'adir da tshur byon: bla rdo srog 'khor rten la bzhugs: 'phrin las sgrub phyir gus phyag 'tshal: ja chang 'o phud skyems kyis mchod: sha khrag 'bru sman zas kyis mchod: go khrabamatshon gsum rdzas kyis mchod: dar zab reg bya gos kyis mchod: 'dod yon mchod pa'i sprin gyis mchod:thugs dam bskang la nyams chags bshags: dug gsum ma riganongs pa bshags: dgra la rbad do mthu ma chung: bgegs la rgyug cig rtsal ma zhan: zab gter bstan pa'i srung ma mdzod: sgrub mchog yod sa la 'tsho ba spyor: 'gal zla nyer

btsasdo: 'che'i phyogs ngan bzlog 'di phyi'i dpal yon ma lus pa: dam ldan yongs kyis 'grub par shog bdag gis bcol ba'i las de dag: ma g.yel ma 'khu1ngas sa ma yā gra sa bsogs gtor skyems gtsang sar mchod rnal 'byor 'dod don lhun gyas grub bstan pa dar zhing der 'dzin rgyas the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka' sa ma wā e ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pa d+ma saṃ bha was ma 'o sa 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis thugs kyi zig le zab gsang rdor snying skor grub pa 'i dab phyug rgyal mchog khyod la gtad da du ma spel ran chen brda la bstims mdo khams bkra shis rdzo der dgos sa pra sdoms ma'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus nad mug mtshon chas gze sa pa lang pa'i tshe dpa' bo khyod nyid bzhad pa rtsal du bzhe sa skyes bu de da gdam sa pa 'di 'phrad nas 'gro don 'phrin las byang gi pha mthar rgyas 'brel tshad don ldan pad+ma 'od du 'god don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i rten 'brel yod bka' 'di srungs shig garod sbyin yang le ber dam nyams lag tu ma shor spu gri gsum las can thugs kya sras dang 'phrad par shog sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya spugri mched gsum gyi mngon rtog zab sgrub 'phrin las lhun grub rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu h+ya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pa d+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o bdo thim

dzi zhes pa 'di'ang lung zin sku snyesapad+ma bsod nams grub pa'i rdo rjes bskul ngor kho bo rgyal mchog bzhad pa rtsal bgyis dag par smras te yi ge pa ni chos bdag nyad kyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ them medalha sarba masgo le/

bsnye: zab gsang rdo rje snying po las bka' sdod dregs pa'i gsol mchod dgra bgegs rdul brlag zhes bya ba bzhugs so:rmi: na re gu ru pad+ma kā ra ya byu1 che/ 'char ga'i gze brjed me ltar 'bar ba yi khrag 'thung pad+ma rte ru snying dbus sim chos skyong srung ma las la myur ba'i phyir pho nya gsol mchod dgra bgegs rdul brlag— stan sa ma yā sha khrag gtor ma dgra da bgegs su shes 'gugs gzhug byas la gnyis su med pa ra bstam dbyings nas mtshon cha' char pha ba dgra bgegs kyi phu khams skye ma ched dum bur gtubs ra bsam sngags da phyag rgyas zad med 'dod yon gyi lo sa spyod nam mkha'i mtha' da mnyam pa ra spel rang nyid dbang chen drag po' ting 'dzin gyis mdun du dregs tshogs gsal la brngan 'bul ni hūṃ bye 'jigs rung bang da par dka' ba'i dpa' rngams can: dgra la gshe zhing bgegs la hab thob byed: rgyal btsan yongs kyi mnga' bdagayang le ber: bka' nyan dgyes bskyed yum mchog sgog len ma:btsan dmag 'bum sde ru 'dren sde bzhi'i tshogs: rdzu 'phrul thogs pa med pas 'dir byon la dgra bgegs 'byung po'i sha khrag srog dbugs rol: rnam 'byor bdag gi dkor

gyi bdag po mdzod: las dbang rlung rta bskyed la snyan grags spel: tshe chos nor gyi dpal mdangs yon tan dang bkra shis dge ba'i legs tshogs mtha' dag bskyed dgra bgegs 'byung po dam sris rgud pa sol: mtha' yi dmag bzlog rgyal bsen zil gnon mdzod: snye ā hūṃ: khams gsum srog gi bdag po rā hu la: zab gsang snying po'i mdzod 'dzin tshogs kyi bdag: rgyud sde'i srung ma legs ldan nag po dang: srid pa lha yi gtso bo thogs med rgyal: las gshin kun gyi mnga' bdag king ging tshogs: ma yam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rje srid pa'i rgyal bdud tshogs zil gnon skos rje drang dkar dang srog len bdud btsan yam shud dmar po dang: rgyal chen sku lnga sgog bdag dregs pa'itshogs: ka la yak+ka gnod sbyin yongs kyi gtso: klu bdud mgo dgu gnyan gtod sa bdag rje: rang rang bka' 'khor sprul pa g.yog da bcas rdzu 'phrul stobs kyais gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: bla rdo srog 'khor brten pa'i rdzas la bzhugs: sangs rgyas bstan pa srung phyir gus phyag 'tshal: zhing bcu'i dbang lnga'i me tog tshil chen sbos: zhun

badz+ra: bsregs mar me mkhris pa'i dri chab dang: sha rus zhal zas rkang gling thod pa'i rnga: bza' bca' btung ba ldag gzhib 'dod yon rdzas: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin mtha' yas pas: bka' sdod dregs pa'i tshogs rnams gsol mchod bskangs: dbu 'phang dgongs pa mtho phyir mnga' gsol 'bul 'brin las lhun gyis grub pa'i 'dod don bcol: dgra la bab na mthu rtsal ma g.yel zhig: bgegs la bab na za kha rngams yus ston: zhing bcu'i sgog longs tshe bla spar gyis thobs: sha khrag ston mo skanasgra bcas te rol: shin tu brtse ba'i rnam 'gyur 'dzum bzang zhal: rnal 'byor sgrub pa po la legs bstan nas: ci bcol las rnams thogs pa med par sgrubs: rgyal bstan rin chen srung ba'i pho nya mdzod: tshe gcig byang chub sgrub pa'i lam grogs kyis: legs nyes rten 'brel ston pa'i dpal mdangs ngom: bde skyid phun sum tshogs mdzod dam tshig can: byarngo badz+ra dharma pā la k+ṣe ṭa pā la ma ka pā la sarba sa pa ri wā ra e de bha shā ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: lan bdun brjod la dgyes pa bskangs shin tu brtse ba' zhal bstan nas gang bcol 'phrin

las sgrub so zhes bka' dang dam la gnas par bsam sa ma mā dregs pa'i srog dbang thob pa yi rnal 'byor lasaldan pho mo rnams rgyun du gsol mchod 'di nyid brten 'phrin las lhun gyis grub par 'gyur the tshom med do sa ma mā e ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha was ma 'ongasa'agro la lhag par thugs brtse bas thugasakyi yang bcud zab gsang rdor snying skor grub pa'i dbang phyug 'brog ban khyod la gtad da dung ma spel ran chen brda la bstems mdo khamasabakra shis rdzong der dgongs pra sdoms ma 'ongabasnyig mar nad mtshon gzeng lang skabs grub pa'i dbang byug 'aprog ban lo tsā dang 'phrad nasabastan pa'i rgyal mtshan byang phyogs 'dzug 'gro don bsam mi khyab pa'i rten 'brel yod bka' 'di srungs shig dregs pa dam can tshogs sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya bka' sdod dregs pa'i gsol mchod dgra bgegs rdul brlag rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzasabakod pa'o brda thim snyi zhesapa 'di'ang lung zin sku skyes pad+ma'i mtshan can rgyas bskul ngor kho bo rgyal mtshog bshad pa rtsal gyis smras te dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ji chosabadag nyid kyis bgyis pa'o sarba maṅga le/ dge'o/ bkra shis/

badz+ra zab gsang rdo rje'i snying po las: bstan srung yongs rdzogs kyi gsol mchod nyung ngur bsdus pa 'brin las lhun grub bzhugs so:rmi: na mo gu n+dan pad+mā ka ra ye: 11 rang nyed gtum po'i nga rgyal gyis mdun du bka' srung rtegs tshogs gsal mchod rja sa bsangs sbyangs byin brlabs nas 'dod pa 'i yid kyis brjod par bya khyen āX/ rang mdun ulas dum gcig bhan dha rba 'dod yon bza' bca' btung ba sha khrag rigs: yi re kho las byung ba'i bsregs gtor bkrus: sha lnga bdud rtsi zag med ye shes rdzas: rnam pa dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i phung khams kyis: dbang drag shan dmar ma hā dhe wa'i sku: tshogs kyi bdag po legs ldan phyag bzhi pa bdud mgon seng gdong las byed bya rog gdong gur zhal phyag drug ma ning tsi ma ra: dregs chen bco brgyad sde dpon sum cu dang: mi mgon dkar po ya ma ra tsa dang: shan pa kus 'debs zangs ri dgra 'joms rtsal gza' mchog chen po dam can rdo rje legs: lha srin sde brgyad pho rgyud dpa' bo'i sde: gsol lo mchod do thugs dam gnyan po bskangs: yeka tsa ti yak+ka nag mo

dang: dpal ldan lha mo sha za kha mo che:rdo rje g.yu sgon tshe ring mched lnga dang: phur srung bcu gnyis myur myogs ngas nus ma: dmag zor rgyal mo dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad: bstan ma bcu gnyis lha mo mo rgyud rigs: gsol lo mchod do thugs dam gnyan po bskangs klu bdud btsan dang spu gri mched gsum bdud po thod pa'i phreng ba can: gnod sbyin ma monyi zla'i do shal can: las mgon rtag zhon seng ge'i mgo gsum mo: sde: drag mo spun gsum thang la rma chen sbom: dge bsnyen nyer gcig 'brong ri smug po dang:rdo rje legs pa rnga la stag rtse sogs: gter srung phyi nang gnyis skyong sde tshogs kyis gser skyems phud bzang rin chen ngar btab pa: sha khrag dam rdzas 'dod dgu'i longs spyod kyis:gsol lo mchod do thugs dam gnyan po bskangs: zhi rgyasadabang dang drag po'i las rnams sgrubs: sangs rgyas bstan skyongs dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod dge 'dun sde spel slob dpon sku tshe bsrings: rnal 'byor don sgrubs sbyin bdag bde rgyas mdzod khyad par zab gsang rdo rje snyi po'i chos: phyogs bcu kun tu dar zhing rgyas pa dang: nad mug mtshon

btsa/ 'khrugs ming gi lhag mar gyur:legs tshogs bkra shis rdzogs ldan ltar smin nas:dus gsum kun nas dge zhing bde legs shog:bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā:ces brjod 'brin las rab 'byams 'grub the tshom med do sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gu h+ya zhes pa 'di ya chos kyi bdag posgoma'i mtshan can gyas bskul ngor/ bdag 'dra nu ldan she rjes bris pa dge'o/dge'o/dge'o/legs so/sarba ma le/

badz+ra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: dbang chen bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal gyi gnad bskul rngams brjed rab 'bar spu gri 'bar ba bzhugs so:rmi: na 31 gu nan pad+ma kro dha shrī he ru ka la ya rwaste sgyus zla gam dbang chen pad+ma brtsegs pa 'a klong bdud dpung zil gnon drag khros he ru ka du tra bsgral ba'i dpa' rtags gtsug na spa rta mchog bzhad pa rtsal la phyag 'tshal lo gdul dka' nyon mongs rgyas pa' sems can rnams mngon spyod drag po'i las kyis ma btul na bstan pa'i nyams dam 'a chos byed yongs la 'tshe de phyir sbyor sgol thabs la 'bad pa ra bya sa ma yu mdun bskyed drag po' gtor ma rjad ldan bshams bdag mdun bsnyen sgrub bskang gsol grub pa 'i rjes mngon spyod 'phrin las zab mor 'a cag pa'i phyir dbang chen bskul ba rngams brjid 'bar bar brtson bskul gtor sha khrag rus pa 'i rgyan can bshams dgra bgegs 'gugs bstil sha rus khrag mtshor bsgyur dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la bstab byas te rol mo sna tshogs sgogs bzhin 'di skad do hūṃ rje : 31sa dbyings dbus mtha' bral ba'i pho brang nas: chos can mtshan ma bcom pa'i brtsal zhugs can: rā tra pho mo bstol ba'i khri yi khar thabs shes zhal sbor nyi zla'i gdan steng nas: rig pa'i rgyal po

pad+ma he ru ga: dmar gsal pad+ma rā ga'i lhun po la: nyin byed 'bum gyis 'khrud pa'i gzi mdangs 'bar: sku lnga mtshon pa'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor la: ye shes gzigs pa'i spyan rnams dmar la zlum: mnyam nyid zhal gyi hom khung rab tu gdengs: tshad med bzhi mtshon mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs: don gnyis lhun grub shangs nas hūṃ glu sgrogs: bden gnyis snyan la thabs shes nyi zlas brgyan: khams gsum yongs rol ljags dmar glog ltar bskyangs: 'khor 'das mnyam nyid skan sgra glal ba 'khyugs: gzung 'dzin dbyings bsregs smra smin me ltar 'bar: rgyud lnga'i gnas stong rta zhal rnam lnga bzhad: ye shes zer 'bar ral ba dbyings su 'khyil: khrag 'thung lnga mtshon thod skam dbu brgyan la: zhi ba rigs lnga rdzogs pa'i rtse phran mdzes: ye shes lhun grub dar sna'i cod pan 'phur: 'dod chags rang grol mi lpags stod g.yog la nga rgyal rnam dag glang kos sked bcing byas:zhe sdang mnyam grol stag lpags sham thabs klubs: phar phyin drug rdzogs rus pa'i rgyan drug spras: bya ba lhun grub dar gyi dpyangs pa 'phur: nyon mongs rgyun gcod ye shes me

bsgo/ lnga 'bar: rngam spyod 'dul ba'i thal tshom dpral bar bkod: chags med bde sbyor mkhur tshos khrag thigs byug: log rtog rol mkhas zhal la zo ris mdzes gti mug rgyan shar sbrul nag do shal la: phrag dog rang grol mgo 'phreng brgyad cus brgyan: thogs med bsgrod pa'i rdo rje'i gshog pa gdengs : bde sbyin dbang gi 'od zer kunanas 'khyug: dgyes bskyed gar dbang rdo rje phag mo 'khril: sku mdog mthing gsal be+eḍūr lhun po 'dra: zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhi ma khro 'dzum sgeg: g.yas pas gri gug yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud g.yon pas bhan dmar dbang chen zhal la stobs: thod skam dbu rgyan rus pa'i rgyan drug spras: zhabs g.yon yab 'khyud g.yas pas 'khor ba gnon rdo rje pad+mo sbyor ba'i 'od zer gyis: 'khor 'das dpal yon dwangs ma gcig tu dril: yab yul gnyis med bde ba chen po'i sku: mi dmigs chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos bzhin: rnam rol gzugs kyi phyag rgyar rab bzhengs te: 'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod: dza bh+yo dbang

chen pad+ma rol ba'i he ru ga'i:thabs kyi cha 'dzin za byed byi la'i mgo zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdzu 'phrul stobs ldan pa dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i mtshon cha phyag na bsnams thogs med myur mgyogs rlung gi dbang rtsal can:zhe sdang las byung dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i phyir:ye shes gzugs kyi phyag rgyar rab bzhengs te:'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod dza spyoyum chen gar dbang gzi ldan phag mo yi shes rab cha 'dzin gsod byed pu shud mgo:srid gsum gzigs pa'i ye shes spyan ldan ma:zhabs gnyis gar bsgyur 'byung ba'i khams la rgyu:gdug rtsub mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams gar bskul de ru thogs med rgyug mdzad pa'i:pho nya chen mo sngon gyi dam tshig can 'dod chags las byung dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i phyir:ye shes gzugs kyi phyag rgyar rab bzhengs nas:'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod:dza stsopad+ma dbang chen khrag 'thung he ru ga'i:las mdzad pho nya rdo rje rta mgrin rgyal:

ba tshu rin chen rta mgrin pad+ma rta mgrin dang: karma rta mgrin dkar ser dmar dang ljang: khro gtum nyams rgyas dur khrod chas rnams spras: g.yas rnams rang rtags g.yon rnams bhan dmar 'dzin: 'phrin las rnam bzhir thogs pa mi mnga' bar: bstan dang 'gro ba'i don phyir mdzad pa yi: khro rgyal chen po las kyi he ru ga: skye med dbyings las gzugs kyi phyag rgyar bzhengs 'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: mngon spyod drag po'i 'brin las 'grub par mdzod: dza smyo pad+ma dab chen khro rgyal he ru ga sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las las sprul pa'i: 'byung po zil gnon khro bo spug nag 'bar: pho gdon zil gnon dri za zil gnon dang: gshin rje zil gnon ma mo zil gnon rgyal: gza' klu zil gnon ye shes khro chen rnams: 'jigs pa'i rnam 'gyur khro gtum gar dgus 'khyud gdug pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams: rang rangadagyes bskyed yum rnams gar gyis 'khyud dur khrod chas rdzogs dpa' rngams brtul zhugs kyis: ma rig las byung rū tra sgrol la mkhas: skye med dbyings las gzugs kyi skur

bzhengs la:'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod:dza spyodrag po chen po pad+ma he ru ga'i:bka' nyan sgobazhi'i bstan pa srung mdzad pa'i:pradzña ta kṛta snying rje'i gter chen po:ya man+ta kṛta byams pa chen po'i dpal:pad+ma ta kṛta dga' ba'i zhal bzang ro mas:bhigan ta kuta btangasnyoms mnga' dbang phyug:kun kyang phyag mtshan lcags zhags sgrog dril 'dzin:thogs med stobs kyis bdud bzhi 'dul la mkhas:'brin las rnam bzhi'i mdzad par rtagaganas pa'i:khro rgyal rigs bzhi mngon spyod las la bzhengs:'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:'phrin las rnam bzhi'i mdzad pa mthar phyin mdzod:dza spyolas kyi dbang phyug khro chen he ru ga'i:bka' nyan khams brgya ma drug dmu long tshogs:dpa' gyi khyi brgyad spyang brgyad 'jigs rngams can:drwa ba glog 'gyu 'brug bzhi 'dab ma can:thams cad dpal gyi pho nya chen po ste:dam la gdung zhing bsgrub pa po la brtse:bstan pa gnyan srung bshad sgrub mel rtses skyongs khyed rnams sngon nas bka' dam gnyer

badz+ra: blang bzhin:da lta bstan pa'i dgra la drag tu bskul rno mtshon brdar zhing gtum rngams shugs byung ste:'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod:dza bya bde chen chos kyi dbyings su mnga' mdzad pa'i:sku mchog 'jam dpal ya man+ta ka ni:las mdzad pho nya gshed bzhi phyogs skyong dang:gi bdud rtsis shan sgo skyong rigs bzhi sogs:rdul bral me long lta bu'i dbyings nyid las:ye shes gzugs kyi phyag rgyar rab bzhengs te:'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:mngon spyod drag po'i 'brin las 'grub par mdzod:dza bh+yo bde chen chags pa bral ba'i 'khor lo la dbang mdzad khro chen che mchog heru ga:gnam zhal dbyings phyug rigs bzhi khrag 'thung dgu:dgyes bskyed yum chen lce spyang ma brgyad sogs:spros bral bde chen klong las ma g.yos bzhin:cir yang gzigs pa'i phyag rgyar rab bzhengs te:'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod:dza spyoro mnyam thig le rdul

bral 'khor lo na thabs mkhas mdzad ston yang dag he ru ga: kro ti shwa ri khro rgyal rigs bzhi dang: gnas ma yul ma dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad: bde gshegs thugs kyi lha tshogs sras 'khor bcas me long lta bu'i klong las ma g.yos bzhin: thabs mkhas thugs rje'i phyag rgyar rab bzhengs te: 'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod: dza bh+yo mnyam nyid bde mchog rol ba'i 'khor lo la: dbang bsgyur dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu dang: 'khor lo rgyas 'debs sras mchog rigs lnga dang khro bcu yab yum za gsod sgo skyong ma: ma mo bcu gnyis skyes bu ging bzhi sogs: thal 'byin 'phrin las mngon spyod grub pa'i lha: ma lus bya grub dbyings las ma g.yos bzhin: ye shes sgyu mar bkra ba'i skur bzhengs te: 'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod: dza bh+yo: 'ub chub rol pa bde mchog 'khor lo phu dbang bsgrur dpal chen bla med he ru ga: nyid bzhi mu kha dbyings yum kun bzang mo: ye shes ma lnga rje mo sman mo'i

bsgo/ tshogs:srid pa ma mo'i dkyil 'khor bsam mtha' yas:bde stong ye shes dbyings las ma g.yos bzhin:thabs mkhas gzugs kyi phyag rgyar rab bzheb sa te 'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:mngon spyod drag po'i 'brin las grub par mdzod:dza bh+yo shin tu 'bar ba chen po'i 'khor lo rtsadabang bsgyur dpal chen dregs pa kun 'dul rgyal:dgyes bskyed khams gsum spyi 'dul gnyis med rol:bka' sdod dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu yis:'jigs rngams mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams:bang rtsal rlung gi rlabs kyis srid gsum nyul:sbyor sgrol thabs la mkhas pa'i brtul zhugs can:skye med dbyings las dgongs pa ma g.yos bzhin:thabs mang mkhas pa'i phyag rgyar rab bzhengs te:'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod:dza bh+yo rab tu skyod byed rlungagi 'khor lo rtsadabang bsgyur dpal chen stobs ldan nag po che:'byung lnga'i bdag mo ye shes spyan dang ldan:dregs pa bco brgyad rngams brjid 'jigs pa'i gzugs:gsod

gcod las kyi mtshon cha phyag na bsnams:zhing bcu sku ngas la brngams pa'i brtul zhugs 'chang kun kyang dbyings las dgongs pa ma gasku sa bzhin:rnam rol gzugs kyi sku ru legs ngoms shing:'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod dza bh+yo:ye shes dwangs ma gtsug tor 'khor lo ru bde ba'i sku can rdo rje chos dbang phyug:dkar dmar mdangs ldan rdo rje bhan+ta 'dzin dgyes bskyed rnal 'byor dbang mo 'khril sbyor rol:rnam smin tshe dbang phyag rgya lhun grub pa'i:rig 'dzin yab yum dpa' bo dpa' mo ging:thams cad bde stong dbyings las ma g.yos bzhin thabs mang mkhas pa'i phyag rgyar rab bzhengs te:'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod:dza bye dkyil 'khor dgu yi bka' nyan dam tshig can:ging chen bco brgyad laṅka bcu drug dang:'bar ma brgyad dang ma bdun sring mo bzhi:dbang phyug nyer brgyad rtog byed 'joms byed dang:gdab phur brgya rtsa gnas yul he ru ga'i:dpa' bo mkha' 'gro

bas/ 'bum phrag yangs pa'i tshogs:rig sngags zhing skyes rdo rje rnal 'byor ma kun kyang skye med dbyings las ma g.yos bzhin:dam tshig gsal ba'i phyag rgyar rab bzhengs te:'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod dza spyogasung gi dbang phyug pad+ma he ru ga'i:bka' nyan sprul ba yang g.yog 'khor dang bcas:mngon spyod drag po'i mdzad pa ston pa'i phyir:'jigs rngams khro gtum rol ba'i phyag rgyar bzhengs:brngan pa'i mchod gtor dam pa 'di bzhes la:sangs rgyas chos kyi bstan dgra ma lus pa:sems can nyes med mnar ba'i bdud sde'i dpung:thams cad ma lus las kyi liṅgar phob:tshe yi rgyun chod srog gi mar me bsnubs:ri bo'i rtse dang rgya mtsho'i gting la sogs dkon mchog skyabs zhabs srid gsum gar gnas kyang:rang dbang med par gzugs brten 'di la bstem:mngon spyod drag po'i las kyis tshar chod cag:thugs dam gnad nas bskul lo sa ma yā:sarba dharma pā la k+ṣe ṭa pā la ma ka pā la sarba sa ma yā:dgra bgegs gnod byed kyi tshe

sgog la mā ra ya rbad thegad gtor skyems dgra yi phyogs su mchod bden pa bdar zhang dmod bcol bya des ni dmigs bya gang yin pa thal ba rdul du brlag par 'gyur sa ma mā ye ma rgyal ba' dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la lhag par thugs brtse bas mtha' dbus thams cad rin chen gter gyis gtams khyad par zab gsang rdo rje snying po'i skor grub pa'i dbang phyug rgyal mchog khyod la gtad da dung spel ba'i dus la ma bab pas rin chen brda la bstims shig sarardzu mdo khams bkra shis rdzong der dgongs pra sdoms ma 'ongs snyags ma sum cu kha ral dus nad mug mtshon chas gzengs pa lang pa'i tshe dpa' bo khyod nyid 'dus pa rtsal du bzhengs skyes bu de dang gdams pa 'di 'phrad nas bstan pa'i 'gro don byang nas byang du rgyas 'brel tshad don ldan pad+ma 'od du 'god bka' 'di srungs shig gnod sbyin yang le ber dam nyams lag tu ma shor spu gri gsum skal bzang zogs la sprod cig ging dmar nag sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya dbang chen rol ba'i gnad bskul bdud 'dul 'bar ba rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o bdo zim snyi zhes pa 'da'ang lung zin chos kyi bdag po sku skyes pad+ma dga' ba'i rdo rjes bkra shis lha reg bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs rten ya mtshan can da dri med ras gzan

gtsaX dkar po kha tshar ma nyams pa 'a skyes bzang po ra bcas te nan ma chen pos bskul ro ra kho bo rgyal mchog bzhad pa rtsal gyisamakha' 'gro gsang ba' 'phrul brda las zhal bsas te dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni chos bdag nyid kyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/sarba masgo le/

pa(: zab gsang rdo rje snying po las dbang chen bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal gyi bskul ba seng ge'i sgra dbyangs pha rol zil gnon bzhugs so:a: na 31 gu nag pad+ma 11 dha h+ya spri wa ya: 3 10//tsho18 bdud kyi dpung tshog ma lus 'thar mdzad pa'i dab chen nye ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo bstan pa 'i ma 'a bdag sgrub pa po rnams la bar chad dgra da gegs kyis mnar ba'i tshe mngon spyod drag ngo 'i las la 'jug pa ra bya de yi 'phrin las thog ltar rno ba'i phyir bskul ba se ge' sgra dbyangs 'di la 'jug sa ma mā sha khrag gtor skyemasabashams la 'gugs bstam bya zagamed ye shes bdud rtsir sbya sa sgyur spel rang nyid dbang chen he ru'i nga rgyal gyas dkyil 'bar lha tshogs gnad nas bskul ba ni dza bh+yo 'og min dbus mtha' bral ba'i dbyings: bde ba chen po'i pho brang nas: rgyal kun gsung gi rdo rje ni: pad+ma dbang chen he ru ga: rta gdong bzhad pa'i gar dang bcas mngon spyod drag po'i las la bzhengs rang grol gtor ma 'di bzhes la a 'thas dgra gdon thal bar rlog: mkha' spyod bde ba chen po'i dbyings: rig sngags zhing skyes rnal 'byor ma: 'du ba chen po'i tshogs kyi rje: rdo rje phag mo dbyings kyi yum

phag gdong ngur ba'i 'dul glu bcas:mngon spyod drag po'i las la bzhengs:rang grol gtor ma 'di bzhes la:a 'thas dgra gdon thal bar rlog:ye shes gzegs pa'i spyan ldan cing:thog med rlung gi gshog pa can dgra dang bgegs la dpa' rtsal ston:nyes pa can la bka' chad 'bebs:khyod ni gsod byed pu shud mgo:gnyis snang dbyings su bsdud la mkhas:dam tshig zhal gyis bzhes pa bzhin:mngon spyod drag po'i las la bzhengs:rang grol gtor ma 'di bzhes la:a 'thas dgra gdon thal bar rlog:zhi ba stong nyid snying rje'i ngang khro gtum rdo rje bshad pa'i gar:dpa' mtshan thog bcas bdud la gshe:ye grol klong las ma g.yos bzhin mngon spyod drag po'i las la bzhengs:rang grol gtor ma 'di bzhes la:a 'thas dgra gdon thal bar rlog:rgyas pa ye shes rjen pa'i ngang:khro tshul rat+na bzhad pa'i gar:dpa' mtshan thogs med bdud la gshe:rang grol klong las ma g.yos bzhin mngon spyod drag po'i las la bzhengs rang grol gtor ma 'di bzhes la:a 'thas dgra gdon thal bar rlog:dbang chen

'amatshu chags pa bral ba'i ngang:khro tshul pad+ma bzhad pa'i gar dpal rtsal dga' brod bdud la gshe shar grol klong las ma g.yos bzhin:mngon spyod drag po'i las la bzhengs rang grol gtor ma 'di bzhes la:a 'thas dgra gdon thal bar rlog:drag po snyeng rje'i ngang nyid las:khro tshul 'bar ba chen po'i gar:dpa' rtsal snyemasabyed bdud la gshe cer grol ngang las ma g.yos bzhin:mngon spyo da drag po'i las la bzhengs rang grol gtor ma 'di bzhes la:a 'thas dgra gdon thal bar rlog gtsug tor ye shes 'khor lo rtsardo rje chos kyi dbang phyug pa:rlung sems bza' ba'i he ru ga:mngon spyod drag po'i las la bzhengs rang grol gtor ma 'di bzhes la:a 'thas dgra gdon thal bar rlog:skyemed dbyengs kyi 'khor lo rtsasrid rtsa gcod pa'i he ru ga:sku mchog 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed mngon spyod drag po'i las la bzhengs:rang grol gtor ma 'di bzhes la a 'thas dgra gdon thal bar rlog:bde chen 'bar ba'i 'khor lo na chags pa bcom pa'i he ru ga:bde mchog che ba'i dab

phyug rgyal:mngon spyod drag po'i las la bzhengs:rang grol gtor ma 'di bzhes la:a 'thas dgra gdon thal bar rlog:rdul bral dwangs ma'i 'khor lo na khyab chen srog gihe ru ga:yang dag ye shes gzigs pa can:mngon spyod drag po'i las la bzhengs:rang grol gtor ma 'di bzhes la:a 'thas dgra gdon thal bar rlog:bde ba brtsegs pa'i 'khor lo phudabyings la rgyas 'debs he ru ga rig stong rdo rje gzhon nu'i gar:mngon spyod drag po'i las la bzhengs:rang grol gtor ma 'di bzhes la:a 'thas dgra gdon thal bar rlog:khams gsum rol ba'i 'khor lo rba su kha bde mchog he ru ga:rdul bral bla med yab yum bcas:mngon spyod drag po'i las la bzhengs:rang grol gtor ma 'di bzhes la:a 'thas dgra gdon thal bar rlog:tshangs pa rme yi 'khor lo sazil gnon khro rgyal he ru ga:srid na bsngags pa'i dregs 'dul rgyal:mngon spyod drag po'i las la bzhengs rang grol gtor ma 'di bzhes la:a 'thas dgra gdon thal bar rlog:bsdud pa rlung gi 'khor lo dza 'joms byed thabs kyi he ru ga:dpal

'dzen chen stobs ldan nag po yang:mngon spyod drag po'i las la bzhengs: rang grol gtor ma 'di bzhes la:a 'thas dgra gdon thal bar rlog:rang rang nye ba'i 'khor lo rnga rgyu ba thogs pa med bzhin du:'phrin las sna tshogs bsam yas pa:bka' sdod dregs pa'i dmag tshogs kyang mngon spyod drag po'i las la bzhengs rang grol gtor ma 'di bzhes la:a 'thas dgra gdon thal bar rlog:phyogs bcu'i gdon tshogs 'dul la mkhas:zil gnon stobs kyi dbang phyug pa:las mdzad khro chen yab yum bcu:mngon spyod drag po'i las la bzhengs: rang grol gtor ma 'di bzhes la: a 'thas dgra gdon thal bar rlog:tshad med bzhi la mab 'a brnyes shing:'phrin las rnam bzhis gdul bya skyongs:ta gta sgo skyong pho nya bzhi:mngon spyod drag po'i las la bzhengs: rang grol gtor ma 'di bzhes la:a 'thas dgra gdon thal bar rlog rgyal ba'i bka' la gnas bzhin du: bstan pa srung ba'i dam tshig can:bka' sdod pho nya'i dmag tshogs rnams:mngon spyod drag po'i las la bzhengs: rang grol gtor ma 'di

bzhes la: a 'thas dgra gdon thal bar rlog: bdag ni rnal 'byorasgrub pa po: bstan la gdung zhing dam la gnas: snying po don gyi nye lam la: 'bad rtsol lhur len byed pod kyang: dgra dang bgegs kyis ma ster bas: 'di la kun mkhyen mgon pos gzigs: nyes pa'i lan du chad pas chod: drag rtsal nus pa ma g.yel cig: khrag skyems gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bar chad dgra dpung rdul du rlog gnod byed ming gi lhag mar mdzod: mngon spyod 'phrin las rab 'byams sgrubs: thugs dam ma g.yel sa ma yā: zhes brjod gtor skyems mchod bzhin du dgra dang bgegs la dmod bcol bya des ni mngon spyod 'phrin las kyis gang la gzes pa tshar gcod 'gyur sa ma yu ye ma rgyal ba'i dbang popad+ma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen sgo yis thugs kyi thag le zab gsang rdor snying skor grub pa'i dbang phyug rgyal mchog khyod lagatad da dung ma spel ran chen brda la bsnyim mdo khams bkra shis rdzong der dgongs bra sdoms ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus nad mug mtshon chas gzeng pa lang pa'i tshe dpa 'a bo khyod nyid 'dusapa rtsal dubazhengs skyes bu de dang gdams pa 'ad 'phrad nas bstan pa'i 'gro don byang gi phyogs su 'byung 'brel tshad don ldan pa d+ma 'od du 'god bka' 'di

gtsaX srungs shag gnod sbyin btsan rgod rgyal dam nyams lag tu ma shor spu gri gsum las can bu la sprod cig ging dmar nag sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya bskul ba ses ge'i sgra dbya sa pha rol dpu 'joms rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpo na pad+ma sa bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda thim lha zhes pa 'di'ang lungazen chosakyi bdag po sku skyes pad+ma dga' ba' rdo rjes shin tu dge ba'i skyes ya mtshan can du mar bcas te nan dan chen pos bskul ngor kho bo rgyal mchog bzhad pa rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i 'phrul brda las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa 'a ya ge pa ni chos bdag nyid kyas bgyis pa dge legs 'phepa/ sarba maṅga le/

badz+ra: zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: dbang chen bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal gyis bka' sdod pho nya'i dgos bskul spu gri ngar ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so:a: na 5sna gu na pad+ma 17 dha rā dza shrī ya: bde ba' dbang byug pad+ma he ru ka rdo rje sgeg bzhad gar la phyag 'tshal lo gdul dka' nyon mongs rgyas pa 'i sems can la 'dul byed maro na spyod 'phrin las gnad la brtson sa ma yu dam rdosachang phud sha khrag dmar gtor bshams dgra bgegs 'gugs bstems byas la mchen char phab sha rus khrag mtsho 'dod yon phung por dmags zag med ye shes bdud rtsir byin brlabs te rang nyid ltar gsal ting 'dzan brtan po yis bka' sdod dregs pa gnad nas bskul ba na hūṃ bye chothangadabyings dbus mtha' bral ba'i pho brang nas: bde stong zung 'jug pad+ma he ru ga'i: bka' sdod stobs ldan rdo rje yang le ber: dgyes bskyed srin mo srog len chen mo dang: ru 'dren sde bzhi las btsan 'bar ba bdun: rol ba skya bdun 'byung lnga'i btsan rgod sogs:sprul pa g.yog bcas bskul lo gnad nas bzhengs: 'dod sku na khrag stems sha khrag gtor ma bzhes: sdang ba'i dgra la rbad do mthu ma chung gnod pa'i bgegs la bsnal lo

rtsal ma can: mngon spyod drag po'i 'brin las 'grub par mdzod: bh+yo: srin yul laṅka pu ri'i grong khyer nas: bka' sdod lcags ging nag po drag rtsal can: gsang sngags rgyud kyi srung ma mthu bo che: legs ldan lcam dral bka' sdod sprul bar bcas: gnad nas bskul lo dbyings nas da bzhengs shig: 'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: gzugs can dgra dang gzugs med bgegs kyi tshogs: log spyod drag pos tshar chod rdul du rlog: bh+yo: nam mkha'i khams la dbang bsgyur rdzu 'phrul can: gza' dang rgyu skar kun gyi gtso bo che: mthu rtsal med byung skrug nag 'od 'phros rgyal: gdong bzhi sde brgyad dregs pa'i dmag tshogs bcas: zangs ging 'bar ba chen po gnad nas bskul:dbyings las skur bzhengs mngon spyod las la chos sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod byed bgegs kyi tshogs ming gi lhag ma tsam yang ma lus par me stag chu yis bsad bzhin rdul du rlog: dang/'a skyems gtor ma dgra bo'i tshe srog bcas mnyam por bzhes la drag rtsal khyad chos ston: bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā: bh+yo: bdud yul mun pa dgu

badz+ra 'khrugs pho brang nas:'jigs byed chen po bdud kyi spu gri ni:las mkhan mched brgyad bka' sdod dmag dang bcas:gnad nas bskul lo mngon spyod las la chos:dpa' skyems mchod gtor dam pa 'di bzhes la:dgra sgog dmar po rbad kyis chod la sgo ga:than dang ltas ngan sna tshogs char ltar phob:dgra bgegs ming med brlag pa'i 'phrin las mdzod:bh+yo:btsan yul me ri dgu 'khrugs pho brang nas:myur mgyogs stobs ldan btsan gyi spu gri ni:bka' nyan brgyad dang 'byung lnga'i btsan dmag bcas:gnad nas bskul lo drag po'i las la bzhengs:dpa' skyems 'dod yon mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:sdang byed dgra sgog dmar po chod la shog:gnod byed bgegs kyi don snying khub kyis thobs:mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod:bh+yo:klu yul rgya mtsho 'khyil ba'i klong dkyil nas:dgra bgegs 'dzin shes gtong mi shes pa'i bdud:dbang chen klu ya spu gri 'khor dang bcas:gnad nas bskul lo mngon spyod las la bzhengs:dpa' skyems rgyud mthun mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:rgol ngan byed

pa'i dgra la rbad do rgyug: than dang ltas ngan ye 'grogs glo bur thongs: bsad rtags don snying mngon sum bdag la sprod mngon spyod drag po'i 'brin las 'grub par mdzod:bh+yo: pad+ma gsung gi bka' sdod dregs pa'i tshogs: khams brgya ma drug dmu long bcu drug dang: khyi spyang bcu drug 'brug bzhi 'dab ma can: rang rang sprul pa yang sprul bsam mtha' yas gnad nas bskul lo mngon spyod las la chos:sha khrag gtor skyems 'dod yon mchod pa bzhes: sgrub la 'tshe ba'i dam sri 'byung po dang: bar chad dgra bgegs nyer 'che'i phyogs rnams kun: ming gi lhag ma tsam yang ma lus par: mngon spyod drag pos tshar chod rdul du rlog: bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā bh+yo:bka' sdod dregs pa'i dmag tshogs mthu rtsal can:do nub mngon spyod drag po'i las la bzhengs: bdud rtsi phud kyi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: ma nyes rnal 'byor bdag gi grogs mdzod cig sangs rgyas bstan dang sems can bde skyid la nye bar 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can:nye'am ring ba gang na gnas gyur kyang:myur du khug la spyo 'bog brgyal du chug:

bas/: dkon pa'i tshe sgog gnyis dang bral bar mdzod: phu nu nye ba rtsa lag gshed du bsgyur: lus sems 'brel thag chod la don snying phyung: gri mtshon cho 'phrul sna tshogs sgo nas sod pho rgyud rtsad chod mo rgyud drungs nas phyung: chung gsum byis pa lhug phran brngas bzhin rlog: mi phyugs dkor dang bcas la za ngu mdzod: ming gi lhag cam med pa'i 'brin las mdzod: mthu rtsal nus pa ma g.yel dam tshig can rdo rje 'chang dang pad+ma he ru ga'i: bka' yi gnyer dam gtad bzhin ma byas na: khyod kyi lus dang srog la'abab ta re: ma1rngon rje/da 'phrin las sdo/ba mdzod sa ma yu zhes brjod gtor ma dgra phyogs rdebs dmod pa bor zhing nyes bsgrags bya des na dgra dpung pha lam kyang rdul bzhin brnyag par the mi tshom: sa ma yu ye ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la shin tu brtse sems kyis thugs kyi thig le zab gsang rdor snyi skor grub pa'i dab phyug rgyal mtshog khyod la gtad da dung ma spel ran chen brda la bstim mdo khamasabakra shis rdzong der dgongs pra sdoms ma 'ongs snyigs ma nad mtshon gzengs lang tshe dpa' bo khyod nyad 'dusapa rtsal du bzhe sa skyes bu de da gdams pa 'di 'phrad na bstan pa'i 'gro don bya gi phyogs su 'byung 'brel tshad

don ldan pad+ma 'od du 'god bslu ba med do rdo rje pad+ma'i bka' zab bcud srungs shig bka' sdod dregs pa'i tshogs dam nyams lag tu ma shor dam rgya srungs skal bzang thugs kyi bu chen rnams la sprod sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya pho nya'i dgos bskul spu gri par ma rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gya slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda zim snyi zhes pa 'di'ang lung zin chosakya bdag po sku skyesapad+ma dga' ba'i rdo rjes bkra shi lha reg bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs rten khyad par can dang dri med ras gzan dkar po kha tshar ma nyams pa'i skyes bcas nan tan chen pos bskul ngor kho bo rgyal mchog bshad pa rtsal gyisamakha' 'gro gsang ba'i 'phrul brda lasazhal bshusate dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni chos bdag nyid kyisabagyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba ma le/
badz+ra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: dbang chen bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal gyi mngon spyod skor:bsgral ba khog phub mtshon cha'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

gas(: na mo gu narngo pad+ma kā ra ye: che sgo // ma bzad sku yisa'adod khams dbyings su sgrol bzhad pa nyi yis gzugs khams kha lo bsgyur ye shes thugs kyas gzugs med chos skur gzhesas khro rgyal bde ba'i klong la phyag 'tshal lo bskyed rdzogasadagongs pa'i gzi byan mthu thob pa nus mthu yon tan rtag tshad mnga' brtes tshe chags pa can rnams chags med thugs rjes skyo sa rngams sems can rnams zhe sdang rdo rjes sgol brtul zhugs gar gyas 'khor ba dbyings su bcom dong sprugs sngags kyi lta dgongs zab mo 'di sangs rgyas dpa sa grub bde ba thob phyir bstan sa ma yā drag po' gtor chen rngam brjed 'jigs ru bya mtshe dug rtsang yungs ru dar dpa 'a rdzas brgyan lhag pa'i lha dang gnyis su med par gsal dpa 'a rngam bskul gtor sha khrag skyems kyis brngan drag khro'i brtul zhugs bzod dka'i nyams bskyed de rol mo bshug glu skang gling g.yab mos mtshon gang 'dul 'phrin las maro na spyod thabs su bskul sa ma yā de yi las la rnam pa bco brgyad bshad da po gser skyems 'bul ba 'di lta ste ja chang khrag skyems phud sna bzang po sbra snyan pa'i dbyangs dang bcas te 'di ltar ro stong pa'i ngang las gser stems gtor ma zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur: slo āḥtram̐: kye: skyabs gnas basma med dkon mchog rin po che sangs rgyas chos dang dge

ba:tshu 'dun rgya mtsho' tshogs:bdud rtsi gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la mngon spyod 'phrin las grub pa'i mgon skyabs mdzod:gdod nasaye sangs rgyasapa thig le che:chos sku lo sa sku sprul sku rin po che bdud rtsi gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la:mngon spyod 'brin las grub pa'i mgon skyabs mdzod dre med klong las gzigs tshul mtha' yas pa:bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro rtsa ba gsum:bdud rtsi gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la:mngon spyod 'phrin las grub pa'i mgon skyabs mdzod bde stong zung 'jug spros dang bral ba'i sku:bdud dpung zil gnon dbang chen yab yum gyis:bdud rtsi gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la:rū tra sgrol ba'i dam tshig mgayel zhig gzhan phan 'phren las mdzad pa mtha' yas pa:khro rgyal rigs bzhi zil gnon yab yum rnams:bdud rtsi gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la:rū tra sgrol ba'idam tshig ma g.yel zhig tshad med thugs rjes gdul bya'i yul la brtse:gang 'dul thogs med sgo skyong pho nya bzhi:bdud rtsi gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la:rā tra sgol

ba'i dam tshig ma g.yel zhig: dgongs pa'i dbyings nas 'brin las glog ltar myur pad+ma gsung gi bka' sdod rgya mtsho rnams: bdud rtsi gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la rū tra sgrol ba'i dam tshig ma g.yel zhig: yul gzhi skyong zhing dkar phyogs skyongs ba'i rigs: pho nya dam can las la myur ba rnams: bdud rtsi gser skyems rgyug chang 'di bzhes la: rū tra sgrol ba'i las la ma g.yel bar: zhing bcu tshang rnams myur ba nyid du sgrol: mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod: gser skyems gtor ma mchod la bdenabardar ro gnyis pa mkhyen dpang gsol ba ni gser skyems gtor ma zag med bdud rtsir spel rtsa gsum dam can mdun gya nam mkhar gsal gdung bas yus tshig gsol ba 'di lta ste hū bye dre med sa 'khyer gzigs pa'i bla mas dgongs: sgrib bral dus gsum mkhyen pa'i yi dam dgongs: legs nyes ri mor bkra ba'i mkha' 'gros dgongs: rdzu 'phrul thogs med bka' sdod rgya mtshos dgongs: rdzan drang shan 'byed dkar phyogs smongs rnams dgongs: bdag ni nges pa don gyi rnal 'byor bas theg chen byang chub mchog tu sems bsted nas 'gro don dang

ba:tshu blangs phan bde 'ba' zhig bsgrubs: ci yod bdog pa bla ma'i phyogs su 'bul: srog gi gta' ru yi dam dbang chen sgrub: gnas yul mkha' 'gro bde stong grogs su brten pho nya dam can bstan pa'i ched du gsol lha sngags phyag rgya ting 'dzin dgangs pa skyongs: sgo gsum dben btsug bsgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan bcug: tshogs drug rang grol nyon mongs 'dul la brtson: 'khor ba dong sprugs mdzad spyod bskyang ba la: dgra bgegs 'byung pos sgrub tu ma ster bas: kun mkhyen mgon pos 'di la dpang mdzod cig: legs nyes bka' yi chad pa byung du gsol: drang nges shan dbyed nyes can rtsad nas chod: gser skyems rgyug chang dpa' skyems gtor ma bzhes: mngon spyod drag po'i las 'di grub pa ra mdzod: thugs dam dus la bab po sa ma yu: gser skyems gtor ma mchod la bden pa brdar smon pa 'i 'phrin las sgrub pa'i dmigs 'dun bya gsum pa gzu dpa gsol bar bya ba ni gtor skyems zag med ye shes bdud rtsir bsgyur snyan pa 'i dbyang sa dang rol mo' sgra bcas te hā bh+yo bdag nai zol med don kyi rnal 'byor pas: yang dag don gyi nyams len rtag tu brtson: bskyed

rdzogs lhur len bstan pa srung ba la: dgra dang bgegs kyis sgrub tu ma ster bar: kun mkhyen mgon pos 'di la gzu dpang mdzod theg chen byang chubasems dpa'i mdzad pa mis: 'gro rnams phan dang bde bas skyong ba la dgra dang bgegs kyisasgrub tu ma ster pa sa kun mkhyen mgon pos 'di la gzu dpang mdzod bdag nyid bde chenagar dbang brtul zhugs kyis: shes rab ma tshogs bde klong sbyor ba la: dgra dang bgegs kyisasgrub tu ma ster pas: kun mkhyen mgon pos 'di la gzu dpang mdzod: snying rje'i 'gal zlarakhros pa'i brtul zhugs kyis: zhing bcu tshang rnams thabs kyis skyongs mod kyang: dgra dang bgegs kyis sgrub tu ma ster pas kun mkhyen mgon pos 'di la gzu dpang mdzod: rang byung bde mchogabade ba'i gzi byin gyis rdul mnyam zhing kun yongs khyab mdzad pa la: dgra dang bgegs kyis sgrub tu ma ster pas: kun mkhyen mgon pos 'di pa gzu dpa nga mdzod: theg brgyad blo yisagazhal byar ma gol bar rig stong mi shig grub mtha' skyong ba la: dgra dang bgegs kyisasgrub tu ma ster bas: kun mkhyen mgon

'a:tshu pos 'di la gzu dpa mdzod:bgren po' blo can sngags las ya gyal mchog: nang rgyud yo ga gsum po nyams len kyang: dgra dang bgegs kyis sgrub tum ster pas kun mkhyen mgon pos 'di la gzu dpang mdzod:lta sgome spyo da pa'i tha snyad rnam dag pas:'od gsal rdzogs chen nying khu spyod pa la dgra dang bgegs kyis sgrubatu ma ster pas: kun mkhyen mgon pos 'di la gzu dpa mdzod yenas sangs rgyas sku gsum nyag gcig gsang: rang byung ye shes snyibhe po skyong med kyang:dgra dang bgegasakyis sgrub tu ma ster pas: kun mkhyen mgon pos 'di la gzu dpang mdzod dgebacu'i khrims kyis 'jig rten thams cad 'dul: za thal dgongs pas nyon mongs dbyingasasgrol kyang dgra dang bgegs kyis sgrub tu ma ster pas: kun mkhyen mgon pos 'di la gzu dpa mdzod:ma nongs yeshes la la mkhyen par gsol: nges pa'i don brtsona'abras bu chud ma gsan: dam can srung ma med dam ra mdar bzlog dpa' skyems mchod gtor dam pa 'di bzhes la: maro na spyod drag po'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod: gtor

skyems dgra phyogs rdeb la dmod pa bor des ni dgra dpung pha lam yin kyang 'jag bzhi ba che bskyed bya ba 'ad lta ste hūṃ: bdag nyid dbang chen drag por gsal ba'i spyi gtsug tu gu ru pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa: bde chen gyi 'khor lor 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs yongs su rdzogs pa: longs spyod kyi 'khor lor che mchog yon tan gyi lha tshogs snying ga chos kyi 'khor lor yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs lte ba sprul ba'i 'khor lor phur pa 'phrin las kyi lha tshogs: gsang gnas bde skyong kyi 'khor lor bla med he ru ga'i lha tshogs: brla g.yas 'bar ba'i 'khor lor dregs pa kun 'dul gyi la tshogs brla g.yon bskyod pa'i 'khor lor stobs ldan drag sngags kyi lha tshogs: gzhan yang rtsa gnas rnams su dpal gyi bka' srung gi lha tshogs: bdun brgya nyer lnga'i dkyil 'khor thams cad ma 'dres rngams brjid 'jigs su rung bar bskyed do: khyad par sku stod kyi cha la rtsa rgyad rig 'dzin bla ma'i lha tshogs kyis bstor ba: sked pa bar gyi cha la yi dam rgyad sde bzhi drag gi dkyil 'khor: sku smad kyi cha la ma gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha'

btsar+sha 'gro dam can rgya mtsho thams cad mkha' la gza' skar bkra ba bzhin du rdzogs par bskyed do:lnga pa e khaṃ bskyed pa ni bdag mdun je thugs ka nas yi getsas gcig chad pa las gru gsum gnam lcags kyi khaṃ sgrom kha dog la mthal yangs pa:zhabs na 'dod chags kyi rang bzhin khrag mtsho 'khyil ba:ma gas na nga rgyal gyi rang bzhinabrag ri snyil ba:zur na phrag dog gi rang bzhin rlung nag 'tshubs pa:phyi nang kun tu zhe sdang ga rang bzhin me dpung 'bar ba:rtag tu gta mug gi rang bzhin mun nag 'thibasapa:rno dbal mtshon cha'i char ba 'beb cing sod sod chod chod kyi sgra sgogs pa 'gugs byed kyi pho nya glog ltar 'byug cing sha zan gyi khyi nag dang gcan spya mang po ngu ba:bla 'dzin gyi drwa ba ris su bkram zhi dug dngadzaḥyi bu yug 'khrigs pa:shin tu skyi g.ya' zhing ya nga ba'i nang du:dṛXdangs yongs su gyur pa las:sku dgra rnam lngar gyur pa nyams pa bdun la gtog pa zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bgegs thams cad kyi rū pa mdog sngo la mdangs nyams pa:nyam thag dbugs dang bral la khad 'dar yed yed byed pa:skang pa

lcags gzer gyis btab cing bu ga dgu nas rnag khrag 'dzag pa mar me shi ba'i me ro lta bu snying rje'i gnas su gyur pa gcig tu gyur: bdag mdun kyi thugs ka nas pho nyalcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu mtshon cha thogs pa dpag tu med pa 'phros te: 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na gnas pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad rang dbang medapar bkug nas liṅga la bstim mo: liṅga dgra bgegs su gsal ba'i sa bon dratswaḥlas kyang 'od 'phros pas dam sri dgra bgegs kyi rigs can thams cad rang dbang med parabakug te chu la char thim pa ltar liṅga la yang yang bstim mo: drug pa khrugs pa ni na mo rig 'jin rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang ston pa blan med pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang: skyobs pa bla na med pa dam pa'i chos rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang: 'dren pa bla na med pa dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang yi dam dbang chen bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal dang yum chen gar dbang rdo rje phag mo: bka' nyan thabs shes byi la dang pu

badz+ra shud kyi mgo can:zil gnon khro chen yab yum bcu drug:bka' nyan sgo skyong pho nya bzhi:las mdzad khyi spyang bcu drug 'byung bzhi'i 'brug chen srid pa'i 'dab lnga:ye shes kyi dmu long bcu drug bka' sdod pho nya'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bden pa dang gzhan yang 'jam dpal sku:che mchog yon tan:yang dag thugs:phur pa 'phrin las:ma mo rbod gtong:'jig rten mchod bstod:dmod pa drag sngags dpal gyi bka' srung gi lha tshogs ste bdun brgya nyer lnga'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang:rig 'dzin rdo rje chos kyi dbang phyug rtsal dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro rig 'dzin paṇa sgrub rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang:don dam chos nyid ngo bo gdod nas rnam par dag cing:kun rdzob rten 'brel rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i mthus spyir mchog gsum bstan pa'i spyi dgra:bshes gnyen dam pa'i sku dgra khyad par du rnal 'byer ba bdag gi bka' la 'khu ba dam las log pa:smon log dam sri'i rigs su gyur pa:kha dkar zhing khung gnag pa sngon gyi las dang 'phral gyi rkyen

las gyur pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad rang dbang med par byi'u chung khra yis ded pa ltar khra kyi li li: nag rga ra ra: gru gsum las kyi gshin rje'i bsha' khang nag po'i nang du gzugs liṅga 'di la khug cig: bstims shig badz+ra e ku sha dza: dzaḥ( baṃ ho: dgu dang nyer gcig la sogs gang skabs brjod bla 'gugs sngags dang 'gugs thung mang du brjod bdun pa bstim pa'ilas drug 'di lta ste dza: dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab sprul pa chen po'i dus la bab bka' nyan pho nya'i dus la bab: mngon spyod 'phrin las dus la bab: dza: dbang chen sku yi pho nya ni: 'gugs byed lcags kyu thogs pa 'bum dkar mo zhi ba'i tshul can gyi: dgra bgegs 'gugs pa'i las mdzod cig: ma badz+ra yo gu sha ya dza dza rta bon dang ra dug pabadug lag gnyis lcags kyu' phyag rgya bya'o ho: dbang chen pad+ma gsung gi lha tshogs rnams kyis mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul gyi dpa' bskyed la dgra bgegs myur du 'gugs pa'i las mdzod cig: brgyad pa dbye ba'i las drug bya ba ni he: dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab: sprul pa chen po'i dus la bab bka' nyan pho nya'i dus la bab mngon spyod 'phrin las dus la bab

badz+ra: e: dbang chen thugs kyi pho nya ni mthing nag kha kha 'ug pa'i gdong: dbye byed thun rdzas thogs pa 'bum: khyod kyis dgra bgegs lha dang phyes ma badz+ra pra we sha ya phaṭa: aḥrjeḥtrag rak+ka ma ra ya phyes phyes: ma ma trag rū tra ma ra ya phyes phyes: dgra bgegs skyobs byed kyi lha dang phyes shig phaṭa: khya'i brun da 'ug pa bya rog gi sgro gzhob bdug lag gnyis thal mo rgyal bsgrad dbye ba'i phyag rgya bya'o ho: dbang chen pad+ma gsung gi lha tshogs rnams kyis mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul gyi dpa' bskyed la dgra bgegs 'di skyobs byed kyi lha dang dbye ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig: dgu pa 'ching ba'i las drug bya ba ni (: dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab: sprul ba chen po'i dus la bab: bka' nyan pho nya'i dus la bab: mngon spyod 'phrin las dus la bab: pa: dbang chen yon tan pho nya ni: 'ching byed zhags pa thogs pa 'bum: ser mo rgyas pa'i tshul can gyis: dgra bgegs 'ching ba'i las mdzod cig:tī dgra bgegs ma ra ya thum ri li li chings shig chings shig pa sha hūṃ thang khrom dang dbang lag brag zhun bdug lag gnyis zhags pa'i phyag rgyas bcing tshul bya'o ho: dbang chen pad+ma gsung gi lha

tshogs rnams kyis mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul gyi dpa' bskyed la dgra bgegs kyi lus ngag yid gsum gru gus mthul du 'ching ba'i las mdzod cig: bcu pa sdom pa'i las drug bya ba ni be:dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab: sprul pa chen po'i dus la bab: bka' nyan pho nya'i dus la bab: mngon spyod 'phrin las dus la bab: be dbang chen gsung gi pho nya ni: sdom byed lcags sgrog thogs pa 'bum: dmar mo dbang gi tshul can gyis dgra bgegs sdom pa'i las mdzod cig: baṃ dgra bgegs ma ra ya sdoms shig sdoms shig sgo ṭa be: la cadang spang spos gu gul bdug lag gnyis lcags sgrog ga phyag rgyas sdom tshul bya'o ho: dbang chen pad+ma gsung gi lha tshogs rnams kyis mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul gyi dpa' bskyed la dgra bgegs kyi lus ngag yid gsum sdom pa'i las mdzod cig: bcu gcig myos pa'i las drug bya ba ni ho: dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab: sprul pa chen po'i dus la bab: bka' nyan pho nya'i dus la bab: mngon spyod phrin las dus la bab: ho: dbang chen phrin las pho nya ni: myos byed dril bu thogs pa 'bum: ljang mo drag po'i tshul can gyis: dgra bgegs myos pa'i las

gas/: mdzod cig: ho: dgra bgegs ma ra ya dz+wa la pa ya dz+wa la pa ya bhan+ta bhan+ta gaṇ+ḍi ho: chu rtsa da dha dhu ra skyer shun rnams bdug lag gnyis dril bu'i phyag rgya bca'o ho: dbang chen pad+ma gsung gi lha tshogs rnams kyis mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul gyi dpa' bskyed la dgra bgegs kyi lus ngag yid gsum spyo zhing brgyal nas 'bogs su chug cig: bcu gnyis dbabapa 'i las drug bya ba ni ā: dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab: sprul pa chen po'i dus la bab: bka' nyan pho nya'i dus la bab: mngon spyod 'brin las dus la bab: ā: dbang chen las mdzad pho nya ni: dbab byed mtshon cha thogs pa 'bum: sna tshogs 'phrin las mdzad pa yis: dgra bgegs gnad la dbab par mdzod: ā: dgra bgegs ma ra ya ā we sha ya ā we sha ya āḥ dug shi da dug sna khya bre bo' smad bzha' spu rnams bdug lag gnyis khyung gshog bca' la drag tu dbab po ho: dbang chen pad+ma gsung gi lha tshogs rnams kyis mthu —1bas rdzu 'phrul gyi dpa' bsted la dgra bgegs kyi lus ngag yid gsum la zhing bcu tshang ba thams cad dbab pa'i las mdzod cig: skabs 'dir phur bskyed tshe khrus gnas gsum bya bcu gsum phur

gdab bya ba ni hū hrīḥ dbang chen zla gam e yi sang dkyil nas: rngams brjid bzod par dka' ba'i he ru ga: dbang chen pad+ma gsung gi rgyal po ni: dmar gsal pad+ma rā ga'i gzi brjid 'bar: khro gtum gar dgu'i dpal rdzogs ha hi sgrogs dbu gtsug rta zhal bzhad pas 'byung po brgyal: sgrub sde dgu yi dkyil 'khor sku la rdzogs: sku smad rno dbal phur pa'i gzi brjid la: lce spyang pho nya mang po glog ltar 'byug sbyor sgrol 'dren pa'i las la rtag tu dgyes: 'od 'bar me yi gzi byin kun tu 'phro:dbang chen srid pa'iphur ba chen po 'di: gnad nas bskul lo las la da bzhengs shig: mngon spyod drag po'i las la ma g.yel bar: zhing bcu tshang ba'i rū tra pho mo yi: blta byed gzugs kyi 'du shes bshigs pa'i phyir: mig gi dkyil du pad+ma kai la ya: nyan pa sgra yi 'du shes ba gas pa'i phyir: rna ba'i dkyil dupad+ma kai la ya: bsnams pa dri'i 'du shes bshigs pa'i phyir sna yi dkyil du pad+ma ki la ya: myong ba ro yi 'du shes bshigs pa'i phyir: lce yi dkyil du pad+ma ki la ya: reg bya lus kyi 'du shes bshigs pa'i phyir: phung po'i dkyil du

btsañtsa pad+ma gī la ya: brnyab pa lag pa'i 'du shes bshigs pa'i phyir: yan lag dkyil du pad+ma ki la ya: 'gro bskyod ldang 'dug 'du shes bshigs pa'i phyir:rkang pa'i dkyil du pad+ma gī la ya: rigs rgyud 'khor ba'i 'du shes bshigs pa'i phyir: gsang ba'i gnas su zhe sdang pha yi sa bon stong ba'i phyir klad pa'i dkyil du pad+ma gī la ya chags 'khrul ma yi mngal sgo skem pa'i phyir: lte ba'i dkyil du pad+ma gī la ya kun gzhi gti mug mun pa sangs ba'i byir: snying gi dkyil du pad+ma gī la ya: rnam shes rten grol chos skur sad pa'i phyir: dwangs ma'i ga'u khrol zhig pad+ma ki la ya: hūṃtsho d+ma bhasto 'i dṛ ྅skopra we sha ya phaṭa: ces brjod la phur pa dgra bgegs kyi snyi gar btab pa sa rnam pa ra shes pa 4dkarapo dri ma med pa 'i rnam pa ra phur rtser bla ste chos nyid 'khrul mi shes pa 'i dbyings su bsres nas sa sa rgyas ri ra bsam moḥ yinam khams gsum sems can rnams: ma rtogs 'khrul ba snying re rje: snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig ni: bsad cing mnan pa ma yin te: phung por rdo rjes gtams byas nas: rnam par shes pa chos skur sgom: 3 badz+ra spa ra ṇa phaṭa: se ha ra ṇa hūṃ: e skye med

chos sku'i mkha' dbyings su: ye shes thugs kyi dwangs ma bsre: 'khor 'das bde ba chen por sbyor: gzhan phan 'phrin las 'gro don bskul: ā: sto dhi cit+ta nirma kwa ya spa ra ṇa phaṭa saṃ ha ra ṇa hūṃ: r+sā bzhi ral gri gdab pa ni hū hrī dbang chen me ltar 'bar ba'i gzi brjid can: khro gtum bzod par dka' ba'i brtul zhugs rgyal:rno mtshon shes rab ral gri'i gzugs su bzhengs: dgra bgegs 'byung po'i phung po dum bur gtubs: dug gsum ma rig 'khrul ba gzhi la sangs: rnam shes ldog med bde chen dbyings su spar: sgyu ma'i tshogs ston 'dod lnga'i phung por sprin: hū ༷badz+ra kha ṭa gat+pa hūm̐ dza ma ra ya dgra bgegs rdul phran phye ma dum bur khrol phaṭa: ces brjod pas dgra bgegs kyi phung khams dum bur gtubs te sha khrag rus pa tshogs kyi phung por gyur par bsam mo bco lnga g.yo du bsdung ba ni e baṃ: shes rab dbyings kyi phag mo'i mkha' 1nga du thabs chen dbang gi rdo rje'i brtul zhugs kyis: dgra bgegs sha khrag drod dbugs phung po khams: dum bur gtubs la nyog tu brdung byas te: ma rig 'khrul ba chos kyi dbyings su bsre: 'khor ba dong sprugs zag med bdud rtsir

bas/ cha bsgyur: bla badz+ra a ko ṭa ya ta tha ya ta tha ya hūṃ phaṭa: bcu drug dmar spri bya ba ni hūṃ ṣ+ṭi lcang lor bcas pa'i bhan+ta dza dug lnga bsgral ba'i khrag chen bskyil:'dod yon lnga yi zer 'phro ba: pad+ma dbang chen lha la 'bul: chags 'khrul 'khor ba dong sprugs nas: dbang chen mdzad pa mthar phyin shog: yin ma hā rak+ta la kha re kha hi: bcu bdun bstab pa bya ba ni hūṃ rje mnyam nyid bde chen dbang gi zhal phyes shig: ma rig rū tra bsgral ba'i phung po khams pad+ma gsung mchog rol ba'i zhal du bstabs: 'khrul ba ka nas dag pa'i phrin las mdzod: pad+ma kro ta h+ya shrī wa sarba sa pa ri wā ra mahā me sa khāhi ma hā rak+ta khā hi: mahā tsit+ta khā hi: mahā ko ro tsa na khā hi: mahā ki ni ri ti kha hi: mahā ba suta la khā hi: ces brjod dgra bgegs phu po khams dkyil 'khor lha tshogs zhal du bstabs dgyes pas skan sgra bcas te gsol 'khor ba do nas sprugs par bsam bco brgyad gtor ma zor bsgyur na hūṃ bh+yo: bskru1pa drag pad+ma gsung gi lnga tshogs rnams: mngon spod drag po'i las la da bzhengs shig dpa' ba'i stobs bsted 'jigs pa'i mtshon rtse ngom: sngang ba'i dgra da gnod pa'i

bgegs la rgyug: ma zad par du rngam pa'i za ngu gyis dpal gyi gtor chen mtshon cha'i rang bzhin gyur: rno ngar nus pa sdang ba'i dgra la ston: drag rtsal khyad chos za ba'i 'dre la phob gtum rngam nga ro zhing bcu'i bgegs la ston: dgra sde thal bar brlag pa'i dus la bab: bgegs dpung ming med mdzad pa'i dus la bab: mngon spyod khyad chos ston zhig sa ma yā tso pad+ma kro ta ka la rū pa thun bh+yo: zor ya zor ya: dgra bgegs gnod byed kyi srog la thun ya: thun ya: zhes brjod dmod bor bden pa brdar dgra bgeg sdul du brlag par bsam des na mngon spyod zogs med 'grub the tshom med do sa ma yu ye ma rgyal ba'i dbang bo pad+ma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la shin tu brtse sems kyas thugs kyi thig le zab gsang rdor snying skor grub pa' dbang phyug 'brog ban khyod la gtad da dung spel ba'i dus la ma bab pas rin chen brda la bstims shig sar bye ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus dpa' bo khyod sprul nus ldan rig 'dzan gyis bka' 'di mdo khams bkra shas rdzongs nas snyed bstan pa'i 'gro don byang gi phyogs su rgyas 'brel tshad don ldan pad+ma 'od du 'god zab bcud thub par srungs shag btsan rgod rgyal bka' log lag tu ma shor dam tshag can sa ma shā rgya rgya rgya mngon spyod drag po'i las

gsaX gzhu mtshon cha'i 'khor lo rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu h+ya yo rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa 'o brda thim snyi ces pa 'di' rdo rje'i lu zin dam pa sku skyes pad+ma dga' ba'i rdo rjes bkra shis 'i rdzas du ma da bcas te 'bad rtsol lhur len gyis ya ya bskul ro ra kho bo dbang chen bzhad pa'i rdo rje 'dzam gli — dab rgyal rtsal gyis mdo khams tsa ri dra'i gnas mdun nas rigs can 'gyur med rgya mtshos tshogs ston gyi spros pa mtha' yas pa 'bul skabs mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i 'phrul brda las zhal bshus te dag par pha ba pa'i ya ge pa na chos bdag nyid kyis bgyis pa 'o/ sarba mame lam̐/

badz+ra cha zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: dbang chen bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal gyi drag las byed tshe: nye bar mkho ba'i phur gdab tshe khrus gnas gsum gyi dgongs nga bzhugs so: rmi: na re gu dzad pad+ma kwa ra ye sgyudzakhri40 ma bzad rab 'bar dbang chen bde ba'i zhal snyi dbus dwa sa ma'i ze 'brur rtag tu mchod mngon spyod drag po 'a dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i tshe pas kyi mthar thug tshes khrus gnas gsum da ཿshin tu zab pa 'i man ngag du ma bstan thugs sras rig pa 'dzin pas da du longs sa ma yā 'ad ya lasal sa bcad brgyad kyis bstan dang po bdag nyad gso bar bya ba ni rang nyid skad cig gi pad+ma dbang chen lam gyis gsal ba'i: sku yi cha la sgrub sde dgu yi dkyil 'khor bdun brgya nyer lnga'i lha tshogs: ma 'dres lam gyi rdzogs pa'i gnas gsum dang thugs ga'i sgog las 'od zer 'phros pas rab 'byams rgyal pa sras dang bcas pa thams cad dbang chen gsung gi 'khor lor bzhengs nas bdag he ru ga'i sku gsung thugs su zim pas: 'khor 'das kyi spyi dpa la chen por dbang bskur bar bsam la: e pad+ma kro ta ha he ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo /: brgya rtsa brngo da la gzi byin nan du bsnyim gnyis pa phur bskyed ni

bdag he ru ga'i lag pa g.yas pa zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la sor mo rnams rigs kyi yab lngar bskyed: g.yon pa nyi ma'i dal la sor mo rnams rigs kyi yum lngar sgom: thal mo'i bar du sgrol phur bzung la rigs lnga yab yum snyoms par zhugs te bde stong byang chub sems kyi spro bsdu mdzad pa las:sras mchog dbang chen he ru ka sku mdog dmar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa smar smin las me yi tsha tshwa 'phro zhing dbu skra mthing nag gyen du 'khyil zhing: skra gseb turta mgo ljang khur rta skad mtsher bas khams gsum dbang du bsdud cing: srid gsum dam la 'dogs pa: dur khrod dpal chas kyis mdzes par klub cing rngams brjid me yi 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba: sku smad gnam lcags las grub pa'i phur dbal rno mtshon gyi ngar dang ldan pa: pho nya dang lce spyang mang po rlung ltar 'tshubs shing sbyor sgrol gyi las la rab tu dgyes par bskyed do: de'i spyi bor khrag 'thung gi lha tshogs: mgrin par rig 'dzin rgya mtsho: thugs gar zhi ba bzhi bcu: lte bar gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams ma 'dres yongs su

bsgotshu rdzogs par bskyed do: gsum pa sras mchog gso ba ni yang sras mchog gi sku las phur pa'i tsha tshwa dpag yas su spros te: 'khor 'das brtan g.yo thams cad phur ba'i rang bzhin du zhu ste sgol phur la thim pas khams gsum 'khor ba yongs su sgol ba'i nus mthu phun sum tshogs pa thob par bsam: de yang phyar ba tsam gyis khams gsum g.yo 'gul byed pa: gzir ba cam gyis dgra bgegs kyi snying khrag skyugs su gzhug pa: btab pa tsam gyis stong gsum thams cad brlag nus pa'i ra bzhin can du gyur snyed pad+ma kro ta gī li gī la ya sarba bhisnan baṃ hūṃ phaṭa: brgya rtsa brjod la gza byin bskyed pa ra bya: bzhi che ba brjod cing bskul ba ni hūṃ bye dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa/'i sku:dbang chen bdud dpung zil gnon he ru ga: khro rgyal yongs 'dus pad+ma ki la ya: steng du bskor bas gza' skar lha gdon 'dul: g.yas su gdengs pas pho bdud dbang du bsdud: g.yon du gzir bas mo gdon bran du bkol: 'og tu bzor bas sa bdag klu gnyan 'thar: mdun du 'dril bas dmigs bya dgra bgegs sgol:mngon spyod mthu nus

rdzogs pa'i sras phur 'di: phyar ba tsam gyis sa gsum 'byung po bsngangs gdengs pa tsam gyis sde brgyad las la 'chun: btab pa tsam gyis stong gsum brlag par byed:dbang chen srid pa phur bu bdag gis bsgrubs: da lta zhing bcu tshang ba'i srog la rbad: btab nas zeb par mdzod cig badz+ra gī la ya: 'phang nas phyir ma bzlog cig badz+ra gī la ya: rnam shes rten dang khrol zhig badz+ra ki la ya: sha khrag tshogs su bsgyur zhig badz+ra gī la ya: mngon spyod 'phrin las grub mdzod badz+ra gī la ya: ma pad+ma kro ta ki li gī la ya sarba bhisnan baṃ hūṃ phaṭa: ces brjod pas rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad byon nas sgrol phur la thim sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis brlabs ye shes lnga yi dab bskur te mthu stobs gzi byin phun sum tshogs pa ra bsam lnga pa la gso ba ni mdun du liṅga dgra bgegs dngos su gsal ba las 'od zer nag po lcags kyu'i rnam pa can spros ste: stong gsum 'jig rten gyi khams na gnas pa'i dgra bgegs dam sri 'byung po thams cad dper na nya brgyas nya tshogs bsdud pa bzhin du rang dbang med par bkugs te brub khung na gi liṅga la sib sib thim par bsam: j-iji

btsasdo rū tra 'du kho: brgya rtsa brngo da la dgra ste lisgor bstim drug pa tshe lu gi dgongs pa ni phur pa dgra bgegs kyi snying gar gdab pas tshe bsod nams kyi ro bo j-iḥyig ljang ku'i rnam par phur rtses blang ste khong gseng nas ma dag pa'i dri ma nyes skyon sbyangs: dwangs ma bdag he ru ga'i thugs gar bstim pas tshe bsod rab tu rgyas par bsam: bdun pa khrus lu ji yang phur pa dgra bgegs kyi snying gar tshad pas phur rtse nas bdud rtsi dkar po'i rgyun bab te: dgra bgegs gyi lus ngag yid gsum la zim pas nyon shes kyi dri ma thams cad sang sang dag par bsam la:dṛ tri sarba pa pe da ha na shirnyi ku ru ye swā hā: brgyad pa bla lu dang gnas lu ni yang phur pa dgra bgegs kyi snying gar btab pas bla yi ngo bo 2ཿdang tri sgrol phur la thim pas sras mchog ngang mer gyi song bar bsam:yang phur pa dgra bgegs kyi snying gar btab pa sa rnam par shes pa āX dkar po dri ma med pa'i rnam par phur rtser blang ste khong gseng nas nyes skyon sbyangs:rtsa gsum lha tshogs rnams kyang bde ba chen po'i rol rtsed bsgyur:slar spyi gtsug nas 'od thig dkar po hrīX yig gi rnam par rgyang

gis thon te 'og min bde ba chen por dbang chen he ru ka yab yum kyi dgongs klong du thim te chos nyid 'khrul mi shes pa'i dbyings su sangs rgyas: yab yum bde ba chen po'i sgras bzla 05 te garja gas (1ra bzhengs par bsam: yi phaṭa: 65 phaṭa ku phaṭa: dgo sa pa chos nyid don la mnyam par bzhag gnad des rtogs pas bdag bsgral thugs rje yis gzhan snang 'khor ba dong nas sprugasapar byed mngon spyod las kyis mtshog gi rig 'dzin 'grub skyon du ma lta bde bas dang du longs sam yā ye ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la thugs rje brtse chen gyis thugs kya yang bcud rdo rje snying po'i skor grub pa'i dbang phyug 'brog ban lo tsādang dbang chen bka' bab rgyal ba mchog dbyangasal zab mo'i pha nor gces pa'i dpal mdzod gtad da lta spel ba'i dus la ma bab ba sa rin chen brda la bstims shig sar phyo mdo khams bkra shisardzongasader dgong pra sdoms ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus nad mug mtshon chas gzeng pa lang pa'i tshe dpa' bo khyed zung sprul ba las ldan gyis zab gsang 'di 'byed bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel 'gro don 'phrin lasasma smar byang rong khyab 'brel tshad don ldan pad+ma 'od du 'god bka' gsang thub par srungs shig btsan rgod rgyal bka' log lag tu ma shor a tham rgya las can thugs kyi

btsardo sras dang 'phrad pa ra shog sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya phur bskyed tshe khrus gnas gsum gyi dgongs pa rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa 'o brda thim snyi zhes pa 'di yang lung zin chos kyi bdag ngo pad+ma dga' ba'i rdo rjes bkra shis dge ba' skyes bza du mar bcas te yang yang bskul ro ra kho po rgyal mchog bzhad pa stsal gyis mdo khams tsa ri'i gnas mdun nas las smon lan pa 'i tshogs ston spros skabs mkha' 'gro'i gsang brda zab mo las zhes bshus te dag par phab pa' yi ge pa ni chos bdag nyad kyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba masgo le/

badz+ra: zab gsang rdo rje snying po las mngon spyod dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i las kyi thun gdab spu gri ka ma la zhes bya ba bzhugs so:a: na mo gu ru pad+ma kā ra ye: ra sgo 1844 dbang dze bde ba'i gzi byin 'bar la 'dud ma 'ongs las can skal bza pho mo yis mngon spyod las kya dgra bgegs tshar bcad tsha kha bskang thun gad ba spu gra ka mal bstan sa ma yu dang ngo gnad nas bskul ba na rtsa ba gsum dang dbang chen pad+ma bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad:thugs ye shes chos sku'i klong nas sku rngams brjed rab tu 'bar ba'i brtul zhugs su bzhengs nas drag po mngon spyod kyi las kyis dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad par bsam:skang gla bzhug pa rol mo' sgra da bcas rngams pa 'i dpa' shugs brtul zhugs rab bskyed de gnyis pa phur thun thogs la 'ad skad do hūṃ bh+yo:mi shig dbang chen rol ba'i dkyil 'khor nas:'jigs rngams dpa' brjid ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul can:mngon sgod drag po'i las la da bzhengs shig:thogs med gnam lcags phur pa'i dbal zer gyis dgra bgegs 'byung po'i che srog

rdul du rlog: rtsa sngags mthar smon log dam sridagra bgegs mtha' dmag 'byung po rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la phob dza phob dza: gsum pa yungs thun gdab pa na hūṃ bh+yo mi shig dbang chen rol ba'i dkyil 'khor nas 'jigs rngams dpa' brjid ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul can mngon spyod drag po'i las la da bzhengs shig: sna tshogs yungs thun rdza ltar snyil ba 'dis: dgra bgegs dam sri'i phung khams rdul du rlog: rtsa sngags mthar smon log dam sri dgra bgegs mtha' dmag 'byung po rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la phob dza phob dza: bzha pa khrag thun gdab pa ni hūṃ bh+yo mi shig dbang chen rol ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: 'jigs rngams dpa' brjed ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul can: mngon spyod drag po' las la da bzhengs shig: rak+ta rba rlabs 'phyo ba'i thun zor gyis: dgra bgegs lus sems spyo zhing 'bogs su chug: rtsa sngags mthar smon log dam sri dgra bgegs mtha' dmag 'byang po rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la phob dza phob dza: lnga pa mtshe thun gdab pa ni tī bh+yo: mi shig dbang chen rol ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: 'jigs rngams dpa' brjid ldan

badz+ra: pa'i rdzu 'phrul can: maro na spyod drag po'i las la da bzhengs shig: dpal gyi mtshe thun mda' ltar rno ngar 'dis dgra bgegs 'byung pa'i don snying tshal bar gtubs: rtsa sngags mthar smon log dam sri dgra bgegs mtha' dmag 'byung po rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la phob dza phob dza: drug pa dug thun gdab pa ni hū bh+yo: mi shig dbang chen rol ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: 'jigs rngams dpa' brjid ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul can: mngon spyod drag po'i las la da bzhengs shig: sna tshogs ha la nag po'i dug thun 'dis: dgra bgegs phung khams gzer nad drag pos sod: rtsa sngags mthar smon ma ga dam sri dgra bgegs mtha' dmag 'byung po rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la phob dza phob dza bdun pa mtshon thun gdab pa ni hū bh+yo: mi shig dbang chen rol ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: 'jigs rngams dpa' brjed ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul can: mngon spyod drag po'i las la da bzhengs shig: rno mtshon spu gri 'bar ba'i gzi byin can dgra la rbad do sgog rtsa dum bur chod: rtsa sngags mthar smon log dam sri dgra bgegs mtha' dmag 'byung po rnams kyi

lus ngag yid gsum la phob dza phob dza: brgyad pa mda' thun gdab pa ni hūṃ bh+yo mi shig dbang chen rol ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: 'jigs rngams dpa' brjid ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul can: mngon spyod drag po'i las la da bzhengs shig: mda' yi thun mtshon rno ngar ldan pa 'dis: dgra bo'i sgog dbugs drung 'byin thal bar rlog: rtsa sngags mthar smon pog dam sgodagra bgegs mtha' dmag 'byung po rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la phob dza phob dza: dgu pa rdo thun gdab pa ni hūṃ bh+yo mi shig dbang chen rol ba'i dkyil 'khor nas 2jigs rngams dpa' brjed ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul can: mngon spyod drag po'i las la da bzhengs shig: gzhom med drag po rdo yi thun zor 'dis: dgra bgegs 'byung po'i phung bams rdul du rlog: rtsa sngags mthar smon log dam sridagra bgegs mtha' dmag 'byung po rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la phob dza phob dza: bcu pa gtor thun gdab pa ni hūṃ bh+yo mi shig dbang chen rol ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: 'jigs rngams dpa' brjid lngan pa'i jo 'phral can: mngon smod drag po'i las la da bzhengs shig: dpal gyi gtor chen ri

bsnye ltar brjid ldan 'dis dgra bgegs ming med thal ba rdul ltar thong rtsa sngags ma thar chen lege dam sri dgra bgegs mtha' dmag 'byung po rnams kyi lusangag yid gsum la phob dza phob dza bcu gcag pa thun gdab pa ni hūṃ sbyo mi shig dbang chen rol ba'i dkyil 'khor nas 'jigs rngams dpa 'a brjid ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul can mngon spyod drag po'i las la da bzhengs shig: 'byung ba sa thun rdul ltar 'tshubs ba 'di dgra bgegs 'byung po'i lus ngag yid la rbad: rtsa sngags mthar chen lege dam sri dgrabagegs mtha' dmag 'byuja po rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la phob dza phob ja: bcu gnyis chu thun gdab na hūṃ bh+yo mi /ga dbang chen rol ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: 'jigasarngams dpa' brjid ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul can: mngon spyod drag po'i las la da bzhengs shig chu thun drag po rba rlabs g.yo ba 'di: dgra bgegs 'byung po'i lus ngag yid larbad: rtsa sngags mthar spyod sku ga dam sri dgra bgegs mtha' dmag 'byung po rnams kyi lus bhe ga yid gsum la phob dza phob dza: bcu gsum me thun gdab pa ni hā sbyo mi shig dbang byen

rol ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: 'jigs rngams dpa' brjid ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul can mngon spyod drag po'i las la da bzhengs shig: me thun drag po tsha ngar ldan pa 'di: dgra bgegs 'byung po'i lus ngag yid la rbad rtsa sngagasamathar spyo na 81ga dam sri dgra bgegs mtha' dmag 'byung po rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la phob dza phob dza: bcu bzhi rlung thunagadab pa ni hūṃ bh+yo: mi shig dbang chen rol ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: 'jigs rngams dpa' brjid ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul can: mngon spyod drag po'i las la da bzhengs shig: rlung thun drag po g.yo zhing bskyod pa 'di dgra bgegs 'byung po'i lus ngag yid la rbad rtsa sngags mthar spyo na ma ga dam sre dgra bgegs mtha' dmag 'byung po rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la phob dza phob dza bco lnga mtshon cha sna tshogs gdab pa ni hūṃ bh+yo: mi shig dbang chen rol ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: rno ngar ldan pa'i ye shes mtshon cha ni: dpal gyi kha ṭ+wāṃ ma mo'i nad skyal dang: bdud kyi spu gri gnod sprin dug thun zor: btsan gyi mdung dmar bdud kyi rgyog zor sogs: rno ngar nus mthu phun sum tshogs pa rnams: dgra bgegs
