btsa/: 'byung po'i tshe sgog lus la rbad phung khams skye mched thal ba rdul du rlog: rtsa sngags mthar smon 'o ga dam sri dgra bgegs mtha' dmag 'byung po rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la phob dza phob dza: bcu drug bh+yo gdab bya ba ni hūṃ bye rang byung gsang chen bstan pa rin chen la nye bar 'tshe ba'i dug gsum 'byung po rnams: bdag nyid dbang chen drag pos rjes su 'dzin: skye med dbyings su ldog med rgya yis gdab: bh+yo: ban byad bon byad lha klu mi yi byad: stong gsum byad zor zhing bcu 'di la bh+yo: dgra sna gyod sna mi kha bra mchu kun phung byed las ngan zhing bcu 'di la bh+yo: mo ngan rtsis 'khrug rmi ngan cho 'phrul rtsub: thams cad ma lus zhing bcu 'di la bh+yo: dug gsum 'byung po'i rgol ngan sna tshogs kun: phung byed smon log zhing bcu 'di la bh+yo: gdug rtsub bsam ngan sbyor rtsub bh+yo bzlog cig: bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo: bzlog bzlog bzlog: bcu bdun dmod pa bya ba ni ho dbang chen gsung mchog pad+ma rol ba'i wa tshogs 'khor pho nya las mkhan dang bcas pa rnams kyis mthu stobs nus byin brdar ro: mtshon cha sna tshogs sprug go: log 'dren dgra

bgegs 'byung po'i phung khams dum bur gtums po: mngon spyod drag po'i las kyis tshar chod la: med par mdzod cig: zhi bar mdzod cig: stong bar mdzod cig: brlag paramadzod cig: 'thar bar mdzod cig: tshar chod cig: drungs nas phyungs shig ming gi lhag ma tsam yang ma lus par thal ba rdul du zlog cig: de ltar drag po'i las kyis dgra dngabagegs thal ba rdul bzhin brlag par the tshom med sa ma mā ye ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la shin tu brtse sems kyis snying dang 'dra ba'i yang zab smad byung ba grub pa'i dbang phyug 'grog ban lo tsā dang dbang chen bka' bab rgyal ba mchog dbyangs la dam tshag pha phog gnyer byang zab mo gtad da dung spel ba'i dus la ma bab pas rin chen brda la bstims shig sa ra bye mdo khams bkra shis rdzong der dgongs bra sdoms ma 'ongasasnyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus dpa' bo khyed zung sprul ba las ldan gyis bka' gsang 'ad rnyed bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzug 'gro don 'phrin las byang ga phyogs su rgyas 'brel tshad don ldan pad+ma 'od du 'god don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i rten 'brel yod bka' gsang thub par srungs shig btsan sgod rgyal dam nyams lag tu ma shor rtag par srungs las ldan thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya thun rdzas gdab pa spu gri ka ma

brterdo la rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pa d+ma sa bha wa' bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brna thim snyi ces pa 'di yang lung zinasku skyes pad+ma dga' ba'i rdo rjes bkra shis dge ba'i skyes du ma dang bcas te bskul ngor/ kho bo dbang chen dgyes pa'i rdo rjes mdo khams tsa ri tra'i gnas mdun nas mkha' 'gro'i gsang brda dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa na chos kyi bdag ponyid kyis bgyis pa'o/ sarba ma la/
badz+ra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las:dbang chen bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal gyi:mngon spyod drag po'i las gtor bzlog dbang chen rab 'bar zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

bas/ na mo gu ru pad+ma kro dha h+ya ṣ+ṭṛ wa ya: bsagru 15maskyazungaX thugasarje zhi ba chos sku'i ngang nyid las rnam rol khrag 'thung khros pa 'i brtul zhugs kya 'bar ba'i gar gyis bdud bzhi 'thar mdzad pa'i dbang chen je ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo ma 'ongasasnyigs mar chos byed pho mo la bar chad bdud kyis rgol ba sna dgu brtsams gti mug kha dar gnyan rims ma nges dang zhe sdang rgyal po sa tshe srog do la 'tshe 'dod chags mo 'dres bkrag mdangs bcud la sku nga rgyal 'byu pos la yog gabrug rtsod rgol phrag dog dam sris 'tshubs ma rlung ltar g.yo rkyen des sgrub pa po la rtag tu 'tshe de nyid bzlog phyir thabs mchog smad byung ba pad+ma dbang chen khrag 'thung rte ru ga'i gas gsum sgyu 'phrul 'khor lor lam byed ca mngon spyod drag po' 'phran las zab gnad brtson de yis dgra sde thal bar brlag nus shing gnod byed 'byung po rtsad nas gcod par 'gyur sa ma yu de mang gtor gshod gru bzhi brjid lngan khar ma tram̐ du tra bras pa'i sto ba la gnam lcags 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi rtsibs phran brgyad rtsibs chung bcu dang khrag khyams mdzes par bkod dpal gyi gtor chen zur gsum khru gang ba mdun du yum gtor za gsod g.yas dang g.yon khro rgyal rigs bzhi zil gnon khro bo da sgo skyo bka' nyan pho nya'i bsgos bu rnams ma 'dres che chung zhal shes bzhin du bkod:gdugs dang ru dar khrag yungs dug mtshes brgyan

btsar+sha gdug rtsub shi ga drwa mig ris su bkod shan tu rngams shi mdzes pa'i che tu bkram rtse la khyu brgyan sha khrag sna tshogs bkram dkyal 'khor dbus bkod rnam lnga nyer spyod dang sman raka gtor ma nyer mkho'imachod rdzas bsham sa sa ma yā rang nyid dbang chen pa d+ma nye ru ga'i bskyed rim gsal sna ting 'dzan brtan po yas mdun bskyed lha tshogs chu zla bkod bzhin gsal ma 'dres dkyil 'khor gcig la gcag rdzogs tshul yeshesargyu 'phrul bdag mdun so sor gsal dbyangs nas dbang chen la tshogs spyan drangs bstims dam ye zung 'jug bde ba chen por bsre lta ba mjal ba' phyag kyang phul bar bgyi ro mnyam rdo rje'i mchod sprin bsam yas stobs dug gsum rtsad gcod sman raka gtor mchod 'bul gar dgu rngams pa'i brtul zhugs 1nga la bstod gnyas med ting 'dzin 'dzab kyis dgongs klong bskul 'khor 'das dpa la yon dwa sa ma gcig tu bsre lha srin dregs payo sa kyi sreg dbugs bsdud mdzad pa sa ngan song do sprung 'gro phan bsgrub gnyis med dab bzha blangs la thugs yid bsre bsgrub bya sgrub byed dbyer med chen por mos de dag dngos gzha'i sgom rim zab mo'o sa ma yā ma rag 'khrul ba'i 'khor lo dbyi sa sgrol phyir thugs dam gnad bskul sngon gyi dam tshig bsgrags bdud rtsi cha phud gser skyems brngan ston 'bul gzu dpang phul zhing mkhyen pa ra snyan gsan dbabs e bskyed bden brjod

bca' ba'i la drug bya tshe khrus gnas gsum dgongasapa mchog la gnas rnam shes skye med dbyings su bsre 'pho bya snyig ma'i lus la ye shes mtshon rgyas bsnun sha khrag rus gsum thabs shes gtun du brdung dga' ston dkyil 'khor lha la dbul bar bya bsod nams ye shes tshogs chen rab rdzogs te mngon spyod mthar thug las kyi byang chub thob sa ma yu ma rtog log rtog phyogs rtog khengs sems can dug lnga rang khar yan pas las 'bras su nag phyogs bdud rigagasna tshogs gzugs su 'phos bstan la gshe zhing sgrub la skabs 'tshol tshe mngon spyod drag po'i bzlog pa zab mo 'dis thams cad skye med dbyings su rgyas gdab po rnal 'byor pa rnams lta ba'i gdengs bskyed de brtul zhugs mdangs byung bshud glu rol mo'i sgra snyan pa'i dbyangs bcas bcol las gdab pa na hūṃ bh+yo: dbus mtha' med pa chos kyi dbyings nyid las ye shes gzigs pa'i sgyu 'phrul zhi khro'i lha: don la ngo bo nyid du ro gcig kyang gdul bya'i mos ngor thabs tshul bsam yas bsgyur rigs gcig kun bzang che mchog he ru ga: ye shes lnga ldan rigs lnga khrag 'thung tshul: gzung 'dzin rang grol sems dpa' sems ma dang: gnas yul pho nya ma 'dres so sor shar thugs ni spros bral yang dag he ru ga: mi zad sku mchog 'jal dpal

badz+ra: gshin rje'i gshed:'gag med gsung mchog pad+ma dbang chen rgyal:thal 'byin 'phrin las rdo rje gzhon nu'i gar:yon tan lhun rdzogs che ba'i dbang phyugargyal:srid pa bde sbyor 'bum phrag ḍāk+ki'i mkha':thabs kyi rdo rje rig pa'i he ru ga:stobs kyi dbang phyug dregs pa zil gnon sku:mthu ldan yongs kyi spyo rje drag sngagasabazhengs:dam tshig mchog gnas bka' sdod srung ma'i tshogs:bdun brgya nyer lnga'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyang:rten 'brel tsam du du ma so sor shar:don la chos nyidamanyam par ro gcig pa'i:kun 'dus dbang chen pad+ma he ru gas:'dod yon rgyan gyi mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:thogs bcas bdud kyi mtshan ma thad gar bzlog:thogasamed bdud kyi 'dzin stangs rang sar bzlog:dga' prod bdud kyi re dogs spros pa bzlog:snyem byed bdud kyi a 'thas 'khrul 'khor bzlog:yar bdud sangs rgyas dngosamatshan rlom pa bzlog:mar bdud 'khor ba rang mtshan rlom pa bzlog:bdag dang gzhan du lta ba'i gnyis 'dzin bzlog:chos can mtshan ma chos nyid dbyings su bzlog:re

dang dogs pa ro snyoms ngang du bzlog: bde dang sdug bsngal ka dag klong du bzlog: thams cad spros bral dbang chen he ru ga'i: dgongs pa mnyam nyid zang thal chen por bzlog: de nas pa d+ma dbang go he ru ka yab yum la bzlog pa 'i las bcol ba ni hūṃ hrīḥ zla gam dmar nag e yi klong dkyil nas: klu rgyal pho mo bsnol ba'i khri steng nas: nyi zla'i dkyil 'khorasprin 'khrigs klong yangs nas: rig pa'i rgyal po dbang chen he ru ga: bde ba'i rang bzhin pad+ma rā ga'i zhal: sku gsum lhun grub spyan gsum dmar la zlum: mnyam nyid zhal gdangs tshad med mche ba gtsigs: bden gnyis snyan zung don gnyis shangs bug har: chos nyid mnyam pa'i hūṃ glu 'brug ltar sgrogs: khrag 'thung rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan mdzes pa la: ye shes lnga mtshon dar sna'i cod pan bcing: snang stong zung 'jug nyi zla'i snyan rgyan mdzes: chos sku'i don rtags g.yas zhal gsum du bzhad: longs sku'i rang bzhin mdun zhal rnam pa gsum: smral sku'i brda rtags g.yon zhal gsum du ngom mthing dmar dkar ba'i bkrag mdangs gzi byin 'bar dug gsum na la ba'i 'khor lo stong

badz+ra: bar byed: dmar ser ral ba srid pa'i rtse ru 'khyil rta zhal lnga bzhad rgyud lnga'i 'gro ba sgrol: dur khrod dpal chas sku yi rgyan du klubs tshogs brgyadamatshan 'dzin rtog pa dbyings su gcod: bco brgyad phyag gis ye shes mtshon cha gdengs ma rtog 'khrul ba'i dgra bgegs 'dul bar byedaḥ zhabs rnams bsgrad pas skye bzhi'ikha lo bsgyur: ye shes me yis ma rig mtshan ma bsregs: bskal ba'i rlung gis bag chags 'ching rgya gtor: dbang chen he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod: dpa' bo'i dgyes bskyedagar dbang phag mo yum: sku mdog mthing gsal be+eḍūr lhun po la: nyin byed 'bum gyis 'byud pa'i gzi 'od 'bar: in+d+ra ni la'i ral pa sku rgyab 'phyangs thod skam dbu rgyanadar sna'i cod pan bcing: nyi zla'i spyan 'khyil sdang mig glog ltar 'khyug: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril rno dkar mche ba gtsigs: mi lngags stod g.yog sbrul chun mgo 'phrengaspras: rus pa'i rgyan drug gzig gi sham thabs klubs: phyag g.yas gri gug yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: g.yon pas bhan dmar dbang chen dgyes phyir stobs: zhabs g.yon

yab kyi sku la 'khril sbyor rol: g.yas pas nyon 'khrul 'khor ba'i sgo 'phar gnon: gnyis med mnyam pa'i drag po'i gad rgyang sgrogs: bde mchog rdo rje phag mo'i sku la bstod skye med dbyings las gzugs kyi phyag rgyar bzhengs: 'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: thogs bcas bdud kyi mtshan ma thad gar bzlog: thogs med bdud kyi 'dzin stangs rang sar bzlog: dga' drod bdud kyi re dogs spros pa bzlog: snyem byed bdud kyi a 'thas 'khrul 'khor bzlog: yar bdud sangs rgyas dngos mtshan rlom pa bzlog: mar bdud 'khor ba rang mtshan rlom pa bzlog: bdag dang gzhan du lta ba'i gnyis 'dzin bzlog: chos can mtshan ma chos nyid dbyings su bzlog: re dang dogs pa ro snyoms ngang du bzlog: bde dang sdug bsngal ka dag klong du bzlog: thams cad spros bral dbang chen he ru ga'i: dgongs pa mnyam nyid zang thal chen por bzlog: de nas che mchog yab yum la bzlog pa'i las bcol ba ni hū bh+yo: spug nag 'bar ba e yi klong dkyil nas: bdud bzhi spyi chings bsnol ba'i khri yi khar: thabs shes nyi zla zung 'jug bsgol steng

bas/: nas:srid pa 'thar byed che mchog ste ru ga:smug nag 'bar ba zhal gsum phyag drug pa zhal gdangs ljags 'dril rno dkar mche ba gtsigs g.yas gsum rdo rjes dug gsum 'byung po 'dul:g.yon gsum bhan dmar srid gsum dwangs bcud rngub:zhabs bzhi bsgrad pas skye bzhi'i kha le bsgyur:dur khrod dpal chas dpa' ba'i rtags su bgo:gnam zhal dbyings phyug sku la 'khril sbyor rol:rdo rje bhan dmar 'dzin cing yab la stobs:yon tan la tshogs sprul pa bsam mtha' yas:gnyis med mnyam pa chen por phyag 'tshal bstod:mi dmigs chos sku'i klong las ma g.yos bzhin:gang 'dul gzugs kyi phyag rgyar rab bzhengs te 'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:thogs bcas bdud kyi mtshan ma thad gar bzlog:thogs med bdud kyi 'dzin stangs rang sar bzlog:dga' prod bdud kyi re dogs spros pa bzlog:snyem byedabadud kya a 'thas 'khrul 'khor bzlog:yar bdud sangs rgyas dngos mtshan rlom pa bzlog:mar bdud 'khor ba rang mtshan rlom pa bzlog:bdag dang gzhan du lta ba'i

gnyis 'dzin bzlog chos can mtshan ma chos nyid dbyings su bzlog: re dang dogs pa ro snyoms ngang du bzlog: bde dang sdug bsngal ka dag klong du bzlog: thams cad spros bral dbang chen he ru ga'i: dgongs pa mnyam nyid zang thal chen por bzlog: de nas 'jam dpal sku mchog yab yum la bzlog pa'i las bcol ba ri hū bh+yo: ser nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: gshin rje chu glang bsnol ba'i khri yi khar: thabs shes nyi zla zung 'jug gdan steng nas: sku yi bdag nyid 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: ser nag zhal gsum phyag drug khro gtum rngams: gar dgu'i nyams rdzogs gyad kyi 'dor thabs bsgrad: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril rno dbal mche ba gtsigs: g.yas gsum tho chen dgra sta ral gri 'dzin: ma rig 'khrul ba'i dgra bgegs brlag par byed: g.yon gsum zhags pa rnge'u chung bhan dmar bsdam: dug gsum 'khrul ba'i 'khor lo stong bar byed: za byed be ta nag mo smra la 'khril phyag g.yas gri shul bhan dmar yab la stobs: g.yas bskum g.yon brkyangs bde stong zung 'jug sbor: dur khrod dpa' chas thabs shes sku la

gas/ brgyan:rab 'bar me rlung phyogs rnams kun tu 'khyil:ma rtog rmongs pa'i mtshan 'dzin bag chags bsregs:ra rang 'khor tshogs sprul pa las la 'gyed:sku mchog yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod:rdul bral dri med klong las ma g.yos bzhin:gang 'dul thabs mkhas phyag rgyar rab bzhengs te:'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:thogs bcas bdud kyi mtshan ma thad gar bzlog:thogs med bdud kyi 'dzin stangs rang sar bzlog:dga' brod bdud kyi re dogs spros pa bzlog:snyem byed bdud kyi a 'thas 'khrul 'khor bzlog:yar bdud sangs rgyas dngos mtshan rlom pa bzlog:mar bdud 'khor ba rang mtshan rlom pa bzlog:bdag dang gzhan du lta ba'i gnyis 'dzin bzlog:chos can mtshan ma chos nyid dbyings su bzlog:re dang dogs pa ro snyoms ngang du bzlog:bde dang sdug bsngal ka dag klobhe du bzlog:thams cad spros bral dbang chen he ru ga'i:dgongs pa mnyam nyid zang thal chen por bzlog:de nas ya dag thugs mchog yab yum la bzlog pa 'i las bcol ba ni hūṃ bh+yo:mazing nag

'bar ba e yi klong dkyil nas: rū tra pho mo bsgol ba'i khri yi khar thabs shes nyi zla zung 'jug gdan steng nas: thugs kyi bdag nyid yang dag he ru ga: mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad zhal gdangs ljags 'dril rno dkar mche ba gtsigs: ha ha hūṃ phaṭaḥdrag po' gad rgyang sgrogs: g.yas gsum rdo rje gri gug thod rnga 'dzin:gnyis snang rū tra'i lus sems 'thar bar byed: g.yon gsum dril bu bhan dmar rgyu zhags 'dzin: dug gsum las skyes 'khrul ba dbyings su sbyor: dur khrod chas brgyad mdzes pa'i rgyan du klubs: dgyes bskyed yum chen kro ti shā ri ma: mthibhe skya khro 'dzum sgeg cing yab la 'khyud: g.yas pas rdo rje g.yon pas bhan dmar stobs: gzig sham rus rgyan dar kyi dpyangs pa 'phur: g.yon bskum g.yas brkyangs srid pa zil gyis gnon gnyis med bde ba'i sgra yis dregs pa 'dar: zung 'jug rtsal snang 'khor gyi rol bar ngom thugs mchog yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod mnyam nyid bde chen klong las ma g.yos bzhin gang 'dul 'gro ba'i dpal du rab bzhengs te: 'dod yon

badz+ra brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: thogs bcas bdud kyi mtshan ma thad gar bzlog: thogs med bdud kyi 'dzin stangs rang sar bzlog: dga' brod bdud kyi re dogs spros pa bzlog: snyem byed bdud kyi a 'thas 'khrul 'khor bzlog: yar bdud sangs rgyas dngos mtshan rlom pa bzlog: mar bdud 'khor ba rang mtshan rlomapa bzlog: bdag dang gzhan du lta ba'i gnyis 'dzin bzlog: chos can mtshan ma chos nyid dbyings su bzlog: re dang dogs pa ro snyoms ngang du bzlog: bde dang sdug bsngal ka dag klong du bzlog: thams cad spros bral dbang chen he ru ga'i: dgongs pa mnyam nyid zang thal chen por bzlog: de nas phur pa 'phrin las kyi la la bzlog las bcol ba ni hūṃ bh+yo lngang nag gru gsum e yi klong dkyil nas: dam bsri pho mo bsnol ba'i khri yi khar: thabs shes nyi zla zung 'jug gdan steng nas: rig pa'i rgyal pordo dzigazhen nu ni: mthing nag 'bar ba khro gtum gar dgu'i 'khyud: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril rno dkar mche ba gtsigs: g.yas gnyis rdo rje rtse dgu rtse lnga gdengs: a 'thas gdon gyi snying la gzir

bar byed: g.yon gnyis 'bar ba'i me dang kha ṭ+wāṃ bsnams: ma rig las byung dug gsum rtsad nas gcod: tha gnyis ri rab phur pa dgra la 'byed: ma rtog 'byung po'i snying khrag khol bar byed: zhabs bsgrad gyad kyis bdud bzhi zil gyis gnon: dur khrod chas brgyad sku yi rgyan du klubs: 'khor lo rgyas 'debs gnyis med 'khril sbyor rol: ut+pal bhan dmar dpal chen yab la stobs gzig sham rus rgyan mgo 'phreng sbrul chun 'phyang: zhabs g.yon yab btud g.yas brkyangs 'khor ba gnon: rab 'bar me rlung 'bar zhing phyogs su 'phyo: ki la rigs lnga khro bcu za gsod sogs: zung 'jug sku las sgyu 'phrul 'khor du ngom thal 'byin 'phrin las lha la phyag 'tshal bstod bya grub ye shes dbyings las ma g.yos bzhin: gang 'dul 'phrin las dpal du rab bzhengs te: 'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: thogs bcas bdud kyi mtshan ma thad gar bzlog: thogs med bdud kyi 'dzin stangs rang sar bzlog: dga' brod bdud kyi re dogs spros pa bzlog: snyem byed bdud kyi a 'thas 'khrul 'khor bzlog yar

badz+ra bdud sangs rgyas dngos mtshan rlom pa bzlog: mar bdud 'khor ba rang mchan rlom pa bzlog: bdag dang gzhan du lta ba'i gnyis 'dzin bzlog: chos canamatshan ma chos nyid dbyings su bzlog: re dang dogs pa ro snyoms ngang du bzlog: bde dang sdug bsngal ka dag klong du bzlog: thams cad spros bral dbang chen he ru ga'i dgongs pa mnyam nyid zang thal chen por bzlog de nas gzi brjid ma mo yab yum la bzlog pa 'i las bcol ba ni hū spyo sha khrag rgya mtsho 'khyil ba'i klo dkyil nas ma mo dgra bgegasabasnol ba'i khri yi khar: thabs shes nya zla zung 'jug gdan steng nas srid pa dbyings sbyor bla med he ru ga: mthing gsal zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad: zhalagadangs ljags 'dril rno dkar mche ba gtsigs: dur khrod chas brgyad dpa' bo'i rgyan du klubs: g.yas gsum zhing dbyug rnge'u chung gri gug 'dzin: g.yon rnams rgyu zhagasaga'u bhan dmar bsnams: ma rig log 'khrul dgra bgegs brlag par byed: dgyes bskyed yum chen nyad bzhi mu kha le: mthing skya gri thod yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: gzig

sham rus rgyan dar gyi dpyangs pa 'phur: zhabs g.yon yab btud g.yas pas 'byung po gnon me rlung 'od zer phyogs rnams kun tu 'phro: mtshan 'dzin gdon gyi 'khrul 'khor kha lo bsgyur: srid pa bde mnyam mkha' 'gro'i 'khor tshogs 'gyed: ma chen bde ba'i 1nga la phyag 'tshal bstod: skye med dbyings las dgongs pa ma g.yos bzhin:thugs rje'i 'brin las nub pa med par bzhengs 'dod bon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: thogs bcas bdud kyi mtshan ma thad gar bzlog: thogs med bdud kyi 'dzin stangs rang sar bzlog: dga' brod bdud kyi re dogs spros pa bzlog: snyem byed bdud kyi a 'thas 'khrul 'khor bzlog: yar bdud sangs rgyas dngos mtshan rlom pa bzlog: mar bdud 'khor ba rang mtshan rlom pa bzlog: bdag dang gzhan du lta ba'i gnyis 'dzin bzlog chos can mtshan ma chos nyid dbyings su bzlog: re dang dogs pa ro snyoms ngang du bzlog: bde dang sdug bsngal ka dag sang du bzlog: thams cad spros bral dbang chen he ru ga'i dgongs pa mnyam nyid zang thal chen por bzlog de nas rig

badz+ra 'dzin slob dpo na yab yum la bzlog pa' las bcol ba ni hūṃ bh+yo thugs rje gdung 'tshob sku yi dkyil 'khor nas: dar chen sdeb khri nyi zla kha sbyor dbus: ye shes 'od 'bar lnga ldan klong yangs nas: rigs rnams kun gyi dbang phyug rdo rje chos: dkar dmar mdangs ldan zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa: zhal 'dzum spyan zlum brtse ba'i rnam 'gyur can: rus rgyan dar dpyangs cod pan sna tshogs mdzes: g.yas gnyis rdo rje gri gug mkha' la phyar: g.yon gnyis dril bu bhan dmar sku la brten: yum chen rdo rje rnal 'byer dmar mor 'khril: pad phreng bhan+ta bde mchog yab la stobs: 'khril sbyor gar gyi bzhengs pas 'byung po gnon: 'ja' 'od zer 'khrugs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ging: rig 'dzin lha tshogs thabs shes 'khor du ngoms: rdo rje slob dpon sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: spros bral chos sku'i klong las ma g.yos bzhin rnam rol thugs rje'i gzugs kyi phyag rgyar bzhengs: 'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: thogs bcas bdud kyi mtshan ma thad gar bzlog: thogs med bdud kyi 'dzin stangs rang sar bzlog:

da ga' brod bdud kyi re dogs spros pa bzlog: snyem byed bdud kyi a 'thas 'khrul 'khor bzlog: yar bdud sangs rgyas dngos mtshan rlom pa bzlog: mar bdud 'khor ba rang mtshan rlom pa bzlog: bdag dang gzhan du lta ba'i gnyis 'dzin bzlog: chos can mtshan ma chos nyid dbyings su bzlog: re dang dogs pa ro snyoms ngang du bzlog: bde dang sdug bsngal ka dag klong du bzlog thams cad spros bral dbang chen he ru sha'i: dgongs pa mnyam nyid zang thal chen por bzlog: de nas mchod bstod dregs pa'i tshogs la bzlog pa' las bcol ba ni hūṃ bh+yo gtum drag me ltar 'bar ba'i 1nga dkyil nas dgra bgegs pho mo bsnol ba'i khri yi khar: thabs shes nyi zla zub 'jug khri steng nas: dpal chen khro rgyal dregs pa kun 'dulani: mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril rno dkar mche ba gtsigs ha ha hūṃ phaṭatshosag po'i gad rgyang sgrogs:g.yas gsum rdo rje lha brgyad mgo bo 'dzin: g.yon gsum bhan dmar tsho brgyad mgo bo bsdams: dug gsum 'byul pa'i 'byud po zil gyis gnon: dgyes bsted yum chen

ba:tshu khams gsum spyi 'dul 'khril:g.yas pas rdo rje g.yon pas bhan dmar stobs:dur khrod dpa' chas dpa' ba'i rtags su bgo:drag po'i gad rgya bdeb chen por sgrogs:sde dpon sum cu las kyi pho nyar 'gyed:'jig rten dregs pa'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod:rnam dag chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos bzhin:legs nyesastong 'dzan dregs pa'i skur bzhengs shig:'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:thogs bcas bdud kyi mtshan ma thad gar bzlog:thogs med bdud kyi 'dzinastangs rang sar bzlog:dga' brod bdud kyi re dogs spros pa bzlog:snyem byed bdud kyi a 'thas 'khrul 'khor bzlog:yar bdud sangs rgyas dngos mtshan rlom pa bzlog mar bdud 'khor ba rang mtshan rlom pa bzlog:bdag dang gzhan du lta ba'i gnyis 'dzin bzlog:chos can mtshan ma chos nyid dbyings su bzlog:re da dogs pa ro snyomasangang du bzlog:bde dang sdug bsngal ka dag klong du bzlog:thams cad spros bral dbang chen he ru ga'i:dgongs pa mnyam nyid zang thal chen por bzlog:de nas stobs lan drag

sngags kyi lha la bzlog las bcol ba ni hū bh+yo: rab 'bar me rlung 'tshubs ma'i klong dkyil nas: dgra bgegs pho mo bsnol ba'i khri yi khar: thabs shes zung 'jug nyi zla'i gdan stenganas mthu rtsal rmad byung stobs ldan nag po che: skrug nag zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril rno dkar mche ba gtsigs: g.yas gsum spu grilha brgyad tsit+ta 'dzin: g.yon gsum thod khrag klu brgyad tsit+ta bsdams: tshogs yul rang grol dur khrod chas brgyad brgyan: dgyes bskyed 'byung ba lnga be+e bdag mo yum: kha ṭ+wāṃbhan dmar dpal chen yab la stobs: zhabs g.yon yab 'khyud g.yas pas dgra bgegs gnon: gzig sham rus rgyan dar gyi dpyangs pa 'phur: me rlung dud sprin 'tshubasama'i dbyings su 'gying: dregs pa bco brgyad las kyi pho nyar 'byed: mngon spyod drag po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: ngang nyid bde chen klong las ma g.yos bzhin ye shes sgyu mar bkra ba'i skur bzhengs shig: 'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la thogs bcas bdud kyi mtshan ma thad gar bzlog: thogs med bdud kyi 'dzin stangs

badz+ra: rang sar bzlog: dga' brod bdud kyi re dogs spros pa bzlog: snyem byed bdud kyi a 'thas 'khrul 'khor bzlog: yar bdud sangs rgyas dngos mtshan rlom pa bzlog: mar bdud 'khor ba ra mtshan rlom pa bzlog: bdag dang gzhan du lta ba'i gnyis 'dzin bzlog: chos can mtshan ma chos nyid dbyings su bzlog re dang dogs pa ro snyoms ngang du bzlog: bde dang sdug bsngal ka dag klong du bzlog: thams cad spros bral dbang chen he ru ga'i dgongs pa mnyam nyid zang thal chen por bzlog: de nas bka' sdod dregs pa' tshogs la bzlog pa'i las bcol ba ni hūṃ bh+yo: dkyil 'khor dgu yi bka' nyan pho nya ba: ging chen bco brgyad laṅka bcu drug dang: 'bar ma brgyad dang ma bdun sring mo bzhi:sa bdag so gnyis 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro ma: gdab phur brgya rtsa rtog byed 'joms byed sogs: 'jigs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams gdug pa'i rnam 'gyur ya ma zung du ngoms: 'brin las thogs med nam mkha'i bya ma rta: legs nyes stong srog 'dzin pa'i dam tshig can: sbyor sgrol thabs mang bstan 'gro'i dpal du 'gyed: bka' sdod

las kyi pho nyar phyag 'tshal bstod:rnam dag chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos bzhin gang 'dul thabs mkhas mdzad phyir skur bzhengs shig:'dod yon brgyan pa'imachod gtor 'di bzhes la:thogs bcas bdud kyi mtshan ma thad gar bzlog:thogs med bdud kyi 'dzin stangs rang sar bzlog:dga' brod bdud kyi re dogs spros pa bzlog:snyem byed bdud kyi a 'thas 'khrul 'khor bzlog:yar bdud sangs rgyas dngos mtshan rlom pa bzlog:mar bdud 'khor ba rang mtshan rlom pa bzlog bdag dang gzhan du lta ba'i gnyis 'dzin bzlog:chos can mtshan ma chos nyid dbyings su bzlog:re dang dogs pa ro snyoms ngang du bzlog:bde dang sdug bsngal ka dag klong du bzlog:thams cad spros bral dbang chen he ru ga'i:dgongs pa mnyam nyid zang thal chen por bzlog:de nas za gsod yab yum la bzlog pa'i las bcol ba ni hū bh+yo thabs kyi cha 'jin za byed byi la'i mgo:yang rtsal bde zhing snang ba dbang du bsdud: phyag g.yas lcags kyus srid gsum bran du bsko la: gaskye na pas rten 'brel rtsa ba bhan khrag rten: zhabs

bas/ gnyis gar bsgyur stag lpags sham thabs klubs:mi lpags stod g.yog sbrul chun mgo 'phreng spras rdo rje'i gshog can thogs med las la rgyu dbang chen bka' bzhin thugs dam gnad nas bskul:brgyan pa'i mchod gtor dam pa 'di bzhes la:mi mthun 'gal rkyen bzlog pa'i 'brin las mdzod:shes rab cha 'dzin gsod byed pu shud mgo:mig rtsi ldan cing srid gsum sa ler gzigs:phyag g.yas nyon mongs rgyun gcod gra gug phyar:g.yon pas bde stong mnyam sbyor bhan dmar brten:zhabs gnyis gar bsgyur gzig sham rus rgyan spras rlu gi bde ga gcig thogs med las la rgyu:za byed phag mo'i bka' bzhin gnad nas bskul:brgyan pa'i mchod gtor dam pa 'di bzhes la:thabs shes sprul pa'i pho nya bsam mtha' yas:mngon spyod drag po'i las la dgyes bzhin par:rno mtshon thogs shing mthu rtsal bskyed bzhin du:thogs bcas bdud kyi mtshan ma thad gar bzlog:thogs med bdud kyi 'dzin stangs rang sar bzlog:dga' brod bdud kyi re dogs spros pa bzlog snyem byed bdud kyi a 'thas 'khrul

'khor bzlog:yar bdud sangs rgyas dngos mtshan rlom pa bzlog:mar bdud 'khor ba rang mtshan rlom pa bzlog:bdag dang gzhan du lta ba'i gnyis 'dzin bzlog:chos can mtshan ma chos nyid dbyings su bzlog:re dang dogs pa ro snyoms ngang du bzlog bde dang sdug bsngal ka dag klong du bzlog thams cad spros bral dbang chen he ru ga'i:dgongs pa mnyam nyid zang thal chen por bzlog de nas bka' snyan khro chen bzhi la bzlog las bcol ba na hū bh+yo chos nyid zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos bzhin:rnam rol thugs rje'i 'od zer mtha' yas pa:gcig bsdus rdo rje rta mgrin dkar gsal brjid:g.yas pas nyon mongs rgyun gcod gri gug phyar:g.yon pas bhan+ta dmar chen dku la brten:dur khrod chas rdzogs gyad kyi 'dor thabs bsgrad:khro gtum gar dgu'i nyams rdzogs he ru ga:bskul lo mngon spyod drag po'i las la bzhengs:'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la zhe sdang rgyas pa'i ma rig dgra dang bgegs:stong nyid snying rje chen po'i ngang du bzlog:mnyam nyid bde mchog dbyings las ma g.yos bzhin:rgyal ba'i yon tan

badz+ra: nus pa gcig rdzogs dpal rat+na rta mgrin ser gsal khro gtum rngams:g.yas pas dgra srog gcod pa'i ral gri phyar:g.yon pas nyon mongs dbyings sbyor bhan dmar brten:dur khrod chas brgyad gyad kyi thabs su rol:log 'dren 'dul phyir khro gtum rngams pa'i gar:bskul lo mngon spyod drag po'i las la bzhengs:'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:nga rgyal rgyas pa'i ma rig dgra dang bgegs:mnyam nyid ye shes rgyas pa'i ngang du bzlog:bde chen chags bral ngang las ma g.yos bzhin:dbang gi sku mchog pad+ma rta mgrin ni:dmar gsal zhal gcag phyag gnyis khro gtum sgegs:g.yas pa sa thod dbyug nam mkha'i dbyings su phyar:g.yon pas bhan khrag sku la brten ci rol:zhabs bsgrad gyad kyis bdud dang dam sri gnon:gar dgu'i nyams rdzogs dur khrod dpa' chas brgyan:gsung gi dbang phyug pad+ma he ru ga:bskul lo mngon spyod drag po'i las la bzhengs:'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'ad bzhes laḥ 'dod chags rgyas pa'i ma rig dgra dang bgegs rtogs bral bde ba chen

po'i ngang du bzlog:tshad med 'phrin las nub med klong yangs nas:drag po'i las mdzad garma rta mgrin ni:sku mdog ljang nag khro zhig gtum pa'i zhal:rngams pa'i nga ro hūṃ phaṭa 'brug ltar sgogs:g.yas pas brdung byed rdo rje'i tho chen thogs:chags pa dbyings spyor bhan dmar g.yon pas 'dzin:dur khrod chas rdzo gas gyad kyi thabs su rol:mngon spyod 'phrin las lhun grub he ru ga:bskul lo mngon spyod drag po'i las la bzhengs:'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:phrag dog rgyas pa' ma rig dgra dang bgegs:bya ba nan tan ye shes ngang du bzlog:kun kyang dmar ser ral pa 'khyil ba'i klo :rta zhal rigs bzhi bzhad pa'i brtul zhugs kyis:pho rgyud mo rgyud dregs pa dam la 'dog:ma mo mkha' 'gro las la bkol bar byed:dug gsum 'byung po 'bog cing snying khrag lhud:sde brgyad dregs pa yongs kyi gtsug gis gtugs:mthu rtsal rtags mtshan rmad byung he ru ga:sngon nas rā tra bsal ba'i dpa' rtags can:da yang dam sri 'dul ba'i 'phrin las mdzod:thabs chen dbang gi rgyal po spral par bcas:ste med

bsnye dbyings las gzugs kyi skur bzhengs la:'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:thogs bcas bdud kyi mtshan ma thad gar bzlog thogasamed bdud kyi 'dzin stangs rang sar bzlog:dga' brod bdud kyi re dogs spros pa bzlog:snyem byed bdud kyi a 'thas 'khrul 'khor bzlog:yar bdud sangs rgyas dngosamatshan rlom pa bzlog:mar bdud 'khor ba rang mtshan rlom pa bzlog:bdag dang gzhan du lta ba'i gnyis 'dzan bzlog chos can mtshan ma chos nyid dbyings su bzlog:redang dogs pa ro snyoms ngang du bzlog:bde dang sdug bsngal ka dag klong du bzlog:thams cad spros bral dbang chen he ru ga'i:dgongs pa mnyam nyid zang thal chen porabazlog de nas zil gajon khro tshogs la bzlog las bcol ba na hūṃ bye dmar nag shākya gsum dbang gi gzhal yas nas pad+ma gsung gi sku gsung thugs kyi gar:'phrin las gdug pa'adul ba'i stobs ldan pa:dri za zil gnon khro bo smrag nag rngams:g.yas pas gri shul g.yon pas zhags pa bsdams:'dod 'a na brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la

'byung po dri za'i dmag dpung dgra la bzlog:gshin rje zil gnon khro chen mthing nag 'bar:g.yas pas tho ba g.yon pas zhags pa 'dzin:'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:'byung po yi dwags dmag tshogs dgra la bzlog:mo rgyud zil gnon khro bo ljang nag brjed g.yas pas ral gri g.yon pas bhan dmar 'dzin 'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la sman dang ma mo'i dmag tshogs dgra la bzlog:pho rgyud zil gargon khro bo ser nag gtum:g.yas pas spu gri g.yon pas sbrul zhags bsdams:'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:pho bdud gnod sbyin dmag tshogs dgra la bzlog:btsan rnams zil gargon khro bo dmar nag bzhad g.yas pas ru mtshon g.yon pas snying zhags bsdams:'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:btsan dang asne ra tsa'i gnod pa bzlog:'byung po zil gnan khro chen mthing nag rngams:g.yas pas rdo rje g.yon pas sdig pa bsdams:'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:rā dza dam sri'i gnod pa dgra la bzlog:gza'

ba tshu rnams zil gnon khro bo mun pa'i mdog:g.yas pas kha ṭ+wāṃ g.yon pas zod khrag 'dzin:'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:drang sgong lha min rgol ba dgra la bzlog khyung chen zil gnon khro bo ser nag brjid g.yas pas rdo rje g.yon pas glog zhags bsdams 'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la gnyan gtod mkha' rgyu'i gnod spyor dgra la bzlog:klu rnams zel gargon khro bo smug nag brjed:g.yas pas me hom g.yon pas rlung zhags 'dzin:'dod yon brgyan pa'i mtshod gtor 'di bzhes la:nā ga klu gdon dmag tshogs dgra la bzlog:zil gargon yeshes khro chen sku mdog dkar g.yas pas 'khor lo g.yon pas bum pa 'dzin:'dodayon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la steng 'og bar gdon gdug rtsub dgra la bzlog:kun kyang khro gtum gar dgu'i nyams rdzogs shing:dur khrod chas brgyad gyad kyi thabs su rol:ye shes me rlang rab tu 'tshubs pa'i dbus:rang rang dgyes bskyed mkha' 'gro sku la 'khril:bde ba'i nyams rgyas gri thod btud cib stobs:zhal spyor drag

po'i gad rgyang ha hi sgogs shin tu mi bzad 'jigs pa'i cha lugs can:skye med dbyings las gzugs kyi skur bzhengs te:'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:thogs bcas bdud kyi mtshan ma thad gar bzlog:thogs med bdud kyi 'dzin stangs rang sar bzlog:dga' brod bdud kyi re dogs spros pa bzlog:snyem byed bdud kyi a 'thas 'khrul 'khor bzlog yar bdud sangs rgyas dngos mtshan rlom pa bzlog mar bdud 'khor ba rang mtshan rlom pa bzlog:bdag dang gzhan du lta ba'i gnyis 'dzin bzlog chos can mtshan ma chos nyid dbyings su bzlog re dang dogs pa ro snyoms ngang du bzlog:bde dang sdug bsngal ka dag klong du bzlog thams cad spros bral dbang chen he ru ga'i dgongs pa mnyam nyid zang thal chen por bzlog:de nas sgo skyongs khro bo bzhi la bzlog las bcol ba na hū bye dbang chen pad+ma gsung gi bka' nyan cing tshad med zhi ba'i sgo sgrong dam tshig can:pradzā ta kṛta khro bo dkar gsal brjed:g.yas pas lcags kyu g.yon pas bhan dmar 'dzin:snying rje chen po'i ngang la gnas bzhin du

badz+ra 'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:zhe sdang dgra bgegs rgol ba dbyings su bzlog tshad med rgyas pa'i sgo skyong dam tshig can:ya man+ta kṛtakhro bo ser nag rngams:g.yas pas zhags pa g.yon pas bhan dmar 'dzin:byams pa chen po'i ngang la gnas bzhin du:'dod ye na brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:ngargyal dgra bgegs rgol ba dbyings su bzlog:tshad med dbang gi sgo skyo dam tshig can:pad+ma ta kṛta khro bo dmar nag gtum:g.yas pas lcags sgrog g.yon pas bhan dmara'adzin:dga' ba chen po'i ngang la gnas bzhin du:'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la 'dod chags dgra bgegs rgol ba dbyings su bzlog tshad med drag po'i sgo skyo dam tshig can:bhigan ta kṛta khro bo ljang nag bzhad:g.yas pas dril bu g.yon pas bhan dmar 'dzin:btang snyoms chen po'i ngang la gnas bzhin du:'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:phrag dog dgra bgegs rgol ba dbyib sa su bzlog:kun kyang 'phren las rnam bzhi'i gar mdzad cing:khro gtum gar dgu'i nyams

rdzogs gtum rngams brjid:ngo bo dbang chen he rur ro mnyam kyang rnam pa sgo skyong tshul 'dzin thabs mkhas pa:las kyi khro bo chen po mched bzhi yang dam tshig dag pa'i mosangor da tshur bzhengs 'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:thogs bcas bdud kyi mtshan ma thad shar bzlog:thogs med bdud kyi 'dzin stangs rang sarabazlog dga' brod bdud kyi re dogs spros pa bzlog:snyem byed bdud kyi a 'thas 'khrul 'khor bzlog:yar bdud sangs rgyas dngos mtshan rlom pa bzlog:mar bdud 'khor ba rang mtshan rlom pa bzlog:bdag dang gzhan du lta ba'i gnyis 'dzin bzlog:chos can mtshan ma chos nyid dbyings su bzlog:re dang dogs pa ro snyoms ngang du bzlog:bde dang sdug bsngal ka dag klong du bzlog:thams cad spros bral dbang chen he ru ga'i:dgongs pa mnyam nyid zang thal chen por bzlog:de nas bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs labazlog las bcol ba ni hu bye dbang chen pad+ma gsung gi bka' nyan pa'i khams brgya ma drug dmus long bcu drug dang:za byed khyi brgyad dpal gyi spyang brgyad tshogs:drwa ba glog

badz+ra: 'gyu 'brug bzhi 'dab ma can:kun kyang las su gnas yul dur khrod 'grim:zas su dam nyams dgra bo'i sha khrag za:sgrub pa'i brod nyul dam sri 'byung po'i gshed:pho nya yongs rdzogs dgra 'dul thugs dam can:thugs dam dbyings las gzugs kyi phyag rgyar bzhengs:'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:gzugs can sdabhe ba'i dgra dpung ma lus bzlog gzugs med gnod pa'i bgegs tshogs kun kyang bzlog:ban byad bon byad skye bos dmod byad bzlog:gza' dang rgyu skar yongs kyis gnod pa bzlog:sa bdag klu gnyan gtod kyis gdug rtsub bzlog:lo nyes sad ser btsa' than 'bu srin bzlog:ma nad nor gyi god yams tha dag bzlog:gcan gzan gdug pa'i za kha ston pa bzlog:ar jag rkun bus rku 'phrog 'jab shom bzlog:gri rigs bco brgyad mtshon ces smas ngo bzlog:dus kyi rgud pas mu ge g.yo ba bzlog:mtha' bzhi'i dmag gi 'ur gzengs 'khrug rtsod bzlog:mo rtsis rmi lam than ltas ngan pa bzlog:thams cad ma lus dgra dang bgegs la bzlog:ming tsam med pa'i

'phrin las mdzad du gsol: de nas dregs pa'i chos skyong rnams la bzlog las bcol ba ni hūṃ bh+yo: laṅka'i yul gyi grong khyer chen po nas: gsang sngags bstan pa srung ba'i dam tshig can:legs ldan nag po lcam dral bka' sdod bcas dam tshig sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir da tshur byon: brngan pa'i 'dod yon mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: sangs rgyas chos kyi bstan dgra ma lus bzlog sems can nyes byed bdud sde ma lus bzlog: chos mdzad yongs la gnod pa'i dam dgra bzlog: sku tshe mdzad phrin 'phrog pa'i bdud sde bzlog: bshad sgrub mkhon 'dzing sgong ba'i dam sri bzlog: bar chad bdud dang dam sris 'tshubs ma bzlog: thams cad bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzod: nyu bh+yo 'byung ba lnga yi khams la dbang bsgyur zhing srid gsum sgog gi bdag po rā hu la gza' dang rgyu skar dregs tshogs las la 'gyed: myur mgyogs rdzu 'phrul nam mkha'i glog las myur: che btsan srid pa gsum na ya mtshan pa'i zangs ging dmar po bstan pa'i sgog 'dzin pa dam tshig gsang ba'i gnas 'dir basmal lo byon 'dod yon rgyan gyi mchod gtor 'di

bsnye: bzhes la:sangs rgyas chos kyi bstan dgra ma lus bzlog:sems can nyes byed bdud sde ma lus bzlog chos mdzad yongs la gnod pa'i dam dgra bzlog:sku tshe mdzad phrin 'phrog pa'i bdud sde bzlog:bshad sgrub mkhon 'dzing slong ba'i dam sri bzlog:bar chad bdud dang dam sris 'tshubs ma bzlog thams cad bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i 'brin las mdzod:( bye:srid gsum sgog bdag rgyal btsan yongs kyi gtso:rbad na mthu che bskul na las myur ba:sangs rgyas chos kyi bstan pa srung mdzad cing:khyad par gsang sngags snying po'i srog 'dzin pa:bka' sdod yongs kyi spyi rje tsi ma ra:rang las spros pa'i 'bar ba spun bdun dang:ru 'dren sde bzha 'byung ba lnga yi btsan:drag rtsal sprul ba myur mgyogs mthu rtsal can:grangs dang bsam pas mi dpog mtha' yas pa:dam tshig gnad nas bskul ma da tshur bzhengs:brgyan pa'i mchod gtor dam pa 'di bzhes la:sangs rgyas chos kyi bstan dgra ma lus bzlog:sems can nyes byed bdud sde ma lus bzlog:chos mdzad yongs la gnod pa'i dam dgra bzlog sku tshe mdzad

phrin 'phrog pa'i bdud sde bzlog:bshad sgrub mkhon 'dzing slong ba'i dam sri bzlog:bar chad bdud dang dam sris 'tshubs ma bzlog:thams cad bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzod:nyu bh+yo:bdud yul mun gling gsod gcod shan pa'i gnas:ki bswo cha sgra sgogs pa'i klong dkyil nas:bdud kyi spu gri myur mgyogs mthu rtsal can:sprul pa dpung bcas bskul lo da tshur byon btsan yul 'bar ba chen po'i klong dkyil nas:sprul pa nyi rdul ltar 'khrigs rdzu 'phrul can:btsan gyi spu gri dgra srog gcod la mkhas dam tshig chen pos 'bod do da tshur byon:dbang chen rgya mtsho 'khyil ba'i klong dkyil nas:dgos 'dod rin chen gter la mnga' mnyes pa'i:klu yi spu gri bstan pa'i gnyer 'dzin pa:'khor bcas gnad nas bskul lo da tshur byon:kun kyang brngan pa'i gtor skyems 'di bzhes la:sangs rgyas chos kyi bstan dgra ma lus bzlog:sems can nyes byed bdud sde ma lus bzlog:chos mdzad yongs la gnod pa'i dam dgra bzlog:sku tshe mdzad 'phrin 'phrog pa'i bdud sde bzlog:bshad sgrub mkhon 'dzing slong ba'i

badz+ra: dam sri bzlog:bar chad bdud dang dam sris 'tshubs ma bzlog:thams cad bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzod:hū bh+yo:dbang chen pad+ma gsung gi bka' sdod pa:shar gyi rgyug ging rdo rje'i bde ga pa can:ma he'i gdong ba dam nyams dgra la gshe:rus pa'i gzugs can ging rus las la 'gyed:sgog gcod sbu gri g.yas largyu zhags g.yon:rdzu 'phrul rlung las mgyogs pa'i za rngams can:shar gyi mtshe thun dgra la 'bebs mdzad pa:gnad nas bskul 'o sngon gyi dam tshig bzhin:dgra la rbad do drag po'i skur bzhengs shig brngan pa'i dpa' ston gtor ma 'di bzhes la mngon spyod 'phrin las lhun gyis grub par mdzod:mi mthun phyogs kun ma lus dgra la bzlog:lho yi rgyug ging rin chen gshog pa can:chu srin gdong pa zhing bcu'i srog la rngams:srin po'i nyams can laṅka'i dmag tshogs 'gyed:sgog gcod mdung ring g.yas la sbrul zhags g.yon:bos na snyan gsang rbad na mthu rtsal can:lho yi dug thun dgra la 'bebs mdzad pa:gnad nas bskul ma sngon gyi dam tshig bzhin:dgra la rbad do drag po'i

skur bzhengs shig brngan pa'i dpa' ston gtor ma 'di bzhes la mngon spyod 'brin las lhun gyis grub par mdzod: mi mthun phyogs kun ma lus dgra la bzlog:nub kyi rgyug ging pad+ma'i gshog pa can:khyung gdong dmar po dam nyams dgra la rngams:shan pa'i gzugs can gnyan gtod las la 'gyed:sgog gcod ral gri g.yas la glog zhags g.yon spyor sgrol thabs la mkhas pa'i rdzu 'phrul can:nub kyi mtshon thun dgra la 'bebs mdzad pa'i:gnad nas bskul lo sngon gyi dam tshig bzhin:dgra la rbad do drag po'iskur bzhengs shig brngan pa'i dpa' ston gtor ma 'di bzhes la mngon spyod 'phrin las lhun gyis grub par mdzod mi mthun phyogs kun ma lus dgra la bzlog:byang gi rgyug ging spu gri'i bde ga pa can:sdig gdong sngo nag dam nyams sgog la gshe: gdol ba'i gzugs can rgyal btsan las la 'gyed srog gcod chu gri g.yas la glog zhags g.yon:sngags pa'i dam la gnas shing las la rgyug: byang gi rdo thun dgra la 'bebs mdzad pa:gnad nas bskul lo sngon gyi dam tshig bzhin:dgra la rbad do drag po'i skur

ba:tshu bzhengs shig: brngan pa'i dpa' ston gtor ma 'di bzhes la: mngon spyod 'phrin las lhun gyis grub par mdzod: mi mthun phyogs kun ma lus dgra la bzlog: hūṃ bh+yo gzhan yang bstan pa'i gnyer 'dzin dam tshig can: bka' yi 'khor na gnas pa'i dregs pa'i sde 'byung po'i rigs can nyams pa'i sha la za: drang sgong rigs can legs nyes ltong srog 'dzin: sha za'i rigs can dam nyams khrag la 'thung: srin po'i rigs can nyams pa'i rus la bza': bgegs kyi rigs can than dang ltas ngan 'gyed: khyed rnams dpal gyi pho nya chen po ste: rnal 'byor dgongs pa mi 'gyur gzer ldan la: lus sgog phul zhing ci bgyis bka' nyan byed tho co rtsang spyod sngags pa gzugs brnyan pa'i: bka' la mi gnas srog la rgol zhing gshe: mi srun 'byu po khyed cag da bzhengs shig: rdo rje pad+ma'i tha tshig dran bzhin du: dpa' skyems mchod gtor dam pa 'di bzhes la: bka' srung chos skyong yongs kyis rgol ba bzlog: snang srid lha 'dres than dang ltas nga na bzlog ban byad bon byad skye bos dmod byad bzlog: dam chos byang chub

bsgrub pa'i nyer 'tshe bzlog: nad rims yas ngang god kha sna tshogs bzlog sad ser btsa' than 'bu srin shā 'ud bzlog: sngon las 'phral rkyen gang yang rung ba bzlog:mdor na mi mthun mi 'dod phyogs rnams kun: sdang bar byed pa'i dgra yi steng du bzlog: gnod par byed pa'i bgegs kyi steng du bzlog: bza' bar byed pa phung sri'i steng du bzlog bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol: badz+ra tsasgosarba duṣ+ṭan ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūṃ phaṭa: mi mthun pa'i phyogs dang mi 'dod pa'i nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad sdang byed dgra dang gnod byed bgegs kyi steng du bsgyur cig: bzlog cig: e sa bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog: e ka bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog: maro na spyod drag po' las rjes bzlog pa bya sdang ba'i dgra sde sdang kyang 'di yis thub gnod pa'i bgegs tshogs 'tshubs kyang 'di yis thub byad kha phur kha g.yo ya 'di yis thub ltas ngan cho 'thul bstan kyang 'di yas thub dregs pa' dmag gas rgol kyang 'di yis thub bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams 'di yis zub rta phyugs nor gyi god kha 'di yis thub phyi na gnyis kya dmod sbyor 'ad yis thub kun thub rgyal po dpal gyi gtor bzlog 'ad phal ba'i nor dang phyogs tsam 'dra ma mtshu sa nag

gtsa(: phyogs bdud la bsru ba 'ad mi bca' bstan pa' chom po ra skyabs chen 'di mi sbyin sdig pa'i dpon la srung skyobs 'di mi byed zas ngo nor la rin chen 'di mi btsong sangs rgyas chos kyi bstan pa bsrung phyir bya sems can yongs la bde skyad 'byung phyir bya bstan 'dzan skyes bu'i sku tshe bsring phyir bya rnal 'byor yongs kyi bar chad bsal phyir bya mtha' bzhi'i dmag gis mtshon kha sdang dus bya zhal shes sham bu sbyar na thog las myur 'ad yi yon tan nam mkha'i mtha' da mnyam ra mazong ma yin don gya che ba yan da la chen drag po'i gtor bzlog yang dag par sgrub pa 'i rnal 'byor bar chad bdud las rgyal tshe ra nad med bkra shis chos kyis phyug dpa la chen mthu btsan dregs pa 'i gtsug na spa dgra 'joms 'dre 'dul mthu yi grags pa rgyas yon tan bcu drug dag la mnga' dbang 'byor the tshom med do rdo rje pa d+ma'i bka' bden rdzun lag tu longs dang nges shes zhabrungs byin rlabs rtags mtshan bsgrub ra rtson dang gsal sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya mngon spyod drag po 'i las kyi mthar phyin tshe phyi nang sgo dbye dngos grub bskul len rjes dpal gyi gtor ma mtshon char bsgyur ba ni bdud rtsi phud rgod mchod la 'diskad do hā bye rtse gcig bsnyen cing sgrub pa'i rnal 'byer la: mchog gsum pad+ma drag pos gsan cing dgongs: bdud rtsi chang phud mchod pa 'di bzhes la: skye med dbyings su

gzu dpang grogs la dpag: 'gags med gtor chen las kyi mtshon char bsgyur: legs nyes shan drang ye shes gzigs pas phyes: bstan pa'i dgra la bskul ma mthu ma chung gnod byed bgegs la rbad do rtsal ma zhan: mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod trag rak+ka dhar hrī rbad bh+yo: nā ga shu tsi ni rbad bh+yo: sharnyi pa ṇi ni rbad bh+yo: yaka rak+ka ni rbad bh+yo: ka la duṣ+ṭan ni rbad bh+yo: durnyi dz+wa la ni rbad bh+yo: mā ra ya dza dza: sarba sha t+t+waṃ hur thum rgyug bh+yo: gtor ma las kyi mtshon char dmigs de nyid dgra bo'i steng du rdebs mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las kyis gang la gzas pa rdul brlag 'gyur sa ma wā rgya rgya rgya ye ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma saṃ snya ༵sa ma 'o sa 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis snying dang 'dra ba'i gdams zab rmad byung ba grub pa'i dab phyugagyes mchog khyod la gtad da dung spel ba'i dus la ma bab pas ran chen brda la bstams shag sa ra bye mdo khams bkra shis rdzong der dgongs bra sdoms ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus nad mug mtshon chas gzeng pa lang pa'i tshe dpa' bo khyod nyad 'dus pa rtsal du bzhengs skyes bu de dang gdams pa 'di 'phrad nas 'gro don 'phran las byang nas byang du rgyas 'brel tshad don ldan pad+ma 'od du 'god bka' 'di srungs shig gnod sbyinabatsan rgod rgyal dam nyams

gas/: lag tu ma shor spu gri gsum skal bzang tshogs la sprod cig ging dmar nag sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya dpal gyi gtor bzlog mtshon cha 'bar ba'i rdzong zab mo rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gas rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pa d+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda thim snyi ces pa 'di'angalu zen chos kyi bdag po sku skyes pad+ma bsod nams grub pa 'a rdo rjes bkra shis lha reg bdebar gshegs pa 'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten snang ya mtshan can dang / dri med ras gzan dkar po kha tshar ma nyams pa'i skyes dang bcas te 'bad rtsol lhur len gyis bskul ba don dang ldan phyir kho porgyal mtshog bzhad pa rtsal gyisamakha' 'gro'i gsang ba'i 'phrul brda las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni chos kya bdag po nyid kyas brgyas pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba ma sgo lo/

pa(: zab gsang rdo rje snying po las dbang chen bdud dpung zil gnon gyi: mngon spyod drag las kyi mtha' bden pa'i stobs bzlog mtshon cha ngar ma bzhugs so rmi: na sna gu na padhā ka ra ye: 3141dza/ pad+ma dbang chen khros pa'i he ru ka ma rig du tra 'dul ba'i dpa' rtags can rdo rje mtshon cha 'bar ba'i zer 'bar ba khro chen he ru'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo ma rung 'byung po smon log dam sri' rags tshar gcod nus pa drag po bsgral ba'i las rdzong 'phra srog gi nus mthu ldan pa sa bya de yi rjes su bden pa'i stobs bzlog 'di shin tu khros pa 'a brtul zhugs dpa' bskyed de rol mo sna tshogs rngams pa'i sgra sgrogs shang pad+ma nye ru'i ting 'dzan nga bskyang sa te hūṃ bye dbus mtha' med pa chos kyi dbyings nyid las ma rtog rū tra 'dul ba'i dpa' rtags can: dbang gi rgyal po pad+ma he ru ga: dmar nag khro gtum sdang mig glog ltar 'khyugs: zhal gsum phyag drug smra smin me ltar 'bar: phyag g.yas nyon mongs rgyun gcod ral gre dang thod dbyug gri gug phyag rgya gdengs thabs 'dzin: g.yon pas sbrul zhags tho ba thod khrag bsdams: dur khrod dpal chas sku yi rgyan du klubs dbu gtsug rta zhal bzhad pas dregs tshogs

'thar:dmar ser ral pa nam mkha'i dbyings su 'khyil:zhabs bzhi bsgrad pas bdud bzhi dbyi sa su gnon:ye shes me rlung 'tshubs ma phyogs bcur 'khyil:gnyis snang dam sri 'byung po bsreg par byed:dgyes bskyed rdo rje phag mo sku mdog mthing:phyag g.yas gri gug yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud:g.yon pas bhan dmar dbang chen zhal du stobs:g.yon skum g.yas brkyang yab la mnyam par sbyor rus rgyan gzig sham mgo 'phreng sbrul chun spras:yab yum gnyis med bde ba chen po'i sku:dmigs med mkha' ltar dag pa'i dbyings las bzhengs:'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:chos nyid ka dag chos can bslu med kyi:bden pa chen po'i mthu dang nus pa yis:gzugs can sdang ba'i dgra yis rgol ngan bzlog gzugs med gnod byed bgegs kyis 'tshe ba bzlog:a 'thas nyon mongs dam sris g.yul ngo bzlog:ma rig 'khrul ba'i bdud bzhi'i cho 'phrul bzlog:phyi nang gsang ba'i 'gal rkyen bar chad bzlog:thams cad zhi ba chos nyid chen por bzlog:hūṃ bh+yo rdo rje phra men thabs kyi cha 'dzin

badz+ra pa: dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i thabs la mkhas pa yi: za byed chen po byi la'i mgo bo can: mngon spyod drag po'i las la da bzhengs shig:'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: chos nyid ka dag chos can baspu med kyi: bden pa chen po'i mthu dang nus pa yis: gzugs can sdang ba'i dgra yis rgol ngan bzlog: gzugs med gnod byed bgegs kyis 'che ba bzlog: a 'thas nyon mongs dam sris g.yul ngo bzlog: ma rig zhakhrul ba'i bdud bzhi'i cho 'phrul bzlog: phyi nang gas ba'i 'gal rkyen bar chad bzlog thams cad zhi ba chos nyid chen por bzlog: hūṃ bh+yo: mgyogs byed phra men shes rab cha 'dzin pa: dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i las la mkhas pa yi: gsod byed chen mo pu shud mgo bo can: mngon spyod drag po'i las la da bzhengs shig: 'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la chos nyid ka dag chos can bslu med kyi:bden pa chen po'i mthu dang nus pa yis: gzugs can sdang ba'i dgra yis rgol ngan bzlog: gzugs med gnod byed bgegs kyis 'tshe ba bzlog: a 'thas nyon mongs dam

sris g.yul ngo bzlog:ma rig 'brul ba'i bdud bzhi'i cho 'phrul bzlog:phyi nang gsang ba'i 'gal rkyen bar chad bzlog:thams cad zhi ba chos nyid chen por bzlog:/ bye las mdzad pho nya rta mgrin rigs bzhi po:rang rang sprul pa yang sprul bsam mtha' yas:dmigs med mkha' ltar dag pa'i dbyings nas bzhengs:'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:chos nyid ka dag chos can bslu med kyi:bden pa chen po'i mthu dang nus pa yis:gzugs can sdang ba'i dgra yis rgol ngan bzlog gzugs med gnod byed bgegs kyis 'tshe ba bzlog:a 'thas nyon mongs dam sris g.yul ngo bzlog:ma rig 'khrul ba'i bdud bzhi'i cho 'phrul bzlog:phyi nang gsang ba'i 'gal rkyen bar chad bzlog:thams cad zhi ba chos nyid chen por bzlog:( bh+yo phyogasabacu'i gdon tshogs 'dul ba'i 'phrin las can:sbyor sgrol thabs la mkhas pa'i he ru ga:zil gnon khro tshogs yab yum sras 'khor bcas:dmigs med dbyings las gzugs kyi phyag rgyar bzhengs:'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:chos nyid ka

pa(: dag chos can bslu med kyi:bden pa chen po'i mthu dang nus pa yis:gzugs can sdang ba'i dgra yis rgol ngan bzlog:gzugs med gnod byed bgegasakyis 'tshe ba bzlog:a 'thas nyon mongs dam sris g.yul ngo bzlog:ma rig 'khrul ba'i bdud bzhi'i cho 'phrul bzlog phyi nang gsang ba'i 'gal rkyen bar chad bzlog thams cad zhi ba chos nyid chen por bzlog:/ bh+yodadza ngas pa dbyengs las rnam rol gar bsgyur ba:khams brgya ma drug dmus long rgyab 'brel tshogs:khyi spyang bcu drug dra baglog 'gyu ma:'brug bzhi 'dab ma gser gyi sring mo sogs:mngon spyod drag po'i las la da bzhengs shig:'dod yod brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:chos nyid kadag chos can bslu med kyi:bden pa chen po'i mthu dang nus pa yis:gzugs can sdang ba'i dgra yis rgol ngan bzlog:gzugs med gnod byed bgegs kyis 'tshe ba bzlog a 'thas nyon mongs dam sris g.yul ngo bzlog:ma rig 'khrul ba'i bdud bzhi'i cho 'phrul bzlog:phyi nang gsang ba'i 'gal rkyen bar chad bzlog:thams cad zhi ba chos nyid

chen por bzlog:hū bh+yo skye rmed dbyings kyi 'khor lor mnga' mdzad pa'i:sku mchog 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po che:sbyor sgrol yum chen gshed bzhi phyogs skyo sogs chos nyid dbyings las gzugs kyi phyag rgyar bzhengs:'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la chos nyid ka dag chos can bslu med kyi:bden pa chen po'i mthu dang nus pa yis gzugs can sdang ba'i dgra yis rgol ngan bzlog:gzugs med gnod byed bgegs kyis 'tshe ba bzlog a 'thas nyon mongs dam sris g.yul ngo bzlog:ma rig 'khrul ba'i bdud bzhi'i cho 'phrul bzlog:phyi nang gsang ba'i 'gal rkyen bar chad bzlog:thams cad zhi ba chos nyid chen por bzlog / bh+yo bde mchog 'bar ba'i 'khor 'o/ra mnga' mdzad pa'i:gsung mchog 'gags med che mchog he ru ga:gnam zhal dbyings phyug khro rgyal rigs bzhi sogs:skye med dbyings las gzugs kyi phyag rgyar bzhengs:'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:chos nyid ka dag chos can bsgru med kyi:bden pa chen po'i mthu dang nus pa yis:gzugs can sdang ba'i dgra

bas/: yis rgol ngan bzlog:gzugs med gnod byed bgegs kyis 'tshe ba bzlog:a 'thas nyon mongs dam sris g.yul ngo bzlog:ma rig 'khrul ba'i bdud bzhi'i cho 'phrul bzlog:phyi nang gsang ba'i 'gal rkyen bar chad bzlog:thams cad zhi ba chos nyid chen por bzlog:nyu bh+yo:rdul bral dri ma med pa'i 'khor lo rtsadab mjad yang dag kro ti shwa ri yum:kro ta rigs bzhi gnas yul dbang phyug sogs:spros kal dbyings las gzugs kyi phyag rgyar bzhengs:'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la chos nyid ca4 / sla med kyi:bden pa chen po'i mthu dang nus pa yis:gzugs can sdang ba'i dgra yis rgol na bzlog:gzugs med gnod byed bgegs kyis 'tshe ba bzlog:a 'thas nyon bye ngas dam sris g.yul ngo bzlog:ma rig 'khrul ba'i bdud bzhi'i cho 'phrul bzlog:phyi na gsang ba'i 'gal rkyen bar chad bzlog:thams cad zhi ba chos nyid chen por bzlog:hūṃ bh+yo:ro mnyam bde mchog rol ba'i pho brang nas:thal 'byin 'phrin las rdo rje gzhon nu dang:'khor lo rgyas 'debs

gras lnga khro bcu sogs dgongs pa'i dbyings las gzugs kyi skur bzhengs nas:'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:chos nyid ka dag chos can baglu med kyi:bden pa chen po'i mthu dang nus pa yis:gzugs can sdang ba'i dgra yis rgol ngan bzlog:gzugs med gnod byed bgegs kyis 'tshe ba bzlog a 'thas nyon mongs dam sris g.yul ngo bzlog:ma rig 'khrul ba'i bdud bzhi'i cho 'phrul bzlog:phyi nang gsang ba'i 'gal rkyen bar chad bzlog:thams cad zhi ba chos nyid chen por bzlog:hūṃ bh+yo:khams gsum rol bachen po'i 'khor lo na ro mnyam bde mchog bla med he ru ga:nyid bzhi mu kha ma lnga yum drug sogs:de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings las rab bzhengs te 'dod phon brgyan pa'imachod gtor 'di bzhes la chos nyid ka dag chos can bslu med kyi:bden pa chen po'i mthu dang nus pa yis:gzugs can sdang ba'i dgra yis rgol na bzlog:gzugs med gnod byed bgegs kyis 'tshe ba bzlog:a 'thas nyon mongs dam sris g.yul ngo bzlog:ma rig 'khrul ba'i bdud bzhi'i cho 'phrul bzlog:phyi

badz+ra: nang gsang ba'i 'gal rkyen bar chad bzlog:thams cad zhi ba chos nyid chen por bzlog:hū bh+yo:shin tu 'bar ba chen po'i 'khor lo rtsagazhan snang zil gnon dregs pa kun 'dul rgyal:khams gsum spyi 'dul sde dpon sum cu po:'khor bcas mngon spyod drag po'i las la bzhengs:'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:chos nyid ka dag chos can bsgru med kyi bden pa chen po'i mthu dang nus pa yis:gzugs can sdang ba'i dgra yis rgol ngan bzlog gzugs med gnod byed bgegs kyis 'tshe ba bzlog:a 'thas nyon mongs dam sris g.yul ngo bzlog:ma rig 'khrul ba'i bdud bzhi'i cho 'phrul bzlog:phyi nang gsang ba'i 'gal rkyen bar chad bzlog thams cad zhi ba chos nyid chen por bzlog:/ bh+yo:rab tu bskyod pa chen po'i 'khor lo phum rig rtsad gcod stobs ldan nag po che:'byung lnga'i bdag mo dregs chen bco brgyad ni:sgrul pa g.yog bcas mngon sprod las la bzhengs:'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la chos nyid ka dag chos can bsgra med kyi:bden pa chen

po'i mthu dang nus pa yis:gzugs can sdang ba'i dgra yis rgol ngan bzlog:gzugs med gnod byed bgegs kyis 'tshe ba bzlog a 'thas nyon mongs dam sris g.yul ngo bzlog:ma rig 'khrul ba'i bdud bzhi'i cho 'phrul bzlog:phyi nang gsang ba'i 'gal rkyen bar chad bzlog:thams cad zhi ba chos nyid chen por bzlog:hū bh+yo:bka' nyan dam tshig dag pa'i 'khor lo dra las mdzad pho nya dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs:'bum phrag yangs pa'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma:chos kyi dbyings las gzugs kyi phyag rgyar bzhengs:'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:chos nyid ka dag chos can baglu med kyi bden pa chen po'i mthu dang nus pa yis:gzugs can sdang ba'i dgra yis rgol ngan bzlog:gzugs med gnod byed bgegs kyis 'tshe ba bzlog a 'thas nyon mongs dam sris g.yul ngo bzlog:ma rig 'khrul ba'i bdud bzhi'i cho 'phrul bzlog:phyi nang gsang ba'i 'gal rkyen bar chad bzlog:thams cad zhi ba chos nyid chen por bzlog:hū bh+yo:dbang chen gsung gi bka' nyan tsi ma ra gzes po' sgog bsdud

ba tshu gza' mchog rā hu la: myur mgyogs stobs ldan lcags ging 'bar ba rtsal: rang rang las mdzad pho nya bsam mtha' yas: mngon spyod drag po'i las la da bzhengs shig: 'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: chos nyid ka dag chos can bslu med kyi: bden pa chen po'i mthu dang nus pa yis gzugs can sdang ba'i dgra yis rgol ngan bzlog: gzugs med gnod byed bgegs kyis 'tshe ba bzlog: a 'thas nyon mongs dam sris g.yul ngo bzlog: ma rig 'khrul ba' bdud bzhis cho 'phrul bzlog: phyi nang gsang ba'i 'gal rkyen bar chad bzlog: bka' srung yongs kyi rgol ngan dgra la bzlog: sde brgyad yongs kyi gdug rtsub dgra la bzlog: mu stegs ban bon yongs kyi byad zor bzlog: snang srid lha 'dres cho 'phrul sna tshogs bzlog: 'jigs chen brgyad dang bcu drug dgra la bzlog: ltas ngan cho 'phrul sna tshogs dgra la bzlog:mdor na mi mthun mi 'dod phyogs rnams kun: sdang bar byed pa'i dgra yi steng du bzlog: gnod par byed pa'i bgegs kyi steng du bzlog: za bar byed pa'i 'dre dang sri la

bzlog: thams cad bzlog bsgyur gzhom pa'i 'phrin las mdzod mi mthun pa'i phyogs dang mi 'dod pa'i nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad sdang byed dgra dang gnod byed bgegs kyi steng du bsgyur cig: bzlog cig: e sa bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog e ka bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog aḥyasasuḥsatsagazhaḥmā ra ya rbad bh+yo rbad bzlog phaṭa: de ltar bden pa' stobs bzlog 'dis mi mthun phyogs rnams thams cad kun zhi ba stong nyid chen po ru bzlog cang bsgyur bar the tshom med sa ma yu me ma rgyalaba'i dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis thugs kyi dwangs bcud zab gsang rdor snying skor grub pa'i dbang phyug rgyal mchog khyod la gtad da dung ma spel rin chen brda la bstims mdo khams bkra shis rdzong der dgongs pra sdoms ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus nad mug mtshon chas gzengs pa lang pa'i tshe dpa' bo khyod nyid 'dus pa rtsal du bzhengs skyes bu de dang gdams pa 'di 'phrad nas bstan pa'i 'gro don byang gi phyogs su 'byung 'brel tshad don ldan pad+ma 'od du 'god bka' 'ad srungs shig gnod sbyin btsan rgod rgyal dam nyams lag tu ma sgo ra spu gra gsum las ldan bu la sprod cig ging dmar nag sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya bden pa'i stobs bzlog mtshon cha ngar ma rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sba rgya zab rgya gsang rgya

btsa(: gu rgya yo rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda thim snyi ces pa 'di'ang sku skye pad+ma dga' ba'i rdo rjes bkra shis ya mtshan can gyi skye du mar bcas te nan dan chen pos bskul ngor/ kho bo rgyal mchog ba'ad pa rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro gsang ba' 'phrul bdo las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa na chos bdag nyid kyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba masgo le/

pa(: zab gsang rdo rje snying po las dbang chen bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal gyi drag po'i khyung gi bzlog pa gnam lcags zhun ma'i tsha tshwa bzhugs so:rmi: na mo gu ru pad+ma kro dha shrī he ru ka ya: pho stanadzonasgo1( pad+ma dbang chen khros pa 'i rgyal ngo yis mngon spyod las kyi dgra bgegs tshar bcad tshe mthu rtsal rmad byung drag po' khyung bzlog 'di gtum rngams khros pa 'i tshul gyi ngang nas bya sa ma yu skad cig gis yi ge khro nag po yongs su gyur pa las ye shes kyi bya khyung 'bar ba: gnam lcags zhun ma'i lus po la sgro gshegag thams cad spu gri ltar rno zhing mtshon rtse ltar rngams pa: lcags rwa gzeng shing spyan mig nyi zla ltar 'khyil ba: shangs nas rdo rje thog gi tsha tshwa 'phro zhing sgro gzhog sprugs pa'i gseb nas dug khrag lcags kyi char ba 'bebs pas sa bdag klu gnyan gtod rigs dgra bgegs 'byung po thams cad rdul du brlag par bsam: 31 khro ga ru ṭa tsa le tsa le hūṃ phaṭa: byad zor mnan gtad mā ra ya byes phyes khrol khrol swā hā: hūṃ phyo chos kyi dbyings nas rig pa'i rgyal po khyod: khro rgyal dag dang dgongs pa mnyam pa'i sku 'jigs byed zil gnon dgra dang

bgegs kyi gshed: mthu rtsal rmad byung ye shes ga ru ṭa ri rab 'bar ba ri yi rtse mo dang dpag bsam rgyas pa shing gi rtse mo nas sprul pa'i khro rgyal khyung chen rigs lngar bcas: rdzu 'phrul thogs pa med pa'i stobs bskyed la do nub ma tram̐ bsgral ba'i las la byon dbang chen gsung dang dgongs pa mnyam par bzhugs: mngon spyod lhun gyis grub phyir phyag 'tshal lo: slo badz+ra ga ru ṭa sarba sa ma ya dza dza: dzaḥshā shā ho: sarba a ti pu ho: hū spyo bdud rtsi sman dang rak+ta dmar chen po: 'dod yon phung po gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul dgra bgegs klu gnyan gdug pa tshar gcod cing mngon spyod lhun gyis grub phyir bzhes su gsol: ma hā ga ru ṇa sarba pu dza sa ma ya ho: hū bye gdug pa'i dgra bgegs ma lus bsgral ba dang mngag gzhug 'phrin las lhun gyis grub mdzad pa'i: ye shes khro rgyal badz+ra ga ru ṭa: gtso 'khor sprul par bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod: hū bh+yo dus gsum rgyal ba'i dbang bsar byin rlabs pa'i: ye shes khro rgyal badz+ra ga ru ṭa rdza 'phrul thogs pa med pa'i stobs bsted la: byad phur rbod zor than dang ltas ngan bzlog:

ba tshu khyed kyi spyan mig g.yas par gser chu 'byil:sa nad me ltar 'bar ba bzlog tu gsol:spyan g.yon zla bar dngul chu khol ba yis:gnyan nad chu ltar 'phyo ba bzlog tu gsol lcags rwa g.yas nas ye shes me chen 'bar:btsan gyi gdug rtsub rgol ngan bzlog tu gsol:lcags rwa g.yon par dug rlung spran ltar 'khyil:bdud kyi shā rdel 'phen pa bzlog tu gsol:rwa bar yid bzhin nor bu 'bar ba yis:'brug seng 'thab pa'i ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol:snyan g.yas gser gyi spu gri 'bar ba yis:ma mo'i dal yams khrag nad bzlog tu gsol:snyan g.yon lcags kyi rno mtshon 'bar ba yis:gshin rje'i khram kha gtong ba bzlog tu gsol zhal gyi lcags mchu rdo rje rno mtshon gyis:rmongs pa klu gnyan gtod kyi gdug rtsub bzlog:lcags sder mtshon rnon lta bur mnga' ba yis:rigs lnga klu yis gdug rtsub bzlog tu gsol:g.yas kyi gshog zur khro rgyal 'bar ba bcus yul ma brgyad kyis cho 'phrul ltas ngan bzlog:g.yon gyi gshog zur ye shes khro mo bcus gnas ma brgyad kyi than ltas cho 'phrul bzlog mjug sgo

rgyal mo bzhi dang gdong mo bzhis:dbang phyug nyer brgyad than ltas cho 'phrul bzlog:lcags kyi sgro phran sbu gri ltar rno bas:than dang ltas ngan cho 'phrul bzlog tu gsol:zhal nas krirnyikri shi〉〉sgrogs pa yis:gza' dang rgyu skar cho 'phrul bzlog tu gsol:'bar ba'i me dang dud rlung 'khrigs pa yis mdze rigs bco brgyad nad yams bzlog tu gsol g.yas su gzigs pas pho gdon zil gyis gnon g.yon du rngams pas mo gdon rgol ngan bzlog mdun du gzigs pas dregs tshogs zil gyis gnon:dpal gyi mtshon gsum sdang ba'i dgra la thobs:spyo ban byad bon byad lha klu mi yi byad:stong gsum byad zor sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo:pho gdon mo gdon klu gdon 'byung po'i rigs:steng 'og gdon tshogs sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo:mi nad nor nad rta phyugs yongs kyi nad:rim yams grib sogs sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo:sngags 'chang bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod la: gnod cing 'tshe ba'i phyogs rnams ma lus pa:zhi bzlog bsgyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol: ma khro ga ru ṭa tsa le tsa le hūṃ phaṭa:rma bya khyung khyung: ha la

badz+ra: ha la: khro khro bh+yo bh+yo: bar zhum trig shag lhog pa sbun dgu'i srog la ram̐ re: sa srin sod gag 'bras srin la rbad rbad: dz+wa la pra dun dz+wa la: mtshal zhal mtshal ku ru bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog: sarba sha hūṃ hur hūṃ dza: mā ra ya bzlog bh+yo ltas ngan byad kha phur kha gtong mkhan rnams kyi snying nas bya khyung gi sder mos zungs gshog pa rdo rje'i mtshon cha'i char ba phobs lcags rwa mtshon rtse ltar rno bas brdung: mchu sbu gri ltar rno bas gsol nas dgra bgegs ming med du brlag pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig: de ltaraye shes khyung gi bzlog pa yis byad phur rbod zor ltas ngan cho 'phrul dang steng 'og bar gdon la klu'i gdug rtsub kun ma lus bzlog par 'gyur ro rdo rje'i bka' sa ma mā chagam rgyalabalidabang po pad+ma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis thugs kyi zab bcud rdo rje snying po 'i skor grub pa'i dbang phyug rgyal mchog khyod la gtad da dung ma spel rin chen brda la bstims mdo khams bkra shis rdzong der dgongs pra sdoms ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus nad mug mtshon chas gzeng pa la pa 'i tshe dpa' bo khyod nyid bzhad pa'i rdo rjer bzhengs skyes bu de dang gdams pa 'ad 'phrad nas bstan pa'i 'gro don byang gi phyogs su 'byung 'brel tshad don ldan pad+ma 'od du

'god bka' 'di srungs shig gnod sbyin tsi ma ra bka' log lag tu ma shor spu gri gsum skal bzang tshogs la sprod cig ging dmar nag sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya khyung bzlog gnam lcags zhun ma'i tsha tshwa rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda thim lha ces pa 'da'ang lung zin chosakyi bdag po sku skyes pad+ma dga' ba'i rdo rjes bkra shis lha reg phun sum tshogasapa'i skyesam mtshan can du mar bcasate nan dan chen posabaskul ngor/ kho bo dbang chen gsung gi rdo rje rgyal mtshog bshad pa rtsal gyisamakha' 'gro gsang ba'i 'phrul brda las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa' yi ge pa ni chos bdag nyid kyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba ma le/

badz+ra: zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: dbang chen bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal gyi: mngon spyod drag las kyi bzlog skor khro bo hūṃ mdzad kyi rngams bzlog gdug pa zil gnon bzhugs so: rmi: na mo pad+ma kro ta rā dza ya:31sgo44 dbang chen he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo khro rgyal hūṃ mdzad rngams pa 'i bzlog las na dpal gyi gtor ma bshams la lha ru mos sha khrag bstab cing 'dod don bcol ba ni hūṃ dza bh+yo: bde chen rdo rje gar gyi sku: khro bo chen po hūṃ mdzad ni: sku ni gzugs kyi khams su 'bying: zhabs kyis 'gro drug kha lo bsgyur: khams nag ral pa srid rtser 'khyil: zhal gyi mche ba ga sa ltar gtsigs: nyi zla 'bar ba'i sdang mig bsgrad: khro gnyer chu yi rlabs bzhin 'khrugs: g.yas kyi phyag na gtor zor thogs: g.yon pas khrag thun dgra la 'bebs sku ni smug nag 'bar ba la ber nag klubs shing thod sbrul brgyan: las kyi khro bo skar ltar 'khrigs: za byed khro mo rdul ltar 'tshubs: kun kyang mngon spyod las la bzhengs brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: mi mthun bzlog bsgyur 'brin las mdzod: lha chen ru 'dren ngang yag dang phyag tshangs me yi 'khor

lo dang btsan pho gdong gi rgyugs yag da : phu bo red kyi rkang gcig sogs: lha yi phyag brnyan thams cad kyis 'phrul ba' byad zor than ltas kun: khro bo hūṃ mdzad khyod kyis bzlog: gdong ba mig gisagang ba dang: lcags kyi skam bu ldeb pa dang: me lce rlung gi zhags pa can: rkang pa lcags 'khor ldan pa sogs: gshin rje'i phyag brnyan thams cad kyis: 'phrul ba'i byad zor than ltas kun khro bo hūṃ mdzad khyod kyis bzlog: ral bsigs khrag tu 'bebs pa dang dus drug rgyud ba'i 'jab mkhas dang: bzhin dmar lus po drod pa'i gzugs: rtag tu khrag nad gtong mkhan sogs: ma mo'i phyag brnyan thams cad kyis: 'phrul ba'i byad zor than ltas kun: khro bo hūṃ mdzad khyod kyis bzlog: bdud po tu legri 'dzin dang phyag tshang skyes yag mtshal mig dang: blon po ngang ldan lcags mche can: sha drang nag po la sogs pa'i bdud kyi phyag brnyan thams cad kyis: 'phrul ba'i byad zor than ltas kun: khro bo hūṃ mdzad khyod kyis bzlog: me lce gdong nas 'gyed pa dang: skar mda' slog gi 'khor lo can: mig gcig khrag gi sham chu 'bebs: mche

pa(: ba lcags rnon gtsags pa sogs: btsan gyi phyag brten thams cad kyis: 'phrul ba'i byad zor than ltas kun khro bo hūṃ mdzad khyod kyis bzlog: 'od kyi sgong nga 'gyed pa dang: gnam sa 'brel ba'i lus ring can: sha skam rid pa'i rnam 'gyur can: gzhon nu khrag zhal snying 'byen sogs rgyal pe3 phyag brnyan thams cad kyis: 'phrulaba'i byad zor than ltas kun khro bo hūm̐ mdzad khyod kyis bzlog sna tshogs gru gus lus po can: rgyug thabs nang 'byin bla 'byin pa : spu gri rnon po'i mche ba can: rdo rje'i thogazhags 'gyed pa sogs: gnod spyin phyag brnyan thams cad kyis: 'phrul ba'i byad zor than ltas kun: khro bo hūṃ mdzad khyod kyis bzlog: gdol ba nag po 'dzin la mkhas gto mi shes pa'i gtum rngams can: kha rlangs nad dang dug tu 'phro: mthong reg grib kyi tsha chu can: klu yi phyag brnyan thams cad kyis: 'phrul ba'i byad zor than ltas kun khro bo hūṃ mdzad khyod kyis bzlog mkha' la thogs sted bsgrod pa can: srog la hur thum rgyug 'gyel gtong: lus la mig gi ri mo 'bebs: nyams pa 'i mig rtsa ltag par 'then/

khwa gdong nag po thebs mkhan sogs: gza' yi phyag brnyan thams cad kyis: 'phrul ba'i byad zor than ltas kun: khro bo hūṃ mdzad khyod kyis bzlog: 'byung ba sa la rgyu mkhan dang bsod nams dpal la 'jab mkhas dang: phug gi lha srung dbye byed dang: thab tu nyal ba'i bse rag sogs: the'u rang phyag brnyan thams cad kyis: 'phrul ba'i byad zor than ltas kun: khro bo hūṃ mdzad khyod kyis bzlog: bh+yo: za byed chen po shar nas rgyu: de yi phyag na skar mda' thogs: cho 'phrul ston pa'i dus byung na: khro bo hūṃ mdzad khyod kyis bzlog: gtub byed chen po lho nas rgyu: lag na spu gri'i 'khor lo 'dzin: de yis cho 'phrul 'byung ba na: khro bo hūṃ mdzad khyod kyis bzlog: 'ching byed chen po lho nas rgyu: lag na gser gyi zhags pa 'dzin: de yis cho 'phrul bstan gyur na: khro bo hūṃ mdzad khyod kyis bzlog: rbad byed chen mo nub nas rgyu: lag na lcags kyi sha zung 'dzin: de yis cho 'phrul btab pa na: khro bo hūṃ mdzad khyod kyis bzlog: 'byin byed chen po byang na rgyu lag na lcags kyi mdung ring 'dzin: de yis cho 'phrul bstan tsa na: khro bo hūṃ mdzad khyod kyis

badz+ra bzlog: khrag 'be+ebs mi mo shar lhor rgyu lag na nad kyi skyal ba bsdam: de yis cho 'phrul btab gyur na: khro bo hūṃ mdzad khyod kyis bzlog:rgyug 'thab nag mo lho nub rgyu: lag na sgyu ma slo snying 'dzin: de yis cho 'phrul 'byung ba na: khro bo hūṃ mdzad khyod kyis bzlog: 'bar ba mo ni nub byang rgyu lag na tshon skud gru gu 'dzin: de yisacho 'phrul 'gyed pa na: khro bo hūṃ mdzad khyod kyis bzlog: bsnubs byed nag mo byang shar rgyu: lag na re ba'i g.yab mo 'dzin: de yis cho 'phrul gtong ba'i tshe khro bo hūm̐ mdzadakhyod kyis bzlog: lus med ma ni mkha' la rgyu: lag na thog chu khol ma 'dzin: de yis cho 'phrul g.yo ba na: khro bo hūṃ mdzad khyod kyis bzlog: gnam sman ma ni sa la rgyu: lagan sdig nag mgo dgu 'dzin: de yis cho 'phrul bstan pa'i tshe: khro bo hūṃ mdzad khyod kyis bzlog: bh+yo: mkha' la rgyu ba'i ga ru ṭa: khros na gza' skar thang la 'bebs: 'khu na'adab chags than rigs g.yo: de yis cho 'phrul g.yo ba na: khro bo hūṃ mdzad khyod kyis bzlog: sa la rgyu ba'i dur phag de: khros na gnam sa yo log byed: 'khu na rmig chags

ltas ngan g.yo: de yis cho 'phrul byung ba na: khro bo hūṃ mdzad khyod kyis bzlog: nags la rgyu ba'i sbre nag de khros na me rlung rgyu ba g.yo: 'khu na sder chags ltas ngan 'gyed de yis cho 'phrul byung gyur na: khro bo hūṃ mdzad khyod kyis bzlog: rdzaspang la brten rmig bu de khros na shwa 'ud chu log 'byung: 'khu na rgong than ltas ngan 'byed: de yis cho 'phrul byung gyur na khro bo hūṃ mdzad khyod kyis bzlog bh+yo: khro chen 'bar ba khyod nyid kyis: rnam 'gyur ma nges ston pa'i tshe: dbu na lcags rwa me ltar 'bar: rwa co can gyis ltas ngan bzlog gdong ba ma he rngams pa'i zhal: gdong can sna tshogs ltas ngan bzlog: dung gi mche ba gangs ltar gtsigs: mche ba can gyis ltas nga na bzlog: rdo rje'i gshog pa mkha' la gdengs: 'dab chags rigs kyi ltas ngan bzlog: rkang lag sen mo lcags kyu 'bar: sder mo can gyis ltas ngan bzlog: sku las rdo rje'i thog ser 'bebs: snang srid lha 'dres ltas ngan bzlog: me dang rlung gi 'od zer 'byed: sde brgyad yongs kyi rgol ngan bzlog: dza dang ram̐ gyi bu yug 'tshubs: byad zor rbod gtong thams cad bzlog:

badz+ra: pho bh+yo de ni g.yas su bh+yo: cho 'phrul thams cad dgra la bsgyur: mo bh+yo de ni g.yon du bh+yo: ltas ngan thams cad dgra la bsgyur: bzlog cig bsgyur cig sa ma yā: de ltar khro bo hūṃ mdzad kyi dregs pa rngams bzlog byed pa 'i thabs do gal che tshe bya bar rigs snang srid yo log 'byu kya thub phal ba tsam la byed mi rung dregs pa yo sa la na ldog shor de phyir bsdam spel mkhasapar gyas sa ma yā na sngags nus pa 'bum rdzogs kyi 'phrin las ya mtshan che ba' lam skal ba can gyi spyod yul las 'dod ster mkhan la 'chor mi ru thugs kyi bu chen thams cad la bstan pa 'dzan pa'i grogs su bzhag ma g.yel thugs kyi dkyil du 'chong ma bul dgos pa byung tshe spel sa ma yu ye ma rgyal ba' dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis thugs kyi zab bcud rdo rje snying po' skor grub pa'i dbang phyug rgyalamachog khyod la gtad da du ma spel rin chen brda la bstams mdo khams bkra shis rdzong der dgongs pra sdoms ma 'o sa snyigs mar nad mtshon gze ba'i tshe dpa' bo khyod nyid 'dus pa rtsal du bzhengs skyes bu de dang gdams pa 'di 'phrad nas bstan pa 'i 'gro don bya ga phyogs su 'byung 'brel tshad don ldan pad+ma 'od du 'god bka' 'di sru sa shig gnod sbyin btsan rgod rgyal dam nyams lag tu ma shor spu gri gsum skal bzang tshogs la gtod cig

ging dmar nag sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya khro bo hūṃ mdzad kyi rngams bzlog dregs pa zil garon rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gya slob dpon pad+ma sa bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chenabazas bkod pa'o brda zim snyi ces pa 'di'ang lung zin chos kyi bdag po sku skyes pad+ma dga' ba'i rdo rjes bkra shis lha reg shag tu dge ba'i skyes ya mtshan can du mar bcas te nan dan chen pos bskul ngo ra 7 kho bo rgyal mchog bshad pa rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i 'phrul brda las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa na chos bdag nyad kyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba masgo lo/

ga(: zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: dbang chen bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal gyi mngon spyod bzlog las kyi rim pa'i nang tshan ma mo bong zhon ma'i than dang ltas ngan bzlog pa rdo rje mchu yi nga ro bzhugs so: rmi: na mo gu ru pad+ma kro dha shrī he ru ka ya r+sā〉lo'i 'bar ba'i gzi byin khrug pa' he ru ka gar dgu'i yos rdzogs rta mgrin rgyal la 'dud gdul dka' nyon mo sa rgyas pa'i sems can gyas bsam sbyor ngan pa'i 'phrul bzlog 'di la brtson sa ma wā rang nyid pad+ma dbang chen he ru gar gsal ba'i mdun du ma: las ltas ngan dang nad yams kyi bdag mo: sku mdog char sprin 'khrigs pa lta bu'i rnam 'gyur can: ral pa bsig cing khrag gi char ba 'bebs pa: spyan gsum bsgrad cing sdang mig glog ltar 'khrug pa: kha rlangs dang sna rlangs las nad kyi na bun sna tshogs pa 'tshubs shing 'gyed pa: re ba nag po'i ber bgo zhing khram shing dang thod khrag 'dzin pa: chibs su bong nag kha dkar la bcibs shing: mchan khung g.yon du nad skyal bsdam pa: de yi 'khor du ma mo nag mo khrag ral gzeng shing gcer bu sbral chun dang rgya mas brgyan pa grangs med

pas bskor bar bsam:g.yin yang than gzugs sna tshogs pas bskor zhing phar sdang ba'i dgra bo'i steng du 'gro ba'i rnam 'gyur dang ldan par gsal gdab po:bshugs glu dang rkang gring gis bskul te hū bh+yo:'og phyogs mun pa'i dur khrod nas:ltas ngan nad yams rims bdag mo:phung byed bong zhon nag mo ni:mun pa'i go bgos khro zhing gtum:'khor du bud med tshogs kyis bskor:bong nag kha dkar chibs su bcibs:khram shing thod khrag phyag na bsnams:mi rtsid re sde sku la gsol:ltas ngan sna tshogs 'phrul dang bcas sngags pas 'bod do da tshur byon:do nub dpal gtor rten la bzhugs dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa bzhes:'dod yon gtor ma'i phung por rol:mngon spyod drag po'i las la dros:bh+yo:khyed kyis mkhyen pa'i gzigs mdzod dang:nyes med bdag la sdang ba'i dgra:do bsdo phod btsug ya bzung ba'i:smon log dam sri'i rigs can la ltas ngan sna zogs char ltar phob:myur du rgyug la phung du chug ming tsam med pa'i 'phrin las mdzod:bh+yo ban bon kun rgyu gang rung la:bdag ni 'dres shing rtsod gyur te pha rol rbod

badz+ra: gtong mkhan rnams kyis ltas ngan cho 'phrul gang bstan kyang:ma bdud rgyal mo khyod kyis bzlog:shar nas khā sha sgo ru rgyug:btsan la gtad pa'i ltas nganate ma bdud rgyal mo khyod kyis bzlog: lho nas sha pho ngu zhing mdur: gnyan la gtad pa'i ltas ngan te:ma bdud rgyal mo khyod kyis bzlog:nub nas wa mo phug tu brgyal bdud la gtad pa'i ltas ngan te:ma bdud rgyal mo khyod kyis bzlog:byang nas than sbrul byi ro za:klu la gtad pa'i ltas ngan te:ma bdud rgyal mo khyod kyis bzlog:shar zhe ra sprel ser nye par rgyug rgyal por gtad pa'i ltas ngan te:ma bdud rgyal mo khyod kyis bzlog:lho nub bya rgod sbra la 'babs:gshin rjer gtad pa'i ltas ngan te:ma bdudargyal mo khyod kyis bzlog:nub bya bya rog 'dzings 'thab byed:gnod sbyin la gtad ltas ngan te:ma bdud rgyal mo khyod kyis bzlog:byang shar gla skya rgyug cing rtse:gtod lagatad pa'i ltas ngan te:ma bdud rgyal mo khyod kyis bzlog:steng nas thog ser rdo char 'khrug:gza' la gtad pa'i ltas ngan te ma bdud rgyal mo khyod kyis bzlog:'og nas

phyi ba khyim du rgyug: the'u rang la gtad ltas ngan te: ma bdud rgyal mo khyod kyis bzlog: skyes pa'i kha nas khrag skyug 'chi: ma yam la gtad ltas ngan te: ma bdud rgyal mo khyodakyis bzlog bud med rnams ni 'gags grir 'chi: gnam sman la gtad ltas ngan te ma bdud rgyal mo khyod kyis bzlog: byis pa chung sri lang nas 'chi: the'u rang la gtadaltas ngan te ma bdud rgyal mo khyod kyis bzlog: dud 'gror ltas ngan than gzugs 'byung: bdud po spun dgur gtad ltas te: ma bdud rgyal mo khyod kyis bzlog: srod lakhyim byas nga ro sgrogs: bla rkun 'byung ba'i ltas ngan te: ma bdud rgyal mo khyod kyis bzlog: nam dgung rta pho mtsher ba de: bla bdud thon pa'i ltas ngan yin ma bdud rgyal mokhyod kyis bzlog: tho rang sgo khyi ngu ba na: mi bla shor ba'i ltas ngan te: ma bdud rgyal mo khyod kyis bzlog: sbra yi gung shing chag pa na: tshe srog chad gas ltas ngan te ma bdudargyal mo khyod kyis bzlog: sbra gur chon thag 'gul ba na: bdud mos glags 'tshol byed pa te ma bdud rgyal mo khyod kyis bzlog: khang khyim bya long 'bab pa na: shi chad 'ong

badz+ra: ba'i ltas ngan te ma bdud rgyal mo khyod kyis bzlog: go cha'i nang du sbrang tshang bca': bla sgog bsod nams nyams pa' ltas:ma bdud rgyal mo khyod kyisabazlog: byi bas sgra dang gos dum za:the'u rang sgog la 'jab pa'i ltas:ma bdud rgyal mo khyod kyis bzlog:gzhan yang cho 'phrul sna tshogs dang: than dang ltas na gang byungayang: ma bdud rgyal mo khyod kyis bzlog:bh+yo:khyod nai rgyu ba mtsho la rgyu: rgya mtsho'i sprin dmar yal ba na:sngags 'chang dza gas mo khyod kyis bzlog: gzigs pa nam mkha'imathong la gzigs:mkha' yi tshe gzugs yal ba na:sngags 'chang grogs mo khyod kyis bzlog:sku ni ri rab zom la brten ri thang dpag bsam shing chag na:sngags 'changagrogs mo khyod kyis bzlog:ral ba lho sprin ltar du phyug:ri bo'i se dkar bab pa na sngags 'chang grogs mo khyod kyis bzlog:'dod yon la ni hab thob byed dge sbyong du ba chad pa'i skyen:sngags 'chang grogs mo khyod kyis bzlog:rlu gi shugs can bang rtsal ldan nyi zla rlung gi 'pho bsgrod na:sngags 'chang grogs mo khyod kyis bzlog:dkyil

'khor kun gyi dbang phyug ma: lam log rlung gis bro 'khrab na: sngags 'chang grogs mo khyod kyis bzlog: byed pa sems can don la 'jug dbyig gi nor bu stong ba de sngags 'chang grogs mo khyod kyis bzlog: legs nyes gnyis kyi shan 'byed mo 'brug seng la sogs 'thab pa'i skyen: sngags 'chang grogs mo khyod kyis bzlog: shan 'byed gzu bor gnas pa mo shel gong nang du dug g.yos rkyen sngags 'chang grogs mo khyod kyis bzlog: dam chig can gyi pho nya mo: ri rtse'i nyi ma nub pa'i rkyen: sngags 'chang grogs mo khyod kyis bzlog: gzhan yang phyi nang gnyis gtogs pa'i: than dang ltas ngan cho 'phrul kun: zhi ba chos sku'i dbyings su bzlog: bsgyur ro ka dag klong du bsgyur thams cad spros dang bral bar āX de ltar ma mo nag mo yi ltas ngan bzlog pa'i 'phrin las kyis mi bzlog mi 'dul gang yang med rnal 'byor yo sa kyi rim gror brten gang la byas kyang phan pa 'byung the tshom med dordo rje'i bka' sa ma mā ye ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma sa bha wa'i ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis thugs kyi yang bcud rdo rje snying po'i skor grub pa'i dbang phyug rgyal mchog khyod la gtad da dung ma spel rin chen bdo la

gtsar+sha bstems mdo khams bkra shis rdzong der dgongs pra sdoms ma 'ongs snyigs mar nad mtshon gze la tshe dpa 'a bo khyod nyid bzhad pa rtsal du bzhe sa skyes bu de dang gdams pa 'di 'phrad nas bstanapa'i 'gro don bya gi phyogs su 'byung 'brel tshad don ldan pad+ma 'od du 'god bka' 'di srungs shig gnod sbyin btsan rgod rgyal dam nyams lag tu ma shor spu gri gsum thugs kyi sras la sprod cig ging dmar nag sa ma yu rgya rgyargya ma bdud bong zhon rgyal mo' ltas ge bzlog pa rdo rje mchu yi gzi ngar rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dngo na pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa 'o brda thim snyi ces pa 'di' lungazen chos kyi bdag po sku skyes pa d+ma dga' ba' rdo rjes bkra shas la reg phun sum tshogs pa 'i skyes ya mtshan can du mar bcas te nan dan chen pos bskul ro ra/ 7 kho bo rgyal mtshag bzhadapa rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro gas ba'i 'phrul brda 'a sa zhal bshus te dag par phab pa 'i yi ge pa ni chos bdag nyid kyis bgyis dge legs 'phel/ sarba masgo le/mi rtsa bzlog bsdus pa na hūṃ bh+yo: 'khor 'das 'ub chub zla gam dgu rdzogs dal: mnga' mjad dbang gi rgyal po'i bka' sdod pa: phyag brnyan ma yam nyer brgyad ngo

bo la: rnam pa gdug rtsub mtshon cha dpal ngar can: gnad nas bskul lo rū tra'i snying la bh+yo: 'jigs dang sdug bsngal ma lus dgra la bzlog: mā ra ya bh+yo bh+yo: bzlog bzlog:zhes kyang nus ldan pas so/ maṅga le/
