badz+ra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las dbang chen bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal gyi ma mo'i rtsang bzlog gdug pa'i rkyen 'joms bzhugs so:rmi: na mo gu 〈co pad+ma 11 dha rā dza ya: 41chen41 mngon spyon drag po'i gtor chen bzlog las kyis mtha' rgyan dab mo' rtsang bzlog bya ba ni ja cha khrag skyems mchod la rol mo sgrogs gtum rngams glu la drangs te 'di skad do hūṃ bh+yo gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: ma tram̐ rū tra bsgral ba'i dpa' rtags can: dbang chen pad+ma'i sku la snyoms zhugs pa'i: ma chen dbang mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad ni: dkyil 'khor gnyan po'i mtha' skyong dam mnos pa'i: ma tram̐ lus la srin po'i 'gro tshul du: gdug rtsub shing la brten cing rkyen bzlog zhes: sngon nas gnyer dam blang ba'i ma sring tshogs: rdo rje gsang ba'i gnas 'dir da bzhengs shig: pho nya za gsod mang po las la 'gyed: rno ngar mtshon cha sna tshogs drag tu gzer: sbyor sgrol dpa' ba'i las la ma g.yel bar: zas su dgra bo'i sha la zan ltar rol: skom du khrag skyems rak+ta'i mchod pa bzhes: gos su mi lngags g.yang gzhi rlon pa klubs: las su

dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i mdzad pa ston:'phrin las dus la bab po sa ma yu:/ bh+yo gdug pa'i rtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dang ldan:yar gyi rtse la pho rog sha 'thab byed:mar gyi rtsel g.yag nag rwa rtsed bsgyur:sked pa'i dkyil nas dpa' bos mtshon cha gdengs:gdug rtsub mtshon dbal sdang ba'i dgra la phobs:hūṃ:gdug pa'i rtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dngaldan:yar gyi rtse la srin byas nga ro sgrogs:mar gyi rtse la dug gi ngad pa g.yo sked pa'i dkyil nas dpa' mos rngams stabs bsgyur:gdug rtsub mtshon dbal sdang ba'i dgra laphobs:hūṃ:gdug pa'i rtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dang ldan:yar gyi rtse la bya rgod ro la lding mar gyi rtse la mtshe mda' glog ltar 'khyug sked pa'i dkyil nas btsan dmag bu yuga'atshubs:gdug rtsub mtshon dbal sdang ba'i dgra la phobs:lha:gdug pa'i rtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dang ldan:yar gyi rtse mor gnam lcags rdo rje 'khrugs:mar gyi rtse la yungasathun bu yug 'tshubs:sked pa'i dkyil na bdud kyi shwa dril bsgrigs:gdug rtsub mtshon dbal sdang ba' dgra la phobs:hūṃ:gdug pa'i rtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dang ldan:yar

badz+ra: gyi rtse la spu gri 'bar ba 'phyo: mar gyi rtse la lcags phur tsha tshwa 'khrugs: sked pa'i dkyil na klu yi dug rlangs 'gyed: gdug rtsub mtshon dbal sdang ba'i dgra la phobs: hūṃ: gdug pa'i rtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dang ldan: yar gyi rtse la dung gi byi ba mkhun: mar gyi rtse la rak+ta'i rba klong 'phyo: zhed pa'i dkyil na srin po'i dmag dpung 'khrugs: gdug rtsub mtshon dbal sdang ba'i dgra la phobs: pa: gdug pa'i rtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dang ldan: yar gyi rtse la gser gyi sbra chung brtse mar gyi rtse la sdig nag mgo dgu 'phro: sked pa'i dkyil du gshin rje'i dmag tshogs 'gyed gdug rtsub mtshon dbal sdang ba'i dgra la phobs: hūṃ bh+yo: gdug pari rtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dang ldan yar gyi rtse la bya rgod ro la lding mar gyi rtse la mtshon cha skar ltar 'khrugs: sked pa'i dkyil na srog gcod shan pa 'tshubs: gdug rtsub mtshon dbal sdang ba'i dgra la phobs:hūṃ: gdug pa'i rtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dang ldan: yar gyi rtse la lcags kyi bya sngon lding: mar gyi rtse la mda' thun bu yug 'chubs sked pa 'i dkyil du ma mo'i dmag tshogs 'phro:

gdug rtsub mtshon dbal sdang ba'i dgra la phobs: ñtsa gdug pa'i rtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dang ldan: yar gyi rtse la dung bya gong mo lding: mar gyi rtse la rdo yi char ba rtil sked pa'i dkyil na mtshon cha'i bu yug 'tshubs: gdug rtsub mtshon dbal sdang ba'i dgra la phobs: hū: gdug pa'i rtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dang ldan: yar gyi rtse la seṅges ral pa bsig:mar gyi rtse la dpal gyi gtor thun 'phro: sked pa'i dkyil du lcags kyi ser ba 'khrug gdug rtsub mtshon dbal sdang ba'i dgra la phobs hū gdug pa'i rtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dang ldan: yar gyi rtse la g.yu 'byug nga ro sgrogs: mar gyi rtse la stag mos so sgra 'don sked pa'i dkyil na lha yi dmag dpung 'tshubs gdug rtsub mtshon dbal sdang ba'i dgra la phobs: hūṃ: gdug pa'i rtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dang ldan: yar gyi rtse la glog dang skar mda' 'khrugs: mar gyi rtse la the'u rang bla rkun 'gyed: sked pa'i dkyil du rgyal po'i dmag dpung 'khrug: gdug rtsub mtshon dbal sdang ba'i dgra la phobs: hā gdug pa'i rtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dang ldan: yar gyi rtse la dpa' bos mtshon cha gdengs mar gyi

badz+ra: : la dpa' mos glu dbyangs sgrogs: sked pa'i dkyil du gnod sbyin las la nyul: gdug rtsub mtshon dbal sdang ba'i dgra la phobs: hū spyo gdug pa'i rtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dang ldan: yar gyi rtse la me khyung dmar po 'phro: mar gyi rtse la gser gyi sbal ba rgyu: sked pa'i dkyil du spu gri 'bar ba 'tshubs: gdug rtsub mtshon dbalasdang ba'i dgra la phobs: nyu: gdug pa'i rtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dang ldan: yar gyi rtse la mtshan rgyu'i bya ma rta: mar gyi rtse la zangs kyi 'phar ba 'kheng: sked pa'i dkyil na ram gyibu yug 'jubs: gdug rtsub mtshon dbal sdang ba'i dgra la phobs: hūṃ: gdug palirtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dang ldan: yar gyi rtse mor sha zas ha ha rgod mar gyi rtse la lce spyang rol 'jul: sked pa'i dkyil du rdo rje thog ser 'phro: gdug rtsub mtshon dbal sdang ba'i dgra la phobs: (: gdug palirtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dang ldan: yar gyi rtse la zhing skyongarlung ltar 'phyo: mar gyi rtse la phyogs skyong gdug rtsub ston sked pa'i dkyil na ma tshogs dga' ston 'gyed: gdug rtsub mtshon dbal sdang ba'i dgra la phobs: /: gdug pa'i

rtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dang ldan:yar gyi rtse la mtshon cha'i tshang khang 'khrug mar gyi rtse la dur khrod bsha' gzhi 'gyed:sked pa'i dkyil du rdo rje'i pho nya rgyu:gdug rtsub mtshon dbal sdang ba'i dgra la phobs:hūṃ:gdug pa'i rtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dang ldan:yar gyi rtse la sha ba ru 'dzangs byed mar gyi rtse la sdom nag tshang khang 'khrug:sked pa'i dkyil na rak+ta'i rba klong g.yo gdug rtsub mtshon dbal sdang ba'i dgra la phobs:hū:gdug pa'i rtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dang ldan:yar gyi rtse la sgrol byed ging dkar rgyu:mar gyi rtse la gzigs mos dpa' rngams ston:sked pa'i dkyil na las kyi pho nya 'tshubs:gdug rtsub mtshon dbal sdang ba'i dgra la phobs:hūṃ:bh+yo:gdug pa'i rtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dang ldan:yar byi rtse la g.yu yi nai tso lding:mar gyi rtse la lcags kyi bung ba rgyu:sked pa'i dkyil du ma bdun sngags ston byed:gdug rtsub mtshon dbal sdang ba'i dgra la phobs:hū:gdug pa'i rtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dang ldan:yar gyi rtse la rma bya'i gshog gur phub:mar gyi rtse la dug sbrul gdug pa rgyu:sked pa'i dkyil du 'dzin byed pho nya 'jubs:gdug

bsnye: rtsub mtshon dbal sdang ba'i dgra la phobs:hū:gdug pa'i rtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dang ldan: yar gyi rtse la go bos gshog 'dzing byed: mar gyi rtse la 'dre srin gdug pa rgyu: sked pa'i dkyil du ging rus cho sgra 'ur: gdug rtsub mtshon dbal sdang ba'i dgra la phobs:lha:gdug pa'i rtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dang ldan: yar gyi rtse mor dpal gyi kha ṭ+wāṃ gzir: mar gyi rtse la mda' mdung spu gri g.yo: sked pa'i dkyil du gnas ma glog ltar rgyu: gdug rtsub mtshon dbal sdang ba'i dgra la phobs:/:gdug pa'i rtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dang ldan: yar gyi rtse la lcags kyi te mo rgyu: mar gyi rtse la srin byas 'jol thabs byed: sked pa'i dkyil du yul ma rlung ltar 'phyo: gdug rtsub mtshon dbal sdang ba'i dgra la phobs:྅:gdug pa'i rtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dang ldan: yar gyi rtse la lcags kyi dom bu 'gros: mar gyi rtse la zangs kyi dred mong 'thab: sked pa'i dkyil du spor ma las la rgyu: gdug rtsub mtshon dbal sdang ba'i dgra la phobs:hūṃ:gdug pa'i rtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dang ldan: yar gyi rtse la lcags kyi drwa ba bkram: mar gyi

rtse la re lde nag po bkod: sked pa'i dkyil du bla rkun pho mo 'tshubs: gdug rtsub mtshon dbal sdang ba'i dgra la phobs: hū bh+yo drag po gdug pa'i rtsang phur nyi shu brgyad: dug khug dur sol nag po'i rdzas kyis byug: mi srun du tra nag po'i rgyu mas 'khyud: rtse mo bya tshogs mang po'i sha khrag brgyan: rtsa ba sha zan sna tshogs khrag gis byug: dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad bzhugs pa'i gnas: rtsang gi drwa ba mig mang ris su bkram: dam nyams dgra bgegs 'chor med bcug pa'i snod: bla rkun bung ba mang po ser ltar rgyu: bgegs 'thar sdig nag mgo dgu char ltar 'bebs: mngon spyod drag po'i las kyi mtshon chen po: sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod byed bgegs la bzor: tshe sgog bsod nams nus mthu ma lus pa me stag chu dang 'phrad bzhin rdul du rlog: ma tshogs dbang mo'i las kyi mtshon cha 'di: dkon mchog dbu 'phang rmad pa'i steng du bh+yo: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dgra yi snying la bh+yo: dge 'dun dkor la 'jab pa'i rkun mar bh+yo bslab pa'i slob bu dam log sgog la bh+yo: nyes med sems can mnar ba'i steng du bh+yo: sngags 'chang dge 'dun

ba:: yongs kyi dgra la bh+yo: zhing bcu tshang ba yongs kyi snying la bh+yo: thams cad ma lus bzlog bsgyur 'phrin las mdzod: aya sadu satsaminaḥnaḥkaḥpaḥraḥduyin taḥtriḥmā ra ya bh+yo bh+yo bacho ga bachosag: de ltar dbang mo' rtsang bzlog 'di byas pas nad gdon 'jags brgyad chos kyi dbyangs su zha tshe bsod dpal 'byor nyams rtogs mkha' ltar rgyas lha 'dre mi gsum srog la mnga'adabang thob dgra dang bgegs tshogs rtsad nas gcod pa ra 'gyur sa ma yu chagam rgyal ba'i dbang ma pad+ma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis thugs kyi yang bcud rdo rje snying po 'a skor grub pa 'i dbang phyug rgyal mchogakhyod la gtad da du ma spel rin chen brda la bstims mdo khams bkra shis rdzong der dgongs bra sdoms ma 'ongs snyags ma sum cu kha ral dus dpa' bo khyod nyid 'dus pa rtsal du bzhengs skyes bu de dang gdams pa 'di 'phradanas 'gro don 'phrin las byang gi phyogs su rgyas 'brel tshad don ldan pad+ma 'od du 'god bka' 'di srungs shig gnod sbyin btsan rgod rgyal dam nyams lag tu ma shor spu gri gsum thugs sras bu la sprod cig ging dmar nag bshad sgrub chos kyi gzhi chug dam tshags can sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya dbang mo' rtsang bzlog dgra bgegs 'thar byed rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpo na pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka'

bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda thim lha ces pa 'di'ang lung zin chos kyi bdag po sku skye pad+ma dga' ba'i rdo rjes bkra shis ya mtshan can gyi skyes du mar bcas te nan dan chen pos bskul ngor/ 7 kho bo rgyal mchog bzhad pa rtsal gyas mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i 'phrul brda las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa' yi ge pa ni chos bdag nyid kyis bgyis pa dge legasa'aphel/ sarba masgo le/

badz+ra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: dbang chen bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal gyi nang sgo dbye ba rdo rje'i tha tshig zhes bya ba bzhugs so:a: na 31 gu na pad+ma kwa ra ye: zugache rte/ོ bdud dpung zel gnon rtsal la gus phyag 'tshal dbang chen drag sgrub las kyi mthar phyin tshe na sgo dbye ba rdo rje'i tha tshig 'ad ran chen gser skyems mchod la 'di skad do dza: bde chen rdo rje rigs kyi phyag rgya mo: tshad med snying rje'i brda thabs lcags kyu yis shar phyogs dung sgo dkar po gsal bar byes: zhi ba lhun gyis grub pa'i dngos grub stsol: ha: badz+ra pra we sha ya phaṭa: 〉: 'dod 'byung rin chen rigs kyi phyag rgya mos: tshad med byams pa'i brda thabs zhags pa yis: lho phyogs gser sgo ser po sa ler phyes: rgyas pa lhun gyis grub pa'i dngos grub stsol: ri rat+na pra we sha ya phaṭa be: chags med pad+ma rigs kyi phyag rgya mos: tshad med dga' ba'i brda thabs lcags sgrog gis: nub phyogs zangs sgo dmar po lam mer phyes: dbang chen lcan gyis grub pa'i dngos grub stsol: ni pad+ma pra we sha ya phaṭa: ho: bde sprin garma rigs kyi phyag rgya mos: chad

med btang snyoms brda thabs dril bu yis byang phyogs lcags sgo sngon po khrol gyis phyes: mngon spyod lhun gyis grub pa'i dngos grub stsol: sa: karma pra we sha ya phaṭa: ho: ye shes las mdzadapho nya khyed rnams kyis: dbang chen gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gnas spor zhu bde klong nam mkha'i dbyings su gsal bar bzhugs: drag po'i gtor chen las kyi mtshon char bsgyur: 'od zer gzi byin dngos grub bdag la stsol: badz+ra sa ma ya ho phud mchod dngos grub len chog bya ba dang phya yi sgo dbye zor bskul zor las byed des ni 'phrin las rab 'byams stun gyis grub drag po mngon spyod las kyi dgra dpung rlog sa ma pā e ma rgyal dbang pad+ma'igasang mdzod thugs bcud skor grub ba'i dbang byug rgyal mchog dbyangs la gtad da lta ma spel rin chen brda la bstams mdo bams bkra shis rdzong der dgongs pra sdoms ma 'ongs bstan 'gro rgud pas mnar ba'i tshe dbang chen bka' babanus ldan rdo rje da 'phrad nas bstan pa ran chen 'dzan skyongs spel 'brel tshad bde chen pad+ma 'od du 'god bka' gsang thub par srungs shig btsan rgod rgyal dam nyams lag tu ma shor sa ma mā las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya nang rgo dbye ba rdo rje'i tha tshag rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya

gas/: gas rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma sa bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa 'o brda thim snyi zhes pa 'di yang lung zin pad+ma dga' ba'i rdo rjes bkra shis dge ba'i skyes da bcas te yang yang bskul ro ra/ kho bo 'dzam gli dbang rgyan rtsal gyas bde sto mchog gi tshogs ston spros skabs mkha' 'gro gas ba'i 'phrul brda las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni chos bdag nyad kyis bgyis ba maṅga 'di/

badz+ra: zab gsang rdo rje snying po las gyi yi sgo dbye rdo rje'i tha tshig dang zor bskul las kyi mtshon cha ngar ma bzhugs so:rmi: na re gu ru pad+ma shrī he ru ka ya: za smyokejam gser snyemasamachad rtseng bden pa brdar he ru'i dam tshag la gnas pas:hū bh+yo shar phyoges rdo rjemi phyag brtan pho nya mo dbang phyug kun gyi sring mo 'dzum bzang ma: phyag na shel gyi mchod rten nyi ltar gsal: rin chen dung gi lde'u mig phyag na bsnams shar phyogs rdo rje can la sogs pa yi: dri zagrul bum yongs kyi spyi rje bo: kun gyi pho nya dam tshig 'dzin mdzad la: bdud rtsi phud kyi mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes: nad gdon 'jigs brgyad zhi ba'i 'brin las mdzod:nad sgo gdan sgo rims sgo yams sgo chod: zor sgo mtshon cha sna tshogs sgo phyes la: dgra bgegs gnod byed thams cad rdul du rlog:hū min chen migs kyi phyag rgya pho nya mo: gshinarje kun gyi sri mo zhal bzang ma phyag na gser gyi mdung ring 'bar ba 'dzin: rin chen gser gyi lnge'u mig phyag na bstsams: lco phyogs gshin rje'i rgyal po la sogs pa'i

las gshin king king yongs kyi pho nya ba: gtso 'khor sprul pa dpung dang bcas rnams kyis: bdud rtsi phud kyi mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes: tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod: nad sgo gdon sgo rims sgo yams sgo chod:zor sgo mtshon cha sna tshogs sgo phyes la dgra bgegs gnod byed thams cad rdul du rlog:sno pad+ma rigs kyi phyag brnyan pho nya mo:chu bdag kun gyi sring mo gtum 'bar ma phyag na rin chen sna lnga'i me long dang:'od 'bar byu ru'i lde'u mig phyag na bsnams:nub phyogs chu bdag rgyal po la sogs pa'i: klu dbang pho mo kun gyi pho nya ba: rdzu 'phrul stobs ldan rlung gi shugs can rnams bdud rtsi phud kyi mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes: khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i 'phrin las mdzod: nad sgo gdon sgo rims sgo yams sgo chod:zor sgo mtshon cha sna tshogs sgo phyes la: dgra bgegs gnod byed thams cad rdul du rlog: sna las rab rigs kyi phyag brnyan pho nya mo: gnod sprin kun gyi sring mo mche gtsigs ma: phyag na g.yu yi rdo rje 'od 'bar dang: rin chen lcags kyi lde'u mig phyag na bsnams: byang phyogs gnod sbyin rgyal

badz+ra: po la sogs pa'i nor skyong pho mo gnod sbyin dregs pa'i tshogs rdzu 'phrul zogs med nus pa'i stobs bskyed la:bdud rtsi phud kyi mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes dgra bgegs rdul du brlag pa'i 'phrin las mdzod:nad sgo gdon sgo rims sgo yams sgo chod:zor sgo mtshon cha sna tshogs sgo phyes la:dgra bgegs gnod byed thamasacad rdul du rlog:dza:dam chig ldan pa'i phyag brnyan khyed cag gis gsang sngags sgrub pa'i grogs su zhal bzhes bzhin:sbyor sgrol mngon spyod las la mthu ma g.yel tshar gcod rdul brlag nus mthu stobs ma zhan:brngan pa'i dpa' skyems gtor ma 'di bzhes la:bdag gi bsam pa'i don rnams 'grub par mdzod:bka' dang tha tshig ma g.yel sa ma yā zhes brjod gtor skyems gtsa sar gshegs mngon spyod 'phrin las lhun gyis grub bar chad bdud kyi g.yul las rgyal bsam don lhun gyis grub par 'gyur sa ma yu de nas zor bskul bya ba ni hūṃ bye zla gam dbang chen rol ba'i e klong nas:pad+ma drag po dmar nag 'bar ba'i gar:mngon spyod drag po'i las la rab bzhengs te:gdug pa'i mtshon rnon dgra la brdar bzhin du:

rngams pa'i nga ro sod rgyob sgra sgogs bzhin: nyams pa'i dgra yi sgog gi gshed du bzhengs: lus la sna tshogs mtshon cha'i char phob la: ming tsam med par thal ba rdul du rlog thugs dam dus la bab po sa ma yā: mngon spyod las la ma g.yel dam tshig can: sa pad+ma kro ta tsarnya sarba dus ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha e hur thum dza rbad bh+yo: dpalachen dbang ga lhatshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar gzu dpang shan 'byed kyi tshul du bzhugs shing gtor ma las kyi mtshon char bsgyur ba ni hū bye dpal je gtor chen me dud bu yug 'tshubs rak+ta'i rba rlabs khrag nad khol ma'aphyo: mtshe mda' drag po las kyi mtshon cha rtsub: yungs dkar drag po dgra bgegs 'thar byed 'phro: rdo yi thun zor rbab rgod ltar du 'dril: dug gi rkyal ba dgra la thog ltara'abebs: dpal gyi spu gri rno ba'i ngar dang ldan: gnam lcags rdo rje sdig pa'i mtshon char 'phro: gang la phog tshad phye mar brlag pa'i mtshon: dgra la rbad do nus mthu ma g.yelacig: bgegs la rbad do stobs rtsal ma zhan cig: dkon mchog gsum gyi bden mthu ma chung zhig: dbang chen he ru'i thugs dam ma g.yel cig: bden gnyis bslu med

badz+ra: 'bras bu chud ma gsan: ma g.yel ma 'khyangs badz+ra sa ma yā 3 hū trig khro bh+yo: ma ṇi ma ra ṇa bh+yo: ma ra du na bh+yo: rasmo raka bh+yo: ting ya rak+ka bh+yo: shrī kā la du pa bh+yo: gnod byed pho mo'i tshe sgog la rbad sod bh+yo rbad ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa: dmod pa bor cing thal mo sdeb gtor ma dgra bo'i phyogs su rdeb dgra dpung pha lam yin kya 'jig bgegs dpung rdo rje yan kyang 'thar rno nus byin rlabs bsam mtha' yas bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsal sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya e ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha was ma 'o sa 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis dbang chen sgrub skor mngon spyod las mtha' bcas grub pa'i dbang phyug rgyal mchog khyod la gtad da dung ma spel rin chen brta la bstems mdo khams bkra shas rdzong der dgongs pra sdoms ma 'ongs snyigs mar nad mtshon gzeng lang tshe dpa' bo khyod nyid 'dus pa rtsal du bzhengs skyes bu de da gdams pa 'ad 'phrad nas bstan pa'i 'gro don byang gi phyogs su 'byung 'brel tshad don ldan pa d+ma 'od du 'god bka' 'di srungs shig gnod sbyin btsan rgod rgyal sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gtor bzlog drag po'i rgo dbye dang gtor ma zor bskul gya rim pa rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda thim lha ces

pa 'di'ang lung zin sku skyes pad+ma dga' ba'i rdo rjes bkra shisadage mtshan gyi skyes du mar bcas te nan dan chen posabaskul ngor/ kho po dbang chen bzhad pa rtsal gyisamakha' 'gro gsang ba'i 'phrul brda lasadag par phab pa'i yi ge pa nichos bdag nyid kyis bgyis pa dge legabasa'aphel/ sarba maṅga la/
'a( cha zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: dbang chen bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal gyi phyi sgrub dpal gyi bum bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

bsgo/: na mo gu dza 41 pad+ma kro dha ya: the rgya gro sgodza/ mi bzad gar dgu 'byugs pa'i he ru ka dbang chen chags pa 'i dpal gyas dregs tshogs 'thar khro chen ma tshogs 'dud pa'i bde chenagadung las kyi rdo rje mchog la phyag 'tshal lo dbang chen pad+ma gsu gi rdo rje yi bsnyen sgrub lhur len rag 'dzin spyod 'dod pas dben pa'i gnas su phyi na dam rgya bsdams dang po lta ba'i mtshams gcod bya ba ni hū hūṃ hū snang srid ye dag chos sku'i dkyil 'khor la: nga bdag mtshan 'dzin spros pa ka nas dag: bar du gcod bya gcod byed dmigs su med: rang byung lhun grub klong chen 'gyur ba med: hū hūṃ 'on kyang kun btags 'khrul ba'i gnyis 'dzin gdon: ma rtog log par 'khrul ba'i 'byung po la: tshogs drug rang grol 'dod lnga'i dga' ston ster: dga' mgu'i tshul spyod rang rang gnas su dengs hū hū badz+ra phaṭa: gnyis pa gzhom med srung ba'i rwa gur ni hū hrīḥ nga ni dbang chen pad+ma gsung gi lha: steng 'og phyogs mtshams ye shes lngayi gur: las mdzad pho nya sdig phag tshang khang 'khrugs: gnyis su snang ba'i 'byung po mtshams chod cig dzā na dhartu rak+ṣa rak+ta sbyo: gsum pa dbang byan gnad nas dbab pa ni hrī hrī0 dza

badz+ra: dbus mtha' bral ba bde chen dbang gi dal: chags sogs rdul skyon 'byung po zil gnon pa'i: dregs pa'i sgog bdag dbang chen he ru ga: rdo rje khro chen ma mo'i tshogs dang bcas che ba'i stobs bskyed gar dgu'i mdangs ngom la gnas 'dir byon la rig pa'i byin phob cig ye shes rnam pa lnga yi dbang bskur stsol: thugs dam ma g.yel dus bab sa ma yā: khyed pad+ma kro ta ṭī sh+ya hoḥ sa ma ya dza: sa ma ya s+t+waṃ:hrīX dbang chen pad+ma bde chen rdo rje yi: chags pa'i bzhad klus srid pa ru bzlog nas: pad+ma krota'i gsang gsum 'gyur med klong: rtog 11la ye mnyam datre ngas pa'i byin dbob cig: pad+ma 〈sna ta a we sha ya a a: bzhi pa ro mnyam chen por brlab pa mi bla( ā hūṃ: tshogs yul gsal sgor shar ba'i chos so cog: rig pa ye shes chen po'i byin brlabs te: gang shar rang grol bde stong dga' bzhi'i sprin: mi zad nam mkha' mdzod du rnam par spel oṃ ā hūṃ sarba pañtsa a pra ta hūm̐ trīḥbra: snyen āḥhūṃ ma hā rak+ta marnyal hūm̐ hrīX'i: ces ā hūṃ ma ha ba lirnyi hūm̐ trīḥtha: snye ā hūṃ ma hā bho dhi tsat+ta sta na gha na sarba phyu dza sa ma ya āḥhūṃ: lnga pa ting 'dzan

gsum gyi khog phub ni ma:chos sku'i dgongs pas 'chi ba dbyings su sbyangs:longs sku'i gzigs pas bar do 'od skur spyor sprul sku'i mdzad pas skye ba 'gro don spyod:don gnyis lhun grub gzhan phan 'gag pa med:tse( ā ཿbadz+ra sa ma dhī hūṃ:drug pa ga yas khang dang lha bskyed ni trīX dbang chen yum lnga'i mkha' 1nga yangs pa dzasgyurnam rtog skyon bral dur khrod brgyad ldan dbus:rab brjed thod mkhar me rlung 'tshubs ma'i klong:gza' klu sde brgyad spyi chings bsnol ba'i khar rig pa'i ngo bo /:dmar yongs gyur ba'i:rgyal kun gsung gi rdo rje rta mgrin rgyal dmar nag bzod par dka' ba'i gza mdangs 'bar:zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi gyad thabs bsgrad:gar dgu'i nyams rdzogs sdang mig glog ltar 'khyug:g.yas mthing g.yon dkar zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs:smra smin me 'bar dbu skra dmar ser 'khyil:gtsug rgyan rta zhal ljang sngon bzhad glu 'don thod skam dbu brgyan dar sna'i cod pan mdzes:nyi zla'i snyan cha rus pa'i rgyan drug dang:dur khrod dpal chas dpa' ba'i rtags su bgo:g.yas g.yon dang pos ral spri thod dbyug

pa(: gdengs: bar bas thod rnga sbrul gyi zhags pa bsdam: tha ma gnyis kyis gri gug thod khrag 'dzin: dgyes bskyed rdo rje phag mo 'khril sbyor rol: mazing gsal rgyan drug me ma nga dril g.yer mdzes: gri gug mgul 'khyud bhan dmar yab la stobs: zhabs g.yas brkyang bas ma tshogs zil gyis gnon: gasku na pa yab btud bde stong mchod sprin stobs: ye shes me lnga rab tu 'bar zhing 'phyo: rigs bdag gsung mchog rak+ka thod 'phreng rtsal: smug nag rdo rje thod pa bsnol thabs 'dzin: zhi ma khro 'dzum chags bde gzi byin 'bar: rus pa'i rgyan drug dar dpyangs mdzes pa ra spras: he ru ka pa'i rnam 'gyur ma 'dres rdzogs: gzhan snang zil gnon rdo rje rgyal por shar phyi rim gnam lcags 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad steng: pad nyi bdud bzhi bsnol ba'i khri yi khar: shar duyang dag rdo rje bhan dmar 'dzin: lho ru 'jam dpal ral gri po ti bsnams: nubatu che mchog gri thod bsnol thabs 'dzin: bya du rdo rje gzhon nu lcags phur 'dril: shar lho bla med pad+ma bhan+ta 'dzin: lho nub rig 'dzin rdo rje dril bu bsnams nub byangadregs

pa thod zor bhan+ta 'dzin:byang shar stobs ldan spu gri tsit+ta bsnams kun kyang mthibhe ser smug ljang 'bar ba'i sku:ma mo mthing ga rig 'dzin dkar dmar zhal:dregs pa mthing nag stobs ldan nag por shar: rang rang las byed sprul pa g.yog dang bcas: ma 'dres nyi rdul 'khrigs bzhin lam mer gsal de yi phyi rim 'khor lo rtsabs bcu la:dregs pa zil gnon dbang chen khro rgyal bcu: kun kyaja mthing nag 'bar ba chen po'i sku: g.yas g.yon thod dbyug phur pa gdengs thabs 'dzin dur khrod chas brgyan ye shes me klong 'gying dregs pa phyogs skyong pho mo zil gyas gnon: de yi phyi rim sgo bzhi bsrung mdzad pa'i khro rgyal pradzña ya lan pad+ma big lcags zhags sgog dril las kyi phyag rgyar bsgyur: tshad med rnam bzhis gdul bya ma lus skyongs: gzhan yang tshom bu dgu yi bka' sdod pa: pho nya dam can las mdzad bu yug 'tshubs kun gyi gnas gsum rdo rje'i sa bon dang: thugs sgog 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu yis: rang bzhin gnas nas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa: spyan drangs dbyer med chu la chu bzhag bzhin: du ma ro gcig bde ba chen

bsgo/ por bsre: spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal mchod bstod rnams las bya ltar ro ga 'os bzhin du bya bdun pa 'dzab kyi 'khrul 'khor bsgyur ba ni rang nyid dbang chen he ru garagasal ba'i: thugs gar pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i ze'u 'brur rā ga'i rdo rje nas 'bru cam gyi lte bar nyi zla'i ga'u kha sbyor ba'i dbus su rig pa'i ngo bo/ dmaragasal spus bris pa tsam gyi khongs sengs su dwangs ma'i sgogahrī dmar po'i mtshan par gsal gdab de yi mtha' bskor du gsang sngags snying po mgal me'i bshesar ma ltaragayas su dmar kyi li li 'khor ba'i 'od zer gyis 'phags pa mchod: sems can gyi don byas dregs pa can thams cad tshar bcad bde stong mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i rtogs pa'abar bar dmigs la: hrīmad+ma ta kṛta h+ya shrī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: 'gyur med ti 'dzin dgos sa pa skyongs spro bsdus 'od zer gar chen bsgyuraḥ dngos grub mchog gi dam pa na 'bru 'bum bzlas pas 'byungabar 'gyur khrus dang go bgos bra ṭu lod 'di dag rtags kyi da pa'o re dogs med pa ra ro snyoms skyongs sa ra rwa rang nyid kyi thugs ga'i sngags 'phreng 'khor ba las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros

steng lha khams thams cad dbang du bsdus: bar dregs pa can thams cad dam la btags 'og sa bdag klu gnyan gtod rigs thams cad 'bangs su bkol: mdor na 'khor 'das kyi spyi dpal chen por gyur bar bsam la mobadz+ra spo ta rā dza shrī pad+ma ta kṛta rgya shrī wa ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ phaṭa: skye med dgo sa pa 'gyur med skyo sa mi nub ye shes gar za bsgyur thun min don gya dngos grub ni bye ba bzla bas 'grub par 'gyur phyag mtshan rnyed da mkha' la 'phur khrom chen dbang bskur bar gyi rtags de yang rtsis gdab bral bar skyo sa sa ma yu yang rang nyid rkyi thugs ga'i sngags 'phreng las 'od zer 'phros pas pha rol ban bon gyis byad gtad: sa bdag klu gnyan gyi cho 'phrul 'jig rten mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad kyis byas pa'i dmod sbyor ngan gtong mtshon 'debs rtsis khram brgyur ba sogs 'bar ba'i zer gyis tshar bcad: rdul phran du gtor ngan gtong 'byung po dgra bgegs thams cad kyi lus srog gi da ngos po so sor phyes te rnam shes 'og min du spar 'pho brgyur ba'i gdug tshogs ming gi lhag mar gyur bar bsam la: moh+ya gra wa hūṃ phaṭa: pra sod chu sod: durta sod: dur

'amatshu mi sod: gnyan mgo la chod: kha la dza: ji tha ra ti sa durnye dz+wa la re pa ye swā hā: tshal chal trig trig: shag shag: phyer phyer hi ga ya gling bzlog: hi bam ghabha ya gling bacho ga: bdag dang bsrung bya'i lus ngag yid gsum phyes phyes 11la khrol swā hā: gdug pa kun 'joms gzer tig 'di ltas na rbod gtong cho 'phrul sogs gang gi daro sa gnyen dam pa ste da po smra bcad 'bum phrag bgra sa rgyun du nyin bzhin brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pas mi de bar chad dang byad phur sbod gto g.yul las rgyal rgyal bsen dam sri'i rkyen las grol tshe bsri sa da pal 'bar nyams rtogs rgyas bdud bzhi' cho 'phrul rang sar yal dregs pa 'a srog phul dam khas len 'bag seng glang dmar byi la bcom lha khang mchod rten 'go las thon gzhan gyi lce la phur ba 'debs de ni tha ma'i rtags mtshan re rkyen snang kun lasagrol bar dbyur ze tshom med do sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya de nas klu yi gdon grol bya ba ni sregs khar klu gzugs sna tshogs bkram pa 'i mthar shi rtsi sna tshogs bal tshon brgyan bcas bkod steng gi lde nga khrir 'o chab klu sman bcas 'bras bu can gyi shing gi /ba rgyan 'dzug de nyid byin brlabs bsgrub pa 'i rim pa ni hū bisnan ta kṛta phaṭa: stong pa'i ngang las rin po che sna lnga'i bum pa rgya khyon yangs pa'i dbus su poḥlas 'o chab

bdud rtsi'i rnam par 'khyil ba'i dbus su pad+ma'i sdong po yan lag lo 'dab rab tu rgyas pa'i ze'u 'bru'i khar: zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba'i steng du bcom ldan 'das klu dbang gi rgyal po sku mdog dkar gsal mgrin pa yan chad mthing ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'dzum bzhad kyi nyams dang ldan pa: klu rnams ngan song las 'don phyir stong nyid mnyam sbyor gyi phyag rgya thugs shar gtad pa: zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs shing chos gos rnam gsum mdzes par klubs pa: sku las 'od dang 'od zer mu med par 'phro ba zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun char ltar bab pas: klu rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la bde ba sbyin cing ngan song las sgol ba'i skyabs chen po sbyin par mos la na mo bha ga wa te nā ga shwa ra rā dza ya nā ga sarba durga te sarba pā paṃ shirnye ku ru ye swā hā: brgya stong ga skabs brjod pa 'i mjug oṃ āḥs lha nyid 'od du zhu nas zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du 'khyil bar bsam: de nas khrung ser sran bya' rigs byed kyi sgro gzhob chu dang sbyar ba byin brlabs na 31 nā ga du na tsarnye tsarnye mi li mi li sarba bi ṣa tā ra phaṭa: brgya rtsa la sogs ga skabs

badz+ra: brjod pa ra bya oṃ nā ga ra tsa mal mal 'gul 'gul tsag tsag gtub gtub khrol khrol bsrung bya sa bdag klu gnyan gyis bzung ba thong bcing pa khrol phyes phyes swā hā: brgya rtsa brjod bzhin rdzas la phu gdab po dang po klu yi mkhon 'khrugs sbyang ba ni a ka ro yis shel tshig la sogs brlabs klu gzugs rnams la mgu ba'i rdzas su bkram snyed ār+ya man ki shwa ra ya: nga nai 41nga nyid snying rje'i dbang phyug sku: 'gro 'dul spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i gter: ma brtsal ye rdzogs don dam mnyam nyid zhal: ye shes gzigs pa nub med kun tu gsal: khyed cag byol song gdug pa klu yi rigs: 'byung ba lnga yi khams la ma brten med: 'gres na mi 'dod gdug rtsub sna tshogs 'byung: 'dum na bkra shis legs pa'i snang ba 'phel: de phyir rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas kyis: sa gnyan bskos dang brag gnyan gtor ba dang: shing gnyan bcad dang ge'u seng pad chal bshig: chu gnyan bcus dang sbra khang gshags bshus gshigs: khyod dang 'gal ba'i las ka gang byas nongs: bdud : 'o chab mchod nas bskang zhing gso: klu sman sna tshogs phul bas bska

zhing gso: 'dod rdzas yo byad bkram la bskang zhing gso: sngon chad 'gres pa yod na ko long bsdom: phyin chad gnas mgron lta bu'i dam tshig srungs: bdag gis bden tshig bka' bsgo dam bzhag bzhin: kun kyang ma 'da' badz+ra sa ma yā: sa bha ra'i sngagasaci mang da bsgrags la klu sman 'o chab 'dod rdzas sna tshogs 'bul lo skabs su de bzhin gshegasapa bzhi'i mtshan brjod bzhin gong ltar yang bzlos bya klu dgyes pa'i phyag rgya bcas te ces hu sdo/ hu sdo ma hā hu sdo/ khrum phu swā hā: lan bdun brjod la me tog sna tshogs 'bul de nas gdon grol khrusabyab bsrung gsum las da po khrus kyi sgo nas sbyang ba ni hū hrī rang bzhin gsal ba'i bum pa rdul bral dbus: stobs chen 'dus pa nā ga klu 'dul gyi: sku gsung thugs bcud 'dus pa'i chu rgyun kyis: khyod kyi sgo gsum nad gdon sdig sgrib bkru: yo nā ga du na tsarnye tsarnye mi li mi li sarba bi ṣa tā ra phaṭa klu rje rigs kyis spyor ba ngan pa phyung phyung phyes phyes khrol khrol swā hā: o nā ga du na tsadhe tsadhe mi li mi li sarba bi ṣa tā ra phaṭa: glu rgyal rigs kyis spror ba ngan pa phyung phyung phyes phyes khrol khrol swā hwa: yo na ga du na tsarnye tsar+bhe mi li mi li sarba bi ṣa tā ra phaṭa klu dmang rigs kyis

ba:tshu sbyor ba na pa phyung phyung phyes phyes khrol khrol swā hā sa nā ga du na tsarnye tsarnye mi li mi li sarba bi ṣa tā ra phaṭa: klu bram ze'u rigs kyis sbyor ba ngan pa phyung phyung phyes phyes khrol khrol swā hā yo nā ga du na cadhe tsadhe mi li mi li sarba bi ṣa tā ra phaṭa: klu gdol ba nag po'i rigs kyis sbyor ba ngan pa phyung phyung phyes phyes khrol khrol swā hā: sa nā ga du na tsadhe carnye ma la mi li sarba bi ṣa tā ra phaṭa: klu dga' bo dang 'jog po'i rigs kyis sbyor ba ngan pa phyung phyung phyes phyes khrol khrol swā hā yo nā ga du na tsarnye tsarnye mi li mi li sarba bi ṣa tā ra phaṭa: klu mtha' yas dang stobs rgyus rigs kyis sbyor ba ngan pa phyung phyung phyes phyes khrol khrol swā hā ma(na ga du na tsarnye tsadhe mi li mi li sarba bi ṣa tā ra phaṭa: klu pad+ma dang pad+ma chen po'i rigs kyis sbyor ba ngan pa phyung phyung phyes phyes khrol khrol swā hā: ཿ/ nā ga du na tsarnye tsadhe mi li mi li sarba bi ṣa tā ra phaṭa: klu rig ldan dang nor rgyas kyis spyor ba ngan pa byung byung byes phyes khrol khrol swā hā: sa nā ga du na tsan+de tsarnye mi la mi li sarba bi ṣa tā ra phaṭa: klu dmu long dang 'tshe bo'i rigs kyis spror ba ngan pa byung byung phyes

phyes khrol khrol swā hā: ma nā ga du na tsarnye tsarnye mi li mi li sarba bi ṣa tā ra phaṭa: klu gyong po dang 'gum pa can gyis sbyor ba ngan pa phyung phyung phyes phyes khrol khrol swā hā sa nā ga du na tsarnye tsarnye mi li mi li sarba bi ṣa tā ra phaṭa: klu srin rigs dang gnyad gtod rigs kyis sbyor ba ngan pa phyung phyung phyes byes khrol khrol swā hā: sa nā ga du na tsarnye tsarnye mi li mi li sarba bi ṣa tā ra phaṭa swā hā: klu sa bdag sna tshogs pa'i rigs can gyis sbyor ba ngan pa phyung phyung phyes phyes khrol khrol swā hā: 37 nā ga du na tsarnye tsarnye mi li mi li sarba bi ṣa tā ra phaṭa: stenga'og bar gsum gyi gdon rigs sna tshogs pas spyor ba ngan pa phyung phyung phyes phyes khrol khrol swā hā: etshon ga na sarba shirnyi ku ru ye swā hā: yeḥwa ya we sarba shirnyi ku ru ye swā hā ram̐tshigasne de wa sarba shidzña ku ru ye swā hā: leḥbhu mi pa ti sarba shidzña ku ru ye swā hā: bo pa ṇi de wa sarba shirnye ku ru ye swā hā: nad gdon sdig sgrib dug rigs thams cad 'byung ba lnga'i rang gnas su bsdus shig: gnyis pa rma bya'i mdongs kyis byabs pa ni hūṃ dhiḥ ma rig las byung bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad 'khrul ba las skyes stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs: gang yang

badz+ra chos nyid stong pa'i dag dbyings su: lha mo rma bya chen mos thabs kyis byabs: o sarba a pa na ya hūṃ swā hā: o nā ga du na tsarnye tsadhe mi li mi li sarba bi ṣa tā ra phaṭa:swā hā klu rgyal rigs kyis sbyor ba ngan pa thams cad sarba a pa nā ye swā hā: 31 nā ga du na tsarnye tsarnye mi li mi li sarba bi ṣa tā ra phaṭa: klu rje rigs kyis sbyor ba ngan pa thams cad a pa nā ye swā hā: ma nā ga du na tsarnye tsarnye mi li mi li sarba bi ṣa tā ra phaṭa: klu dmangs rigs kyis sbyor ba ngan pa o nā ga du na tsadhe tsarnye mi li mi li sarba bi ṣa tā ra phaṭa:klu bram ze rigs kyis sbyor ba ngan pa oṃ nā ga du na tsarnye tsadhe mi li mi li sarba bi ṣa tā ra phaṭa: klu gdol ba nag pos sbyor ba ngan pa oṃ nā ga du na tsarnye tsadhe mi li mi li sarba bi ṣa tā ra phaṭa: klu dga' bo dang 'jog po'i rigs kyis sbyor ba ngan pa thams cad sarba a pa nā ye swā hā: o nā ga du na tsarnye tsarnye mi li mi li sarba bi ṣa tā ra phaṭa swā hā: klu mtha' yas dang stobs rgyu'i rigs kyis spror ba ngan pa oṃ nā ga du na tsan+de tsarnye mi li mi li sarba bi ṣa tā ra phaṭa: klu pad+ma dang pad+ma chen po'i rigs kyis spyor ba ngan pa oṃ nā ga du na

tsarnye tsarnye mi li mi li sarba bi ṣa tā ra phaṭa: klu nor rgyas dang rigs ldan gyis sbyor ba ngan pa marwa gdu na tsasnye tsadhe mi li mi li sarba bi ṣa tā ra phaṭa: klu dmu long dang mche bos sbyor ba ngan pa man ga du na tsadhe tsadhe mi li mi li sarba bi ṣa tā ra phaṭa: klu gyong po dang 'gum pa can gyis sbyor ba ngan pa oṃtsang du na tsadhe tsarnye mi li mi li sarba bi ṣa tā ra phaṭa klu srin rigs dang gnyan gtod rigs kyis spyor ba ngan pa skonag dun tsarnye tsarnye mi li mi li sarba bi ṣa tā ra phaṭa: klu sa bdag sna tshogs pa'i rigs can gyis spyor ba ngan pa marwa ga dun tsadhe tsarnye mi li mi li sarba bi ṣa tā ra phaṭa steng 'og bar gsum gyi gdon rigs sna tshogs pas sbyor ba ngan pa thams cad sarba a pa nā ye swā hā: yetshon ga na sarba a pa nā ye swā hā yesam ya we sarba a pa nā ye swā hā: ram̐ḥ.asne de wa sarba a pa nā ye swā hā: be pa ṇi de wa sarba a pa nā ye swā hā: leḥbhu mi pa ti sarba a pa nā ye swā hā nad gdon sdig sgrib dug rigs thams cad 'byung ba lnga yi dbyings su byab po: de nas klu rnams rang gnas bsdu ba ni ye: rang ba nasnam dag 'byung lnga'i mkha' klog nas: sgyu 'phrul rten 'byung

badz+ra: legs nyes ston pa'i klu: bar du bde legs spel phyir mchod cing bskangs: tha ma rang gnas yum lnga'i mkha' ru rlu zhes klu dkar phyogs skyong ba rnams rang gnas 'byu ba'i dbyings su bsdu mi srun pa'i rigs can rnams la phag tshul dang glang dmar gyi rwa gzhob gla rtsa 'dre 'jags pa rnams me la bsregs nas dud pa btang nad pa'am bsrung bya la bdug yungs dkar gyi thun brab ste hūṃ /sang ni ye nas ma bcos ngang gis khros: ma rtog gnyis 'dzin 'byung po'i gshed du shar: yas kyis mi tshim bka' la 'khu ba rnams: stobs chen rdo rje mtshon chas gzhom ta re: o pad+ma kro ta nā ga ra tsa mal mal 'gul 'gul tsag tsag gtubs gtubs khrol khrol chom chom sarba bi ṣa tā ra phaṭa swā hā: / bzhi'i sngags brjod thun gyis brab la klu gdon dbye bsal bya'o gsum pa srung ba'i go cha bgo ba ni hūṃ trīḥ ma rig las byung nad gdon grib rigs kun: dang po sbyang zhing bar du dbyings su dbye: tha ma gzhom med rdo rje'i go bgos pas: ma rtog log 'a la 'byang po mtshams chod cig: badz+ra ma ma du na tsakra tri spyo: o na ga du na tsache tsarje mi li mi li sarba bi ṣa ta ra phaṭa swa hwa: tsho rgyal rigs kyi sbor ba ngan pa las rak+ṣa raku:

oṃ nā ga du na tsarnye tsadhe mi li mi li sarba bi ṣa tā ra phaṭa: klu rje rigs kyis sbyor ba ngan pa las rak+ṣa rasnya: slo nā ga du na tsarnye tsadhe mi li mi li sarba bi ṣa tā ra phaṭa: klu dmang rigasakyis sbyor ba ngan pa las rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: o nā ga du na tsadhe tsadhe mi li mi li sarba bi ṣa tā ra phaṭa: klu bram ze rigs kyis sbyor ba ngan pa las rak+ta rak+ta: o nā ga du na tsarnye tsarnye mi li mi li sarba bi ṣa tā ra phaṭa klu gdol ba nag po'i rigs kyis sbyor ba ngan pa las rak+ta rak+ta: cha nā ga du na tsadhe tsadhe mi li mi li sarba bi ṣa tā ra phaṭa: klu dga' bo dang 'jog po'i rigs kyis sbyor ba ngan pa las rak+ta rak+ta: ma nā ga du na tsarnye tsarnye mi li mi li sarba bi ṣa tā ra phaṭa: klu mtha' yas dang stobs rgyu'i rigs kyis sbyor ba ngan pa las rak+ta rak+ṣa: o nā ga du na tsadhe tsarnye mi li mi li sarba bi ṣa tā ra phaṭa swā hā: klu pad+ma dang pad+ma chen po'i rigs kyis spyor ba ngan pa oṃ nā ga du na tsaste tsadhe mi li mi li sarba bi ṣa tā ra phaṭa: klu nor rgyas dang rigs ldan gyis spror ba ngan pa oṃ nā ga du na tsarnye tsarnye mi li mi li sarba bi ṣa tā ra phaṭa: klu dmu long dang mche bos sbyor ba ngan pa oṃ nā ga du na tsarnye tsarnye mi li mi li

badz+ra: sarba bi ṣa tā ra phaṭa: klu gyong po dang 'gum pa can gyis sbyor ba ngan pa oṃ nā ga du na tsadhe tsadhe mi li mi li sarba bi ṣa tā ra phaṭa: klu srin rigs dang gnyan gtod rigs kyis sbyor ba ngan pa 61 nā ga du na tsarnye tsarnye mi li mi li sarba bi ṣa tā ra phaṭa: klu sa bdag sna tshogs pa'i rigs can gyis sbyor ba ngan pa las rak+ṣa rak+ta: bla nā ga du na tsadhe tsarnye mi li mi li sarba bi ṣa tā ra phaṭa steng 'og bar gsum gyi gdon rigs sna tshogs pas sbyor ba ngan pa las rak+ta rasnya: yeg ga na cit+ta rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: ye wa ya we garma rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: ram̐ḥ.asne de wa wāk+ka rak+ṣa rak+ta: rba pa ṇi de wa kā ya rak+ta rak+ta: leḥbhu mi pa ti ga rak+ta rak+ṣa: de nas shis brjod kyi mtha' brgyan pa ni na re mchog gsum bden mthu baspu ba med pa'i mthus: lha yi dpung tshogs lha min las rgyal bzhin: deng 'dir bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas ma rig bdud las rgyal ba'i shis pa stsol:rtsa ba gsum gyibaden mthu bsnga med kyis: drang srong gdon las nyi zla rgyal ba bzhin: deng 'dir bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas: nga bdag g.yul las rgyal ba'i shis pa stsol: sku

gsum thugs rje bslu ba med pa'i mthus: rgya mtsho'i klu las mkha' lding rgyal ba bzhin deng 'dir bdag cag dpon slob 'bor dang bcas: nyon mongs g.yul las rgyal ba'i shis pa stsol: dza ya dza ya bi dza ya swā sti maṅga le de nas smon lam gdab pa ni rdo rje slob dpon gya zhabs spyi bor blang ste 'ad ltar rjes bzlos bya e ma: zla gam dbang chen brtsegs pa'i dkyil 'khor du drag po nā ga klu 'dul he ru ga'i: sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba chen po ru/ grong 'pho grong 'jug byang chub bsgrub par bya'o zhes lan gsum bskyar rjes bsngo ba dang smon lam rnamadag du gdab so de ltar klu' yi gdon grol zab mo ni mang du byas na rang la chad pa sa gzir skal ba can la phan thog rgya cher 'byung mdze rigs bco brgyad klu nad ma lus sel ma 'ongs dus kyi snyigs mar gyur ba na dgra ru klu sdang nad du mdze ru 'ong de tshe phan phyirasnga rgyan nyid kya thugs kyi zab bcud man ngag nor lta bu rin chen sa ya gter du sbas te bzhag 'dzam gling spyi la mkho ba'i man nga ga yan nga khyod med par kun gyis nyams su longs phan ba 'i 'bras bu bral tshe nga yis basmus phyi rabs brgyud 'dzin yongs kyi thugs la 'chongs sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya ye ma sku gsum ston pa pad+ma saṃ bha was thugs kyi bu chen rgyal ba mchog dbyangs la dgongs pa'i rgyar bcug rten

btsaX 'brel sa yi gter mdo khams bkra shis tsa ri ṭa la bstims gter bdag bun tshogasaklu bdud btsan la gnyer dus kyi snyigs mar nad mtshon gzeng lang tshe 'gro 'dren dpa' bo rgyal mchog bzhad pa rtsal bstan 'gro'i rgud pa gso phyir bzhengs pa'i tshe skyes bu de da gdams pa 'di 'phrad nas sma smrar rong sngags chos 'dis 'dul bar shog bka' log lag tu ma 31ra pho nyas srungs dam ldan thugs sras rnams dang 'phrad par shog sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya da bang chen rte ru ga'i phyi sgrub zab mo rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya:gu h+ya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kya bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa 'o brda thim ñtsā zhes pa 'da' lu zan chos kyi bdag po pad+ma bsod nams grub pa'i rdo rjes bkra shis la reg bde bar gshegs pa 'i sku gsung thugs rten ya mtshan can dang kha tshar ma nyams pa'i dri med ras gzan dkar bo 'bad rtsol lhur len gyi skyes bcas nan dan gyis bskupha ngor/ 7 kho bo rgyal mchog bzhad pa rtsal gyis mdo khamasatsa ri ṭa yi gnas mdun nas mkha' 'gro'i gsang brda dag par phab pa 'a yi ge pa ni chos bdag nyid kyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phe la/sarba maṅka lo/
bsgo/ zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: dbang chen pad+ma he ru ga'i: bka' sdod lcags ging nag po'i mngon spyod zab mo'i skor rnams bzhugs so:

brteX na 31 gu nag pad+ma 11 dha shrī he dzag ka ya: ོ ma bzad bde ba'i sku mchog he ru ka pad+ma dbang ga rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo ma 'ongs las ldan sgrub la snyigs rus can rtse gcag snying po lhur len byed pa'i tshe bar chad dgra yis rgol ba tshar gcod phyir drag po lcags ging sgrub pa'i zab gnad bstan sa ma wā mi 'bral 'grogs phyir bla rdo srog 'khor gces de yi thabasani 'di ltar lag len 'debs rin chenashog dkar dri ma bral ba'i ro ra mtshal dang bzang drug mnyam par sbyar ba yis mu 'khyud rim pa bdun du bskor bar byed dbus su legs ldan yab yum sku gzugs bri srog gi yi ge ram gyis bkod bar bya gnyis pa la ni dbu can tshag med kyi rtsa sngags yag mgo phya ru bstan te bri gsum pa la ni 'di ltar gong bzhin dgod 67 :skur ma hā kā la kro ti shā ri sarba sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya rak+ta rak+ta: mthu chen rgyud kyi mgon po legs ldan lcam dral bka' 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi sku gsung thugs rten 'di la brten par gyur cig: bla gnas par gyur cig: byin chags par gyur cig: gnyis su med par gyur cig: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra rak+ta rak+ṣa: bzhi pa la ni 'ad bag gong ltar dgod oṃ bhuskur ma hā kā la kro ti shwa ri sarba sa ma ya dza dza sgrub pa po la zas nor longs spyod kyi char chen po

btsa/ 7 phob cig: mi sems g.yos shig: snang ba dbang du bsgyur cig: gdul bya slob bu bstan pa'i dpal du bsdus shig: bshad sgrub dar rgyas su spel cig:mdzad 'brin yar zla ltar 'phel zhing rgyas par gyis shig: tshe su sti sirnyi maṅga lo: lnga pa la ni dbyangs gsal rten snying mjug rten 'brel nyes pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar gyur cig shirnye ku ru ye swā hā: legs tshogs dpal 'byor gyi dngos po thams cad rgyas par gyur cig: puṣ+ṭi ku ru ye swā hā: lha 'dre mi gsum dregs pa can thams cad dbang du gyur cig:wa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: log 'dren 'byung po dam sri thams cad rtsad nas chod par gyur cig: mā ra ya phaṭa swā hā: zhes pa'i sham sbyar chad lag bral bar bra drug pa la ni lcags zhags sgrog dril dang 'byu ba bzhi yi ri mo brkod pa ra bya bdun pa la ni me ri pa drwa bkod rdzas ni khab len rdo da shi kya rta gangs kyi thigs pa rgya mtsho'i sbu ba dang gser dang rwa gan bzang drug chos sman sbyar legs pa ra byugs la gri lcags thog lcags dang khab len lcags bsres shwa mig zur drug pa ya getra sde shā sgror bkod de nyad dar tshon sna lngas dril byas te srog 'khor dbus gzhug sna lnga' rgya chings gdabs sgrub ba 'i rten 'dzug rab gnas me tog 'thor

lus la bci bas srung ma grong bzhin 'dud sa ma yu de nas drag sgrub mngon spyod gzhung bsra sa ni rang nyed pad+ma he ru gar gsal ba'i mdun du yīḥlas rlung gi dkyil 'khor:rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rba klong rab tu 'phyo ba'i dbus su sumaḥlas zhing chen gyi lngags pa rab tu brgyang ba'i khar: bdud ma tram̐ rū tra bsgral ba'i khong par gnam lcagabargyad pa'i lte bar dug gsum las kyi btson khaṃ gru gsum nag la gting zab pa kha khyer mtho zhing nad kyi na bun 'thib pa: mtshon cha'i bu yug 'tshubs shingab 'bebs pa de lta bu'i nang du yid la brnag pa'i dgra bo de nyid mgon med skyabs dang bral ba shin tu nyam thag pa rkang lag lcags gzer gyis ba rnag khrag 'dzag cing 'dar phri li li byed pa gcig tu gyur: de yi sa bonadṛ las 'od 'phros pas yid la brnag pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad rang dbangagazugs liṅga la yang yang bstem: phyi rim 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad la dregs pa lha srin sde brgyad kyi phyag na gdug pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs bsnams shi

badz+ra: nyams dang ldan pas dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dgongs pa dang bcas te bzhugs bar bsam:de dag gi steng gi nam mkhar me rlung dud sprin 'khrigs pa'i dbus su dgra bgegs pho mo bsnol ba'i khri ru hūṃmo5sa rgyud mgon legs ldan nag po ni:khro gtum rngams brjid bltar mi bzod pa'i sku:zhal gdengs ljags 'dril rno dkar mche ba gtsigs:lcags ral gzengs shing rdo rje rtse lngas brgyan thod skam lnga dang dar sna'i cod pan bcing:rin chen snyan cha mdzes pa'i khra ldan brgyan:dar nag ber chen me tog tshom bu ris:sbrul chun mgo phreng stag gi sham thabs klubs:zhabs gnyis sag lhum dang bcas gyad thabs rol:phyag g.yas nyon mongs rgyun gcod gri gug phyar g.yon pas khams gsum rgyan rol thod khrag 'dzin:dug gsum rtsad gcod kha ṭ+wāṃ mchan g.yon brten:sku la laṅka'i dmag tshogs 'dud cing 'khor:g.yon du yum mtshog kro ti shwa ri ma:mthing nag khro gtum srin mo khros pa'i sku:phyag g.yas spu gri g.yon pas dgra snying 'dzin:mi lpags go bgos sbrul chun gzig sham mdzes:thabs chen sku la bde

ba'i dpal mdangs ngom gnyis ka me rlung du sprin 'khrigs pa'i klong: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dgongs par dgyes bzhin du: mngon spyod las la 'brin las 'gyed par dmigs: skabs 'dir laṅka'i lul nas dregs tshogasabastim 'byung ba lnga yi khams kyi dregs pa dang rnod bcud brtan g.yo ma lus gcig tu dril de nas bzlas pa sngags kyi 'phrul 'khor ni bdag nyid dpal chen 11 pad+ma he ru ga'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros mdun du chos skyong dregs pa'i tshogs kyi thugs rgyud bskul: de dag las spros pa'i las mkhan pho nya'i dmag tshogs rnams kyis yid la brnag pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad rang dbang med par bkug nas rū pa la bstim par dmigs la: sa bhuskur ma hā kwa la kro ti shwa ri aḥya maḥduḥdza tsamigaḥnaḥs ma ya dza dza: 'bod rbad rtags mtshan ma byung bar du bzla de nas drag las byed tshe gser skyems ni zag med bdud rtsi dmigs la 'bul byas te kye: skyabs kyi dam pa dkon mchog gsum po dgongs bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro nor lha dgongs skyes bu ging drug dbyings kyi ma lnga dgongs: bdud rtsi gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las 'grub par

pa(: mdzod bdag ne+e ma nyes rang bab 'dug pa la:dgra dang bgegs tshogs 'di yis ma ster ro:nyi ltar gsal kyang mun ltar sgrib te byung:gangs ltar gsal kyang sprin ltar 'azib nas byung:legs lam dge ba bcu ni sgrubs ma ster:nyes pa mi dge bcu ni rtag tu brtsams bshad sgrub gzhi gtor ting 'dzin zab mo bshig tshe sgog dam la skabs lta glags 'tshol bas:'di la kun mkhyen yongs kyis gzu dpang mdzod:mthu rtsal 'a da na nyes can chad pas chod:bden rdzun mnga' na legs nyes shan drang phyes chos rgyud 'dzin la mgon dang dpung grogs mdzod:bka' chad gdug rtsub dgra dang bgegs la ston:gdung ba'i smre sngags chud mi za bar mdzod:'brin las ma g.yel badz+ra sa ma yā:zhes brjod gtor skyems gcang sar mchod de nas 'gugs bsnyim bya ba ni na ma rig 'jin rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang:sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang:chos kyi bka' bden pa dang:dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang:bden gnyis bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang rdo rje chos skyong ba'i srung ma bka'

sdod pho nya'i dmag tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang:bden pa chen po'i stobs kyis:spyir mchog gsum bstan pa'i spyi dgra:bshes gnyen dam pa'i sku dgra:khyad par du rnal 'byor ba bdag la phod btsug pa:do bsdo ba:ya bzung ba:'gres tshol ba:snga dgra lag gis brdar ba:phyi dgra yid la sems pa :da dgra thad du bsdo ba'i dgra bgegasathams cad rad dbang med par khra gyi li li nag sga ra ra bye'u chung khras ded pa bzhin du rang dbang med par bkug nas gzugs liṅga 'di la khug cig:bstim cig:dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho lan gra sa ci nus brjod par bya de nas bskul ba gtong ba ni rol mo sna tshogs sgra sgrogs shing pa d+ma he ru'i ti 'dzan gyis hūṃ bye bdag ni rig 'dzin sgrub pa po:dam la gnas shing lha la 'phreng:khyod ni srung ma mthu rtsal can:gsang sngags snying po'i bstan srung ba bzhugs ni laṅka'i yul na bzhugs:legs nyes gnyis kyi bya ra ba:mdzad pas bstan dang sgrub mchog skyongs bdud kyi dpung 'joms drag shul can:lcags ging legasaldan nag po ni:gnad nas bskul lo da chur bzhengs:rngams brjid 'jigs pa'i gzugs skur ngoms:drag po'i

badz+ra: gad rgyang 'brug ltar sgogs: gdug rtsub thugs kyis dgra la gzigs: mngon spyod drag po'i dpa' rtsal bskyed: rno ba'i mtshon cha dgra la bzor: laṅka'i dmag tshogs las la rgyug dgra sgog dmar po rbad kyis chod: bsad rtags don snying bdag la sprod: las mkhan dregs pa'i dmag tshogs kyis: phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad gar gnas pa'i: dgra bgegs nyes can pho mo rnams: btson pa bzhin du khrid la shog: ye shes mtshon chas phung po gtubs: sha khrag rus par za ngu gyis brngan pa'i gtor skyems 'di bzhes la: mngon spyod 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod snye bhuskur ma hā kā la kro ti shwa ri aḥyaḥmasagubutsasha na ma ra ya dgra la rbad rbad rgyug bh+yo: gtor skyems dgra bo'i phyogs su mchod dmod bcol bya zhing thal mo steb des ni dgra dpus rdul du brlag sa ma yā snyed bhuskur ma hā kā la kro ti shwa ri aḥya maḥsdo dza tsa gaḥnaḥmā ra ya rbad rbad: dgra bgegs gnod byed sarba dza hūṃ baṃ ho: dgra bgegs gnod byed rnams kyi bla sha re ma ti 'gri 'gri sha ma ru ti thul thul phyog myog yed yed sha ma ru ti khug khug: ling myog ling shag ling thum tsa murnyi

dza hūm̐ baṃ ho brgya rtsa la sogs gang skabs brjod bla 'gugasartags thon bar du bskyar sa ma yu 31 bhuskur ma hā kwa la kro ti shā ri aḥyaḥmaposaḥdza 'dza/ gaḥnaḥmā ra ya rbad rbad: dgra bgegs mā ra ya: chings chings: lus chings ngag chings yid chings yid kyi dran pa rmug par gyis shig: sum̐ ri li li dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho: brgya rtsa la sogs ci nus brjod des ni dgra bo' sgo gsum chings sa ma yu o saskur ma hā kā la kro ti shā ri aḥyaḥmanaduchogatsamigaḥnaḥmā ra ya rbad rbad: a dṛ trag raka mā ra ya phyes phyes: ma ma trag rū tra mā ra ya phyes phyes: dgra bo skyobs byed kyi lha dang phyes shig: badz+ra pra we sha ya phaṭa: brgya rtsa la sogs gang 'os brjod des ni dgra bo lha dang dbye sa ma yā skyid bhuskur ma hā kā la kro ti shwa ri aḥyaḥm du rnga tsasgagaḥnaḥmā ra ya rbad rbad: dgra bgegs dz+wa la pa ya dza la pa ya myag rbad: sarba sha hūṃ khung sum̐ dza ngag phyos: 'ur 'ur trig shag khung thum dza rbad sod: brgya rtsa la sogs gang 'os brjod des na dgra bo spyo zhing 'bog sa ma yu de nas bsad pa'i las byed pa hā dza: dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab: bdag ni rig 'dzin sgrub pa po: khyod ni chos skyong dam tshig can: mngon spyod 'phrin las dus la bab: bdag la

ba:tshu sdang ba'i dgra bo 'di: skad cig nyid du gzugs la phob: lus sgog dngos po so sor phyes: rnam shes skye med dbyings su sbyor: slo bhuskur ma hā kā la kro ti shwa ri aḥya maḥsaphutsashaḥn mā ra ya rbad rbad: dgra bo'i snying la dza dza: bla la shag shag: sgog la dun dun: sha khrag rus gsum la mā ra ya rbad phaṭa: rnam shes skye med dbyi sa su spar sha khrag rus pa tshogs su bsgyur sa ma yu de nas gtad du bcol ba na tsher hom la ni me char te hū tshu rab 'bar bskal ba'i me rlung 'tshubs ma'i dbus dregs pa yongs kyi spyi rje mthu rtsal can: legs ldan nag po lcam dral bka' sdod bcas gtum drag 'jigs rung ma 'dres gsal bar bskyed: srog gis bskul te rang bzhin gnas rnams nas: dam can rgya mtsho spyan drangs gnyis med bstim: rab 'jigs rngams pa'i zhal gyi hom khung du: log rtog du tra bsgral ba'i phung po khams: bstabs so gnyis med mnyam par bzhes su gsol: dgra yi dpung tshogs ming med stong bar mdzod: slo byu smar ma hwa ka la kro ti shu ri ཿya 4buphutsashaḥnaḥs pa ri wā ra dgra bgegs kyi me sa rak+ta tsitā ko ro tsa na ki ni

ri ti la kha kha khā hi kha hi:brgya rtsa la sogs ci nus brjod skabs su 'dod gsol gdab pa ni ho:dgra dpung 'dul ba'i pho nya legs ldan dgra bla'i dmag tshogs 'dza ra dang bcas pa rnams kyis: sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la 'tshe zhing sems can gyi bde skyid bcom pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad rdul du rlog cig:med par mdzod cig:stong bar mdzod cig:brlag par mdzod cig:ming tsam yang mi gnas pa'i phrin las dam pa mdzod cig:ces sbyar bsdu rim bya ba ni ho:legs ldan nag po lcam dral bka' sdod bcas: rang bzhin gnas nas byon zhig bcol ba'i las:thogs med yid bzhin mdzad pa mthar phyin te: rang rang so so'i gnas su badz+ra hūṃ:zhes brjod dregs pa rang gnas bsdu snyigs ma'i thal sol kun bsdus te rgya gramalam gyi 'og tu mnan yul gzhi'i bdag por gnyer gtad pa kya:rgyal ba gong ma'i bka' dam bzhin 'dir gnas yul lha zo dor kun dam tshag chen pos 'bod do byon:brngan pa'i gtor skyems 'di bzhes la:bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo yi: zag rdzas snyigs ma khrol bur bcas: gtad du bcol lo dam du bzhes: 'tshor med thal ba rdul du rlog:ming

badz+ra tsam med pa'i za ngu gyis: dam tshig 'di la khyod ma 'da': 'da' na rgyal ba thams cad kyi: bka' yi chad pas gcod par 'gyur: de bas gtad 'di dgyes par bzhes: snyen sarba ma ka pā la e do bha lirnyi kha kha khā hi khā hi: dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag rus pa tshe bla sgog gsum ma ra ya khā nyi: stum bha ya nan: bhan+ta ya nan: na sha ya nan:81 aḥhūṃ swā hā: e ye re sum mā ra ya nan: zhes brjod mngon spyod drag las kyi bya ba' shu' mi maro na pa ra bya des ni dgra dpu rtsad gcod 'gyur sa ma wā maro na spyod drag po 'a rlo mde'u 'di do gal chen po ma byung bar gang yang rung la byar mi rung byasan mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad 'bebs dregs pa 'khu bas gdug rtsub ston de phyir thabs la mkhas par gyis sa ma yā e ma rgyal ba'i dab po pa d+ma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis thugs kyi thig le zab gas rdor snying skor grub pa' dbang phyug rgyal mchog khyod la gtad da dung spel ba' dus la ma bab bas rin chen brda la bstims shig sa ra bye ma do khams bkra shas rdzongs der dgongs bra sdoms ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus nad mug mtshon chas gze pa la pa'i tshe dpa' bo khyod nyad 'dus pa rtsal du bzhengs skyes bu de dang gdams pa 'di 'phrad nas 'gro don 'brin las byang nas byang du rgyas 'brel

tshad don ldan pad+ma 'od du 'god bka' 'di srungs ga gnod sbyin btsan rgod rgyal dam nyams lag tu ma shor spu gri gsum dam ldan yo sa la spel cig ging dmar nag sam yu rgya rgya rgya lcabalas rno ba'i mtshon cha rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bza bkod pa'o brda zim lha bdag po sku skyes pad+ma bsod nams grub pa'i rdo rjes bkra shis ya mtshan can gyi skyes du mar bcas te 'bad rtsol lhur len gya bskul ngor/ kho bo rgyal mchog bshad pa rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro gsang ngadag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni chos kyi bdag po nyid kyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga le/
badz+ra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: dbang chen bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal gyi las mtha' grin las kyi skor btsod sgrub rgya mdud zab mo bzhugs so:

badz+ra: na mo gu ru pad+ma kro ta h+ya snyi wa ya: sgomi/sgorgya37/ bzod ga'i rnam 'byur 'bar ba'i sdang mig bsgrad dbang gi 'od zer kun nas 'gyed mdzad cing ma tshogs mkha' 'gro rtag tu sprinabazhin 'khrigs bde ba chen po' klong la phyag bgyi'o skal lngan gdul bya'i pad tshal rab rgyas shang gdul bya'i rgyud kyi dug gsum nad sel phyir dbang gi 'phran las nā ga klu 'dul kya btsod sgrub dbal chu las kya rgya mdudabastan sa ma yu dben pa'i gnasasu phyi nang dam rgya bcad maṇ+ḍal mda' gang zla gam khod snyoms ste dri bza ba byung chag chag legs par gdab rdul tshon ras bris tshom bu 7 grangs ltar ga ru legs par bkod la sgrubagator sogs zab mo gtor ma' las rim ltar du bkod sngon 'gro phyi ltar gtor ma cha gsum gtong bas sa khrusalegs par bya zhing bde bar gnas: de nas lta bas mtshams gcod bya ba ni hūṃ /sa snang srid rnam dag chos sku'i dkyil 'khor la: nga bdag yid chos spros pa ka dag kyang: 'phral snang gzung 'dzin 'khrul ba'i glo bur gdon: bde chen rdo rje'i ngang du mtshams bcad do oṃ da ha da ha: pa tsa pa tsa: bhan+ta bhan+ta hu lu hu lu: dhi na me ge na ya hūṃ phaṭa: sru gur ni hūṃ hrīḥ thabs kyi rang bzhin khro bos nam mkha' gang : shes rab rtsal mdangs khro mos sa gzhi gang

ba:: phyogs mtshams ye shes lnga yi mtshon chas gtams: 'di la gnyis 'dzin 'byung po nye mi nus: dzñā na dhartu rak+ṣa rak+ta spyo: byin 'bebs na hū rdzi bde chen pad+ma brtsegs pa'i klong ya sa nas: dbang gi rgyal po rta mchog rol pa rtsal ye shes rang rtsal bsam yas 'khor dang bcas: don dam ngo bo nyid du dbyer med kyang: kun rdzob gdul bya'i mos ngor mthun pa'i phyir: ma 'gags sgyu ma'i phyag rgyar rab bzhengs te: gnyis med mnyam pa chen po'i dbang byin phob: grub rtags mtshan ma bzang po bstan du gsol 6( pad+ma kro ta h+ya ṣ+ṭṛ wa sarba sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: dzñā na a we sha ya a āḥ mchod rja sa byin rlabs ni hū gyi dbang chen rol ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir:'dod yon ma 'gags sgyu ma'i dga' ston kun: mtshan ma rang grol mnyam nyid dga' ston du kun bzang rol pa chen por yongs su spel: snyen ma hā su kha byu dza sarba sa ma ya ho:lha bskyed ni snyen chos sku spre sa bral mkha' ltar dag pa'i dbyings: yis longs spyod rdzogs mdzad byang chub sems sprin 'khrigs: hūṃ: sprul sku thugs rje 'phrin las phyogs mtha'

yas: gang gdul 'gro ba 'dren pa'i dpal du bzhengs: tsho( yi/hūṃ badz+ra sa mā dhi hūṃ: hrīX khyab brdal ka nas dag pa'i mkha' dbyings su: gsal dag nogs ma bral ba'i 'od kyi klong: ris med mnyam pa chen po'i da la dra bde chen ye shes 'bar ba'i gzi byin 'khyug: gang yang 'gags med 'byung ba'i shugs ldan pa: yum chen lnga yi mkha' 1nga yangs pa rtsa bde chen thod mkhar dur khrod brgyad rdzogs pa: sgo gru rta babs mtshan nyid phun tshogs dbus: klu gdon pho mo bsnol ba'i khri yi khar: rig pa hrīḥyig spro bsdus zhu ba las: bdag mdun dbang chen nā ga klu 'dul ni: sku mdog mthing nag char sprin 'khrigs 'dra'i zhal : spyan gsum dmar zlum sdang mig glog ltar 'khyug: zhal gdengs ljags 'dril rno dkar mche ba gtsigs: dbang gi gad rgyang nam mkha'i 'brug ltar sgrogs: smrar smin me yis 'byung po gzhob kyis bsregs: dmar ser ral gseb khyung gi tsha tshwa 'phro:rta zhal ljang sngon drag pos mtsher skad sgrogs: lha klu mi gsum dregs pa dbang du bsdud: phyag g.yas gcod byed spu gri ngar ma phyar: g.yon pas bhan khrag btsod zor gtor

pa(: chen 'dzin: dpal dang dur khrod chas brgyad 'jigs par gsol: dbang gi 'od zer me yi tsha tshwa 'khrugs: gyad kyi 'dor thabs klu gdon khri la bsgrad phyogs bcur gdon 'dul ye shes khro bo bcu: gnam lcags 'khor lo 'bar ba'i rtsibs dbus 'bying: klu 'dul pho nya sna tshogs char ltar 'bebs: 'jigs rngams mtshon cha ma rungs gdon la 'debs: 'brin las bzhi sgrub dpal chen khro bo bzhi: dkar ser dmar ljang 'jigs pa'i cha lugs ldan:rno ngar mtshon cha klu bdud rnams la 'bebs skyemed dbyings su 'khrul ba kha lo bsgyur: bka' sdod dregs pa sde bcu rlung ltar 'tshubs: rnal 'byer 'phrin las rab 'byams thogs med sgrubs kun gyi thugs srog las spros 'od zer gyis: dbang chen rol pa'i lha tshogs spyan drangs bstims: spyan 'dren ni hū nyi pad+ma dbang chen rol pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: bde ba'i sku mchog rta mgrin yang khros gar ye shes sgyu ma'i phyag rgyar rab bzhengs te gnas 'dir spyan 'dren dbang bskur byin chen phob: 'gro ba'i don phyir 'phrin las sgrub pa la rtags mtshan bzang po myur bar

bstan du gsol: mopad+ma kro ta rā dza sarba sa ma ya dza dza: bams gsol ni hū ni rin chen pho brang 'od 'bar gzi byin ldan: thabs shes nyi zla zung 'jug 'od re gsal: gtimug las skyes klu gdon nyam re dma': dam tshig gdan steng dbang chen bzhugs su gsol: badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: phyag 'tshal ni na 33 dbang chen pad+ma rā ga'i gzi mdangasacan: bzod dka' dus me 'bar ba'i bkrag dpal 'khyud: stobs ldan rdo rjes 'khrul ba kha lo bsgyur: pad+ma he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo: sa ma ya na mo hūṃ: mchod pa ni hū hrīdabang chen yang khros dkyil 'khor dgyes pa'i phyir: rnam mang mchod sprin nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam pa: khyad par rmad byung dbang lnga'i me tog dang tshil chen bdug spos zhun gyimar me'i 'od: mkhris pa'i dri chab sha rus zhal zas dpal mi rkang gling bu thod pa'i rnga sgra sogs: pad+ma drag por gnyis su med par 'bul: blang dor bral bar thugs rjes nyerabazhes nas: 'phrin las lhun gyis grub pa'i dngos grub stsol: slo ma hā byu dza sa ma ya ho bstod pa ni hā 〉 be+eḍūr lhun po lta bu'i gzi mdangs 'bar: ha ha'i gad rgyang nam

badz+ra: mkha'i 'brug ltar sgogs:mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer gdul bya'i yul la gzigs:dpal chen rta mgrin nag por phyag 'tshal bstod:thugs dzozhoba'i rnam 'gyur ngoms pa'i tshe:rā ga'i lhun por nyin byed 'bum 'khyud gzi khams gsum dbang bsdud dbang gi char 'bebs pa:pad+ma he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod:dga' bzhiyiro ston gdul bya'i dpal bskul tshe:rdo rje la ma dum skyes kha kha sogs:'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro sprin ltar 'khrigs:thabs shes gnyis med klong la phyag 'tshal bstod stobs ldan rdo rje'i ging ni glog ltar 'khyug:sgrol ging ya ma ra tsa thog ltar 'bebs:rgyug ging gza' bdud chen po mda' ltar 'debs pho nya ging gi tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod:khams gsum dbang bsdud rta glu 'brug ltar sgrogs:bde ba'i dgyes 'debs phag skad ngur sgra 'don:dug gsum 'byung po dam 'dog ar la gtad:rjes chags glu dbyangs 'gyed la phyag 'tshal bstod:bshags pa na ho:chags sogs nyon mongs ngo bo ka dag kyang:ma rig dbang gis gdos po mtshan mar bzung:dbang chen yab yum yin

pa ra ngo ma shes: dbyer med mnyam pa'i ngang du bzod par gsol: badz+ra sa ma ya shukhye āḥ yi ge brgya pas bzod gsol phul 'dzab bskul ni trīḥ dbus mtha' med pa zla gam dbang gi dal: chags bral pad+ma 'bar ba'i pho brang nas: pad+ma dbang chen rta mchog rol ba'i sku: ma rung 'dul phyir yang khros nag por bzhengs: mdzad pa'i 'phrin las sprul pa glog ltar 'gyu: 'dzab rgyun rdo rje'i dam tshig gyis bskul na: dgongs pa'i dbyings las thugs rje'i rtsal ngoms la ma rtog log 'khrul 'byung po tshar gcod cing sgrub pa po la dbang bskur gzi byin phobs ma pad+ma krota rā dza sarba sa mā ti āḥ bzlas dmags ni hūṃ hrīḥ bdag mdun rta mgrin yang khros nag po yi: thugs gar nyi zla'i ga'u kha sbyor sbubs rig pa hrī ga dmar nag me dpung 'bar: gdan 'og 'khor lo cibs brgyad lte ba rtsa nā yig ljang skya shar du ā dkar po: lho ru yaḥsngon nub tu maḥdamar po: byang du du nag shar lhor rulig ser: lho nub tsadakar nub byang shadag po: byang shar ra4 3ga smug nag 'od 'bar ba: kun kyang thugs srog 'od kyis rab gcun pas: ma rungs dregs pa

btsarnya las la 'chun pa dang: ye shes pa rnams dbang bsgyur gzengs bstod dmigs 'phrin las lhun grub pad+ma he ru ga'i: gsang ba gsum du dag smin rdzogs bsam la: snyen pad+ma 11 ta ma hā kā la shrī he dzag ka hūṃ phaṭa: dgongs pa 'pho 'gyur bral ba yis bzlas pa 'byu 'bum tshad du 'byol rtags su bum chu khol ba dang me dmar rang 'bar bhasnyo lud gtor ma zhu zhing me stag 'phro bde stob rtogs pa mkha' ltar rgyas sgrub khang dra bzang 'thul ba dang nyams dga' dang spro skyo ba med de dag phyi nang gsang ba yi grub pa'i rtagasamatshan bstan pa'o sa ma yu de nas sgrub pa' bzlas dmigs ni hūṃ rdi pad+ma dbang chen rol ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: bdud dpung zil gnon yang khros nag po'i gar: nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par rab g.yos te dug gsum 'byung po'i gnyis 'dzin rtog pa bcom: dregs tshogs gdug pa dam la 'dog pa dang: dbang gi 'brin las rab 'byams lhun grub ste snang grags rig gsum pad+ma gsung gi dal bde chen dbang gi dkyil 'khor mngon gyur ngang: o pad+ma kro ta ma hā kwa la shrī he ru ka hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa: o pra sod: chu sod durta sod: durmi sod gnyan mgo la chod: kha la dza: cha

thum tha rate sa dun te dz+wa la ram̐ pa ye swā hā: lta ba'i gzer da ting nge 'dzin gyi gzer gsal ba'i gzer dang 'phrin las las kyi gzer mi 'da' dam tshig mchog la gnas pa yis bye ba gcig bzlas nyams rtogs mkha' ltar rgyas ya dam dbang chen pad+ma he ru ga'i zhal gzigs lung bstan dbung dbyung gzengs bstod pa rab dngos 'bring nyams tha ma rmi lam 'byung sa ma yu de nas las sbyor bsnyen dmigs ni hū hrīḥ bdag mdun dbang chenapad+ma he ru ga'i: thugs ga'i sngags 'khor las spros 'od zer bzhi: stong khams rab 'byams 'jig rten khyab par 'phros: 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i 'gro don lhun gyis grub ma rungs dregs pa zil gnon dam la btag: dus mtha'i 'byung po 'bog brgyal rengs bar byed: mngon spyod lhun gyis grub pa'i mthu thob dmigs oṃ pad+ma kro ta h+ya skṛ wa ma hā kā la pañtsa ma hā shrī he ru ka hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa: nā ga ra tsa mal mal 'gul 'gul tsag tsag gtub gtub khrol khrol chom chom: sa bdag klu gnyan gtod kyis bzung ba thong bcing pa 11la phyung phyung las sngags chu bo' rgyun ltar bzla spro bsdu dug gsum gdon la 'bebs 'phrin las bzhi yis bskul ma bya de tshe gtor ma me stag 'phro sngags pa bye mar rlangs pa 'byung shesapa gsal zhing

btsasdo: dregs pa 'du nyi ma gdan du btang ba dang stag gzig 'brong sogs bran du bkol ra chen rtse ru sdod pa sogs rtags kyi rmi lam sna tshogs gsal las sbyor 'grub pa'i tshad du phyin sa ma yu de nas 'dod gsol gdab pa ni hūṃ hrīḥ phyogs ris mi dmigs bde chen dbang gi sku gdul zhig dug gsum gdon la drag por ngoms: thabs mkhas mdzad 'phrin rnam pa mtha' yas pa'i: he ru ka dpal bdag la dgongs su gsol: bsnyen sgrub ting 'dzin bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor la: pad+ma drag po'i zhal gyis nye bar phyogs: sa ler gsal ba'i dbang chen spyan gyis gzigs: 'du 'bral med par thugs kyis nyer bskyang nas tshe 'di nyid la rig 'dzin mchog thob shog: srid pa'i sgyu lus rlung sems zag zad de: 'od gsal sgyu lus dwangs ma'i rol bar smin: gsal 'grib bral ba'i ye shes zung 'jug ste: sku thugs gnyis med mnyam pa nyid thob sgo ga: zhe sdang gdon la phyag gi ral gris bsnun:'dod cing chags rnams bde chen bhan mar bskyil gti mug rmongs tshogs shes rab spyan gyis bsregs: thabs mkhas mdzad pa ston pa'i dus la babs: rta ni srid zhi'i sa

las bsgral ba'i gar:mgrin pa 'khor 'das mnyam pa nyid kyi glu:dbang chen phyogs ris med pa'i thugs mnga' ba:don gyi pad+ma dbang chen mngon gyur shog:ye stong dbu ma don dam phag mo'i klong:'od gsal gnyug ma rdo rje'i rnal 'byor ma:sgyu lus phyag rgyar bzhengs pa'i dam tshig rten phra rags kun dang nam yang 'bral med shog:rtsa yi 'gros rim rlung gi phyed bcing dang thig le dbab bsdu thabs mang bsgyur mkhas pa'i:kun rdzob rtags kyi sa lam rtsal rdzogs te:don dam bde ba chen por yongs zlum shog ji ltar snang ba dbang chen yab kyi dal:thams cad stong pa shes rab phag mo'i dbyings zung 'jug rtsal las sgra grags bde chen gsung snang srid dag pa rab 'byams mngon gyur shog gangs dkar rtse nas bzhengs pa'i pho tshogs dang rgya mtsho'i gting nas bzhengs pa'i ma tshogs kyis:nam zhig bdag gi snang ba dbyings sdud tshe mkha' spyod rig 'dzin tshogs gral skyel bsu mdzod:sems can las kyisamanar ba'i zag pa can:nyon mongs gdon gyis dam bcing gzir ba na:thabs mkhas dbang chen drag sgrub bcod dpal

ba tshu 'dis: thams cad ma lus zhi zhing stong bar mdzod: bdud rtsi mthong reg nyams su myong ba kun: srid pa'i du kha'i dbang du mi bsgyur bar: rta mchog myur bde'i shing rta la zhon nas: he ru ka dpal sras su byang chub shog: gzhan yang bsngo smon shis pa brjod dga' ston tshogs kyas bskang ba ni hūṃ ༷ dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor 'dir: dga' ston tshogs su shar ba'i chos so cog: zhi wag rig pa'i rang mdangs me rlung chus: mtshan mar 'dzin pa thams cad re ye kho: ye shes ting nge 'dzin las spros pa yi lha klu mi yi dga' ston mtha' yas pa: rdo rje'i lha mo mdzes pa'i gar dang bcas: dbang chen gsung gi dkyil 'khor bskang phyir spro re yi kho oṃtsa hūṃ: badz+ra spa ra ṇa sa:spyan 'dren ji hūṃ nyi chags pa'i rdo rje dbang chen bzhad pa rtsal: du tra bsgral ba'i dpa' rtags gtsug na spa: dbang gi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas: dga' ston 'du ba chen por spran 'dren gshegs: dpa' bo pho chogs bro brdung khrigs se khrig: dpa' mo mo tshogs bshug tsho kyu ru dra rdo rje'i ging rnams las byed khyugs se khyug dga' ston

tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren bu la dbang bzhi bskur: nyams rtogs 'phel rgyas rig 'dzin mchog thob mdzod: slo pad+ma kro ta bīdu dha ra sarba sa ma ya dza dza: tshogs mchod na ho: bde bar gshegs po thams cad bcom ldan 'das: ye shes mnyam pa nyid kyi dkyil 'khor la: gnyis su med par dga' ston 'bul lags na: ro mnyam bde ba chen por bzhes su gsol: o ma hā ga ṇa tsakra pū dza ho: bar bshags ni ho: chos nyid mnyam pa chen po'i rang bzhin la: 'da' nyams srung mtshams bshags par bya ba dben tha snyad tsam du chags nyams gang byung yang: ye shes tshogs kyis bskang zhing bshags bgyi'o: badz+ra sa ma ya bi shukhye ho: tha ma tshogs bsgral ni hū bh+yo stong gsum 'jig rten pad+ma dbang gi dal: bde ba chen po ye shes mchog gi gsang: mtshan ma ris chad 'dzin pa'i gnyis snang bdud: so so rang rig rjen pas bsgral bar bya: sarba rwa tra pra we sha ya phaṭa: bstab pa ni ṭ+wāṃ spo bde chen mnyam pa nyid kyi zhal bum du: mtshan mar bzung ba'i phung khams skye mched kun mtshan ma med pa nyid du bsgral te bstabs

badz+ra: chos nyid mnyam pa nyid du bzhes su gsol ma hā me sa rak+ta tsit+ta la khānyi: lag ma na bh+yo: tshogs kyi bdag po pad+ma he ru ga'i: spyan sngar khas blangs ma sring dbang phyug tshogs: sngon gyi khas blangs dam tshag ci bzhin du pham 'bab bzhes la 'phrin las rab 'byams sgrubs: ma ma paspyo ṭa ba lirnyi khāhi bskul ba ni hūṃ bh+yo dbus mtha' med pa bde chen dbang gi dal: sor stog pad+ma 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: chags pa'i rdo rje rta mgrin yang khros gar: ma sring dbang phyug pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs:gnad nas bskul lo dbyings nas da bzhengs shig: chags sogs nyon mongs 'khrul ba'i dgra dang bgegs: rig pa ka dag dbyings su da sgrol cig: 'khrul ba ka nas dag pa'i 'phrin las mdzod: chad tho ni bh+yo: dus gsum thog mtha' ka nas dag mod kyang: rten 'brel tsam du he ru ka dpal dang: pad+ma thod 'phreng grub pa'i rig 'dzin kyi: spyan sngar khas blangs dam tshig gnyer blang ba'i dpal mgon bdun bcu sde dpon sum cu dang: dregs pa bco brgyad ma gza' dam gsum sogs: phyi nang gsang ba'i bka' spung dregs

zogs kyis: chad kyi gtor skyems dam pa 'di bzhengs la: sangs rgyas bstan srungasasems can phan bde spel: rnal 'byor grogs mdzod sbyin bdag bar chad sel sgrub pa'i rkyen bzlog sngags 'chang nyams rtogs spel: don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod: bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā bstan ma na spyo sgob dathon pad+ma khrag 'thung he ru ga'i: spyan sngar khas blangs dam tshig gnyer thob pa'i: bdag nyid chen mo bdud mo mched bzhi dang gangs dkar sha med gnod sbyin mched bzhi dang: kong btsun de mo sman btsun spun bzhi dang bod skyong bstan ma ya ma'i tshogs rnams kun: lhab lhub mang po'i brgyan bcas da tshur byon: dril g.yer mang po'i sgra bcas da tshur byon: 'khor tshogs mang po'i dpung bcas da tshur byon brgyan pa'i mchod gtorabashal chu 'di bzhes la: 'phrin las rab 'byams thogs med 'grub pa dang: sgrub pa po yi 'gal rkyen bar chad sol mthun snang legs tshogs yar ngos zla ltar spel 'od skur grub pa'i 'phrin las grogs mdzod cig: bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā rta bro ni ཿhrī gru gsum

badz+ra 'bar ba me yi klong dkyil du: gnyis snang dam sri rū tra brub pa'i steng: dbang chen rol ba'i brtul zhugs rta bro brdung: mnan no ldang med chos sku'i dbyings su rgya: ka āḥs swā hā: dz+wa bha ya nan: ma ra ya nan: dngos grub ni hūṃ nyi skye 'chi med pa rdo rje tshe yi dbang: nub pa med pa bsod nams dpal 'byor srid: don gnyis lhun grub dam pa chos kyi dpal: bdag cag sgrub pa po la stsal du gsol sa āḥ( swā hā hūṃ sirnyi pha la hūṃ ā bzod gsol ni hūṃ ༷ lta ba dman zhing spyod pa 'chol ba dang: sgom yun thung zhing ting 'dzan ma gsal ba: cho ga lhag chad 'gal 'khrul nongs pa kun: pad+ma dbang chen lha la bzod par gsol: snyen badz+ra sa ma ya ā bsngo smon ni ho: dus gsum bsags pa'i rnam dkar dge tshogs kun: gcig tu bsdus te mar gyur 'gro la bsngo: thams cad gdod ma'i grol gzhi mngon gyur nas: dbang chen pad+ma gsung gi dpal thob shog: lan gsum bsdu ldang ni phyi sgod gzhal yas nang bcud lha la bsdu: lha rnams gtso bo thugs sgog hūṃ la bsre nā da smra bsam brjod bral ngang du bzhag: shes rab phra ba'i dbyings las

phyag rgyar ldang: aphaṭa phaṭa: shis brjod ni na mo: ye grol gdod nas dag pa chos sku'i dbyings: rang bzhin 'od gsal sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i sprin thugs rje bde ba chen po'i dpal stsol ba'i: pad+ma dbang chen rgyal pos shis pa stsol: gdul dka' nyon mongs rgyas pa'i sems can rnams: thabs la mkhas pa'i thugs rje mtha' yas pas: grol lam rim dang cig char sna tshogs kyis: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa'i shis pa stsol: nyin yang bkra shis dpal 'bar da la la : mtshan yang bkra shis dge mtshan kyi li li: rtag par bkra shis chos 'khor rgya mtsho yis: 'jig rten kun khyab bde skyid phun tshogs 31ga: gzhan yang shis brjod rgya cher bya bsngo ba smon lam rgya yas gdab des ni nyams rtogs 'phel zhang rgyas grub rtags yon tan khyad 'phags 'byung sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya de nasalasaspyor sgrub pa ni dkyil 'khor bca' bkod zhal shes dang yig chung man ngag ltar du bya phyi nang rgyu 'grul dam rgya bsdams zhi sgrub sngon song rnal 'byor bas ting 'dzan rtse gcig gnad bskyang ste bskyed rim bsgom pa 'di ltar ro oṃ su bha wa sogs shusno nya: stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las rngam brjid 'jigs su rung ba'i zhing gi bkod pa phun sum

bsnye: tshogs pa'i dbus su btsan dug gi ngad rlangs rab tu 'phro ba'i rgya mtsho chen po yongs su 'khyil zhing rba rlabs kun tu 'khrugs shing sa bdag klu gnyan gtod tshogs bsreg cing brlag par byed pa'i mthu dang ldan pa: dur phag nag po dang dug khyung grangs med pa lcags sdig mgo dgu la sogs gdon 'dul gyi pho nya gra sa med pa 'phro zhing rgyu ba: de dbus su dur phag nag po mgo dgu pa'i steng du snomathing nag yongs su gyur pa las: dbang chen yang khrosanag po rngam brjid 'jigs su rung ba char sprin 'khrigs pa'i rnam 'gyur can: zhal gyi dkyil 'dza ra 'bum phrag nam mkha'i dbyings su sa ler gsal ba: g.yas phyag 'bum phrag gis gri gug 'dzin cing khams gsum gyi gdon tshogs dbang du sdud pa: g.yon phyag 'bum phrag gis dug sbrul nag po bsdam zhing gdol ba klu'i tshogs rnams zil gyis gnon par byed pa : sku la dur khrod chas brgyad kyis mdzes shing klu rgyal rigs dkar po'i dbu rgyan: rje'u rigs ser po'i snyan rgyan bram ze dmar po'i phyag zhabs kyi gdu bu: dmangs rigs mthing ga'i do shal byas shing

gyad kyi 'dor thabs su bsgrad pa: ral ba dmar ser 'khyil pa'i khrod du rta zhal mthing nag hi hi sgrogs pa'i rnam 'gyur can dregs pa sde brgyad srid gsum 'byung po thams cad dbang du sdud cing dam la 'dog pa sprul ba khro bo bcu'i 'phrin las rtag tu sgrub pa: za byed pho nya'i tshogs kyis klu 'dul gyi las la rgyu ba: bka' sdod dregs pa'i dmag tshogs rang dbang med par dam la gdung ba: lce spyang sha zan gyi tshogs rnam dug gsum gyi gdon la rngams pa: kang ka dang khyung gi tshogs rnams klu gnyan gtod tshogs za rngam gyi ldeng ba khro chung 'gal gyi tsha tshwa ltar 'phros pas rgyal bsen dam sri bsgral ba'i las la rngam pa: drag po'i me rlung dang dug mtshon gyi char ba 'bebs pa: shin tu 'jigs pa'i gnas mchog ma rung 'byung po'i tshogs rnams rgyu bar mi nus pa'i rang bzhin can du bskyed do: rang rang gi thugs srog sa bon las 'od zer spros dbyings nas ye shes pa kha ba bu yug 'tshubs bzhin spyan drangs te gnyis su med par bstim mo: hūṃ dza zla gam dgu brtsegs thod pa'i sku mkhar nas 'jigs rung khro bo'i dmag tshogs 'khrigs klong nas:

badz+ra pad+ma dbang chen yang khros nag po'i tshogs: rngam brjid stobs bskyed che ba'i gzi mdangs ngom: nā ga'i gdon 'dul las la da bzhengs shig: sprul ba dug khyung nag po'i bu yug 'tshubs: bka' sdod lcags sdig mgo dgu char ltar 'bebs las mdzad phag rgod tshogs ni rlung ltar rgyu: nā ga'i gdon tshogs 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: za byed byi la'i mgo can sngon nas rgyu gso byed pu shud mgo can rjes nas 'brang: bka' sdod dregs pa'i dmag tshogs sprin ltar gtibs: nā ga'i gdon tshogs 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: steng phyogs khro bo be+eḍūr mdog can tshogs: shar gyi khro bo zla ba'i 'od ltar brjid lho yi khro tshogs nyi ma'i 'od ltar 'byug: nā ga'i gdon tshogs 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: nub phyogs khro bo rā ga'i 'od ltar 'bar: byang phyogs khro tshogs in+d+ra'i mdangs ltar brjed shar lho'i khro tshogs rgya mtsho'i gos can rnams: na ga'i gdon tshogs 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: lho nub khro bo rje rgyal khros pa'i tshogs: nub byang khro tshogs dbang gi 'od zer can: byang shar khro tshogs nam mkha'i

mdangs 'dzin pa: 'og phyogs gdon 'dul khro tshogs dud kha'i mdog: kun kyang nā ga 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol lha yi cho 'phrul sna tshogs gzhom pa'i phyir: srid pa'i lharab sham po la sogs pa'i: las byed sprul ba'i dmag tshogs sa ya 'bum: dam tshig dbang gis 'bod do gshegs su gsol: 'chi bdag tshogs kyi cho 'phrul bzlog pa'i phyir gshin rje ya ma ra tsa la sogs pa'i pho nya yi dwags dmag tshogs sa ya 'bum: dam tshig dbang gis 'bod do gshegs su gsol: chu bdag pho mo'i rgol ba bzlog pa'i phyir ma mo srid pa'i rgyal mo la sogs pa'i: ma yam gnam sman sprul pa sa ya 'bum: dam tshig dbang gis 'bod do gshegs su gsol: gnod sbyin tshogs rkyi rgol ba 'joms pa'i phyir: bdud po skos rje brang dkar la sogs pa'i: bdud kyi dmag tshogs las byed sa ya 'bum: dam tshig dbang gis 'bod do gshegs su gsol: btsan gyi cho 'phrul rgol ba gzhom pa'i phyir: shan pa kus 'debs rgyal po la sogs pa'i: 'byung ba lnga yi btsan dmag sa ya 'bum: dam tshig dbang gis 'bod do gshegs su gsol rā tsa'i hur

badz+ra thum rgyug 'gyel bzlog pa'i phyir: srog bdud be dkar rgyal po la sogs pa'i: rgyal chen sku lnga ru 'dren sa ya 'bum: dam tshig dbang gis 'bod do gshegs su gsol: rlung lha'i tshogs kyis rgol ba drungs 'byin phyir: gnod sbyin kā la yak+ka la sogs pa'i: dmu bdud mu stegs rū tra'i tshogs rnams kun: dam tshig dbang gis 'bod do gshegs su gsol: bgegs kyis sbyor ba ngan pa tshar gcod phyir klu bdud 'chi bdag mgo dgu la sogs pa'i: gnyan gtod sa bdag klu yi phyag brten kun dam tshig dbang gis 'bod do gshegs su gsol: khams gsum grong khyer gsum brtsegs pho brang nas sangs rgyas bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho rnams: bdag gi dam tshig chen pos 'bod lags na: nā ga'i gdon tshogs 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: drag po dbang chen bsregs sgrub btsod dbal 'dis: sa gsum 'byung po'i srid pa gtan brlag mdzod: pad+ma kro ta ma hā kwa la sarba sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: hūṃ nyi rgya mtsho dug rlung nag po 'byil ba'i klong klu bdud pho mo gan skyal 'gyel ba'i steng: dur

phag nag po mgo dgu 'jigs pa'i khar: dbang chen yang khros nag po bzhugs su gsol: snyen badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan:na re ma reg kun gzhi ka nas dag pa'i zhal: gti mugarmongs pa'i gshed por shar ba'i sku rta mgrin yang khros nag po'i dkyil 'khor la: gnyis 'dzin dag phyir brda yi phyag bgyi'o: sa ma ya na mo hūṃ: ( sdi dbang chen yang gres nag po dgyes bskang phyir: dbang lnga'i me tog tshil chen bdug pa'i spos: zhun gyi mar me mkhris pa'i dri chab dang: sha rus zhal zas rkang gling thod pa'i rnga gzugs sgra dri ro regabya chos la sogs: sman gtor rak+ta dga' ston mtha' yas pa: ting 'dzin rdo rje'i rol mtsho las byung ba'i rnam mang mchod sprin rgya mtsho kun bsdus te: dbang chen yang gsangakhros pa'i dal du 'bul dgyes bzhes bde chen ye shes dngos grub stsol: 37 ma hā byu dza sarba sa ma ya ho: / nyi sgeg dpa' 'dzogs rung rdo rje'i sku yi gar: rgod gshe dragashul rdo rje gsung gi gar: snying rje rngam zhi ye shes thugs kyi gar 'bar ba'i yon tan rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: dbus zhal 'bum gyis dus gsum sa ler gzigs

bsnye: g.yas phyag 'bum gyis srid pa'i drwa ba gcod: g.yon phyag 'bum gyis zhi ba mnyam nyid sgrol: 'khor 'das gzhi rdzogs klong la phyag 'tshal bstod: zhal rnams bsgrad pas skye bzhi zil gyis gnon: tshogs yul mtshan ma rang grol dpa' chas klubs: gzung 'dzin bsregs gtor me rlung 'bar zhing 'khyil: che ba'i yon tan rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: sprul pa'i khro bcu nyi ma'i zer bzhin 'khyug: yang sprul rnams ni skar tshogs bzhin du bkra: las byed pho nya nyi rdul 'khrigs bzhin g.yo: thabs mkhas 'phrin las gter la phyag 'tshal bstod: ho ma rig bag nyal dri ma'i skyon dbang gis: thams cad gdos por bzung ba'i mtshan 'dzin dang: kun rdzob sgyu ma lta bu'i chag nyams kun: dbang chen yang khros lha la bzod par gsol: yi ge brgya pa bzla bzlas dmigs na bdag nyid dbang chen rta mchog rol bar gsal ba'i thugs sha'i sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros: mdun gyi yang khros nag po' thugs rgyud bskul: sku las btsan dug gi ngar rlangs 'phro ba'i chu rgyun byung: dam tshig rdzas la thim: chu de rab tu khol zhing rba rlab
