nam mkha'i dbyings su 'phyo ba: ngad zer gyis 'byung po thams cad 'bog brgyal byed nus pa'i rang bzhin can du gyur bar mos la: yo pad+ma kro ta h+ya skṛ wa ma hā ku la sarba duṣ+ṭi hūṃphaṭa rtsa ba'i snying po'o oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la pra dz+wa la pra dz+wa la nā ga ram̐ ram̐ hūṃ phaṭa: drag po me yi sngags so ma bhurkur tsikho pra ma na ye sur+ya sur+ya dz+wa la dz+wa la bam dz+wa la bam dz+wa la ram̐ ram̐ hūṃ phaṭa: btsodadabal gyi chu khol ba'i sngags so 61 nyibha tibha lcags zhun rnal ma rnal te swā hā: lcags bsregs pa 'i tsha dbal thub pa'i sngags so yis zhi shi su su mkha' zhi sdo(5 dz+wa la ram̐ ram̐: bye ma nus bskyed kyi sngags so oṃ pra sod chu sod: durta sod: durmi sod: gnyan mgo la chod: kha la dza: dzi tha ra ti pa durnye dz+wa la ram̐ pa swā hā: nad yams gag lhog mdze skran zhi phyir sngags pa ra btab pa' sngags so oṃ khyo ga ru ṭa dug khyung tsa le tsa le hūṃ phaṭa: nā ga rā dza mal mal: gul gul tsag tsag: gtubs gtub: khrol khrol: chom chom bsrung bya sa bdag klu gnyan gyis bzung ba thongs bcing pa khrol: phyung phyung khrol cig swā hā: 'di ni gang la' bawa chog pa'i sngags so o lhang lhang tser tser: trig trig: shag shag shel shel hūṃ sum̐: gas pur nan: gnyan sarba ta

pa(: tsi tsi nag po sha ya can dz+wa la ti sarba duṣ+ṭi phaṭa lhog pa sbun dgu ram̐ ram̐: mdze rigs bco brgyad sarba dz+wa la re: 'di na bye ma nus bskyed dang bdug sman byug sman bcodadabal chu kun la nus bskyed dam pa'o sa ma yā de nas las kyi gnad dbab pa yang khros nag po'i bskul ba na bshud glu rol mo sna tshogs sgrogs sbyar spos bdug cing snyan pa' glus 'di nyid dus drug brjod pa ra bya hūṃ jo dmar nag gru gsum e yi klong dkyil nas: rgyal ba kun gyi gsung gi rdo rje che: klu gdon pho mo zil gyis gnon mdzad cing rū tra bsgral ba'i dpa' rtags med byung ngoms che ba'i stobs rdzogs khro tshogs bu yug 'tshubs las byed pho nya nam mkha'i thog ltar 'bebs pad+ma he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'dod spe na brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: steng 'og bar gdon 'byung po'i rgol ba bzlog sa bdag klu gnyan sbyor ba'i dug rnams bzlog: byad phur rbod gtong dus kyi cho 'phrul bzlog: mi nad nor gyi god kha mtha' dag bzlog: bzlog basbyar mdzad pa'i 'phrin las ma g.yel bar mngon spod drag po'i las la rab bzhengs te na ga'i gdon tshogs zil gnon 'phrin las mdzod

dpa' rtags yon tan rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod:'dod lon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: steng gdon gza' dang rgyu skar ma lus pa: 'og gdon sa bdag kluganyan gtod kyi tshogs: bar gdon dregs pa sde brgyad gdug rtsub can thams cad zil gnon sma phob dam la thogs: byad zor gtad mnan phra men sbyor las kun: zhibazlog gzhes zhing brlag pa'i 'phrin las mdzod thugs dam dus la bab po sa ma mā:dza nyid kyi sku gsung thugs las sprul ba yi: dbang chen khro bo'i rgyal po 'thar byed bcu pho nya las byed yang g.yog bsam mtha' yas: dam tshig chen po'i las la da bzhengs shig:brgyan pa'i mchod gtor dam pa 'di bzhes la ma rig dug gsum gdon tshogs zil gnon cing skye med dgongs pas gzir la phyag rgyas thobs: mngon spyod 'phrin las srid na ya mtshan pa'i: drag rtsal khyad chos ston pa'i 'phrin las mdzod: thugs dam

ba:tshu dus la bab po sa ma yā: dza: dregs pa sde brgyad drang srong rā hu la: ging chen rdo rje legs pa la sogs pa'i: rang rang g.yog 'khor sprul pa bsam mtha' yas: mngon spyod drag po'i las la da bzhengs shig: brgyan pa'i mchod gtor dam pa 'di bzhes la: rang rang 'khor du gtogs pa'i dregs pa can dug lnga las skyes gdon sgod sna tshogs pa: dbang du bsdus la zil gnon bka' khrims sdoms ngan gtong sbyor ba sna tshogs rang gnas bsdus: nad gdon grib rigs yams nad zhi bar mdzod:mthong reg kha rlangs dug rnams bsal ba dang: 'phral snang 'gal rkyen bar chad bzlog tu gsol: thugs dam dus la bab po sa ma yu: 31 ā lha: yaḥmaḥtha duḥrak+ṣa: sa pa duḥphuḥdzhaiḥtri gaḥniḥ.a bh+yoXdzaḥdza: a shig shig phyung phyung: khrol khrol swā hā: sngags la rgyun bzung bcod me rab tu sbar chu yi rba rlabs mkha' la 'phyo ba' tshe bcod kyi dbang bskur bsrung bya yongs la sbyin klu chog klu gtor klu gdon dbye bsal bya de nas yas khros nag pa'i sgrub pa yi khrus kyi cho ga nā ga klu 'dul ltar byab da bsrung ba rnams kyang legs par gtong de nas btsod dbal bkram la 'di skad do dza bye bde ba chen pa

pad+ma dbang gi sku 'bar ba'i rang bzhin don la dgyes bzhin du: 'od zer rdo rje me yi tsha tshwa 'khrugs: btsan dug ngad rlangs 'phro ba'i chu rgyun 'di: 'go ba'i lha la mchod pa'i tshul du 'bul: skyobs pa'i lha la bskang ba'i rdzas su 'bul: pho nya sdong grogs gzi byin bskyed byir 'bul: steng gdon gza' dang rgyu skar sbyor btab pa 'bar ba chen po btsod kyi dbal 'dis bsregs bar gdon sde brgyad cho 'phrul btab pa kun 'bar ba chen po btsod kyi dbal 'dis bsregs 'og gdon sa bdag gtod kyis bzung ba kun 'bar ba chen po btsod kyi dbal 'dis bsregs rgyal rigs klu yi phyag rgyas btab pa na: 'bar ba chen po btsod kyi dbal 'dis bsregs: rje'u rigs klu yi kha rlangs reg pa na: 'bar ba chen po btsod kyi dbal 'dis bsregs: dmangs rigs klu yi mche bas btab pa na: 'bar ba chen po btsod kyi dbal 'dis bsregs gdol ba nag pos bzung zhing bsdam pa na: 'bar ba chen po btsod kyi dbal 'dis bsregs: 'dzin shes gtong mi shes pa 'i cho 'phrul kun: 'bar ba chen po btsod kyi dbal 'dis

gas/: bsregs: phyags brnyan gdug rtsub can gyis bzung ba na: 'bar ba chen po btsod kyi dbal 'dis bsregs: phyi ru lus kyi mtshan ma bag chags bkru:nang du sems kyi zug rngu sna tshogs bsal: thams cad mi gnas stong pa chen por brdal: dag gsal nogs med ngang du ṛ ye khe: glu nā ga du na tsadhe tsasnye mi li mi li sarba bhi ṣa ta ra phaṭa swā hā: 'byung ba lnga la rten bcas pa'i sa bdag klu gnyan gtod dang dregs pa sde brgyad kyi bsam sbyor ngan pas bzung ba thams cad btsod dbal drag pos zhi zhing stong par mdzod cig: dbang pho gyi sku rten dang phyag mam bras pa spyi bor bkod la 'di skad do trī baṃ: ma rig gnyis snang rū tra'i gshed shar ba: dbang gi rgyal po pad+ma he ru ga: bde ba'i sku can 'bar ba'i gar mdzad pa: sa gsum gdon tshogs mtshan thos tsam gyis 'bog: sku mthong brgyal bar 'gyur ba lta ci smos: dbang chen pad+ma'i bka' rtags phyag rgya cha bod khams lha 'dre yongs la bzhag pa ni: las 'phros bskul tshe dbang chen bzhad pa yis snyigs ma'i gdon sgod bsam sbor phyin log rnams: 'bras bu mya ngan zug rnga sgol ba'i

phyir: rdo rje'i bkas gzir dam rtags phyag rgyas bcing: 'da' 'khu sdog par mi nus snying la gzir: thams cad dkar phyogs skyong ba'i grwal mthar tshud: phyin ci log rnams snying bsregs thal bar brlag: de phyir rgyal ba'i bka' la gnas par gyis: rig 'dzin yongs kyi dam tshig bzhin du sgrubs: tha tshig 'di las ma 'da' sa ma yā: ( badz+ra phaṭa zhes brjod la bka' rtags kya phyag rgya gtad cing sbra khyim gong shing la bzhugs su gsol nas me tog 'thor ro de ltar dbang chen yang khros nag po yi 'bar ba mer brten bsregs sgrub zab mo 'dis steng gdon gza' dang rgyu skar gnod pa dang de la gtad du bcol ba kun thub 'gyur bar gdon dregs pa sde brgyad cho 'phrul da de dag la byas mthu byad gtad rnams grol 'og gdon sa bdag klu gnyan rgol ba dang de dag la gtad byad mnan thams cad grol ban bon mu stegs sha za 'dre pha tshogs gang gis sbyor ba'i mthu gtad byad zor thub dgra la bab na nus pa thog las che bgegs la bab na rtsa kung me 'phrad bzhin 'di yis mi thub mi 'dul gang yang med gdug rtsub cho 'phrul shin tu che ba'i na sangs rgyas bstan pa'i phyir dang rang gi don rdo rje slob dpon mched grogs dam ldan phyir sbyin bdag dad can bka' dam gnas pa las su yang rung bar 'di nyid byar mi rung mang du sgrub na dregs pa yo

bas/: log ste rnal 'byor rang gi srog la nges pa ra 'bab de phyir gzu bor gnas bzhin gces par zungs rang gzhan don gnyis sgrub pa'i thabs la brtson zab chos 'di nyid shin tu gnyan pas na bsdamaspel mkhas pa bla ma'i bka' bzhin gyis de tshe rno nus nam mkha'i mtha' da mnyam the tshom med do rdo rje pad+ma'i bka' sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya e ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen ngo yis thugs kyithig le zab gsang rdor snying skor shin tu zab pa dbang chen sgrub skor 'di gsung gi bka' babargyal mchog khyod la gtad da lta spel ba' dus la ma bab pas rin chen brda la bstims shigs ra bye mdo khams bkra shas rdzong der dgongs rgya bsdams ma 'ongs snyigs ma nad mtshon gzeng lang skabs dpa' bo khyod nyidanus ldan rdo rjer bzhengs bka' bab chos bdagarma ban ṛn mchog dang rka ba dpal brtsegs rgyal ba bya chub da 'o bran dbang phyug ldanam rtse mang sogs de yi grogs su 'gyur zhing bstan pa spel bshad sgrub grags snyan byang gi pha mthar brdal 'brel tshad don ldan rig 'dzan zhi du 'god bka' 'di srungs shig btsan rgod ya le ber dam nyams lag tu ma shoraspu gri gsum las can thugs kya sras dang 'phrad par shog sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya btsod sgrub zab pa'i rgya mdud zhes bya ba rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i

bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzasabakod pa'o brda thim snyi zhes pa 'di'ang lung zin sku skyes pad+ma bsod namasagrub pa'i rdo rjes bkra shis lha reg bde bar gshegs pa 'i sku gsung thugs rten dri med ras gzan dkar po sogasakyi skyes du mar bcathate 'bad rtsol nan tan chen pos ya yang bskul ngor/ 7 kho bo dbang chen gsung gi rdo rjes mdo khams tsa ri byung gnas mdun nas mkha' 'gro'i gas brda zab mo dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni chosabadag de nyid kyas bgyis pa phyogs dus gnas skabs kun tu dge zhing bkra shis pa' rgyur gyur cig sarba masgo la/
badz+ra cha zab gsang rdo rje snying po las:dbang chen pad+ma bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal gyi:'phroṃn las gtod 'dul dbal chu'i kha bskang ye shes me yi 'khor lo zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

btsarnyi na mo gu ru padha ka ra ye: rgashāmadza)chenaX/ bdeba'i sku mchog pad+ma he ru ka dab gi rgyal po snying dbus ze'u 'byur mchod sgrub pa zab mo mtha' ru phyin pa dang dngos grub rgya mtshogegs med 'byung ba'i phyir rab 'bar dbal chu'i lasakyi kha skong ba shin tu gces pa'i yan lag lta bu bstan sa ma yu 'di la las kyi rim pa brgyad du mchis thog mar khri skang thod rgyed btsug pa ni hūṃ ༷sa ya rgyan rang byung dur khrod chen po rtsa nges par dpe blang don gnyis 'byung ba'i byir sgrub pa zab mo sbyor dngos rjes gsum brtsam: gegs med phun sum tshogs par dbang byin phob: shā nyim rig mtshan ma dbyings su gzhom pa'i phyir: ye shes me yis dkyil 'khor sbyang bar bya: thod pa skam po dri za 'joms pa'i rdzas: sa 'og bgegs kyis sbyor ba bshig pa'i phyir: shar gyi thod sgyed dbang chen bro ra bca': zhe sdang rgyas pa'i 'byung po dbyings su sgrol: e maṇ+ḍal dzha: thod pa rnyid pa snyems byed bdud 'joms rdzas: sa steng 'byung pos sbor ba bshigs pa'i byir: lho yi thod sted dbang chen bro ra bca': gti mug rmongs pa'i sems can dbyings su sgol yemaṇ+ḍal sbyo: thod pa rlon pa nyon mongs bdud 'joms

btsan rdzas: sa bla'i 'byung pos rgol sbyor tshar gcod phyir: nub kyi zod sgyed ma tshogs bro ra bca': 'dod chags 'khrugs pa'i sems can dbyings su bsgral: e maṇ+ḍal je: pa hrīḥ rgyal rigs rje rigs dmangs rigs bram ze'u rigs: gdol ba nag pos ngan sbyor sna tshogs pa: mthong ba'i dug dang kha rlangs reg pa'i dug btab dang zos pablo dug rnams phyir bsal phyir: dbang chen klu 'dul pad+ma te ru bskul sku gsum lhun grub thod pa'i sgyed pu bca' bde ba chen po'i me yang thabs kyis sbar: gsal ba chen po'i chu yang rnam par bskyil zung 'jug thabs kyis 'phrin las gzhan don bskul: sgrub pa zab mo mtha' ru phyin pa dang: sa 'og klu gnyan gdug rtsub tshar gcod phyir:ye shes nus dbal phun sum tshogs gyur cig: ram spa ra ṇa phaṭa: se ha ra ṇa 〉: zhes brjod la ra chen gsum gyi rdo blang nas thod rgyed bca' lu pa gsum gyi chu bla nas za sa dkar dmar gnyis rim gya na du bskyil ba dmar po da ra nag po rta dkar po gsum gyi 'o mas dkar rtsa bkye rdo sol dang li shi tsha ba'i shis 'thag pa 'i phye btab sgron shing la bza drug zhun mar dang sbyar nas 'bar me bya tsher shing gsum gyi sol ba me

tshang du bca' la de ru dbang chen yab yum kyi dkyil 'khor du mos te me sbar ro sa ma yu las rim da po'o rgya rgya rgya me la nus ngar bskyed ci byin dbab pa na sha chen gya dud pa btang sbyar spos bzang po bsregs rol mo snatshogs bsgrags nas 'ad skad do hūṃ dza: ma chags pad+ma dbang gi dkyil 'khor nas: bde ba'i sku can pad+ma he ru da: khro rgyal yongs kyi gsung gi rdo rje che: ru dra 'dul ba'i dpa' rtags gtsug na spa nā ga klu tshogs 'dul ba'i dam tshig can rab 'bar dbal chu'i las la da bzhengs shig: rno nus stobs rtsal mthu shugs bskyed du gsol: hū dza rgyal rigs klu yis sbyor ba bshigs pa'i phyir: thugs kyi dbang chen mthing gsal nam mkha'i sku: chos kyi dbyings las gnas 'dir skur bskyod la: gti mug 'khrul ba ka dag gzi byin phob: rje rigs klu yis sbyor ba bshig pa'i phyir: sku yi dbang chen dkar gsal shel gyi sku: me long ye shes dbyings las skur bskyod la: zhe sdang ka nas dag pa'i gzi byin phob: dmangs rigs kla yis sbor ba bshig pa'i phyir yon tan dbang chen ser gsal gser gyi sku: mnyam nyid ye shes dbyings las skur bsgrod la: nga rgyal ka nas dag

btsan pa'i gzi byin phob: bram ze'u klu yis sbyor ba bshig pa'i phyir gsung gi dbang chen dmar gsal rā ga'i mdog sor rtog ye shes dbyings nas skur bskyod la: 'dod chags ka nas dag pa'i gzi byin phob: gdol ba klu yis sbyor ba bshig pa'i phyir: las kyi dbang chen ljang gsal in+t+ra'i mdog: bya grub ye shes dbyings nas skur bskyod la phrag dog ka nas dag pa'i gzi byin phob: nyu 1 chags pa'i rdo rje pad+ma he ru ga'i: dbang gi 'od zer khro bo 'chol ba'i tshogs: skye med dbyings las gzugs kyi rgyar bzhengs la: 'bar ba chen po grub pa'i gzi byin phob: steng gdon zil gnon ye shes 'khyil ba'i las: bar gdon tshar gcod rab 'bar me yi dpal: 'og gdon drungs 'byin btsod dbal nus mthu'i stobs: phun tshogs gegs med 'byung ba'i gzi byin phob: glu pad+ma kro ta rā dza sarba sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: a we sha ya a yisaḥ zhes brjod cing dbang gi g.yab dar da byan pheb pa' phyag rgya las sna tshogs su bya'o sa ma yu las ram gnyas pa'o rgya rgya rgya de nas btsod sgrub dbal chu'i gzhung khog phub ltar du legs par bya bar skabs sgrub dmigs

bsdus pa ni re ye kho: me chu rlung gis bskal pa stong: gzung 'dzin srid pa'i drwa ba bshig: stong gsal bde ba chen por brdal: de yi ngang las skad cig gi: snang ba dbang chen rol ba'i dal: srid pa dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i zhing: brda don rtags rdzogs bkod pas brgyan: dur khrod thod mkhar me rlung 'khrigs: rin chen khri skang pad nyi'i khar gdolab pho mo bsnol ba'i steng: rig pa hū mazeng yongs gyur ba'i: dbang chen nā ga klu 'dul ni: mthing nag char sprin 'khrigs 'dra'i sku: spyan gsum sdang mig glog ltar 'byug zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche bzhi gtsigs: drag po'i gad rgyang hi ya sgrogs smra smin me yi 'od zer 'phro: dmar ser ral pa mkha' la bskyil: thod rgyanato zhal rngam glu sgrogs: sa gsum 'byung po 'dar zhing sngangs: dri ngan dpag tshad rgyang grags 'phro: rgyal bsen 'bog rgyal rengs bar byed: phyag g.yas gnam lcags rdo rje gdengs: dug lnga'i 'khrul ba rming nas bshigs: g.yon pas sbrul nag dam du bsdams: sa bdag klu gnyan gtod tshogs 'dul: dur khrod dpal chas rgyan du klubs: me rlung dug zer sprin

bas/ 7 ltar 'tshubs: zhabs bsgrad klu gdon pho mo gnon: las byed thabs kyi pho tshogs kyis: rgya mtsho chu yi dbal ngar bskyed shes rab rang bzhin ma tshogs kyis: rab 'bar me yi dbal ngar byung: gnyis med zuja 'jug sras tshogs kyis: btsod dbal 'gro ba'i don du bskul: rdo rje ging gi tshogs rnams kyis: gtor sdud 'brin las thabs mkhas byed: pad+ma ging gi tshogs rnams kyis: 'byin dbyung mdzad pa sna tshogs ngom: dregs pa'i dmag tshogs thams cad kyis sri 'dul 'byung po tshar gcod byed kun kyang gco 'dza ra tha mi dad ye shes sgyu 'phrul dal du shar: kun gyi srog yig las spros pa'i 'od kyis ye shes lha tshogs bskul: spyan drangs gnyis su med par bsre skabs 'dar spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal mchod bstod las gzhu gang rung ltar du bya bzlas dmigs ni bdag pad+ma dbang chen he ru ga'i thugs ga'i sngags 'khor las 'od zer 'phros: nā ga klu 'dul gyi wa tshogs rnams la phog: 'gro ba' don du thugs rgyud bskul zhing sku las dbal ngar tsha ba'i chu rgyun byung ste rab tu khol zhing lud: de yi 'od zer gyis mthu gtad

byad phur klu gnyan gtod kyis sbyor ba'i dug thams cad tshar bcad cing yongs su skem par mos: 37 nā ga rā dza mal mal gul gul tshag tshag gtubs gtubs khrol khrol chomachom sa bdag klu gnyan gyis bzung ba thongs bcing pa 11la cig phyes phyes swā hā drag sngags stobs rdzogs me dpung 'di ting 'dzin ldan pas ci nus bzla 'phrin las rab 'byams lhun gyis grub the tshomamed do sa ma yu 3 ka ru ka ru kho ru kho ru nu ru nu dz+wa la ram̐ ram̐ hūṃ phaṭa: nus pa bskyed pa'i sngags rgod 'ad bye ba bzlas pas mngon spyod lasab 3 bha sod bha sod tibha tibha dz+wa la ram̐ ram̐ tsakra hūṃ phaṭa 'di ni 'bar ba'i sngags rgod de chu la me yi dbal ngar thon me la chu yi bsal dang ldan rlung bzhan kun tu 'phyo zhing 'khyil rtags mtshan ya mtshan rmad byung 'byung sa ma mā las rim gsum pa'o rgya rgya rgya de nas grub rtagasa'abyung ba'i tshe tsha chu nus ngar ldan pa de shing sna lnga yis blang byas nas bsrung bya'i mgo lus kun tu bkram bden tshag rdo rje' glu dbyangs kyis hū bh+yo dza:che chen pad+ma dbang gi gzi byin can: bde ba'i sku mchogarta mgrin rgyal po dgongs: 'gro ba'i mthun snang legs yon dpal 'phel phyir: dbang chen yab yum gnyis med bde sbyor chab: bsrung bya rnams kyi lus la rtag tu bye 'byung

ba tshu ba bzhi las gyur ba'i nad dang gdon skye 'gags med pa'i dbyings su re ye kho: dug lnga las byung rnam rtog nad rnams kun: spros kun bral ba'i ngang du re ye kho: sa bdag klu gnyan gtod kyi nad rnams kun ma skyes brjod bral ngang du re yi kho: byad phur hom zor phra men dmod sbyor kun: lhag med chos kyi dbyings su re ye kho rgyal bsen dregs pa las byung gdug rtsub kun: sgrib bral de bzhin nyid du re ye kho: sa pad+ma spyo ta h+ya ṣ+ṭṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa: bla pra 'u da chu sod: durta sod: durmi sod gnyan matre la chod: kha la dza: thim tha ra ti sa durnye dz+wa la ram̐ pa ye swā hā: lus kya cha shas kun tu bkru sgo gsum ma 'dod skyon kun zha byad gtad zor gya g.yul las rgyal byad gtad nad gdon kun las grol sa ma yā las rim bzhi pa'o rgya rgya rgya de nas bal 'dab dkar po'i ste du rdo dkar bsregs pa bzhag phye gsur dang lhum rtsa 'thag pa'i bye rnams bsreg cing bdug dud pa yon bdag rnams la phog pa ra byas te 'di skad do hūṃ dza dmar nag gru gsum dbang gi gzhal yas su tsho bdud pho mo bsnol ba'i khri steng nas: dbang gi rgyal po pad+ma he ru ga: sprul pa phra min phyag brnyan tshogs dang bcas

gnad nas bskul lo dbyings nas da bzhengs shig: dug gsum gdon 'dul 'phrin las dus la bab: dza gti mug rmongs pa'i 'khrul zhing smyos pa rnams: bdag 'dzinadabang gis 'gro la gnod cing rgol: mthong reg kha rlangs bsam sbyor dug gis btabs: mi 'dod 'tshubs ma zug rngu sna tshogs bslangs: nyes pa'i tshogs rnams gtan nasabazlog pa'i phyir bdag nyid dbang chen pad+ma he ru gas: pho tshogs g.yas nas 'gyed cing bro ra brdung: mo tshogs g.yon nas bskul zhing gar gyis bsgyur: rdo rje'i ging tshogs klu gdon gshed du spro sku las 'phros pa'i btsan dug ngad rlangs dang: dri ma mi zhim dpag tshad spro bsdu yis: klu chen rigs lnga bros shing rengs bar byed: gdol ba nag po 'bog cing brgyal bar byed: mthong ba'i dug rnams ma lus phyir phyungs shig: reg pa'i dug rnams ma lus phyir phyungs shig: kha rlangs btang ba'i dug rnams phyir phyungs shig mche ba btab pa'i dug rnams phyir phyungs shig nad gdon rkyen dang bar chad phyir phyungs shig: mdze rigs bco brgyad ma lus phyir phyungs shig: dreg dang grum bu'i tshogs

ba tshu rnams phyir phyungs shig: mthu gtad ser gsum ma lus phyir phyungs shig: rten 'brel nyes pa'i tshogs rnams phyir phyungs shig: legs tshogs yon tan gong nas gong 'phel mdzod: tsho āḥ( ya ma tha du rakū pa sa ti phu dṛ triḥka ṇi a bh+yo dza dza: a shig shig phyung phyung khrol khrol swā hā: che ge mo klu gdol ba nag pos bzung ba thongs:bcing pa khrol: bsdam pa 〈snad: mnan pa khyog: zos pa skyugs gtad du bcug pa phyung phyung khrol khrol swā hā: ca rigs brjod la rdzas sngags nus pa 'a byin rlabs bdar ro bsrung bya gal chen ma gtogs par las 'di bya bar ma rung ro sa ma yu las rim lnga pa'o rgya rgya rgya de nas 'bru brgya'i mar dang khyim bya'i khrag bying ba'i gzugs rdul du btags pa'i phye snams bsres te ril bu bdun btsod dbal gyi nang du blugs la 'di skad do dza bh+yo: chos can mtshan ma ka nas dag pa'i dbyings: chos nyid bde ba chen po'i klong yangs nas: rgyal ba kun gyi gsung gi rdo rje che: dbang chen pad+ma bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal: spral pa yang spral nam mkha'i mthar mnyam pa: ste med dbyings las gzugs kyi phyag rgyar bzhengs: sna tshogs thabs dang rten 'brel mdzad mkhas pas: dug

gsum gdon tshogs rdul du brlag pa'i phyir: rdzas rnams khro rgyal khyung gi sku ru gyur: rno dbal dug chu rab tu khol zhing lud: gar dmigs gdon la thogs pa med par 'debs: lus ngag yid gsum thal bar brlag pa dang nad dang dug rigs mdze grum sna tshogs pa: mi gnas stong pa chen por rab bsregs te: phun tshogs legs pa'i dpal yon rgyas gyur cig: ma khro ga ru ṭa nag po ti pa rā tsa phe khyi ma hūṃ bh+yo dza dza: o lhang lhang tser tser drig drig shag shag shel shel thum thum gas par nan sod: nā ga du na nag po sod: nag po sod: nā ga 'dus: nā ga 'dus: phe le kwa la rū pa hūṃ phaṭa sngags brjod cang chu gnas khang tho phyi kun tu bkram zhing mi nor thams cad la bgyi'o sa bdag klu gnyan nad dang gdon rkyen ngan bar chad thams cad kun mi gnas stong pa nyid du sangs the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka' sa ma yu las rim drug pa'o rgya rgya rgya de nas khyung dar phyogs kun tu bzor zhing bzlog pa'i las bcol ba ni dza bye pad+ma dbang chen gsung gi dkyil 'khor nas che ba'i stobs rdzogs nā ga klu 'dul ni: skye med dbyings las gzugs kyi phyag rgyar bzhengs: sprul pa khyung nag bu yug 'tshubs bzhin

ba:tshu du:brgyan pa'i mchod gtor dam pa 'di bzhes la bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas rnams rgyal rigs klu yis bcing pa bzlog tu gsol rje'u rigs klu yis bcing pa bzlog tu gsol: bram ze'u klu yis bcing pa bzlog tu gsol: dmangs rigs klu yis bcing pa bzlog tu gsol: gdol ba nag pos bcing pa bzlog tu gsol: sa bdag rigs kyis bcing pa bzlog tu gsol: gnyan gtod rnams kyis bcing pa bzlog tu gsol: nad rigs sum brgya drug bcu bzlog tu gsol: bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams bzlog tu gsol:stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs rnams bzlog tu gsol:ye 'grogs nyi khri cig stong bzlog tu gsol:mdze dreg grum bu'i nad rnams bzlog tu gsol: lhog pa sgrang lo'i nad rnams bzlog tu gsol: rgya 'byum chu bur lug mig bzlog tu gsol: skem pa g.yem pa'i nad rnams bzlog tu gsol: dgra bgegs yongs kyi rgol ba bzlog tu gsol: bzlog cig bsgyur cig sdang ba'i dgra la bzlog:sprul pa khyung chen 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams dang: dbang chen pad+ma gsung gi bden stobs

kyis: mi mthun phyogs rnams zhi zhing stong bar mdzod: e ka sa ma ya bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog e sa sa ma ya bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog: de ltar bzlog pa'i 'phrin las 'di grangs ldan bsgrangs tshe 'phral rkyen zhi sa ma pā las rim bdun pa'o rgya rgya rgya de nas gtor zor sdeb pa ni hū dza: mchog gsum sku gsum rtsa gsum bden stobs dang: bden gnyis baglu ba med pa'i nus mthu dang:dbang chen bdud dpung zil gnon byin rlabs kyis nyon mongs las skyes dug gsum 'khrul ba'i gdon: sa bdag klu gnyan rgyal bsen 'byung po'i tshogs: rdul phran bzhin du brlag par bya ba'i phyir: dpal gyi gtor zor mtshon cha 'bar ba 'di sdang ba'i dgra la rbad do mthu ma chung: gnod pa'i bgegs la bzor ro rtsal ma zhan: yid la brnag pa'i 'byung po gnyis 'dzin bgegs: thal ba rdul du rlog cig mā ra ya: thun ya thun ya zor ya zor ya sa bdag klu gnyan gtod kyi srog snying la rbad bh+yo: mā ra ya phob dza phob dza: gtor ma dgra gzugs steng du sdeb las kyi shul mi mngon par bya des ni dgra dpung rdul brlag 'gyur the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka' sa ma mā las ram brgyad pa'o rgya rgya rgya de ltar btsod dpal drag po'i las sus byas

btsa( 'phral snang skyen las rgyal yan lag zha grum thamasacad grol 'go 'khor snying 'dar snying 'phar zhi steng 'og bar gdon grib rigs byang 'phral snang ma lugasel bar 'gyur byin rlabs yon tan bsam mtha'ayas bden rdzun lag tu lo sa dang gsal sa ma yā tshem rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis thugs kyi thig le dbang chen gsung gi chos man ga mtha' brgyan nā ga klu 'dul skor snyigs mamisems can skyobs phyir yongs su bstan da dung spel ba'i dus la ma bab pa sa rin chen brda la bstemasashigasar bye mdo khams bkra shisardzong der dgongs pra sdoms ma 'ongs snyigasam nad mtshon gzeng langs skabs rgyal mchag sprul ba nus ldan rdo rje dang 'phrad nas bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel bar 'gyur bka' 'di sru sa shig btsan rgod yang le ber dam nyams lag tu ma shor thub par srungs sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya kha bskang las rim brgyad pa rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpo na pad+ma saṃ bha wa' bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda thim snyi ces pa 'di'ang sung min pa d+ma'i mtshan can gyis bkra shis dge ba'i skyes dumar bcas te nan dan chen pos bskul ro ra/ kho bo rgyal mtshago bzhad pa rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i 'phrul brda las zhal bshus te dag pa ra pha ba pa 'i yi ge pa ni chos bdag nyid kyis brgyas pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga le/
badz+ra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: dbang chen bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal la brten pa'i las bzhi'i sreg blugs 'phrin las lhun grub zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

—41 na mo gu ru pad+ma kwa ra ye: za za )/ 'bar ba'i gze byin 'byug pa' 'od zer gyis gang bsam 'phrin las nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam spel bde stong dga' bzhi'i ro yis gdul bya'ikhams dbang chen gsung gi rdo rjer bkod la 'dud ma 'ongs lasacan skal bzang pho mo yis dbang chen gzhung bsri sa brten sgrub lhu len tshe lasasbyor 'dzan las rnam bzhi lhun grub phyir thabs mtshog 'bar ba me yi las sbyorabastan sa ma yu de yang las mthun sreg dkyil spyi ltar bya hom gyi shing dang thab rgya las mthun ltar bsreg rdzas mchod pa yo byad gzhung mthun bya me dar rlung g.yab 'bar me rang gnas 'khod rnal 'byor chas gos zhi rgyas dbang drag tshul zhal gyi kyu phyogs las mthun ltar du shes de nas sreg rdzas byan gyis brlabs pa ni sa a hū: thabs dang shes rab sbyor las byung ba yi phyi nang gsang mchod 'dod yon mtha' yas pa sreg rdzas longs spyod lnga ldan phung por gyur: dbang chen gsung gi rdo rje'i dgyes pa bskangs oṃ tsos/: badz+ra pañtsa a mṛ ta shirnyi puṣ+ṭi wa shaṃ ma ra ya phaṭa swā hā: de nas me rbar rim pa ni hā hri0 me yi ngo bo bde chen snang mtha' yas rang bzhin mtshan ma'i las nyon bag chags bsregs: rol ba 'phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med sgrab: don dam dbang chen zla

badz+ra gsang lhun gyis grub: pad+ma kro ta pradzñā dzñā na dz+wa la ram̐:de nas rlung g.yab thogs la hūṃ hrīrlung gingo bo dam tshig sgrol ma'i dbyings:rang bzhin thabs chen bdebar bskul ba'i las:rol pa 'phrin las gnad la dbab pa'i thabs:dam tshig las kyis bskul la phyag rgyas btabs yon/ ru phyo dre ye swā hā:de nas thab kha lha bskyed ri snyen ma hā shurgye ta sogasako3nya:mi dachags ka dag chos sku'i rang bzhin las:lhun grub ye shes sgyu 'phrul gzhal med khang:sgo gru rta babs mtshan nyid phun tshogs dbus:gza' kludregs pa pho mo bsnol ba'i steng:shādamar las byung dbang chen he ru ga dmar gsal pad+ma rā ga'i gzi byin 'khyug:zhal gdengs ljags 'dril rno dkar mche ba gtsigs:hahi3phaṭa gad rgyang 'byug ltar sgrogs:gar dgu'i nyams rdzogs dur khrod dpal chas brgyan:dbu gtsug ral gsebarta mgo ljang zhur mtsher rngog ma le brgan ye shes me ltara'abar:phyag g.yas ral gris gzung 'dzin mtshan ma gcod:g.yon pas lcags kyus dregs tshogs dbang du bsdud:zhabs gnyis gyad kyis log 'dren bdud tshogs gnon

bde ba'i rang bzhin rdo rje phag mo mthing: zhi ma khro 'dzum spyan gsum glog ltar 'byug: dmar ser ral gseb phag skad ngur glu len rus rgyan mgo 'phreng gzig sham dar dpyangs brgyan: yab yum gnyis med bde ba chen por sbyor: g.yas phyogs thabs kyi cha 'dzin byi la'i gdong g.yon du shes rab rang bzhin pu shud mdza mi lpags go bgos sbrul chun thod phreng brgyan: shes rab ral gri sgrol byed phur bu 'dzin: gtum rngams rab 'jigs dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar: de yi phyi rol zil gnon khro chen brgyad: yab yum gnyis med bde ba chen por bzhugs: tshad med rang gdangs las mdzad sgo ba bzhi: pho nya khyi spyang dmus 'o nga rgyab sbrel tshogs: 'brug bzhi 'dabs brgyad ma 'dres yongs rdzogs shar rtsa ba'i 'khor lo'i ye shes lnga ldan klong: sgrub sde brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs shar: spyi gtsug rigs bdag pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal: zhi ma khro 'dzum he ru ka pa'i chas: rdo rje rnal 'byor gnyis med 'khril sbyor rol: phyag g.yas gri gug g.yon pas bhan+ta 'dzin rgya bod lo paṇa rig 'dzin spro bsdu 'byed: 'ja' 'od lnga klong dwangs ma'i

badz+ra phung por bzhugs: kun gyi gnas gsum rdo rje'i sa bon las: 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum rab spros te: phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus dang: dbang chen bdud dpung zil gnon lha tshogs rnams: phyag rgya yig 'bru 'ja' 'od thig le dang: phyag mtshan sna tshogs rnam par sib sib bstem: dam ye ro gcig bde ba chen por gyur: de nas spyan 'dren bya ba na hūṃ spyi dbus mtha' med pa bde chen pad+ma brtsegs: zla gam chos 'byung dbang chen dkyil 'khor nas: bdud dpung zil gnon pad+ma gsung gi wa yab yum sras 'khor ma lus bka' sdod bcas: dgongs pa'i dbyings su gshegs bzhugs med mod kyang: thugs rjes gdul bya skyong phyir gshegs su gsol: bdud dpung zil gyis gnon pa 'i 'brin las mdzod: snye pad+ma kro ta sarba sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: de nas bzhugs su gsol ba na hūṃ snyi nyi zla zung 'jug dregs pa sde brgyad steng:bdud bzhi pho mo smi chings bstsol ba'i khar: dbang chen pad+ma gsung gi lha tshogs rnams: gnyis med ro gcig bde ba chen por bzhugs: cha pad+ma kro ta sarba sa ma yā tiṣ+ṭha wan:

de nas phyag 'tshal ba ni na ce kun khyab ye shesamatha' dbus mi dmigs pa ye nas dbang chen gsung gi 'khor lor bzhugs: ngo mtshar rang ngo rig pas phyag bgyi'o: 'du 'bral med pa'i ngang du thugs rjes bzhes: ma pad+ma spo ta hṝ na mo na ma ho: de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni ཿhrīḥ gzung bas ma gos phyi mchod sprin ltar gtibs me tog bdug spos par me dri zhal rol: 'dod yon lha mos bde stobs gar bsgyur bcas dbang chen pad+ma gsung gi lha la 'bul: ma badz+ra pur+sha dhub pe a lo ke ghadhe ne+e widu shabha pra tits+tsha ye swā hā:ཿhrīḥ 'dzin pa'i ma gosanang mchod 'ja' ltar 'khyug: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos la sogs bde stong lha mos gar bsgyur bcas te stobs dbang chen gsung gi dkyil gabor dgyes pa bskangs: ma badz+ra du pa shabha gharnye rā sa sparnye dharma pra tits+tsha ye swā hā: hūhrīḥ chags pas ma gosagasang mchod bde stong sprin: sgeg 'byang glu gar dga' ster mdza' na mo: yid 'ong 'dzum zhal ngoms pa'i gar dang bcas: dbang chen gsung gi dkyil 'khor dgyes pa bskangs: ma badz+ra wā phye mā phye girti nirti dī wi a nu rā ga sarba byu dza de hūṃ:

ba:tshu hūṃ 〉rtsa brgyad stong sbyar pañtsa a mṛ ta chags pa rab bsgral rak+ta dmar chen po:mtshan 'dzin rnam dag 'dod yon bha ling ta:ye shes rol ston ḍāk+ki'igar dang bcas:pad+ma dbang chen dkyil 'khor dgyes phyir 'bul:yi ma hā pañtsa rak+ta bha ling ta phyu dza khā hi:/ hrīthabs dang tsharas rab sbyor ba'i bcud chen po:bdag 'dzinamatshan ma bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus rmad byung ting 'dzin sgyu 'phrul ltad mo'i sprin:thams cad pad+ma dbang chen dgyes phyir 'bul:yin ma hā sta na gha ṇa bo dhi tsit+ta sa ma dhi pū dza sa maya ho:de nas sbyor skyems 'bul ba ni hūṃ nyi thabs dang shes rab sbyor las byung ba yi:rtsi bcud 'byung ba'i dwangs ma kun bsdus te:zag med ye shes mchod pa'i mchog chen pos dbang chen bdud dpung zil gnon dgyes pa bskangs rtsa sngags mthar sarba pañtsa a pro ta khā hi:nyer gcig phul pas dgyes pa bskangs de nas zha ba'i rdzas 'bul ni hūṃ ༷ tshad med snyeng rdzechen po'i rang bzhin las:zhi ba'i 'phrin las lhan gyis grab pa'i rdzas 'bra mchog til dang zas mchog gas ri dbang chen bdud dpung zil gnon lha la 'bul:rtsa sngags

mthar ma hā sarba byu dza khā hi: nad gdon 'jigs brgyad shirnyi ku ru ye swā hā: de nasa'adod gsol gdab pa na ho: dbang chen pad+ma bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal gyi lha tshogs khyed rnamasal zhal zas sreg blugs gyis mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba'i byin rlabs la brten nas bdag cag rnal 'byor sgrub pa po rnams kyi nad gdon 'jigs brgyad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad dang 'phral skyen ngan pa thams cad zhi zhing stong pa'i 'phrin las dam pa mdzod cig: de nas rgyas pa'i dzos 'bul na hūṃ trīḥ tshad med byams pa chen po'i rang bzhin las:byung ba'i yam shing zhun mar 'bras dkar dang: bsrung ba'i rgyal po ku sha dur wa sogs: dbang chen gsung gi dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: rtsa sngags mthar ma hā sarba byu dza khā hi:tshe bsod dpal 'byor puṣ+ṭi ku ru ye swā hā: de nas 'dod gsol gdab pa ni: ho dbang chen pad+ma bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal gyi lha tshogs khyed rnams la zhal zas sreg blug kyi mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba'i byin rlabs la brten nas bdag cag rnal 'byor sgrub pa po rnams kyi tshe bsod dpal 'byor ye shes yon tan nyams rtogs thams cad zla ba yar gyi ngos

084 bzhin gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig: de nas dbang ga rdzas 'bul ni hūṃ nyi tshad med dga' ba chen po'i rang bzhin las: byung ba'i 'tsho byed bzang drug sman sna dang: li khri mtshal chen ghi haṃ rak+ta dang: bstan pa rgyas phyir sngags byang shing thog sogs: dbabhe chen gsung gi dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: rtsa sngags mthar ma hā sarba pū dza khā hi: khams gsum srid gsum 'dod rgu'i dpal yon sarba wa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: de nas 'dod gsol gdab pa ni ho: dbang chen pad+ma bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal gyi lha tshogs khyed rnams la zhal zas sreg blugs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba'i byin rlabs la brten nas bdag cag rnal 'byor sgrub pa po rnams kyi mthun rkyen zas nor longs spyod 'dod rgu'i dpal yon khams gsum mos bzhi thams cad dbang du 'du ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig: de nas drag po 'a rdzas 'bul na / nyi tshad med btang snyoms chen po'i rang bzhin las: byung ba'i stobs bskyed ma hā bha la ya: bgegs 'joms yungs dkar dgra bgegs sha rus khrag: dbang chen bdud dpung zil gnon dgyes phyir 'bul: rtsa sngags mthar

ma hā sarba pū dza khā hi: bstan dang 'gro la 'tshe ba'i gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa swā hā: de nas 'dod gsol gdab pa ni ho dbang chen pad+ma bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal gyi lha tshogs khyed rnams la zhal zas sreg blugs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba'i byin rlabs la brten nas bdag cag rnal 'byer sgrub pa po rnams kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad nad gdon zug ngu slong ba'i dgra bgegs dam sri 'byung po thams cad mngon spyod drag pos tshad gcod pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig: jos sngags brgya stong khri 'bum sogs gang 'os brjod la dgyes pa bskangs de yis 'phrin las rab 'byams 'grub mchog thun dngos grub gegs med thob sa ma yu de nas rdzas 'dus 'bul ba ni hū hrīḥ gdul zhing 'a11 ba ma lus bder babo/da phyir:'phrin las rnam bzhi grub pa'i rdzas mchog rnams: gcig tu bsdus te dbang chen lha la 'bul: gang bsam 'dod don ma lus lhun grub mdzod: rtsa sngags mthar ma hā sarba byu dza khā hi: shidhe pu/ wa shaṃ ma ra ya phaṭa: las bzhi lhun gyis grub par gyur cig: brgya stong khri 'bum la sogs brjod las bzhi grub pa'i dmigs pa skyongs de nas 'dod don gsol ba ni ho: dbang

gas/: chen pad+ma bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal gyi lha tshogs khyed rnams la zhal zas bsreg blugs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba'i byin rlabs la brten nas bdag cag rnal 'byor sgrub pa po rnams kyi nad gdon 'jigs sogs zhi zhing stong pa dang: tshe bsod dpal 'byor nyams rtogs yon tan rgyas pa dang: khams gsum srid gsum mos bzhi dbang du 'du ba dang: gnod byed dgra bgegs rdul du brlag pa la sogs 'phrin las rab 'byams thams cad thogs med yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod cig de nas bstod pa bya ba ni rgyas par gzhung ltar bya ba'o bsdu na 'di nyid kho nas 'thus hūṃ ༷ chenabargyad dregs pa yongs kyi gtsug na spa: bdud dpung dam sri dran pa tsam gyis 'thar: gtum drag bzod par dka' ba'i gzi mdangs can: dbang chen rta skad bzhad la phyag 'tshal bstod: de nas chos skyongs gsol mchod dang bskang tshogs rgya cher 'bul bar bya slar yang gtang rag mchod pa ni sa badz+ra rta bu la ye swā hā zhes so rtsi 'bul snye wasta ye swā hā: zhes gos zu 'bul hūṃ nyi yeshes ting nge 'dzan las byung ba yi: phyi nang gsang mchod sman gtor rak+ta rnams 'dod

yon lha mos dgyes stobs gar dang bcas: dbang chen bdud dpung zil gnon lha la 'bul skyi ma hā pañtsa sarba byu dza shā: de nas gshegs skyems 'bul ba ni hūṃ hrī 'bru yi mar dang rtsimar 'byung ba'i bcud: dbang chen dgyes bskang zag med ye shes rdzas: 'phrin las mdzad pa mthar phyin yon du 'bul: gtang rag bzhes la rang bzhin gnas su gshegs rtsa sngags mthar pañtsa a dṛ ta kha hi: nyer gcig brjod la dgyes pa bskangs de nas bstod pa gong ltar bya bzod gsol nyes sgrib bshags pa ni ho: dbang chen bdud dpung zil gnon lha tshogasadagongs: bdag ni ma rig rmongs shing ting 'dzin g.yel: lhag chad 'gal 'khrul nongs pa gang song yang: snying nas 'gyod sems drag pos bshags bgyi'o: mi sgrib tshang pamachog gi dngos grub stsol: sa ma yā a yig brgya lan gsum bzlas te lhag chad bskangs de nas bsdu rim bya ba ni ho: nā nga chen ye shes ngang las rang byung ba'i dbang chen pad+ma gsung gi lhatshogs rnams 'phrin las rab 'byams mdzad pa mthar phyin pas: da ni rang gnas bde ba chen por dengs: ca yis ye shes pa chos kyi dbyings su gshegs dam tshig pa rang gi thugs gar

btsa/: bsdu'o de nas bsngo ba smon lam ni ho dus gsum bsags pa'i rnam dkar dge tshogs kun: gcig tu bsdus te ma gyur 'gro la bsngo: phyam gcig gdod ma'i ye gzhir byang chub phyir: kun khyab dgongs pa'i 'khor ba dong sprugs bya'o: lan gsum de nas shas brjod ni na mo byin rlabs mchog stsol rig 'dzin bla ma dang: dngos grub char 'debs yi dam rgyud sde'i la bar chad kun sel gnas gsum mkha' 'gro ste rtsa gsum dam can rgya mtsho'i bkra shis sgo ga: 'bar ba las kyis mtshan ma'i bud shing kun: ye shes bde ba chen po'i klong du bsregs: mkha' khyab yid can kun bzang dgongs par sbyor: 'bar ba me yi 'khor lo'i bkra shis shog: gawa yang shis brjod bsngo smon bya des ni 'phrin las rab 'byams 'grub bar chad bdud kyi g.yul las rgyal don gnyis lhun grub the tshom med sa ma yu ye ma rgyal ba' dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i ma 'ongs 'gro la shin tu brtse sems kyis thugs kyi thig le zab gsang rdorasnying bskor grub pa'i dbang phyug 'brog ban khyod las gtad da dung spel ba'i dus la ma babs pas rin chen brda la bstamasashags ra bye mdo khams bkra shis rdzong der dgongs pra sdoms ma 'ongs snyigasam sum cu kha ral

dus nad mug mtshon chas gzeng pa lang pa'i tshe dbang chen bka' bab sprul pa'i skyesamachog dang 'phrad nas bstan pa rin chen 'dzin skyongs spel 'gro don 'phrin las byang gi phyogs su rgyas gdul zhing ma lus pad+ma 'od du 'god bka' 'di srungasashig gnod sbyin yang le ber dam nyams lag tu ma shor thub par srungs sa ma mā las bzhi'i sreg blugs 'phrin las lhun grub rdzogasaso gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyislob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha pa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda tham dzi zhes pa 'di'ang lung zan chos kyi bdag po pad+ma dga' ba'i rdo rjesabakra shis dge ba'i rdzasadu ma dang bcasabaskul ngor kho bo dbang chen dgyes pa'i rdo rjes mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i 'phrul brda las dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni chos bdag nyid kyis bgyis pa'o sarba maṅga le/

badz+ra: zab gsang rdo rje snying po las dbang chen bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal gyi 'phrin las sgrub skor las chog yid bzhin nor bu them med zab pa'i gnad byang bzhugs a:na mo pad+ma kro ta h+ya skṛ wa ya:'a bsgrirte) mibazad bde ba'i sku mchog rab g.yos pa pad+ma 'bum sprin 'byel ba'i rdo rje la dbang gi 'phrin las mdzad pa bsam mi khyab bde chen 'khor lo' rgyan du rtag par mchod snyigs ma lnga bdo'i semasacan dug lnga rags dmag 'khrug mtshon las bya ba mi dger brtson gsang sngags log par spyod cing ma rung ba thams cad bdud dang srin po dam srir 'gyur legs pa'i dpal 'phrog nyes pa sna dgu rtsom sgrub la bar gcod chos mdzad sku tshe 'phrog sems can bde skyid dpal 'byor nyams par byed nad du mdze rags bco brgyad ma nges slongs gdon du gdol ba nag po nges par ldang de tshe lha gzhan stobs kyis mi 'dul bas pa d+ma dab chen las kyi da por shar dam tshig de bas 'di nyid srog gtar zungs sgrub pa zab mo nyin mtshan dus drug brtson dbang chen pad+ma'i tang 'dzin 'gyur med skyongs dug gsum gdon tshogs 'dul ba'i gshed po ra 'byung sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gsang sngags rdzas bral dngos grub mi 'byung bas gzhung las bshad pa'i yo byad sa rnams bsags phyi nang gsang ba' dam rgya nan du bcad sgrub pa las kyi

gzhung 'dir 'jug pa ra bya sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya hū hrī chos rnams ma gyes de bzhin nyid kyi klong:phyogs ris bral ba'i snying rjes yongs su gang:zung 'jug rtsal mdangs rig pa hū dmar po:ye shes me yi 'od zer 'bar bar shar de las eX yiḥram̐ḥs kernyireḥ'aphros:srid pa 'dag byed 'byung lnga lhun gyis grub: dpal dang dur khrod 'jigs rngams bkod pa rdzogs: rang bzhin srog yig las 'phros bheḥdamar po:yongs gyur pad+ma dbang gi gzhal med khang:sgo gru rta babs mtshan nyid phun tshogs dbus: rin chen zur brgyad pad zla nyi ma'i khar: klu bdud gdol ba nag po bsnol ba'i steng:rig pa hrīḥyig yongs gyur he ru ga: pad+ma dbang chen nā ga gdon 'dul ni:sku mdog spug nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa: zhal gdengs ljags 'dril rno dkar mche ba gtsigs: ha ha hū phaṭaḥdrag po'i gad rgyang sgrogs dur khrod dpal chas dpa' ba'i rtags su bgo: rus rgyan sbrul chun sna tshogs mdzes par spras: g.yas gnyis 'bar ba'i me dang lcags kyu phyar gasku na gnyis sbrul zhags thod dbyug gdon la gdengs: tha ma'i phyag gnyis khyung nag dur phag

'a tshu bsdams:zhabs rnams bsgrad pas klu gdon pho mo gnon:bskal ba'i me rlung dug sprin 'tshubs dbus 'byang:spyogatsug rta zhal drag pos 'dul glu sgogs las byed pho nya nyi ma'i zer bzhin 'byug:phyi rim gnam lcags 'khor lo rtsibs bcu'i khar:ma rungs klu gdon pho mo bsnol ba'i steng:shāḥyig dmar nag re re yongs gyuraba'i shar stod khro bo chen po/ ka ra:mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis phur ba 'dril:shar rtsibs khro bornam par rgyal ba ni:sku mdog dkar gsal rdo rje zhags pa 'dzin lho rtsibs khro bog na rjeligashod po ni:ser nag ral gri dang ni bhan khrag 'dzin:nub rtsibs khro bochags pa'i rdo dze+eni dmar nag zo chen sbrul zhags dam du bsdams:byangadu khro bobadud rtsi'abyel ba ni:ljang ser rgya gram dang ni dril bu 'dzin:shar lhorabyug sngan mazeng nag me rlung 'dzin:lho nubamigayo dmar nag rdor dril 'dzin nub byanga'adod rgyal smrag nag thod bum 'dzin byang sharakhams gsum rnam rgyal mda' gzhu 'gengs nub rmadab bas chen rdo rje sdig pa gdengs:kun kyang sku smad gnam lcags dbal

phur ni: 'byung po klu bdud pho mo'i snying khar zug: me rlung dud sprin 'tshubs ma rab tu g.yo: rngams brjid 'jigs rung rdo rje srin por bskyed: de yi phyi rim las mdzad sgo bzhi ni dkar ser dmar ljang khro rgyal 'jigs pa'i sku: 'big byed chen pos chu yi bum pa thogs: 'thag byed chen pos 'byung ba sa thun thogs sreg byed chen pos me yi 'khor lo'adzin: gtor byed chen pos rlung gi zhags pa bsdams: kun kyang mi lpags sbrul chun mgo 'phreng spras: dud sprin 'tshubs dbus rdo rje gar gyis 'gro: de rgyab dregs pa sde bcu 'jigs pa'i sku: klu gdon pho mo 'dul ba'i gshed du shar: kun gyi thugs srog rdo rje'i sa bon las: 'od 'phros 'og min pad+ma brtsegs pa nas: dbang chen khro rgyal rta mgrin bzhad pa'i gar: ma rung rū tra dug gsum gdon 'dul phyir sgrub mchog mos ngor ngom la gzi byin phobs rmongs pa klu gdon 'dul phyir bzhugs su gsol mtshan bcas gdon 'dul gar la phyag bgyi'o: dug lnga rang grol 'dod yon ro mnyam gyi: dga' ston mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol: ma rtog log rtog phyogs rtog gnyis 'dzin can

badz+ra kun kyi gshed por shar la bdag bstod do: thugs srog hrīḥl snying po 'bru drug 'khor: bzlas pa'i sngags phreng 'od kyis don gnyis byas: 'byung po ziganon gdon tshogs tshar bcad dmigs: snang srid pad+ma dbang gi rol bar blta: hrīḥha ha phole hūṃ phaṭa: bye ba bzlas pas me lce'i 'od zer 'phro nus mthu yon tan nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam gdon 'byung po thams cad nye mi nus bden rdzun lag tu longs dang nges shes gsal sa ma yu thun skabs sha chen dud btang zhun me sbar rol mo sgrogs shi gtor skyems brngan phul te hūṃ dza: dmar nag zla gam eklong dkyil nas: klu gdon pho mo zil gyis gnon mdzad pa dbang gi rgyal po pad+ma he ru ga: khro bo 'chol ba'i sprul ba g.yog 'khor bcas: thugs dam bskul lo dbyings bed bzhengs shig: brgyan pa'i mchod gtor dam pa 'di bzhes la: klu gdon pho mos byad gtad bcing pa khrol: mdze rigs bco brgyad dreg dang grum bu bzlog: drag sngags rdopa 'bum rdzogs 'brin las sgrubs: btsod kyi dbal chu las kyi mtha' skyongs shig: 'phrin las dus la bab po sa ma yā: rab 'bar khro bo hūṃ dkar rgyal po yi las byed spru

ba'i gar bcas 'dir bzhengs la:dam rdzas brgyan pa'i mchod gtor rab bzhes natha:klu gdon pho mos byad gtad bcing pa khrol:mdze rigs bco brgyad dreg dang grum bu bzlog:drag sngags nus pa 'bum rdzogs 'phrin las sgrubs:btsod kyi dbal chu las kyi mtha' skyongs shig:'brin las dus la bab po sa ma yā:rab 'bar khro bo hūṃ dkar rgyal po yi:las byed sprul ba'i gar bcas 'dir bzhengs la:dam rdzas brgyan pa'i mchod gtor rab bzhes nas:'jigs byed khro bo rnam par rgyal ba yi:sprul pa rdo rje mtshon cha'i thog zer 'khrigs:dam tshig gsang ba las kyi dal 'dir gshegs:dam rdzas brgyan pa'i mchod gtor rab bzhes la klu gdon pho mos byad gtad bcing pa khrol:mdze rigs bco brgyad dreg dang grum bu bzlog:drag sngags nus pa 'bum rdzogs 'phrin las sgrubs:btsod kyi dbal chu las kyi mtha' skyongs shig:'phrin las dus la bab po sa ma yā:rab 'bar khro bo gshin rje'i gshed po yang:las byed pho nyas bu yug 'tshubs bzhin du:dam tshig gsang ba'i gnas 'dir da bzhengs la:brgyan pa'i mchod

ba:tshu gtor dam pa 'di bzhes nas: klu gdon pho mos byad gtad bcing pa khrol: mdze rigs bco brgyad dreg dang grum bu bzlog:drag sngags nus pa 'bumardzogs 'phrin las sgrubs btsod kyi dbal chu las kyi mtha' skyongs shig 'phrin las dus la bab po sa ma yu:rab 'bar khro bo hūṃ dkar rgyal po yi las byed sprul ba'i garabacas 'dir bzhengs la dam rdzas brgyan pa'i mchod gtor rab bzhes nas:chags pa'i rdo rje dbang gi rgyal po yang dam tshig las kyi pho nya 'tshubs bzhin du: gsang babasgrub ba'i gnas 'dir da bzhengs la brgyan palimachod gtor dam pa rab bzhes nas:klu gdon pho mos byad gtad bcing pa khrol:mdze rigs bco brgyad dreg dang grum bubazlog:drag sngags nus pa 'bum rdzogs 'phrin las sgrubs:btsod kyi dbal chu las kyi mtha' skyongs shig:'phrin las dus la bab po sa ma yā: rab 'bar khro bo hūṃ dkarargyal po yi: las byed sprul ba'i gar bcas 'dir bzhengs la:dam rdzas brgyan pa'i mchod gtor rab bzhes nas:zel gnon khro chen bdud rtsi 'khyil ba yang:las byed pho

nya'i bu yug 'tshubs bzhin du:khyad par rmad byung sgrub pa'i da la 'dir:ye shes sgyu ma'i gar chen rab gapos te:brgyan pa'i mchod gtor dam pa 'di bzhes la:klu gdon pho mos byad gtad bcing pa khrol mdze rigs bco brgyad dreg dang grum bu bzlog drag sngags nus pa 'bum rdzogs 'phrin las sgrubs:btsod kyi dbal chu las kyi mtha' skyongs shig:'phrin las dus la bab po sa ma yā:rab 'bar khro bo hūṃ dkar rgyal po yi:las byed sprul ba'i gar bcas 'dir bzhengs la:dam rdzas brgyan pa'i mchod gtor rab bzhes nas:stobs mchog 'dus pa dbyug sngon rgyal po yang:rdo rje'i khro tshogs ging gi 'khor dang bcas:gsang ba mchog gi gnas 'dir da bzhengs la:brgyan pa'i mchod gtor dam pa rab bzhes la:klu gdon pho mos byad gtad bcing pa khrol:mdze rigs bco brgyad dreg dang grum bu bzlog drag sngags nus pa 'bum rdzogs 'phrin las sgrubs:btsod kyi dbal chu las kyi mtha' skyongs shig 'brin las dus la bab po sa ma yā:marngon spyod las mdzad mi g.yo mgon po yang:rdo rje phra men laṅka'i tshogs dang bcas dam

badz+ra tshig chen po'i gnas 'dir da bzhengs la: brgyan pa'i mchod gtor dam pa 'di bzhes nas: klu gdon pho mos byad gtad bcing pa khrol: mdze rigs bco brgyad dreg dang grum bu bzlog: drag sngags nus pa 'bum rdzogs 'phrin las sgrubs: btsod kyi dbal chu las kyi mtha' skyongs shig 'phrin las dus la bab po sa ma yā: rab 'bar khro bo hūṃ dkar rgyal po yi: las byed sprul ba'i gar bcas 'dir bzhengs la: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i mchod gtor rab bzhes nas: 'phrin las stobs myur 'dod pa'i rgyal po yang las mdzad sprul pa pho nya sa ya 'bum: thogs med stobs bskyed gnas 'dir da bzhengs shig brgyan pa'i mchod gtor dam pa 'di bzhes la: klu gdon pho mos byad gtad bcing pa khrol: mdze rigs bco brgyad dreg dang grum bu bzlog drag sngags nus pa 'bum rdzogs 'phrin las sgrubs: btsod kyi dbal chu las kyi mtha' skyo sa shig 'phrin las dus la bab po sa ma yā rab 'bar khro bo hūṃ dkar rgyal po yi: las byed sprul ba'i gar bcas 'dir bzhengs la: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i mchod gtor rab bzhes

nas: thogs med las myurakhams gsum rnam par rgyal:sha za srin po ro lang tshogs dang bcas: sgrub pa mchog gi gnas 'dir da bzhengs la: brgyan pa'i mchod gtor dam pa 'di bzhes nas: klu gdon pho mos byad gtad bcing pa khrol mdze rigs bco brgyad dreg dang grum bu bzlog: drag sngags nus pa 'bum rdzogs 'phrin las sgrubs btsod kyi dbal chu las kyi mtha' skyongs shig 'phrin las dus la bab po sa ma yā: rab 'bar khro bo hūṃ dkar rgyal po yi: las byed sprul ba'i gar bcas 'dir bzhengs la: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i mchod gtor rab bzhes nas: ma rig du trabasgral ba'i dpa' rtags can: 'byung po klu 'dul stobs chen rgyal po yang: rdzu 'phrul thogs pa med pa'i 'dir spyon la: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i mchod gtor rab bzhes nas: klu gdon pho mos byad gtad bcing pa khrol: mdze rigs bco brgyad dreg dang grum bu bzlog: drag sngags nus pa 'bum rdzogs 'phrin las sgrabs: btsod kyi dbal chu las kyi mtha' smongs shig: 'phrin las dus la bab po sa ma yā: rab 'bar khro bo hūṃ dkar rgyal po yi: las byed spral

badz+ra ba'i gar bcas 'dir bzhengs la dam rdzas brgyan pa'i mchod gtor rab bzhes nas phyogs bzhi'i gdon 'dul dug gsum 'byung po'i gshed:'phrin las bzhi sgrub khro rgyal sgo ba bzhi:dam tshig gsang ba'i gnas 'dir da bzhengs la brgyan pa'i mchod gtor dam pa rab bzhes nas:klu gdon pho mos byad gtad bcing pa khrol:mdze rigs bco brgyad dreg dang grum bu bzlog:drag sngags nus pa 'bum rdzogs 'phrin las sgrubs:btsod kyi dbal chu las kyi mtha' skyongs shig:'phrin las dus labab po sa ma yā phyogs mtshams steng 'og bcu ru dbang bsgyur bas:sangs rgyas bstan bsrub sems can phan bde spel rnal 'byor grogs mdzad dregs pa sde bcu po:rang rang sprul ba g.yog bcas da tshur byon:brgyan pa'i mchod gtor dam pa 'di bzhes la klu gdon pho mos byad gtad bcing pa khrol:mdze rigs bco brgyad dreg dang grum bu bzlog:drag sngags nus pa 'bum rdzogs 'phrin las sgrabs:bcod kyi dbal chu las kyi mtha' skyongs shig:'phrin las dus la bab po sa ma yā:gtor skyems 'bul zhing bden pa

bdar bzlas pa sngags kyis gzir ba ni 61 nā ga du na tsarnye tsarnye mi li mi li sarba bhi ṣa ta ra phaṭa swā hā 'ad ni rab 'bar las kyi sngags nus mthu yon tan bsam mi khyab sa ma yu yin dz+wa la ro ram̐ a dṛta kuṣ+ṭa li rba dz+wa la ram̐ ram̐:swā hā: 'di ni 'bar ba chen po'i sngags rdzas la nus pa phun tshogs bskyed yin me do kha ru ram̐ dz+wa la dz+wa la kha ṭaṃ kha ṭaṃ re bha ti s+t+waṃ: 'di na 'khrugs byed chen po' sngags gang ladamigs kyang khol bar 'gyur skyid kho thegab 31ba baṃ dul dul swā hā: 'di ni gnon byed chen po ste tsha ba'i nus pa tshar gcod 'gyur sa ma wā dmags pa las dang 'debs kha dang phyag rgya bca' thabs gzhan las shes ye ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis snying da 'dra ba'i yang zab med byung ba pa d+ma dbang chen sgrub phran yan lag bcas skal ldan rig pa 'dzan pa'i dpal du bstan da dung spel ba'i dusal ma bab pas rin chen bdo la thob cig gar bye mdo khams bkra shis rdzong der dgongs pra sdoms ma 'ongs snyigs ma nad mtshon gzeng lang tshe rgyal ba mchog dbyangs mi yi rdzu ru pheb dbang chen bshad pa'i rdo rje zhes bya 'byung skyes bu de dang gdams pa 'di 'phrad nas tha rgod lcags kyi yul gru 'dul bar shog bka' gsang srungs shig btsan rgod yang le ber dam nyams lag tu ma shor gnyan rgya'o sa ma pā rgya rgya rgya sgrub phran gya cho ga them med kyi ram

btsa/ pa rdzogs so gter rgya gto rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa' bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda tham snyi ces pa 'da'angasku skyesadam papa d+ma'i mtshan can gyis bkra shis dge ba'i skyes du mar bcas te ya yang bskul ro ra/gothorgya mtshogabazhad pa rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i 'phrul brda las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa 'i ya ge pa ni chos bdag nyid kyisabagyis pa dge legs 'phel/sarba masgo lo/

badz+ra: zab gsang rdo rje snying po las pad+ma dbang chen rol pa'i 'brin las kyi skor: drag po'i me gtad spu gri'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba bzhugs so:a na ma pad+ma kro dha h+ya ṣ+ṭṛ wa ya: sgodza/rna/ mchag shi bde ba sbyin mdzad cing nyon mo sa gdon tshogs 'thar mdzad pa 'a pad+ma dbang chen dkyil 'khor la mthon mthang ral pas btud de 'dud maro na spyod drag po' las byed pa'i sgrol ba'i zag rdzas lhag ma rnams drag po'i me gtad 'dir bstab na bag chags 'khrul rgyun gcod nus so sa ma yu deyang blang chung dang shing bya bcag brdu byas pa 'i tshal ba dang shog ling dum gcod chalabar gtub pa rnams 'bru nag dang bsres te byin gyis brlabs pa ni re ye kho: badrarags rdzas rnams dgra bgegs dam sri bsgral ba'i phung khams skye mched las byung ba: zag med ye shes kyibadud rtsir byin gyis brlabs te lha tshogs dgyes pa bskang ba'i mchod rdzas phun sum tshogs par gyur: sngags drug dang phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlabs drag po' shi ga tam la me sbyar ba ni yi re badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐: ye shes kyi me dmar nag mtshon cha'i tshwa tshwa 'phro ba: drag po'i gzi mdangs dang ldan pa: dpa' brjid bzod par dka' ba'i klong du: dregs pa bdud bzhi

bsnol steng nyi zla'i khar: stsadamar me yi tsha tshwa 'phro ba can yongs su gyur pa las dpal khro bo'i rgyal podabang chen steru ga: sku mdog dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyanagasum dmar zlum sdang mig tu g.yo ba: zhal gdengs ljags 'dril rno dkar gyi mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa: smra smin las me yi tsha tshwa 'phro zhing dmar ser ral pa'i gseb tu rta mgoljang nag bzhad pa'i sgra g.yo ba: 'jigs rung srin po khros pa'i gzugs can dur khrod dpa' chas kyis mdzes par klubs pa: phyag mtshan gri thod 'dzin cing ma rdo dzophag modang 'khril sbyor mdzad pa sprul pa'i khro tshogs nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par 'gyed cing dam sri dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i las la bskyed do: dbang chen phab tham mnyamapar rol ba'i zhabs rnams gyad thabs su bsgrad pas bdud bzhi zil gyis gnon pa: de lta bu'i thugs srog sa bon las 'od zer 'phros dbang chen pad+ma rol ba'i dkyil 'khor nas ye shes pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs nas bstim mo: rol mo'i sgras bskul la spyan 'dren pa na hūṃ nyi dbubakamatha' med pa bde chen zla gam 1nga: 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro

bsgo/: rtag tu nye ba'i gnas ma rung rū tra bsgral ba'i khri steng nas dbang gi rgyal po pad+ma he ru ga: rjes chags bshad pa'i rtsal snang 'khor dang bcas: mngon spyod drag po'i las la da bzhengs shig: drag pome yi las 'dir gshegs su gsol: dam tshig rten dang gnyis su med par bzhugs: bde chen gar dgu'i 'khyud la phyag 'tshal lo:du tra bsgral ba'i dbang lnga'i me tog dang sha chen dud spos zhun gyi mar me dang: mkhris pa'i dri chab sha rus zhal zas dpal: rkang gling thod rnga 'bul lo bzhes su gsol: mahā byu dza sa ma ya ho: sreg dzos 'bul ba na hūṃhrīḥ nyon mongs las las skyes pa'i ma rig pa: dug lnga dug gsum rnam rtog 'khrul ba'i gdon: ye shes rang mdangs mtshon chas rab bsgral te: pad+ma dbang chen khros pa'i zhal du bstabs: dgra bgegs 'phar sdang med par bcol lo bzhes: rtsa sngags mthar dṛ tri a mu ga'i mi sa rak+ta tsit+ta la kha kha khā hi khā hi brgya rtsa la sogs gang 'os su bskyar nas phul lo 'dod gsol gdab pa ni snangasrida'ajig rten gyi khams thams cad pad+ma dbang chen gsung gi dkyil 'khor du rig ste: gnyis snang bdud

bgegs dam sri 'byung po thams cad zhal du bstabs pas gzas pa po mgo mjug log ste rkang mthil skya lhag gis rol de las ngan 'khrul ba'i rgyun chad par bsam mo: yongasardzogs phul rjes bstod pa ni hū hrīḥ sku yi dkyil 'khor dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar: bzhad skad sgra yis dregs pa las la gcun: skye med dgongs pas yid chos ar la gtad dbang chen gsung gi rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod bzod gsol ni ho: ye nas bde chen dbang gi dkyil 'khor la: ma rig 'khrul ba'i gdon tshogs mi dmigs phyir: sbyor dang sgrol ba'i tha snyad spros bral kyang: kun rdzob sgyu ma tsam du byas pas nongs: gnyis 'dzin sems kyi dri ma bshags bgyi'o: yag brgya bzla bsdu rim mi hū —8 ye shes me yi dkyil 'khor chen po ru phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor gsal ba dang bcas pa: da ni mngon spyod lhun gyis grub lags pas: rang bzhin rnam dag bde chen dbyings su gshegs: badz+ra mu ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor dbyings su bsdu snyigs ma' thal sol rnams lam rgya gram gyi dkyil du bcol ba'am klu bdud ma rung ba la gtad du bcol bar bya'o de ltar mngon spyod las byas pas sgrub la 'tshe ba'i dam sri bgegs

ba tshu zab gsang rdo rje snying po las dbang chen bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal gyi klu 'dul dbal chu'i las kyi rdzas sbyor 'jigs med pha lam gzhom med rdo rje'i bo cha bzhugs: a: na ཿ pad+ma kro dha rā dza ya:tsamathazatheg(15 sa 'og 'byung po dbang bsgyur zal gnon pa'i khro chen rgya sto wa la phyag 'tshal snyigs ma'i sem sa can klu gnyan gdon gyisazin 'phral rkyen rgud pa bsal ba'i man ngag ñtsa rta mgrin btsod sbyor dbal chu'i las sbyor da kha bskang cha lag rdzasakyi sbyor ba bstan sa ma yā del bcas bsas med pa 'i ra du da sa yi dwa sa ma rin chen gser dang ni chu yi dwangs ma mtshal dkar dri bral da me yi dwangs ma rdo sol ngar ldan dang rlung gi dwangs ma ga bur dkar nag da nam mkha'i dwa sa ma be+eḍūr+ya dang ni rdzas rnams bsdus te dar tshon sna lngas dril rin chen zangs kyi ga'u'i nang dugazhugs de nyid ra du nang bcud btsod snyi gzhug me yi gza' skar dar dus bya ba brtsams sra ba bzang drug ra btab dzos sbyor la me lcags bug ral skyon dang bral ba sgrub pad+ma rā ga'i me rdo nus ldan btsal bya ba brtsamadus 'di ltar che ba brjod e ma ho: thabs kyi rang bzhin me lngags dbang chen yab: shes rab rang bzhin me rngo phag mo mam: zung 'jag rtsal las kra 'dal sras mchog shar: reg

bya nus ldan gang la phog tshad kun: nyon mongs gcong 'byin bde ba mchog tu gyur: nyi maḥre41 ra ṇa phaṭa: saṃ ha ra ṇa nyu: nā ga phe le hūṃ phaṭa: zhes brjod la tsher nag dang mda' shing sadag tsher gsum gyi sol ba'i nang du me tsha bca'o yang glag sgro leb mor bstar ba lag tu thogs te 'di skad do hūṃ ja bde stong zung 'jug dbang chen yab yum dal: gnyis med mnyam pa nyid du dbang bskur ba'i: rdzas mchog khyung rigs sgro yi rlung g.yab 'dis: gdul bya'i mthun snang bde legs dpal 'phel zhing: mi mthun nyes pa'i tshogs rnams bsregs pa'i phyir:bsil ldan rlung lha 'gro ba'i don du bskul: ye ku ru phyo phyo ye swā hā: zhes brjod la phyogs bzhi nas rlung g.yab po de nas rin po che zangs kyi sgod skyon da bral bas lu gsum gyi chu sna bsdus te 'di skad do kye ho: 'byung ba lnga ni ye nas rdzogs sangs rgyas: dbyings kyi yum chen lnga ru mngon byang chub: ma mā ki ni bde ba chen po'i gzhi: don dam 'gyur med mkha' dbyings dag pa las: bkra shis mi zad chu yi rgyun bzang po gdul bya'i mthun snang spel phyir stsal du gsol bo sa ra dza maṅga le ma hā sirnyi sa ma ya a la la ho: zhes brjod la chu rgyun dal bar dbab te

gtsa(4 snod bkang ngo de nas bdug rdzas bsags pa ni glang dmar gyi rwa pha ga ga tshil te lo'i sha rta bon mu zi 'dre 'jigs pa gcan gzan gyi sder mo de rnams bsdus la zhib tu btags nas mdzo dug gi rwa nang bye gzhug la sngags 'di btab po shes nā ga du na tsarnye tsadhe mi li mi li sarba bi ṣa ta ra phaṭa phaṭa: ci rigs brjod la byin gyis brlabs de nas srung rdzas gdag 'dod na gla nag rtsi dang sha kun mu zi byiba'i tshil phyi nag sder mo 'dre 'jigs pa de rnams gza' skar drag po'i dus su bsdum la gcan gzan gyi snyang shun nang du gzhug cang mtshan ldan ma'i lca los bci nas sngags 'di' byin gyis brlabs te mgul du 'chang na nad gdon rams yams thams cad kyis mi tshug go sa ma yu sngags na dz+wa la dz+wa la phaṭa: yaka nag po phaṭa: pra dun tshal pa phaṭa: sarba dz+wa ra phaṭa: tsi tsi sarba ta phaṭa: nag po nā ga rā dza phaṭa: nganasngags 'bum gyi rgyal po la dab phyug chen po'aphaṭa drug gdag gang la btab kyang don de 'grub rgol ba ngan pa kun thub 'gyur ya mtshan rno nus bsam mtha' yas bden rdzun lag tu longs da gsal sa ma yā de nasasngags pa bshad pa ni d+ma rak+ta sirnya ra kha dog dmar po rdo bral ba nus ldan lce la ro yod pa sgyu 'grul dben pa'i gnas bzang sa thabs kyis btsal la ral bu bya bzang po drug da gla nag rtsi sbyar zhing sngags kyi dbang

bskur na nad rim kun la phan par bshad ma rung gdon rgod thams cad thub yon tan byin rlabs nus mthu che bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsal sa ma yu de nas bye ma gzi bskyed ni chu chen 'gram gyi bye ma de khyung gi phyagargyas blang bzhin par drag sngags 'di nyid brjod par bya skyid tso ra tso ra mu ra mu ra nā ga 'dus nag po sod shrī kā la rū pa hūṃ phaṭa: de nas tsher me bsregs pa'i khar lcags slang nang du bye ma blugs phag gi shatshil khrag gsum so gang 'dzom sbyar la nan du bsregs drag po' sngags rgod 'di nyid bzla skyirngo rte ga ru ṭa dug khyung tsa le tsa le hūṃ phaṭa: nā ga shag pa shag pa tshal pa tshal pa trig shag trig shag hūm̐ phaṭa: ca rigs brjod la nusapa bskyed gri lcags sbyar ba'i lcags sgod nang ma lag ma brgyud dam du 'cha bar bar sngags 'dis nus pa gso rte dug khyung tsa le tsa le nā ga ༷sko/ shag hūṃ phaṭa: smra bcad byas la cirags brjod sngags phu gdab nas gzi byin bskyed gang la btab kyang phan par 'gyur khyad par lhog pa tshar gcod 'gyur byin rlabs nus mthu bsam mi khyab sa ma mā de nas btsod sngags gdab pa ni dz+wa 05 dz+wa 'a kha ṭaṃ kha ṭaṃ ba la ba la hṝ ma hā dz+wa la ram̐ ram̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā: yang nus bskyed kyi sngags ni 31 lcags ka ra si si ting ting mel mel dz+wa la re re mā ra ya phaṭa: lcags ra bsdu ba ni 31 haṃ k+ṣ-i ka la

btsa( lcags zhun baṃ baṃ khaṃ khaṃ mul mul trig shag hūṃ phaṭa:khol sngags ni 3 dz+wa la dz+wa la dṛ tram̐ kun li sirnyi sirnyi sarba khaṃ ram̐ sirnyi pha lacan ā sa:nus pa ma 'dzom bar du bskyar de 'bras btsod kyi rig 'dzan thob dbal ra tsha ba me da 'dra stobs 'dzom gnam lcags zog las lhag bden rdzun lag tu longs da gsal sa ma yā de ltar rdzas kya sbyor ba la lhag chad skyon dang bral gyur na nus mthu nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam gzhung nas bshad pa' yon tan ldan yang cig sngags kyi rim pa rnams lhag chad bral bar sgra dag pa ra smra bcad dam tshig ldan pas bzla bug ral 'khyal tshig skyon bral na nus mthu ri yi rba kya bzlog rgya mtsho che yang sgem par nus byad phur zod gtong thams cad bsregs dgra bgegs 'byu po tshar gcod nus sa ma yu:ti 'dzin dgongs pa'i gnad ldan na pad+ma dbang chen rte ru ka nyid dang skal ba mnyam pa dang ma dang mkha' 'gro dbang du 'du chos skyong dam can grogs su byed nyon mongs 'khrul ba'i gdon tshogs 'dul he ru ka yi gnas la spyod 'du ba can gyi grogs da 'grogs 'phrin las nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam thob bcod dbal 'bar ba ro mtshar gnas grub rtags ya mtshan che bar 'byung bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsal sa ma yu ye ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pa d+ma saṃ sto was ma 'o sa 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis thugs kyi zig le yang zab med byung ba

zab pa'i man ngag bcas bstan 'gro'i don du las can khyod la gtad da dung spel ba'i dus la ma bab pas rin chen brda la thob cig sar bye mdo khams bkra shis rdzong der dgongs rgya sdoms ma 'ongs lang tshe gdon du klu sdang nad du mdze rags 'byu ar jag skun po 'go 'phang mtho ba'i dus rgyalamachog sprul pa nus ldan rdo rje dang gdams pa 'di 'phrad skye 'gro'i rgud pa sel gso bar mi btub zab gsang bstan pa yar ngos zla ltar 'phel chos rgyud 'dzin pa'i sku tshe mdzad 'phrin 'phel don gnyas lhun gyis grub par gdon mi za bka' 'di srungs shig gnod sbyin ya le ber dam nyamasalag tu thugs kyi sras sogs rnams dang 'phrad par sgo ga sa ma wā rgya rgya rgya man ngag rdzas kyi spyor ba shin tu zab pa' gnad rag rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa 'o brda tham lha zhes pa 'di' stu skye pad+ma bsod nams grub pa'i rdo rjes dri med ras gzan dkar po thabs shes mtshon pa 'i skyes du ma dang bde bar
btsa(: kyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel sarba maṅga la/

ba tshu zab gsang rdo rje snying po las:dbang chen bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal gyi 'phrin las mtha' brgyan skor lcags zhun btso lugs dug gsum gdon 'dul bzhugs so: a:na mo gu ru pad+mā ka ra ye:4khrin ma rung gdon gyisasbyor bas zin pa' tshe de la pha na phyar lcags zhun ma/dor bsdus bstan khro dkar dum bur a ru nag chung sbyar khro nag dum bu mu za nag po bsre zangs tshal la ni dkar po sman gcig sbyar 'om bu ba lu sur dkar mkhan pa dang gla nag rtsi sbyar zangs chen chu yis bka sngags dang sgrub pa zhi drag sna tshogs bya bzlas pa sngags kyis ngar 'dogs bya ba na stong pa'i ngang las mdun du lcags zhun gyi mtsho chen btsan dug gi ngad zer g.yo ba'i klong du:dur phag nag po dang lcags kya sdig pa:khyung dmar me yi tsha tshwa 'phro ba grangs med pa 'phro zhing:nyon mongs las skyes pa'i gdon tshogs thams cad bsregs gtub za zhing rdul du brlag nus pa'i 'phrin las dang ldan par dmigs la: h+ya sbyo wa ma hā kwa la nag po ti pa ra tsa phe khyi ma kā la rū pa hūṃ phaṭa:ra tsa bse mo yasmo shwa na mo be the'u dam sri 'byung po sarba tshal pa tshal pa:shag pa shag pa:dz+wa la pa ye asne ye re ram̐

drag sngags 'bar ba me ya 'bar lo 'di brgya stong la sogs skabs da bstun te brjod sa ma yu oṃ ya ma me ram̐ dz+wa la ram̐ pra dz+wa la ram̐: pra sod: chu sod: durta sod: durmi sod: gnyan mgo la chod: khal dza: thim tha ra ti sa durnye dz+wa la ram̐ bha ye swā hā: rab 'bar spu gri lta bu' sngags rgod 'di chu khol nus mthu rtags thon bar du bskyar skye tri chung mahā kā la pañtsa a dṛ ta kro dha rā dza tsadhe tsadhe: mi li mi li: sarba bhi ṣa ta ra hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa: dz+wa la re ram̐: yak+ka rasmo yasmo ra tsa be the dam sri thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa: dz+wa la re ram̐ hūṃ phaṭa: nus pa 'i mthu 'phel grub rtags 'byung 61 ma hā kwa la h+ya snyiwa nag po sod nag po sod: nā ga 'dus: nā ga 'dus ya ma me khrag sod 'dzer rkang srin bu sod: lhog pa spun dgu ram̐: gags 'bras srin la rbad: ci tsi hur thum sod gnyan sarla ta ram̐: me yi 'khor lo can hur thum sod: mje rigs bco brgyad skem rgya 'brum skrang lo skya bob dz+wa la ram̐ ram̐: karma ram̐ ram̐: mā ra ya rbad sod: nus pa 'bum rdzogs spu gri'i'akhor lo 'di drag tu bzlas pas nad gdon kun thub 'gyur las la sbyar tshe bden brjod 'di ltar bya na mo dasko na mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal ma : rig sngags gar gyi khro bo dang khro mo rnams phyag

ba tshu 'tshal lo: drag po lcags kyi mchu can spu gri'i 'khor lo ltar 'khyil ba la phyag 'tshal lo: 'ching ba po la srung du gsol bskyab tu gsol: kwa ya snya ya badz+ra tshidhe tshirnye swā hā: wāk+ka k+ṣa ya bhan+ta bhan+ta sarba a pa na ye swā hā: tsit+ta k+ta ya hūṃ ṣ+ṭṛ bhan+ta bhan+ta mo hā mo ha gha ta ye swā hā: tar+ya thā: sko a na le a na le kha sa me kha sa me: bhe re bhe re: so me so me shadhe shasdo dan+de dan+de: sarba bi ṣa ta ra phaṭa phaṭa swā hā: rlu hūṃ rdu bhan+ta bhan+ta swā hā: bsrung bya rnams pha rol pos byad du bcug pa thams cad shirnyi ku ru ye swā hā:ma āḥhūṃ yas thaX du rak+ṣa palataḥphuḥ:jigajethamaḥbh+yoḥdzaḥdza ༷ a shig shig phyung phyung khrol khrol swā hā: bsrung bya rnams dregs pa bco brgyad kyi rigs 'bangs 'khor du gtogs pa rnams kyis cho 'phrul ngan pa'i btab pas nad thams cad shirnyi ku ru ye swā hā: gdon thams cad shirnyi ku ru ye swā hā grib thams cad shirnyi ku ru ye swā hā: zhes sngags grangs lngan du brjod la lcags zhun gyi chu khol ma lus kya nad phya nang mngon pa rnams la byugs khong du gnas pa'i nad la btung gdon dzos la brab rnam rtog tu gyur ba'i yul gdon gya gnas gzhi kun la 'bebs par bya'o khyad pa ra du lhog pa 'a

sa mig dang klu gam gdug pa can gyi gnas la bawa na rtsad nas gcod cing drungasanas 'byen par 'gyur ro oṃ trig shag hūṃ phaṭa: tsit+ta rak+ṣa ma ma cisti hūṃ t+t+waṃ: ma pra dun badz+ra tsit+ta rak+ta: / badz+ra rak+ta:sngags 'di brjod bzhin par btsod chu lcags zhun khol ma gnas khang gtor bas mthu gartad ser gsum gyis mi tshugs yul la gtor bas bkra shis rnal 'byor bas sgrub kha) la gtor na bar chad mi 'byung sku khrus su gsol bas grib dang mi gtsang ma 'byung saphyogs la gtor bas rtsi shing lo ba da rgyas zhing la gtor bas shā bud ma 'byung zhing lo thog legs por rgyas ser ba 'byu ba'i lam la gtor bas thog ser bsrung bar 'gyur gzhan yang yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa yin no bden tshig brjod pa ni na mo: mchog gsum bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod rnams: bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams las: rtag tu thar zhing rgyal gyur cig dbang chen rta mgren bden stobs kyis: bdag cag dpon slob bsrung bya rnams: stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs rnams las: rtag tu rgyal zhing bkra shis shog dbang chen 'khor tshogs bden stobs kyis: bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas rnams: ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu las: rnam pa kun tu rgyal gyur

ba:tshu cig: bka' sdod dmus long dregs pa'i mthus: bdag cag dpon slob bsrung bya rnams steng 'og bar gyi gdon rnams las: rnam pa kun tu rgyal gyur cig: sangs rgyas rnams ni bdud las rgyal: chos ni chos ma yin las rgyal dge 'dun mu stegs pa las rgyal: nam mkha' lding ni klu las rgyal: me ni rtsa shing kun las rgyal:dbang chen du tra'i tshogs las rgyal: bden pa rgyal gyur rdzun ma lags bden tshig gang btab 'grub par shog: o dza ya dza ya bi dza ya bi dza ya na ma pa tu tu swā hā: me tog 'thor zhang shis pa brjod bden tshig chud ma za bar 'gyur sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya e ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis thugs kya thig le mkha' 'gro'i snyi khrag skor dbang chen rtsa ba 'dus pa 'i chos sde'i bcud phrin las mtha' brgyan btsod dbal cha tsha sa bcas grub pa 'a dbang phyug rgyal mtshog khyod la gtad da dung spel ba' dus la ma bab pas rin chen brda la bstims shag sa ra rdzu mdo khams bkra shis rdzong du dgongs bra sdoms ma 'o sa snyigs mar nad mtshon gzeng lang tshe grub pa' dbang phyug rgyal mtshog bshad pa dang gdams pa 'di 'phrad rgud pa sna tshogs sel bstan pa'i 'gro don byang ga phyogs su rgyas 'brel tshad don ldan pad+ma

'od du 'god bslu ba med do rdo rje pad+ma'i bka' thub par srungs shig btsan rgod yang le ber dam nyams lag tu ma shor mel rtses skyo sa thugs sras rig pa 'dzin pa'i dpal du sprod don gnyis yid bzhin 'byung ba'i rgyur gyuracag sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya man ngag lcags zhun bco lung zab gnad shan tu bsdus pa rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbasargya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya: o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzasabakod pa 'o brda thim snyi zhesapa 'di'ang rdo rje'i lung gi bsngags pa'i sog sprul rin po che pad+ma bsod nams yongs su rgyas pa'i sdes bkra shis dge ba'i skyes du mar bcas te nan dan chen pos bskul ba don dang ldan phyir 7kho bo rgyal mchog bshad pa rtsal gyisamakha' 'gro gsang ba'i 'phrul brda las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa' ya ge pa na snying slob shākya'i dge slong sa marnya bha dra ma ṇis bgyis pa dge'o/ dge'o/ dge'o/ legs so/ sarba ma le/

badz+ra: zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: dbang chen bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal gyi sreg sbyor gyisgrub pa las sngags kyi lde kha spu gri'i 'khor lo bzhugs so:a na 31 gu ru pad+ma kro dha h+ya skṛ wa ya: tshanarjesta/ mibazad khro zhing gtum pa dab gi sku pad+ma he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo sems can las kyis gzir ba' zug rngu kun bsal byed man ngag sngags kyi 'phrin las bstan sa ma rwa dang po nyes pa sel byed bzlas sngags ni snyen dhu na du ru dza ya mu khe swā hā: de nas mkha' 'gro'i 'khru ba tshar gcod sngags snyen spyo mtshal zhal rak+ka zhal mtshal hūṃ swā hā: de nas dregs pa 'dul byed sngags snyen shaṅka ra phe lang aḥyaX maḥduXnasatsaḥshaḥn0 dus phaṭa: ma ru sa 'byung po thams cad 'dul ba'i sngags snyen phe le hūṃ phaṭa: nad rnams ma lus sel bar byed pa'i sngags snyen thim tha ra ti sa durnye dz+wa la ram pa ye swā hā: mdze skran gags 'bras skran rigs brlag pa'i sngags snyen nā ga du na tsadhe tsarnye mi li mi li sarba bi ṣa ta ra phaṭa swā hā: dus kyi nad rims gdon sgod brlag pa'i sngags oṃ nā ga nag po sod: pañtsa ma sod: ha la dudzña sod sha hūṃ rbad sod: btsod dbal nus pa mchog tu bskyed pa 'i sngags oṃ dz+wa la re ram̐ pra dz+wa la pra dz+wa la baṃ khol khol ram̐ dz+wa la ram̐: bye ma nus bskyed

phun sum tshogs pa'i sngags o pra sod: chu sod durta sod durmi sod: gnyan mgo la chod: kha la dza: o zim tha ra ti pa durnye dz+wa la ram̐ pa ye swā hā rdo dkar mkhar rgong las kya sngags rgod ni oṃ rma bya khyung khyung bar zhus trig shag sar+sha ta sod: mdze khrag skem tor rkang sod nag po spun dgu ram̐ ram̐: ldum sogs rdzas la ngar 'dogs bya ba ni oṃ lhang lhang tser tser trig trig shag shag shel shel thum thum gas pur nan sod: sarba tsi tsi dz+wa la ram̐: gnyan mdze dreg grum bu lhog pa sgrang lo rgya 'brum gas rims nag po sum sbril sarba sha hūṃ hur thum dza mā ra ya rbad sod: lcagasangar dbang bsgyur sngags ni 'di lta ste a zhi zhi mal mal sarba shirnyi a pa na ye swā hā: chu tshan nus pa dbang bsgyur 'di lta ste 31 ka ri ka ri nā ga nag po sa ta dz+wa la pra dz+wa la swā hā: byad kha dbyings su bkrol ba'i sngags rgod ni ces nā ga rā tsa mal mal: 'gul 'gul: tsag tsag: gtubs gtub: khrol khrol: chom chom: bsrung bya sa bdag klu gnyan gyis bzung ba thongs bcing pa khrol cig: phyung phyung: btsod kyas sgo gsum bkru tshe 'di skad brjod oṃ pra sod: chu sod: durta sod: durmi sod: gnyan mgo la chod: kha la dza: sa thim tha ra ti

cu'i bgegs rnams 'dul bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams thub 'go ba'i yams rigs kun las rgyal gag stog mdze la sleb chog yin grang chu bsngags nas cha bar bta tsha chu bsngags nas gra bar btang chang la btang na dugathab sel 'dre 'jigs la btab rgyal gdon thub byi ba' tshal sbyar 'go yams srung tag tar sbyar bta mkhris pa thub dza ti la btab rlung nad sel lhum rtsar btab btang sha ma thon tsha la btab btang rtsa chu grol spra b.rabatab sbyar khrag chod nges khyung khra'i byer btab klu nad thub 'di yi yon tan bsam mtha' yas bzlas chog rdo rje'i go khrab dang nad brgya 'joms pa'i sngags rgod yin gdon brgya thub pa'i thog zer can khrag 'thung kun gyi lasasngags ste rnal 'byor mthu 'dod mos gus can sngags 'di rin chen srog gtar 'chong gcag brgyud las ni 'chor mi rung rin chen srog las btsa' shes kyis bsdam spel mkhas pa'i dam tshag zungs sa ma rwa chagam rgyal ba' dbang po pad+ma sa bha was ma 'ongasa'agro la brtse ba chen po yis thugs kya thig le zab gsang rdor snying skor shin tu bcud bsdus rta mchog myur bde'i lam ma tshogs mkha' 'gro'i bkur rta byed pa'i gnas dam can yongs kyibla rdo lta bu 'di grub pa'i dbang phyug rgyal ba mchog dbyangasad rje 'bangs bcu gsum dgyes sde mo la gtad da dung ma spel rin chen brda la bstems mdo khams bkra shis rdzong du dgongs rgya sdoms gter bdag bzang phyir klu

btsaX bdud btsan la gnyer ma 'ongs snyigs mar nad mtshon gzeng lang skabs mtha' bzhi'i dmag tshogs dbus su 'byung ba'i tshe rgyal mchog sprul pa nus ldan rdo rje 'byung skyes bu de dang gdams pa 'di'aphrad nas bstan pa 'i 'gro don bya — nas bya phyogs byed 'brel tshad don ldan rig 'dzin zhing du 'god de bar bka' 'di srungs shig btsan rgod rgyal dam nyams lag tu ma shor thub par srungs skal bzang pad tshal 'phel rgyasa'abrin las mdzod sa ma pā rgya rgya rgya zab gnad sngags kyi lde kha rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brdathim khyu zhes pa 'di'angasang zeno spul pa' sku mchog pad+ma bsod nams grub pa'i rdo rjes bkra shis lha regs bde bar gshegs pa 'a sku gsung thugs rten dra bral ras gzan dkar po/ gos bzang gser gyi kha dog 'char ba'iskyes bcas 'bad rtsol go ma'i rnam thar lta bu' don gnyer bcas bskul ro ra 7 kha ba dbang chen gsu gi rdo rje rgyal mchog bzhad pa rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro gas ba'i brda mdzod las zhal bshus te dag pa ra phabapa'i yi ge pa ni rang slob sa man+ta bha dra ma ḍis brgyas pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba ma la/

badz+ra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las dbang chen bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal gyi 'phrin las bye ma nus bskyed 'bar ba spu gri'i 'khor lo bzhugs a: na 37 gu ru kro dha rgya skṛ wa ye: rtsan/zung/35 rmi bzad bde ba'i sku mchog he ru ka dbang gi rgyal po de la phyag bgyi'o 'gro ba gti mug gdon gyis gzir ba'i tshe rta mchog sreg sgrub btsod kyi las 'di bya sa ma mā bye ma lcags sreg sbyor ba bshad zin ltar dza gad lan tshwa sbyar ba byugs nas su ngar 'dogs bya ba 'di skad gyer bar bya ste/nga pa'i ngang las khro yig yongs su gyur pa las rdzas de khyung dkar po mu med par gyur nas rgyal rigs klu gnyan gtod sogs dregs pa lha dang dri za'i tshogs rnams tshar gcod nus par dmigs la: 67 badz+ra che ga ru ṭa tsa le tsa le hūṃ phaṭa: skyid lhang lhang tser tser: trig trig: shag shag: shel shel hūṃ sum̐: gas pur nan sa bdag klu gnyan gtod sogs kyis bzung pa thongs: bcing pa khrol cig swā hā: ci 'grub brjod la lha rnams dbyeramed bsre gang dmags gdon brlag nus ldan gyur bar bsam sa ma yu de nas dza gad mu za sbyar ba de bye mar myos nas ngar 'dogs bya ba ni che nga pa'i ngang las khro sku ngas su gyur pa las: rdzas de rje rigs
